tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sgrol dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i 'don 'grig ni/tshig bdun lan gsum dang /gsol 'debs rnam gsum/bsang chu byin rlabs/mchod rdzas byin rlabs/spos byung sgroladamar gsol 'debs/skyabs yul bskyed pa/skyabs sems sogs maṇ+ḍal mjug bar/tshogs zhing bsdu ba/dkar gtor byin rlabs/ sngon gtor 'bul ba/ bgegs gtor byin rlabs/bka' bgo nas srung mjugaye rdzogs bgegs sum/ byin bskul/byin 'bebs/mchod rdzas byin rlabs/ti 'dzin rnam gsum nas lha bskyed kyi/sa ler gsal gyi bar/dbang bskur rgyas gdab/lha bskyed kyi kun gyi thugs srog sogasabastims:lhan thabs kyi spyan 'dren bskul/gzhung gi spyan 'dren nas mchod mjug bar shad phud bya/sman mchod bstod pa/'dzab/'phreng ba byin rlabs/'dod gsol lhag chad bskang/mchod stod/dge ba 'di yis 'di ltar bskyed rdzogs bshags pa/rdzas bskang/tshogs bsdus ci 'grub/rje btsun bla ma sa twa ci 'grub/yig brgya/ho/dam tshig nyams chags sogasanam mkha'i mthar thug

sogs/tshogs byin rlabs nas tshogs phud mjug bar/bskang rdzas byin rlabs/dgyes bskang/bshags pa/tshogs 'gugs/bsgral ba/bstabs pa/gnam phud/drangs ba/bsam lhun dang sgrol ma che chung skabs bstun/pad+ma tā re'i dkyil 'khor sogs yang na ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sogs shogalhag ma byin rlabs/lhag mjug tu tshogs mchod phul bas sogasashogabashags chung 'don/rmang sri bkar/khrus chab gsol/bsang che chung ci rigs skabs bstun bya/mdun bskyed kyi mjug gi g.yang 'bod che chung ci rigs/bzlas dmigs bsnyen pa ci 'grub/g.yang blan rten bzhugs mchod bstod bsngo ba shis brjod sogs bya gter sgrub bsnyen skabs la sprod/gsol kha skabs bstun bya de nas dga' ston tshogs mchod gong bzhin bya/ bskul ba byin rlabs bskul ba chad brtan byin rlabs chad brtan 'phen bro 'gugs bro mnan mchod dmigs mchod pa bstod dmigs bstod pa/lha mo rnams sogs bzod gsol bsngo smon rten bzhugs bsnga

༄༅// ldang bkra shis ci rigs grol dus kyi bya ba la gong gi mchod bstod bsdus pa dang maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma dngos grub len hrī: 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs sogs mchod bstod rgyas pa g.yang 'gugs ci rigs brjod phye mar logs rim bzhin gtad g.yang blan bstan bzhugs smon lam shis brjod sogs so/༄7// sgol dmar sgrub gtor bca' thabs ni/ 'bru kheb steng gdan zla gam sum brtsegs snying thig ltar chos 'byung bsnol ma rin chen zur brgyad nyi zla bcas kyi gdan la nor bu gdong drug gi phyogs bzhir pad 'dab dang/ mtshams bzhir pad gtsab bya/ spug ma'i 'ja' khyim nyis rim bya/ mtha' bskor du rtag brgyad/sna bdun/ rdzas brgyad sogs 'dod rdzas rnams bkod/ phye mar ni mar gyi gdan bang rim bzhi'i steng zlum po/ de steng cog zlum 'dra ba la mar rgyan nyi zla nor bu dang/ nam

mkhar khyung gis brgyan/ g.yas su 'dod 'jo'i ba dang g.yon du dang gi lu gu/ gzhan g.yang zhags 'khyil ba/ bzang drug bsres pa'i dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ bkra shis rdzas rtags sna bdun g.yang rgye gter bum mda' dar spos mar me tshogs kyi yo byad sogs tshang bar bya/bsham bkod ni rtsa gsum gtor ma rgyas bsdus gang rung dang sgrub gtor sman gtor sogs bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed la bum pa g.yang rgye g.yang zhags 'khyil ba phye mar bkra shis rdzas rtags sna bdun no rgyun gtor la dkar bgegs 'gong bkar tshogs chad brtan sngags srung ma sogs gsol mchod skabs dang bstun/ mchod pa stong bzhi sogs tshogs bsagasad sbrel dge'o sarba maṅga la/

stanazu dag snang lasaḥ sngon gtor 'bul ba phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so tram̐ju na mo pad+ma tā re ye: ma daje'i rang nyid lha ya nga ya gyis dkar skyems gtor ma sbya sa bsgyur spel kyi: sngon che rdo rje 'chang chen pa bar du o rgyan pad+ma 'byung tha ma rig 'dzin brgyud pa yi spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'iX pho mo ma ning dregs pa'i tshogasaḥ kun kyang rdo rje'i tha tshig bzhinaḥ sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs dam rdzas dkar skyems mchod pa bzhesaX khyod la phrin las bcol ba niḥ skal ldan rnal 'byor bdag nyid kyisaX rje bcun pad+ma tā re yiḥ gsang gsum dkyil 'khor sgrub pa laḥnye bar 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs ming gi lhag mar mdzad du gsol mthun snang legs tshogs char ltar phobaḥ rnam bzhi'i phrin las gang 'dod donaX thogs med rtsol zhig dam tshig can0 ces badz+ra dharma pā la k+ṣe ṭa pā la ma ka pā la sarba ba lidha kha kha khā hi khā hi0 lan bdun gyis phul gtor skyems mchod sgrub pa mthar phyin gegs med 'grubaḥ sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda
thimaḥsnyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin gan kirta bskur ngor/ kho bo nu na 'dusapa rtsal gyisadag pa ra phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma le/

sa (byezu dag snang lasaḥ 'phags ma'i gsol 'debs gzhan phan nyi ma bzhugs soX ༷ ju sapradzā tshe na mo abyu tā re yaḥ gang sku mthong bas chags sogs nyon mongs skemasaḥ gsung gas thos pas sgra mtshan rang sar grolaḥ dran pas bde stong klong yangs rtogaru/ pa bskyedaX ma cig bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debasaX yid 'dod re skong bsam 'phel dpal mnga' zhing 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i gru bo cheḥ ma rig mun pa sem ba'i sgron me mchog 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig 'phags mar gsol ba byams dang brtse bas gdul bya bu bzhin skyongaḥ btang snyoms chen pos ris med yongs la gzigasaḥ brgal dka' srid pa'i g.yul las bsgral mdzad pa'iX rje btsun thugs rje'i dbang mor gsol ba 'debasaḥ ngo bo skye rmed dbying las ma g.yos bzhinaḥ rang bzhin lhun grub bde chen dpal ster zhing0 thugs rje chags bral kun la snyoms pa'i zhalaX rje btsun pad+ma tā rer gsol ba 'debasaḥ de ltar gsol btab 'jigs brgyad dbyi sa su zhi

tshe bsod dpal yon yar ngos zla ltar 'phel gzung 'dzin mtshan ma ka dag dbyings su sangs klong chen mkha' 'gro'i gsang gsum mngon gyur shog de ltar gsol btab 'phral rkyen zha legs tshogasadapal pon dngosapo rgyas 'phags ma'i bsang gsum mngon gyur te mi ldog mkha' spyod mngon du 'gyur sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim lhaḥ zhes pa 'di'ang lung zinatha brta'i bgo skal du gyur ba nyid /kho bo nusaldan 'dus pa rtsal gyisamakha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod lasabasgyur de dag par phab pa'i yig ge pa ni chos bdag nyid do sarba masgo le/

sko྾gra྾zugu34zlor+yā྾7྾ཿzu r+shagadibhasamāyamongakaḥdīren+d+rapa 〉jiphyagasnyir+sādha.atiṣ+ṭhabṛdwaṇabihar dag snang sgyu r+sāl rol ba lasaḥsgol dmar dbang gi rgyal mo' zab sgrab byin rlabs dpal sder bzhags soḥ

// na mo pad+ma tā re ye phyogarteskyeche mo bde ba kun gyi mthar son cing ye shes gzigs pa ngomasal 'dud mos ldan las can bsgo skal du myur lam 'phagasama'i zab sgrub bstanaḥ sa ma māḥdepang yar 15//pang po la phun tshogs 'phrod sbyor 'dzom pa' nyinaḥ dben gan bkra shis skyid tshal du phyin la sabaslang dam rgya sdom maṇ+ḍal mda' gang zla gam bya sgrub gtor pad+ma spung pa las gter bum dum gcig kwa pā lar lnga tshan lnga dang 'bru snas gtams 'phags ma' sku rten srog 'khor gzhugs dar sna lnga yis na bza' gsol gzungs thag sna lngas rgya ching gdab rnam lnga nyer spyod mdzes par bkrams bde ba'i stan la bag phab nas bskyed rdzogs sgrub pa'i las gzhung bsrangasaḥ sa ma yuḥ 'ad la sbyor dngos rjes dang gsumaḥ dang po rim pa brgyad kyi bstanaḥ thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni na re chags chenags rdul (1na ka nas dag: bde chen ye shes 'bar ba'i gzhi 'phags ma dbang gi rgyal mo la rang rig rjen pas skyabs su mchi: gnyas pa sems bskyed na ho gzhi dbyings ka dag chos kyi sku: gzhi snang lhun grub longs spyod rdzogasaḥ gzhi rtsal thugs rje zang ma thal: mngon sum rtogs phyir 'phags ma sgom: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa ni na mo: rgyal ba kun yum 'phags ma la: mtha' bral lta

//ju ba'i phyag bgyi'o: gang shar rang grol rgyan mchod 'bul: mu bzhi sems kyi 'dzin stangs bshagasaḥ dus gsum mnyam bdal rjes yi rang: zang thal ye she byedro 'khor bskul 'gyur med rdo rje'i klong du bzhugasaX dge rtsa 'khor gsum dag par bsngoḥ 'gro kun rang rig mngon gyur shog: bzhi pa mas ni treḥ chos dbyings maṇ+ḍal rgya tshad bral: 'od gsal maṇ+ḍal kun gsal ngang sgyu 'phrul maṇ+ḍal nam mkha' mdzod 'phags ma'i gsang gsum dgyes phyir 'bulaḥ bdag bzhan tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs shingaḥ gnas lugs rtogs pa mngon gyur shog: badz+ra maṇ+ḍal pū dza āḥhūṃX lnga pa bka' bsgo ni ka hrīḥ snang ba bde chen dbang gi klongaX srid pa 'phags ma'i sku gsung thugasaX 'di na ma rtog nga bdag gdon ro mnyam rdo rjes dbyings su bskradaḥ drug pa srung lor ni hūṃ hrīḥ rang byung don gyi dkyil 'khor 'dir: thams cad ye shes lnga yis gtamasaX gzung 'dzin gdon gyis glags mi rnyedaX kun zlum rdo rje'i rwa gur dkrigs bdun pa byin 'bebs ni teḥ skye 'gag 'byur ba med pa'i klong: gting gsal bde ba chen po nas ma bcos

zang thal 'phags ma yumaḥ gshegs bzhugs spros pa bral mod kyang: gdul bya'i re smon skong ba'i phyir dbang bskur byin phob rtog pa spor: hūṃḥ pad+ma tā re sa ma ya phiX brgyad pa mchod sa byin brlabs ni tsho āmi/༷ sna tshogs ma 'dres bkod pa kun: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin du: ting 'dzan rdo rje'i rol ston bsgyur 'phags ma'i gsang gsum rgyan du spro ces badz+ra spra ra ṇa dzaḥ de dag sngon 'gro'i ram pa'o sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gnyis pa dngos bzhi sgom pa ni rnam grangs bcu gcig sgo nas bstan da po tang 'dzin rnam gsum ni āḥ 11 'das dza sa sku de bzhin nyidaḥ so ma rang grol kun tu snang: 'gag med rgyu yi sa bon rtaḥ skye 'chi bar do stong phyir sgom: sa aXhūṃ badz+ra sa ma dhi hūṃ gnyis pa rten dang brten pa bskyed pa ni hrī blo bral de yi ngang nyid las yum chen lnga yis mkha' klong du: bde chen dbang gi zhing bkod ni: ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus: ye shes rang mdangs gzhal med khangaḥ brda don rtags bkod rdzogs pa'i dbus: dbang gi 'od khyim g.yo ba'i klong chags bral pad zla nyi ma'i kharaX hūṃ7)ga las byung 'phags ma ni0 bde stong rab 'bar rā ga'i mdangs:

//de/ — zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum bzhad g.yo:phyag g.yas pad+ma'i lcags kyu 'dzin:'gro rnams dbang du sdud par byed:g.yon pa gter gyi bum pa bsnams )spra la daro sa grub char ltar 'bebs:longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rgyan rnams 'changaX'agro rnams thugs rjes 'dul bar mdzad:zhabs gnyis sems ma'i skyil krubhe bzhugs0 snang stong ma 'dres sa ler shar:sku gsum lhun rdzogs ngang tshul can rtsa khams gnas yul he ru ga'i0 dpa' bo mkha' 'gros dgyes ston spro rigs bdag snang mtha' tshe dpag med bcu gsum rgyan rdzogs tshe bum 'dzin:snang stong ma 'dres sa ler gsal:kun gyi thugs sgog sa bon dang:rdo rje'i snying po 'bru gsum las:'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas:'phags ma'i rnam pa ra spyan drangs bstimasaḥgasum pa spyan 'dren na twe skye med 'od gsal thig le'i klong:'gag med bde ba chen po las rgyal ba kun yum tā re maḥtshur gshegs bde stong zhal bzang ro masaX dbang bskur rtogs pa mngon gyur zhing:gdod ma'i grol sar byang chub mdzod:a abyu tā re dzñā na mu drwa sa ma ya dza dzaX bzhi pa

bzhugs gsol naḥ trīḥ dam tshog rten gyi dkyil 'khor la: ye shes dbyings nas drangs ba'i lha: gnyis med bde ba chen por bsre: dam ye gnyis med zung 'jug bzhugs: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhanaX lnga pa phyag 'tshal ni na mo ma bcos rig pa stong gsal las: lhun grub mtshan dpe'i skur snang baḥ 'dod rgu'i dpal ster tā re la ngo mtshar lta ba'i phyag bgyi'o: na mo na ma 〉ཿ drug pa mchod 'bul ni hūṃ trīḥ nga bdag mtshan 'dzin ka dag nasaḥ gzung ba dag pa'i nyer spyod bdunaX dug lnga cer grol 'dod yon lngaḥ khams gsum dbyings sgrol sman gtor rakāḥ rgyu lnga gnas stong bsgral mchod dang: chags med bde sbyor byang chub sems chos nyid ye mnyam lta ba'i 1nga snang srid rdo rje'i 'phrul chen po gang shar rang grol mchod sprin gyisaḥ rje btsun 'phags ma'i dgyes pa bskangs rtogs pa mngon gyur dngos grub dang bsod nams gter chen rtsal du gsol: o pad+ma arnya twa re ma hwa pu dza khā hi bdun pa bstod pa ni hūṃ hriḥ ma chags rā ga'i gzi 'od 'khyagaḥ ye shes gzigs pas gdul bya smong: chags bral bde stong dpal sprin pa'i 'phags ma

// yum la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ pad+ma'i lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis gdul zhing 'gro blo dbang du sdud: yid bzhin gter gyi bum pa yisaX dgos 'dod stsol la phyag /shārlo bstod: mkhyen nus brtse ba'i dpal mnga' ba'iḥ zhabs gnyis sems ma'i phyed skyil bzhugasaḥ gang 'dul mdzad chen rab ston pa'iḥ bcu gsum rgyan rdzogs yum la bstod: ngo bo mnyam nyid chos sku lasaḥ rang bzhin ma 'dres ye shes sku: sgyu 'phrul mkha' 'gro bsam mtha' yasaḥ spro bsdu'i rgyal mor phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ 'chi med tshe la mnga' brnyes byir rigs bdag 'od snang mtha' yas niḥ longs sku'i rgyan rdzogs ma 'dres sharaḥ dbang chen gsung gi rdo rjer bstod bdag lus rdul rted grangs sprul nasaḥngag gis gdung dbyangs glu dang bcas: sems ni dad brgya'i zer 'bar bas: 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ brgyad pa bshags pa niḥhoḥ gsang dang 'dzin pa'i 'ching rgya yis 'phags ma'i gsang gsum zhal ma mjalaḥ da ni shes rab chen po yis sgrib tshogs chos kyi dbyings su bshagasaḥ badz+ra sa ma yā āḥ dgu pa 'dzab dmigs mi hrīX rang nyid

'phags ma'i thugs ka 2tsho dmar gsal pad+ma'i ze 'bru'i kharaX dbyangs gsal nyi zla kha spyor sbubasaḥ rig pa rtaḥl sngags kyis bskoraḥ bzlas pas tshe bsod nyams rtogs 'baraḥ brtan g.yo'i dpal bcud thob par dmigasaX tsos pad+ma tā re sarba sidhi hrīḥ 'byu 'bum bzlas pas nyams rtogs 'phel tshe bsod dpal 'byor ma 'a thang rgyasaḥs ma wāḥbacu pa sgrub 'dzab niḥhrīXrang srog sngags kyi 'od zer niḥ lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag med sprosaḥ lha 'dre mi yi tshe bsod namasaḥ dpal 'byer dngos po ma lus paḥ bdag gi dbang du 'du bar dmigasaḥ skyog pad+ma tā re sarba a dṛ tri ā raX ya bsdus bsdus pa shaṃ ku ru hūṃ ༷ bye ba bzlas pa sa 'jig rten da jig rten las 'das dpal 'byor thob sa ma yu bcu gcig las sbyor bablos dmags ni hrīḥ bdag gi thugs ga'i sngags phreng lasaḥ 'od zer dpag yas khams su sprosaḥ ra gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags 'jigs tshogs zhiḥ tshe bsod dpal 'byor yon tan rgyas thams cad bde ba chen por dbang sdang zhen rtog dang dgra bgegs rnamasaḥ mngon spyod drag pos tshar gcod cing phrin las rab 'byams rgya

// mtsho kunaḥ thogs med yid bzhin grub par dmigs pad+ma tā re sarba shirnyi puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya pāṭa swā snya sum 'bum bzlas pa sa phran las kunaḥzogs med yad bapho (11 rwar 'gyuraḥ sa ma yāḥdangos bzhi'i las rim tshang ba'oḥ sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la rnam gra sa bcu gsum sgo nas bstan da po bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs dum gcig snod du bsags byas te bsangs sbyangs bsgyur spel bya ba niḥ hrīX dga' ston tshogs kyi longs spyod laḥ mtshan mar 'dzin pa re ye khoX zag med ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyuraX 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod du spel snyed āḥshāX gnyis pa tshogs zhang spyan 'dren ni rtaḥ mi dmigs bde ba chen po'i klong zla gam dbang gi gzhal yas nasaX bde chen mchog stsol 'phags ma yumaḥ ye shes sgyu 'phrul gar dang bcasaḥ dga' ston tshogs kyi 'du ba la dgyes brtses gzigs pa'i gar bcas gshegs ro mnyam bde chen dpal ston stobasaX yin artswa ta redzña na mu tā sa ma ya dza dza gsum pa tshogs phud ni sa āḥ&X longs spyod chogs kyi 'khor lo niX 'dod yon ro mnyam dga' bde'i sprinaX gnyis med 'phags ma yum la 'bulaX 'ub chub bde

ba chen por bzhesaḥ ma ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hiḥ bzha pa bar bshags niḥ hoḥ mu bzhir gol ba'i nongs pa yisaX lha dang dkyil 'khor zhal ma mjal0 sor byang sngags kyi sdom la 'gal gang yang mi 'chab tshogs kyis bshags ga ṇa tsakra sa ma ya bi shudhe āḥ lnga pa tshogs bsgral ni nyu trīḥ nga bdag mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i bdudaX tshogs chen ye shes stobs su bsgralaḥ ma rig 'khrul ba ka dag nasaḥ bde stong klong yangs mngon gyur shogaḥ sarba rā tra ma ra ya ha la ha la phaṭaḥ drug pa bstab mchod niḥ shā trī0 bdag rtog mtshan ma bsgral ba yiX dbang yul phung khams skye mched kunaX mnyam nyid 'phags ma'i dgongs klong stobasaḥ 'khrul 'khor gzhi la sangs bar mdzodaX sarba rū tra me sa rak+ta tsit+ta la kha re khā hiḥ bdun pa tshogs la rol ba niḥ e ma ho rin thang med la legs 'ong chosaḥ myong grol sngags kyi dga' ston 'diḥ mnyam pa nyid du rol par byaX mtshan 'dzin rtogs pa dbyings su gzhig0 a la la ho bam pa lhag ma ni phe chos nyid stong pa'i gsang srog canaḥ thogs med dam tshig las la rgyaḥ rnam 'phrul rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung cir yang

rge|— skyabs yul bskyed pa na skyabs yul mdun gyi nam mkhar pad sdong kharaḥ zhi bsil rta bdun ri bong 'dzin pa'i kharaḥ yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'dzin grub rgyal mo:gangs la nyi 'khyud mtshan dpe'i 'od stong 'khyud: gzigs pa bdun ldan rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs longs sku'i chas rdzogs 'ja' 'od gur khyims phubaX dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyi rdul 'khrigs ltar rdzogasaḥ mkhyen brtse'i gzigs pa skal ldan bu la ngoms 'di phyi'i phan bde dngos grub kun stsol dmigs: skyabs sems tshogs bsags maṇ+ḍal 'bul dzaḥ/ baṃ hoX tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim pas gnyis su med par gyuraḥ rol mo byin rlabs niḥ hrī kun bzang thugs kyi rdo rje mtshan ma bral: skye 'gags 'gyur ba med pa dril bu'i sgra: dpa' bo yab yum 'bod pa'i ḍā ma ru thabs kyi rnga chen shes rab rol mo'i sgra: rdo rje glu ma 'byugs ma 'gyur ma zungasaḥ ting tija shag dang pi waṃ phag rdob paḥ kha grags bshud pa la sogs rol mo'i rigs: rgyal ba'i dgyes sprin 'phags ma'i dal du 'bul: bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs phyir bzhesaḥ tho badz+ra ghan+de dharma shabha

〉ཿ zab chos 'od gsal thugs thig las 'phags ma'i nyams len la brtson tshe sngon gtor 'bul ba phrin las lhun grub bzhugs soḥX/— da na ma gu ru padha ka ra ya: 21tshurnam rang nyid snyang rje'i dbang phyug gsal gtor ma dkar dmar bas sa sbya sa spel yad kyis nam mkha' mdzod du spel lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas mgron rnams bkug rkyeX stong gsum 'jig rten khams la dbang mdzad pa'iḥ sa yi lha mo sa 'dzin lto 'bye dngaḥ lo zla zhag dus dab mdzad tsang kun sogasaḥ gangs dkar nyer gcig srid pa'i la dgu dang ma 'a ri skor gsum dbu gtsang ru bzhi dngaX mdo khams rgang drug skyong ma'i dregs pa canaX pho rgyud mo rgyud ma ning rigs gtogs pa'i gtso 'khor bran 'bangs sprul pa g.yog dang bcasaḥ 'der gshegs dkar dmar gtor ma ja chang skyemasaX gzhes la sgrub pa'i rkyen bzlog mthun snang sbyor legs tshogs dpal spel nyes 'gyed dgra bgegs sgrolaḥ bstan pa srung la sems can phan bde spelaḥ gang bcol brin las stsol cig sa ma yāḥ ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegs sgrub pa gegs med mthar phyin

'gyuraḥ sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang snga sor ma khrol ba phyis su rten 'brel phun sum tshogasaskabs/ bdag 'dra nus ldan pasadag par phab pa' yi ge pa nitshosobadag ga zhwa sa bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo le/

// zab chos 'od gsal thugs thig lasaḥ 'phags ma'i byin 'bebs dpag bsam rgyas pa bzhugs soḥ//ju na mo gu bye padh+wa ka ra yeḥ gagoshāka sbyor spos dud btang rol mo sgrogs snyan 'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad do hrīḥ ya pho ༷ spros mtha' bral ba dbyangs kyi klongaḥ sku gsum lhun grub bde chen mdzod: sgyu 'phrul ye shes gsang ba'i dal phrin las mdzad phrin bsam mtha' yasaḥ gting gsal don gyi 'og min nasaḥ rje btsun yad bzhin 'khor lo maḥ tshe dang ye shes dpag med paX rang gdangs ma 'gags 'khor dang bcasaḥ dad pa'i mos ngor sa ma dzaX snang ba dag chen zhing khams dngaḥ srid pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nas byin chen phob la dbang skur cigaX ye shes bkod rdzogs gzhal yas khangaḥ bkod pa rab rdzogs da la rba gnas khang bkod mdzes dkyil 'khor 'dir byin chen phob la dbang skur cigaḥ rnal 'byor gdan gsum lha yi dpalaḥ rtog pa klong chen ye shes ngangaḥ sgo gsum rdo rje gsum ldan duḥ byin chen phob la dbang skur cag gzung

dang 'dzin pa'i 'phrang sgrol nasaḥ khams gsum sku gsung thugs su chubaḥ don grub chos sku'i rgyal sa na ka dag kun bzang mngon gyur nas byin rlabs byin chen dbab tu gsol rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po stonaX dngos grub ma g.yel char ltar phob rtogs pa mngon gyur dbang skur cig o tā retut+ta re tu re ma ma pukhye a yudzñā na sarba badz+ra a we ro/ ya 65 aḥ de ltar byin dbab rtogs pa rgyas dab dang dngos thub thob par nges chos kyi snying khu ma nyams pa' gdam pa 'od gsal thugs thag 'ad skal dman rnams la bstan mi rung thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shogaḥ sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥ brda' thimaḥdzizhes pa'ang snga sor gsang gnad gab pa phyas su rten 'brel phun sum 'tshogs tshe kho bonus ldan rdo rjesadag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos bdagakwarma /rtis bgya pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

gli mchod rdzas byin rlabs naḥ.āḥ stango pa ches dgyings brgyan gyur lha rdzas sprin phyi nang gsang mchod sman raka bā lirnyiḥ dngos bshams yid sprul ting nge 'dzin gyi byedadroX rje btsun 'phags ma'i gsang gsum bskang phyir spelaḥyin badz+ra byu dza spra ra ṇa dzaḥ 'di yang nus ldan rdo rjes so/hūṃ hūṃ saḥmakha' spyod mkha' 'gre'o lngarang nas spyan drangs ba'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis bdag gnas yo byad sgrub rdzas rnams la byin chen dbab cing dbang chen bskur bar bsam mo/ nus ldan pas so/zwa byin bskul ni rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul te/ 'og min mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i gling nas tshe 'dzin grub pa'i rgyal mo'aphags ma yid bshin 'khor lo'i thugs brgyud bskul/ dgongs pa'i klong nas thugs rje'i brtsal mdangs bskul te sgrub mchog byin gyis brlabs phyir sku phyag rgya 'ja' 'od lam lamaḥ gsung bde stong bdud rtsi'i sbrang char sil silaḥ thugs mkhyen brtse'i gzigs pa'i 'od stong 'bar bzhin skal ldan sgrub pa po gnas khang dam rdzas thams cad la byin chen dbab cing

dbang chen bskur bar bsam la byin dbab po ཿ bsgrangs phreng byin brlabs ni sarba dharma ā phreng ba rnam mi dmigs pa'i ngang las rang snang dag pa 'od gsal kyi bkod pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ḍāk+ki'i tshogs su gyur de yang dpa' bos bro 'khrabaḥ dpa' mo'i gar bsgyur rdo rje rnal 'byor pho mo bde stong spros pa dang bral ba'i dgongs spyod la snyoms par zhugs ci rnam mangs phrin las rab 'byams lhun gyis grub par mos la/ dbyangs gsal rten snying dang/ yin ru rtser marna pra badhe na ye swā hāX ci ma brjod la rab tu gnas shing me tog 'thor dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni /0 rang lus bde ba chen po'i gnas: rtsa khams zig le zhal sbyor bsaḥ spros pas dkar dmar dga' ba 'khrul mkha' spyod dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bskulaX rdo rje spyod pa la gnas pa'iX rnal 'byor yab yum rol bar byonaX dga' bzhi'i 'od gsal dbang bzhi'i rgyunaḥ skal ldan tshangs pa'i bu gar brtsal snying dbus gtsug pa'i ga'ur simaX khu rdul rjang sems zag zad nasaX dngas ma'i he ru gar gyur mos0 a hūṃ swā e hwa ṭ+wāṃ swe me:bye rta a we sha ya a āḥphyag rgyas yeshes nyid kyi

༷/ gzisaḥ sa chu sha khrag sku rdo rjeX me rlung drod dbugs gsung rdo rjeḥ mkha' sems rnam dag thugs rdo rje: sgyu lus bde mchog rgyas gdab poḥ kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ rang srog dam tshig lcags kyu yisaḥ lha dang snang ba gnyis med paraḥ phyag rgyas ye shes nyid du sad bde ba mchog gi rdo rjer gyuraX sa ma yā pheḥ e a ra li hrī dzaḥ 'di yang nus ldan rdo rjes soḥX/— tshogs bsgral spro na hūṃ shā0 'khor 'dasamed la yod par bltasaḥ nga dang bdag tu bzung ba'i 'dreḥ srid pa'i rtsa ba rlung sems 'diḥ bdag med yul med chos skur bsgralaḥ sarba rū tra pra be sha ya phaṭaḥ bstabs pa na hūṃ trīḥ 'khrul ba'i sems can snying re rjeḥ ma rtogs 'khor ba'i rdzun mtsha sa stongaḥ khams gsum chos sku'i dgongs kongs bsngabasaX srid gsum ka nas dag par mdzod me saraku tsatā kha ram̐ kha nyi bsu bzlog 'dod na pheni mkha' sgod sa spod la gnas pa 'i dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor maḥ

'di byon dga' ston tshogs la rol ma dang mkha' 'gro'i sun ma bzlogaX bla ma'i sku tshe bstan pa dang mdzad brin bstan pa rgyas par mdzod grangs bsogs na byin rlabs che bsnyams ༷ ༷ni/ ṭ+wāṃ///nga sku zla ba'i dbang po laḥ nyin byed 'bum 'khyud bkrag mdangs 'baraḥ skye dgu'i ma rig skoms gdu sel yid bzhin 'khor lor mchod pa 'bulaḥ nu ldan
rgi zab chos 'od gsal thugs thi/zhwa snriphyi/phags ma yid zhin 'bor lo'i zab sgrub tshe bsring dpal bum zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ

rjo /— na mo ār+ya tā re a ma ra ṇa shrī yeḥcanazos/sgorngorab 'byamasargyal ba thams cad kyi phrin las gcig bsdus pad+ma 'byung bde za mkhor lo'i rgyan tu rol byin rlabs snying dbus pad+mor simaḥs ma yāḥlasacan sgrub la snya rus can gang gi bgo skal zab pa'i bcud 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo yi zab bcud tsha sring dpal bum bstan sa ma yāḥde yang dben gnas skyad mos tshalaḥ 'phrul glags col bral ba dang nyi zla 'char snga nub phyi zhang bsru bzhi'i ka ba ma chags pa rtsa bcud lo 'bras rab sbud tshal rgyun 'bab g.yas 'khyol shes nyams skyid0 gong ma'i zhabs bcag sar phyan nas dkar nag gnyis skyo sa gtor ma 'a brngan sa bslang skyen bsal phrin las bcol maṇ+ḍal khod snyoms mda' gang ba gru bzhi mdzas bkod yid 'ong khar bum pa thod chang gtor ma da shel rdo rnam lnga nyer spyod bkrams mda' dar tshogs gtor snang gsal sogs nye bar mkho ba'i chas kun bsags phyi nang dam rgya bcad byas nas zab mo'i las gzhung bsreng bar byaḥs ma yāḥsngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa'oḥrgya rgya rgya gu rgya de nas sgrub pa'i khog phub la rnam grangs nya shu rtsa lnga'i bstan dang po skyabs su 'gro ba niḥn mo bye med ka dag 'phags ma yumaḥ'agag bral longs sprod rdzogs sku'i tshulaḥm bcos rang grol rig pa'i gshisaḥmangon sum 'char bas skyabs su

rwa/ / mchiḥ gnyas pa sems bskyed rim pa na ho: sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su med: re dwogs 'phrang grol bde chen gshisaḥ kun bzang dgongs mnyam byang chub semasaḥ bskyed du med de ye yin ngang gsum pa tshogs bsags rim pa niḥ na moḥ sku gsum sang yangs 'phags ma'i zhalaḥ mngon sum lhug pa'i phyag 'tshal loḥ ro mnyam rdo rje'i mchod pa 'bulaX ma rig gnyis snang dri ma bshagasaḥ dus gsum ka dag rjes yi rangaḥ 'khor ba chos skur bsgral bar bskulaḥ zang thal 'pho med chen por gzhugasaḥ dge rtsa 'khor gsum dag par bsngoX phyam gcig kun bzang sa thob regag bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni treḥchos dbyings maṇ+ḍal rgya tshad bralaḥ 'od gsal maṇ+ḍal spros las 'das sgyu 'phrul maṇ+ḍal stong gsum bkodaḥ sku gsum 'phags ma'i dal du 'bulaḥngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i dalaḥ mngon sum rjen mthong dngos grub stsolaḥtrerat+na maṇ+ḍal pū dzi te aḥhūṃḥ lnga pa bgegs la bka' bsgo ba hri0 mtha' dbus mi dmigs chos sku'i zhingaX rnam rtog mtshan ma'i spros pa bral gnyas med rol pa chen pos brdalaX ye rag rdo rje'i drwa bas basmradaX

hūṃ hūṃ bisne ta krita phaṭa phaṭaḥ drug pa bsrung 'khor sgom pa naḥtrīḥ snang ba'i rang bzhin mtshan bral dbyingasaḥ 'khor ba mi dmigs chos kyi skuḥ du ma rang grol bde chen klong byang chub sems kyi bsrung gur dkrigs oṃ dzñā na rak+ta rak+ta t+t+waṃḥ bdun pa byin pho dbab pa niḥshā hrī ཿka dag dbyings lasathugs rje'i rtsalaX dag mnyam rol ba'i rlabs g.yos teḥ kun rdzob mtshan ma'i chos rnams kunaḥ ye dag dkyil 'khorje gsum byin phobaḥ brgyad pa mchod rdzas byin brlabs ni nyu trīḥ bshams pa'i phyi nang gsang mchod kunaḥ ye shes rol ba'i ting 'dzin gyisaḥ mtshan bral 'dzad med dbyings kyi rgyanaḥ kun bzang rol ba chen por gyuraḥ au badz+ra spra ra ṇa dzaḥ dgu pa ti 'dzan rnam gsum niḥ.āḥ chos sku ngo mtshar spros mtha' bralaḥlongs sku lhun grub rdzogs pa che: sprul sku rig pa rten 'byung hrī thabs shes zung 'jug dpal las byungaḥ ñtsa āḥshā badz+ra sa mā dhi (ཿ bcu pa rten da brten skyed naḥtrīḥ spro bsdumigazhi las 'phos pa yiḥ 'byung chen sa bon lngas bsted dalaḥ chos dbyings nam mkha' mtha' dbus bralaḥ bya grab rab brten rlang gzhu'i dbyibs mnyam nyid sa gzhi thog reg

shā/ /— dben ༷ dngas gsal yan lag brgyad ldan chuḥ sor rtog rab 'bar yo sa su 'khyilaḥ ngo mtshar shar grol mtshan med dpalaḥ rdo rje lha mo'i rtse gar bsgyuraḥbamil ldan khrus chab jing bu dang sman ljongs 'bras ldan ljon bzang tshalaX ku mud skyid tshal g.yu'i ne'u sengaḥ rat+na'i bye ma phyur bur bkramaX dpa' bo'i rang bzhin ri dwags brtseḥ dpa' mo'i rnam rol bya snyan 'tshogs rol ba chen po bkra shis rtagasaX mnyam pa nyid chub dge ba'i rdzasaḥ 'dod 'byung lhun rdzogs rgyal srid nor: zad med zhen bral gter bum dang: dgos rgu ster ba bsam 'phel mdzodaḥ shugs 'byung 'bad med dpag bsam shing dbyings la dbyings rdzogs 'ja' zer 'khrigs sna tshogs mi 'gag nam mkha' mdzod: rang snang bsam brjod yul las 'das ༷ bkod pa rab 'dzes de yis dbusaḥ dag gsal rat+na'i gzhal med khang: sgo 'khyud rta bab dbyibs rgyan mdzes:brda rtags bkod pa phun tshogs klong chu skyes ge sar 'dab rgyas kharaḥ thabs shes nyi zla zung 'jug stong: rang nyid 'phags ma tā re'i skuḥ yid bzhin 'khor lo dkar gsal

mdzesaḥbacu drug mdangs 'khyud tshul dgus brgyan:phyag g.yas pad sdong tshe dar bsnams:g.yon pasaphra thal tshe bum 'dzinaḥchos sku'i spyan gyis dbyings la gzigs sprul dang longs sku'i 'gugs sgol byedaḥshes rab kyis ni gsang ba rtogs:snying rjes gdul bya zin par byed:ye shes kyis ni chos nyid mkhyen sgol ma'i spyan gyis sa ler gsal:gzigs stangs yon tan bdun dang ldanaḥzhal 'dzum dgyes nyams brtse shugs 'baraX longs sku'i rgyan cha bcu gsum spras:zhabs gnyis phyed pa'i skyil krung bzhugs rigs bdag snang mtha' tshe dpag medaḥdamar gsal tshe mda' bum pa bsnams:blta ba'i mi ngoms mtshan dpes 'khyud longs spyod rgyan rdzogs gsang ye rolaX bde stong 'du 'bral med par bskyed rdo rje sgeg ma 'gying tshul canaḥrin chen 'gying ma gser 'od 'bar pad+ma glu dbyangs brtse rol dmaraḥlas rab gar ma in+d+ra'i mdangs:rdo rje'i tshe dar rigs lnga g.yab:'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud bum par bskyilaḥyid bskang la mo'i cha byad can stangs stabs gar gyis pad zlar rol:tshe sgog bsod

nams bskyed pa moX las byed 'du 'phro 'gag pa medaḥde rgyab pad+ma 'dab bzhi la smin ma dkar mo bum pa 'dzin:grub mdzad ser gsal nor bu brtenaḥg ster dmar gsal pad+ma bsnams:dbyings phyug mthing ga rdor dril thogasaḥkun kyang gar bsgyur thabs la mkhas rdo rje rtsed mo pad zlar rolaḥspros pa'i 'od rtser rang 'bumaḥtshe sgog bsod nams gso la mkhas 'gags med 'ja' yis 'khyug bzhin dpal 'pho med grub pa'i rdo rjer dmigs:de yi bye rim sgo bzhi la:'gugs byed ra mo lcags kyu 'dzinaḥ'aching ba ser mo zhags pa bsdamasaX sdom ma dmar mo lcags sgrog 'chab ཿmyos ma ljang gu dril bu 'khrol:gcer bu pad phre 'ja' sham mdzesaḥ 'khyug stabs kyis pad zlar rolaḥgazhan yang 'chi med tshe yi la grub pa'i rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogasaX nyi ma dang ni 'od zer bzhin:ma 'dres yongs rdzogs gsal bskyed srog gi bskul de ye shes paḥspyan drangs gnyis su med par bsre:bcu gcig spyan 'dren rim pa miḥhūṃḥskye med chos dbyings mnyam klong nasaX 'gags pa med pa 'od

gsal sku: sgyu 'phrul 'phags ma'i gsang ba gsum tshur btagags ār+ya tā re dzaX ces ār+ya tā re dzñā na dhartu mu tā ma hā sa ma yā dza dza bcu gnyis bzhugs su gsol ba niḥ hrī ma bcos rdzogs pa rten gyi lharaḥ ye shes gsang ba gsum rdzogs dalaḥ gnyis med bsre ba rdo rje'i ngangaX mnyam pa nyid du brdal bar bzhugasaḥ o ār+ya tā re sarba sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhanaX bcu gsum phyag 'tshal bya ba ni na moḥ rang byung mnyam rdzogs byang chub semasaḥ mtha' dbus spros pa'i dri ma bralaX mi shig gnyug ma tā re'i dpalaḥ rang ngo rig pa'i phyag 'tshal lo ༷ o ār+ya tā re sarba a ti pu hoX pra ti dza ho: r+sā bzhi mchod pa 'bul ba ni hūṃ trīḥ chos dbyings rol pa chen po las sna tshogs rgyan gyi bye brag niḥ 'dzin med phyi mchod sprin ltar gtibasaX rang grol 'dod yon nyi ltar gsalaX ro mnyam gsang mchod mkha' ltar dag rdo rje'i lha mo 'ja' ltar 'byug chos sgras stong khyab glu mchod snyanaḥ 'khor ba dbyings sgol gar mchod bsgraraḥ khams gsum rol ba bro yi mchogaX rig dang stong pa zung 'jug sboraX gsal bun dbu mar 'dren bcom sgolaX chos can tshogs pa'i

— 'khor lo yang rdo rje stobs kyi dpal du cheX 'di na rmongs pa'i dri tshogs bral kun bzang rol ba mnyam pa'i mchog mchod bya mchod byed ka nas dgaḥ/ sa lugs rang ngo shes pa'i laraḥ 'gag med rgyan gyi bye brag 'bulaḥ 'khrul 'khor gzhi la sangs phyir bzhesaḥ ka dag dgongs pa'i rlabs shugs kyisaḥ 'pho med rig dus gsum drilaḥ 'phags ma nyid klong mngon gyur stsol o ma hā pa ñtsa pū dza hoḥ bco lnga sman mar 'bul ba ni oṃ ātshuḥ mtshan ldan bde skyong mi'i nor bu rtsa brgyad yan lag sbyar bcudaX sha lnga bdud rtsi che ba'i mchogaḥ dpa' bo dpa' mo'i rgyu rkyen lasaḥ ro mnyam rdo rje sprin mchod kyisaḥ gnyis med yongs bkang a dṛ tasaḥ yid bzhin 'khor dgyes pa bskangs mthu dbang tshe yi dngos grub stsol0 sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta kha ram̐ kha hiḥ btu drug rak+ta'i mchod 'bul niḥhrīḥ pad+ma'i snod bzang ka pā la sbyar dang rang byung rak+ta'i 5/laḥ stobs ma girti'i mchod pa yis 'phags ma' dgyes bskang dngos grub stsol: sa ma hwa raku kha re khā nyi bcu bdun gtor ma' mchod 'bul ni hriḥ ratra'i gzhong pa khyon

yangs dbus 'dod yon ro mchog ri ltar spungasaḥrdo rje lha mo'i gar bsgyur bcas 'phags ma'i dgyes bskangs dngos grub stsolaX oṃ ma hā ba lirnyi kha ram̐ khā hiX bco brgyad bstod pa 'di lta ste hūṃ hrīḥ chos nyid stong pa de bzhin nyidaḥ rang gsal phyogs ris mi dmigs pa kun khyab rol ba thugs rje'i mdangs0 'phags ma'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥm rig phyog bralagangs ltar 'tsheraḥ mthong bas yid 'phrog mdzes 'dzum 'khyudaḥ dran pas 'jigs tshogs kun las sgrol 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal bstod g.yo 'gul med pa rdo rje bzhinaḥ 'od snang mtha' yas dbu la brgyan sprul pa'i pho nya bsam mtha' yasaḥ ār+ya tā rer phyag 'tshal bstodaX bdag lus gus 'dud rdul snyed sprul ngag gi glu dbyangs sgra brgya'i gdangasaḥ sems ni dad brgya'i zer 'khyug pas 'phags ma'i sku gsung thugs la bstodaḥ bcu dgu bshags pa bya ba niḥho sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su medaḥ yod med spros mtha' bral ba yiX gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen po na rmongs pa'i dri ma thams cad bcomaX badz+ra sa ma mā ā nyi shu 'dzab kyi rim pa niḥhriḥ

ste/ 'phags ma'i thugs klong zla dkyil dbusaḥ sems dpa' dkar gsal tshon gang baḥ rgyan bral gcer bu mdzes 'dzum 'baraḥ de yi thugs gar nyi gdan la ting 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje'i lteraḥ thabs shes zung 'jug ga'u rtsa rig pa shāḥl 'bru gsum rdzogasaḥ drug ldan sngags kyis g.yon du bskoraX bzlas pas tshe bsod stobs 'byor rgyas 'byung bzhi'i dpal yon bsdus de bstimasaḥ 'khor 'das ro mnyam bde ba cheḥ dkyil 'khor gsum du dag mnyam rolaḥ o tā re a yudzā na tshe hūṃ n+ni ༷dza sidhi pha la hūṃ bzlas pa dbugs kya rta la bskyon spro bsdu shes rab rag pas 'gyed chags med bde sbyin 'od gsal 'grogs ra grol dgongs pa dbyings la gtad gra sa tshad 'bru 'bum tshad 'khyol na bza po'i rtags mtshan 'char bar 'gyuraḥ sa ma yu nyer gcig sgrub pa'i 'dzab dmigs niḥ hrīḥ thugs srog 'od 'bar zer brgya g.yoḥ thogs med kun khyab myur shugs ldan 'khor 'das 'byung lnga'i dpal yon kunaX bsdus te sgog gi 'khor lor bstimasaḥ 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par dmigs oṃ tā re a yurnyi na ma hā pukhye tshe sbyo 〉ཿdza sirnyi pha la hūṃḥ spro bsdu'i gzi 'bar nus byin gsoḥ

g.yeng ba'i bsru dbang mi 'chor bar rdo rje gar dang ldan pa yis grangasatshad 'bum phrag bcu grub na grub pa'i yon tan rtags bzang 'char gang zag dbang po' bye brag gis dngos nyamasarmi lam gang rung 'charaḥ sam māḥnyer gnyis las sbyor bzlas dmigs niḥ hrī 'phags ma'i thugs srog sku rnams lasaX 'od zer 'gugs pa'i pho nya sprosaḥ rnal 'byor bla srog nyams pa rnamasaX a rjiḥ/ gi rang bzhin duḥ bsdus de srog gi snying por bstimasaḥ tshe dpal bkrag mdangs rab rgyas shingaX 'byung ba mi 'khrugs khod snyoms bde dus min 'chi ba'i g.yul las rgyalaḥ snang grags rig par shar ba kun lha sngags phyag rgya chen po'i ngang oṃ tā re a ma ra ṇa dzī brnye ye swā rwa yengs med ta 'dzan gzer ldan pas 'chi med rtsa sngags las la bsnyen dmigs pa rno nus ngar zab can gang la thogs med rgyas gdab bya grangs tshad 'bum phrag lnga bzlas pas rtags mtshan bzang po baglu med 'byungaḥ sa ma māḥ nyer gsum tshe bskul bya ba la snyan gsan dbab cing tshe mda' bsor rdo rje pho nya' 'du 'phro 'gyed dam tshig las kyi rgyal dbyangs niḥ ( trīḥ rang snang ma 'gags g.yu lo bkodaḥ shes rig rdo rje tshe yi lha 'gro ba'i mgon po tā re ma yid bzhin 'khor lo thugs rje'i gter0

— phyag g.yas rdo rje tshe dar 'dzinaḥ brkus 'phrog yar ba'i tshe bsod 'gugasaḥ g.yon pa 'chi med gter bum bsnamasaḥ 'thor zhig gas pa'i tshe sgog gsoḥ'od rdo rje'i pho nya 'gyed 'khyams ral bkugs pa'i tshe bcud rnams thabs kyis dril la stobs kyis bkug bla srog khams 'dus thig le laḥ 'gyur med rgyas thob 'chi tsheḥ mi nus g.yung drung ltar bskyil nasaX lha dang skal ba mnyam gyur cigaḥ ( nyi ma chags bde chen pad+ma brtsegasaX zla gam dbang gi gzhal yas nas bcom ldan snang 'a tshe dpag medaḥ dmar gsal dbang gi 'od stong 'byugaḥ mnyam gzhag tshe yi bum pa 'dzinaḥ 'gugs sdud myur ba'i 'od zer 'gyedaḥ bdag dang bsrung bya'i bla sgog niḥn gyis 'phrog dang lha 'dres brkus0 yal 'thor zhig ral gas dang 'khyamasaḥ thams cad ma lus 'ub 'ub bsdus thabs kyis dril la stobs kyis bkugasaḥ bla srog sa 'dus thig le laX 'gyur med rgyas thob 'chi med tshe mi nub g.yung drung ltar bskyil nas lha dang skal ba mnyam gyur cigaḥ/ ni chos nyid stong pa de bzhin nyidaḥ ma

'gags rdo rje sgegs ma niḥ dkar mo zhi ba'i tshe dar 'dzinaX g.yon pas bum pa bcud kyi bkangaḥ rdo rje gar kyi stobs g.yos te bdag dang bsrung bya'i bla sgog ni gdon gyis 'phrog dang lha 'dres brkus: yal 'thor zhig ral gas dang 'khyams: thams cad ma lus bum par bsdus sgrub pa po la tshe dbang bskuraḥ 'chi med rig 'dzin myur 'grub mdzod sne hrī: ka dag blo bral dri med kyang0 rang bzhin ma 'gags 'gyeng ma niḥ ser mo rgyas pa'i tshe dar 'dzin g.yon pas bum pa bcud kyis bkang: rin chen gar gyi stobs g.yos teḥ bdag dang bsrung bya'i bla sgog ni: gdon gyis 'phrog dang lha 'dres brkus: yal 'thor zhig ral gas dang 'khyams thams cad ma lus bum par bsdusaḥ sgrub pa po la tshe dbang bskuraḥ 'chi med rig 'dzin myur 'grub mdzodaḥ / 1 dag chen mnyam rdzogs g.yo med kyang ma 'gags bde chen glu ma niX dmar mo dbang gi tshe dar 'dzin g.yon pas bum pa bcud kyis bkang pad+ma gar gyi stobs g.yos teḥ bdag dang bsrung bya'i bla srog ni: gdon gyis 'phrog dang lha 'dres bkyes: yal

༷/— 'thor zhig ral gas dang 'khyams: thams cad ma lus bum par bsdus sgrub pa po la tshe dbang bskuraX 'chi med rig 'dzin myur 'grub mdzodaḥ shā hrī bdiklong mnyam 'khyel g.yo med kyang ma 'gags bde chen gar ma niḥ ljang mo mngon spyod tshe dar 'dzinaX g.yon pas bum pa bcud kyis bkangaḥ las rab gar gyi stobs g.yos teḥ bdag dang bsrung bya'i bla srog ni: gdon gyis 'phrog dang lha 'dres brkus: yal 'thor zhig ral gas dang 'khyams: thams cad ma lus bum par bsdusaḥ sgrub pa po la tshe dbang bskuraX 'chi med rig 'dzan myur 'grub mdzodaḥ shā sti mtshan ma med pa chos nyid ngang ༷ ma bcos rang grol smin ma ni dkar mo shel gyi mdangs 'khyud dpalaX dri bral gter gyi bum pa 'dzinaḥ tshe dang dpal gyi 'od zer 'bar drongs shig dpal bcud srog bskyed cig 'chi med tshe la dbang 'byor shogaḥshā nyi spros las rab dben 'od gsal ngangaḥ bde chen gzi 'bar grab ma niḥ rin chen gser bye mdangs 'od 'bar 'gags sder yid bzhin nor bu 'dzanaḥ spral ba'i pho nya gog lngar 'khyagaḥ tshe

dpal bsod nams stobs kyis bkugs:drongs shig tshe khug sgog bskyed cigaX 'chi med rdo rje'i dpal thob shogaḥ / nyi ma bcos klong yangs thig le'i ngangaḥ 'gag med ro mnyam mchog ma niX dmar gsal rā ga'i mdangs 'od 'khyugaX chags bral bde klong pad+ma 'dzinaX thugs rje'i 'od zer sprin ltar 'gyedaḥ 'khor 'das 'byung ba'i dngas bcud kun:drongs shig tshe sgog dpal bskyed laḥ 'pho med rdo rjer rgyas thob cigaḥ / nyi zang thal dri med dag chen ngangaḥ mtha' bral mnyam rdzogs dbyings phyug ni mthing gsal be+eḍūr 'od 'khyug dpalaḥ dbyer med brda ston rdor dril thogs spros pa'i rang 'dra 'bum 'bum gis tshe dang bsod nams dpal bcud kunaX drongs shig mi nub srog ka tshugs: g.yo med sra brtan rdo rje'i rgyaḥ shā phyi tshad med snying rje'i gter chen mo ༷ 'gugs byed dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzinaḥdri za me lhar bla 'khyams na drongs shig 'chi med tshe rgyas thob hūṃ hriḥ 'gag med byams pa'i gter mnga' baḥ 'ching ma ser mo zhags pa bsdams: gshin rje srin por tshe ral na drongs shig rdo rje'i rgyas thob cigaXhūṃ

༷/zu ngag bdud rtsi'i 'od la drangasaḥ sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las bsgral nasaḥ kun kyang bde brtsegs pad+ma 'odaḥ mngon par byang chub sar bkod pa'iḥ tshe bsrings dpal 'dredar smon lam mthu gegs med yid bzhin 'gro1ba gyur cigaX ces dang shis brjod dge ston bya tshogs rdzogs tshe bsra sa don kun grub 'ad dus mkhon 'dzi 'khrul rtog bsal grib can rtsig pa'i grogs la 'dzems mi ru bya ba na pa spangs mi tshag smra ba bcad pa gal bskyed rdzo gas ting 'dzin gas gnad da ཿ ldan pa 'a bzhi rdzogs gzhung bsra sa na bum chu khol zhing dri bza 'azibs khrus la zhugs spyod gos dkar gyon rol mo 'khrol zhing bdud rtsi myo mkhar rdzo spre 'us 'dzan cing brtsigs chu bo bsgal la ri rtser byin me tog tshal sleb nyams rtogs 'bar rab la zhal gzigs lung bstan thob 'ad ni nyams gsum gang la 'byu de dag tshe yi grub rtags ste ngo mtshar mtshan ma bzang po 'oḥ go glog na pa shar ba na chags sgo che bar nges shes nas spogs chog bzang mtho bar du bskyar tshe ri rnal 'byor don gnyis 'grub 'ad ni man ngag gtso bor zungs tshe thar srog bslu tshe zam 'dzug tshe 'phra— bsal la ka chen baspa sa mthun pa'i las rnams kun la brtson 'gal zla thams cad spang bar bya sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya ye ma che bdag pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas bstan gror

ste|/ ca namo gu ru we: rwaspyorna zu// lasacan byub la snying rus can skal ba ldan pa de ya dpa la 'phags ma yid bzhen 'bor lo ya chos sde zab pa'i mthil gcig bstan sa ma yā de pang phyi ltar sgrub pa la rin chen bum pa mtshan ldan nang bla med so lnga'i bcud kyas bkang rgyun bab chu yis sum cha gtam sa mgul chings pad+ma'i drwa gur phub kha rgyan gzu sa thag rdo rje bcas dal dbus bkod cang rnam lnga dang nyer spyod 'dod yon mdzes pa'i bskor 'bags rtsog dri ma bral ba gnad gzhan gyis mthong reg med par bya bde ba'i stan la bag phab nas blo gsal ting 'dzin brtan po yis mi dang ma 'phrad dam rgya bsdams smra rgyun bcad la 'di ltar bya'o sa ma yā snyen su bha wa sogs shudzha3nya: rten 'brel 'phrul snang chos skur brdal: ka dag rig rtsal ma 'gags pa: lhun grub bum pa rgya tshad bral: rang byung dag chen gzhal med khang: sgo gru rta bab rgyan bkod pa: yongs rdzogs mdzes tshul phun sum tshogs: dag chen gsal ba de yi dbus: dwangs gsal mtsho dkyil pad sdong khar: thabs shes nyi zla zung 'jug steng: rig pa hrī:bab 'phro 'dus zhu: yongs gyur rje btsun tā re ma yid bzhin gsar 'o/ dkar gsal mdzes: bcu drug gzhon tshul lang tsho'i 'byud:

rde/ / long sa sku'i rgyan chas bcu gsum spras:ye shes 'od gur 'khrigs pa'i klongaḥ'aja' lus sgyu ma'i phung po yi:phyag g.yas mda' dar rigs lnga 'dzin:'khor 'das 'byung ba'i dwangs bcud 'gugs g.yon pas pad sdong tshe bum bsnams:skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub sbyin:nu 'bur bde ba'i gzi mdangs can:zhabs gnyis sems ma'i phyed skyil bzhugs:phyi rim pad+ma 'dab bzhi la:rdo rje sgeg 'gying glu gar ma phyogs mdog tshe dar bum pa 'dzin:yid bskang brtse zhal 'dzum pa'i sku:mtshams 'dzin ge sar gyes pa'i khar smin grub mchog dbyings chen mo rnams:dkar ser dmar mthing bcu drug nyams:mthong bas yid 'phrog zhal bzang can:gar bsgyur bde stong spros mtha' bral:gter bum nor bu pad phreng dang:zung 'jug rdor dril phyag rgya 'changaXkun kyang longs sku'i chas bcu gsum:ma 'gags rgyan gyi bye brag rol:de rgyab pad 'dab bzhi gyes khar:'gugs 'ching sdom myos sgo skyong bzhi:dkar ser dmar ljang mdzes pa'i sku:gcer bu 'ja' sham pad phreng dang rat+na'i rtse phran thod rgyan lngas:

gnag snum dbu sgra rnam par mjes: lcags zhags sgrog dril bsdam tshul 'chang: stangs stabs rol ba sna tshogs bsgyur: 'od gsal dwangs ma'i phung por bskyed: gzhan yang tshe lha rig pa 'dzin: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging laṅka: dpag yas nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin rdzogs: snang dang stong pa gnyis med gsal: lha tshogs gnas gsum yig 'bru las:'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros: rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas bskul: khyad par rnga yab dpal ri nas o rgyan pad+ma tshe dpag med: yid bzhin 'khor lo gtso 'khor bcas: sbyan drangs dbyer med ro gcig bsre: ma ār+ya tā re a ma ra ṇa dzñā na mu dra sarba sa ma yā dza dzaX spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag mchod bstod rjes 'dzab bzlas dmigs pa sa gcil 'bor ni bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer mchod pa'i tshul can dpag tu med pa 'phros bum pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul: de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag tu med pa 'phros de bdag dang bsrung bya'i bla tshe sgog gsum 'khyams pa yal ba zhig ral gas pa thams cad 'byung ba lnga yi khams nas 'bru

༷/ gsum gyi rnam par me re re byung ste bdag dang bum pa'i wa tshogs rnams la yang yang bstems: bum lha'i sku las bde stong byang chub kyi sems bcud bab te bum pa 'chi med tshe yi rang bzhin gyis gang bar dmigs la: snyad tā re a yum na tshe sbyo rtsi dza sidhi pha la hūṃ: smra bcad tang 'dzan brtan po yas 'byu 'bum bzlas pas rtags mtshan 'char nyams rtogs tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas don kun grub par the tshom med sa ma yu yang 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las 'od zer dpag yas spros te: bdag dang bsrung bya'i bla tshe bsod nams gdon chen gyis 'phrog pa: gdon phran gyis brkus paḥ byad ma lha bsrung gis bkug pa thams cad dngaḥ khyad par snod bcud stong khams kyi dwangs bcud ma lus pa 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par 'ab se 'ub se sib rug rug bsdus nas bum pa mer gyis gang: bdag la yang thim pas bkrag mdangs gzi brjid dang ldan par dmigs la: snyed tā re a yum na ma hwa pukhye tshe sbyo rji:ja sidī pha la hūṃḥ yengs med ting 'dzan brtan po yis spros bsdu 'bar ba'i gzi 'od kyi bla srog nyams pa sor chud byed 'ad na sgrub pa' gnad rim yan sa ma yu yang rdo rje

tshe yi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku yi ba spu'i bu ga nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas: phyi sa chu me rlung 'byung ba bzhi'i dwangs bcud thams cad dang: nang rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi dpal dang nus stobs gzi brjid ma lus pa dang: gsang ba phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum kyi dbang byin dngos grub ma lus pa bun ling ling 'ja' sprin thig le phra mo'i rnam par byung nas bum pa ltem gyis gang: bdag la yang zim pas thugs sgog bkrag mdangs gzi brjed dang ldan te 'chi med rig 'dzin gyi sku thob par bsam la ma tā re a ma ra ṇa dzi witrī ye swā hā: 'byul rtog ngan pas mi bsru bar rig stong rdo rje' gzi 'bar bas gang 'dul phrin las gegs med 'grub 'ad ni las kyi sbyor ba yin sa ma yu de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni thal mo sbyar la 'di skad do kyi: rje btsun tā re mkhyen brtse'i bdag: yid bzhin 'khor lo grub pa mo: tshe dang dbang gi bdag nyid can: mgon med bdag la brtse bas dgongs: re ltos gzhan na ma mchis pas: thugs rjes zungs shig bka' drin can: skye 'chi med pa'i tshe dbang

zu bskur 'byung ba'i bcud bsdus lus la bstims: bkrag mdangs gzi brjid bskyed du gsol: rdo rje tshe yi sku thob nas: phrin las 'gro kun 'dul ba dang:gas ma'i mdzad pa dang mthun pa'i: rlabs chen spyod pa mthar phyin re ga: lan gsum mchod ca bstod la bzhu btul na 31 āḥ4: bum pa ye shes kyi gzhal med khaṃ gi dbus su: chu bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'khyil ba'i klong du lha tshogs ma 'dres 'od skur bzhugs par dmigs: gnyis pa las bum sgrub pa ni oṃ swā bha wa shud+dha sogs shudhi3nya: stong ngang las dag chen ye shes kyi gzhal med khang mdzes shing yad du 'ong ba'i dbus su: pad zla nyi ma'i gdan la dbang chen h+ya spri wa sku mdog dmar gsal: zhal gcig gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa: khro 'dzum chags pa'i rnam 'gyur du mas 'khyud cing: phyag g.yas ral gri dang g.yon bhan+ta dku la brten pa: zhabs 'dor thabs su bsgrad dur khrod kyi chas thams cad rdzogs par spras pa: ye shes kyi me dang 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i dbus su: snang stong zung 'jug rol pa'i sku ru gsal ba'i gnas gsum

las 'od zer 'phros: dbyings nas ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstims: bde gshegs rgyal ba rigs lngas bum pa thogs te dbang bskur: de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i nus mthu thob la: slar yang thugs srog hūṃtshopa sngags kyi bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis bar chad gdon bgegs rnams btul: byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub ma lus pa bsdus de bstems: bum pa rdo rjes rdul phra rab kyis gang bar dmigs la: bla h+ya kṛ wa bisne ta krita hūṃ phaṭa brgya stong la sogs ci 'grub bskyar sngags kyis mchod cing bstod pa ni hūṃ gyi ngo bo spyan ras gzigs dbang gar: rnam pa ma chags pad+ma'i sku: bgegs mthar rdo rje rdul ltar 'bebs: h+ya gh+ri wa khyod la bstod: lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum chu dag byed ye shes kyi bdud rtsi nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur: de ltar spro dang bsdu ba yis phrin las rgya mtsho gegs med 'grub byin rlabs dngos grub bang mdzod na skal pa can gyi dpal du shog sa ma yu ye ma che bdag reg 'dzin pad+ma ngas bstan 'gror pha na pa' lhag bsam gyis tshe bskyed

che/na// 'a gas ma'i chos skor rnams grub dbang 'brog ban lo tsā la dpal spungs bsam yas nyid nas gdams da lta ma spel brda la bstems mdo khams a sha'i smon grub gnas bkra shis sgo mang zhes bya bar rin chen gter gya rgya thob cig rdo rje zil btsun chen mor gnyer thub par srung 'bras dus tshig na gdul bya'i lag ma smin grol byed the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi ces pa 'da'ang lung zin dharma ku mud da /chosakyi bdag bo kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyasakyi yang ya bskul ba dang /grogs rat+na saras bskul ba rnams rten 'brel bzang po ra shes nas/bdag 'dra dpa' bo nusaldan rdo risamakha' 'gro gsang pa'i brda ris las dag pa ra pha ba pa'i gnas/jor bdag 'dod rgyal dmar po 'i mdun ngos gli ba'i me tog ga ra ba yo 'bogs skyid pa'i thang nas spel ba dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga la/dge'o/bkra shis/

༷ / zu de nas bdag 'jug len pa ni sa mi 'gyur sku yi da la nas: āḥm 'gags gsung gsang che ba'i mchog: snye thugs klong spros pa bral ba'i mdangs: swā ye shes yon tan rgya mtsho' gter hā phrin las nub pa mi mnga' ba gdan gsum tshang ba'i da la na byin rlabs rgya mtsho dbab tu gsol: bskur thob bral ba ro mnyam pa'i: wa dang rnal 'byor gnyis su med bde chen mngon par byang chub pa'i: rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: e ātshu swā hā a bhi ṣiñtsa saḥ gnas gsum la gam rol bar bya dbang bzhi'i ye shes rjen mthong zhing gdul bya rjes 'dzan dpa la la dbang don gnyis gegs med 'grub par 'gyur sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu h+ya ñtsā ces kyang kha bskang gi ched dang rnal 'byorakun bzang dgyes phyir bdag 'drasas ldan rdo de sa spel ba dge legs 'phel/ dge'o/ bkra shis/
rgi zab chos 'od gsal thugasarnyi sna ༷༷///na/ nga bsgrub dngos grub char 'bebs byin rlabs gzi 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

༷ / na mo ār+ya tā re dzñā na dhartu mu tra shrī ye: zargyasmrami—1/ rgyal ba kun gyi yum za mo skye med dbyi sa las ma g.yos bzhi: sna ba thabs la rgyas 'debs dpal yid banyan 'bor lo la phyag 'tshal ma 'ongasalas ldan pho mo la tshe rkyen gegs 'phra bsgral ba'i phyar 'phags ma'i sgrub skor zab pa' bcud rmad byung thugs kya mthil gcig bkod sa ma shā de yang gong ma'i shadas bcag sa mi yi sgyu 'grul dben pa' gnas rtsi bcud lo 'bras spud cang rgyas chu gnyis mdun 'dud bsrung bzhi tshang nyi zla 'char snga nub phyi zhi nyams dga' dang spro skyid 'char ba sa 'dabs phyag rgya bsnol 'dra yi ra rtse rja brag gangs kyis 'dzin der phyin phun tshogs yar tshesal rta bdun mar la ma phyogs gong ra ba dbyar gyi rgyal mo yi gza' skar spen snar 'phrod 'dzom dus dkar nag gnyasaskyong gtor mas brngan ja chang skyems kyis mnyes pa bskangs bgegs tshogs chang glud sbyin btang nas rkyen bsal mthun rkyen sbyor bar bskur ma rung bdud sde thams cad bskrad bsrung ba'i gur khang rim brgyad phub de nasad la mda' gang ba gru bzhi khod snyoms bzhi brtsegs bya gzha dkar ba byung rnams lngas byugs thag tshon sgo rdzogs rta bab bzhi mu khyud rwa ba pad 'khor sogs mtshan nyad tshang ba spyi mthun bkod de dbus ldi— khrir bum pa ni bla med so lnga'i byur bur gtams rgyun 'bab chu yis sum cha bkang gzung thag kha

rte/na// rgyan mgul chings gdab rgyab tu pad+ma' drwa gur nang tshe gtor las bzha'i dbyibs ldan pa gang sa rir nya 'byud rnam 'gyur can nya zla nor bu 'ja' gur phub 'phan gdugs ba dan du mas mdzes g.yas su thod pa'i rgyed pu'i khar dum gnyis ka zwa la ya nang dza gad nus ldan skyon bral blugs bza drug mngar gsum dang sbyar ba 'bri mar gyis dril ril bu ni kha gting mkhru pas phyur bur bya dar dmar kha bkab me long la li mtshal sin rdu ra byugs pa ra chos lung mkha' 'ayo ma' sngags bkod / de steng 'ja' shel mdangs ldan dang me long hrīḥyi ma' pa brten g.yon du shel bum skyon bral nang tshe bskyed ril bu dbang mdog gas yongs su bkang ste kha kheb da ཿbka' rtags bcas la pha sha tshe nas steng yo logs bral bar legs bkod do gas yang rtsa gsum sgrub gtor dang tshe mda' tshe rten tshe zan r+sāg sman gtor rak+ta rnam lnga da nyer spyod tshogs gtor rgya chen bkram ḍa ma ru dang dral bu sogs mkho ba'i chas rnams yongs bsags nas bde ba'i stan la bag phab gnas rnal 'byor tang 'dzin g.yo med pa sa phyi na gsang ba'i dam rgya bsdams sngon 'gro srog bslu tsha tshwa dang chab gtor mar me stong 'bul la bar chad rkyen snang bral bar bya sa ma mā sbyor ba sta gon gyi ram pa 'o rgya rgya rgya de nas las la 'jug pa ni rnam grangs bcu gsum gyis

bstan no dang po brda sgo dbye ba ni hūṃ trīḥ ma bcothangaganas lugs sku gsum zhal: ye nas rang dang 'du 'bral med: ma rig 'khrul bas zhal ma mjal: rang rig dag pa'i gsal sgo dbye: rgyu maṇ+ḍal pra we sha ya phaṭa gnyas pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni na mo 'khor 'das gnyis med rang byung don: mi g.yo thig le cher gnas kyang: rtog pa'i dbang gis mu bzhir gol: rang rig gsal ba'i brda phyag 'tshal: na mo ār+ya tā re na ma ho gsum pa dam bca' bzung ba niḥ trī rtsal chen thugs rje'i rlabs g.yos nas: 'khor 'das mi dmigs chos skur sbyangs: don dam 'chi med tshe yi gsang: sgog gi slad du la khyod 'dzinaḥ hrīchosgot+ta badz+ra sa ma yā shā: bzhi pa bsrung ba'i dmigs rim ni spre dzñā na badz+ra rak+ta rak+ṣa s+t+waṃ ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i bsrung ba'i gur khang rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen pad+ma rgya gram ral gri dbyug do me dpung 'bar ba'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu dkrigs te 'byung po gdon bgegs tshe sgog la re ba thams cad nye mi nus pa'i rang bzhin can du gruraḥ badz+ra tsakra ratā pad kerma khasgo rtigru dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐ hūṃ phaṭaḥ lnga pa mdun bskyed bsgom bzlas ni sgo ma hwa shu n+ya

ca ta dzña na badz+ra sā bhā wa arma ko3nya: mdun gyi dkyil 'khor mi dmigs pa las rang byung dag chen ye shes kyi gzhal med khangaḥ shar dkar lho ser nub dmar ljang dbus mthing gsal du 'dug pa: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta bab bang rim khyud mo 'khor yug dang bcas pa: mtshan ma gdos bcas su ma grub pa dwangs gsal 'od kyi bzhin can du gsal ba'i dbus su ma chags pad+ma ge sar lo 'dab rab tu gyes pa'i khar zla ba nya gang ba'i gdan laḥ rig pa hrī:dkar po 'phros 'dus zhu ba las rje na 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dkar gsal dung 'od 'bar ba la phu tshod kyis cung zad mdangs ba lta bu'i 'od chags pa zhal 'dzum dgyes brtse'i rnam 'gyur du 'khyud pa: spyan bdun rab tu dngas ba'i gdul bya rjes su 'dzin zhing: skal ldan bde la 'god pa'i nu pad rgyas pa: phyag g.yas tshe yi mda' dar rigs lnga 'dzin cing na pad+ma thugs gar bkan pa'i lo 'dab snyan gyi thad gar kha gyes pa'i steng du 'chi med tshe yi bum pa 'dzin pa: rat+na'i dbu rgyan snyan cha mgul rgyan se mo do do shal sku reg

phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu ste rin po che'i rgyan brgyad gyis mdzes par spras shing: dar gyi dpyangs pa stod g.yog smad sham gar gyi phu dung cod paṇa zi ldir rnams legs par klubs pa pad+ma'i thod gdengs dang pad phreng rnam par mdzes pa'i do shal byas pa: zhi tshul rnam pa dgu yis khyud cing snang stong gnyis su med par bskyed do de yi spyo bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la tshe bdag snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar gsal longs sku'i rgyan cha bcu gsum mdzes par spras pa: phyag mnyam gzhag gi steng na bum pa 'chi med tshe yi bcud kyi gang ba bsnams paḥ dgyes bskyed gsang ba ye shes pad 'phreng dang bum pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba 'ja' 'od zlum 'khyil gyi dbus su sku snang la rang bzhin ma grub par gsal ba'i phyi rim pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'iḥ shar du sgeg ma dkar mo g.yas mda' dar dang g.yon tshe yi bum pa 'dzin pa: lho ru 'byang ma ser mo g.yas mda' dar dang g.yon tshe yi bum pa 'dzin pa nub tu1 ma dmar mo g.yas mda' dar dang g.yon tshe yi bum pa 'dzin pa: byang dugar ma ljang mo g.yas mda' dar dang g.yon

zu tshe bum 'dzin pa sku la mdzes pa lha mo'i chas thams cad kyi rnam par brgyan paḥ zhabs stangs stabs gar gyis pad zla'i gdan la rol ba snang stong 'dzin 'od skur bskyed doḥ de rgyab mtshams 'dzan gyi pad+ma dang zla gdan laḥ shar lhor smin ma dkar mo g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa: lho nub tu grub ma ser mo sa nor bu dang g.yon dril bu brten paḥ nub byang du mchog ster ma dmar mo g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon pad+ma bsnams pa: byang shar du dbyings phyug ma mthing gsal sa rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa: kun kyang las byed kyi pho nya 'bum 'gyed cing: sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug dang dar dpyangs 'ja' sham pad phreng rat+na'i dbu rgyan sogs / mdzes par byas pa: zhabs rnams brtul zhugs rol pa'i gar bsgyur can snang stong 'dzin pa dang bral bar bskyed do: de'i phyi rim sgo bzhi la shar du lcags kyu ma dkar stogs kyu dang pad phreng 'dzin pa: lho ru zhags pa ma ser mo zhags pa dang rin po che'i sgrom bu bsnams pa: nub tu lcags sgrog ma dmar mo lcags sgrog dang bhan+ta brten pa:

byang du dril bu ma ljang mo rgya gram dang lcags phur gdengs ba kun kyang gcer bu rus rgyan 'ja' sham can gar 'khyugs sta sa stabs su rol pa'o: gzhan yang tshe yi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rig 'dzan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad ma 'dres yongs rdzogs til gong phyur ba bzhin du bskyed do: la tshogs de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ mgrin par ā snyeng gar hūṃ gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing thams cad nas rdo rje tshe yi la tshogs thams cad 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rnams par spyan drangs nas gnyis su med par bstim moX oṃ ār+ya tā re dzñā na dhartu ma hā mu tra badz+ra sa ma yā dza dzaḥ spyan 'dren bzhugs thu ga rma chad bstod bya bzlas — sngags kya 'byupa 'bor ni bdag dang mdun bskyed 'phags ma'i thugs gar pad+ma dang zla ba'i dal dbus su ye shes sems dpa' tshe dpag med dkar po tshon ga ba rgyan med gcer bu mnyam gzhag gi steng na tshe bum 'dzin cing zhabs sgril mo krung gis bzhugs pa de yi thugs gar gser kyi rdo rje rgya gram pa'i lce bar nyi zla kha sbor ba'i dbus su thugs srog hri yig 'od 'bar

༷yi/ ca ba'i g.yas su tshe yi rang bzhin āḥdakar poḥ g.yon du sgog gi ngo bo rje:dmar ljangs gnyis bkrag mdangs 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i mtha' bskor du sngags kyi phreng bas g.yon du bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros: 'khor 'das brtan g.yos dwangs bcud ma lus pa a—byet+t+waṃ:gsum rnam par mer re re byung ste bdag la yang yang bstems: mdun bskyed kyi phyag gi bum pa dang bshams pa'i bum pa dbyer med pa'i nang du chi li li 'dus ste 'chi ba med pa rdo rje'i sku thob par dmigs la: rtsa bsnyen ci 'apyob bzla'o yang bdag mdun thugs ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag tu med pa 'phros pasaḥ rang dang bsrung bya'i bla sgog gdon chen gyis 'phrog pa gdon phran gyis brkus paḥ byad ma la srung gis bkug pa thams cad 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par 'ab se 'ub se sib rug rug bsdus ste rang la yang yang bstems pas bla srog nyams pa sor chud nas tshe dpal bkrag mdangs dang ldan par dmigs laḥ sgrub bsnyenaci 'grub bskyar ro yang bdag mdun thugs ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas

rang dang bsrung bya'i bla tshe yar ba 'khyams pa zhig ral chad gas su gyur ba thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus nas tshe srog gong nas gong 'phel gyi rang bzhin du gyur nas 'chi med grub pa'i rdo rjer dmigs la sgrub bsnyen gang 'os bzla'o yang bdag mdun thugs ga'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas snod bcud rgyal blon 'bangs gsum 'khor 'das snod bcud 'byung bzhi'i dpal yon ma lus pa 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan gyi rnams par kyi li li 'dus ste bum pa bcud kyi gangaX bdag la stims pas bcu drug lon ba'i gzhon sha chags shing bsgres bral rdo rje'i sku thob par dmigs: mdun bskyed la bstims pas byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub kyi char chen po 'bad med lhun grub tu rdol ba'i brin las bzang po grub par dmigs la: las sngagasamang mang bzla bar bya'o drug pa gsol ba gdab pa ni (1kye rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku: mkhyen brtse'i gter chen 'gro ba'i mgon: phan bde'i nyi ma gsal mdzad pa'i: rje btsuna.ur+ya tā re ma: gtso 'khor sprul pa dpung dang bcas: thugs rje chen pos nye bar dgongs: bdag

rwa/ / cag sgrub mchog pho mo rnamasaḥ tshe 'phrang 'chi ba'i 'jigs las skyobs: bzod dka' ngan 'gro'i 'phrang las sgrolaḥ 'gyur med tshe yi dbang chen bskur lus ngag yid gsum smin grol mdzod: pad+ma'i rigs mchog snang mtha' da ཿ gnyis med rdo rje'i sku 'grub shogaḥ lan gsum brjod la byin rlabs bskul bdun pa ril bu bskyed bzlas ni hūṃḥmatshan rdzogs bum pa rgya tshad bralaḥ 'od snang dngas ba'i gzhal med dbusaḥ thabs shes nyi zla zung 'jug khrir ril bu'i mtshan 'dzin dri ma sbyangs: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud bsdus te bstims: hūṃ:yig las skyed rje btsun ma dkar gsal gangs rir nyi 'khyud mad sa: bcu gsum rgyan rdzogs mtshan dpe 'baraḥ byang chub sems kyi phyag rgya yisaḥpad sdong tshe mda' bum pa 'dzin: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil spyan bdun 'chang: 'dzum sgeg bcu drug lang tshos 'khyud dwangs gsal sku yi 'od klong duḥ sgeg 'gying glu gar phyogs mdog can: wa mo smin grub mchog dbyings maḥ las mdzad lcags zhags sgog dril bzhi: tshe lha dpa' bo dpa' mo dngaḥ rig 'dzin paṇa grub rgya mtsho rnams: ma 'dres

gza' skar bkra bzhin gsal: rigs bdag snang mtha' tshe dpag med: dmar gsal mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzinaḥ gsang ba ye shes 'khril sbyor rol: rig kyi 'od zer phyogs bcur sproX 'khor 'das 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud sdud tshe bsod bla sgog nyams pa gso lha tshogs gnas gsum yig 'bru las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas bskul khyad par rnga yab dpal ri nas: o rgyan pad+ma tshe dpag med gtso 'khor sprul pa dpung dang bcas: phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyiX rnam par spyan drangs gnyis med bstems ma ār+ya tā re dzñā na mu tra ma hā sarba sa ma ya dza dza dzaḥhūṃ be ho tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo shā na ma ho ma hā pañtsa sarba pū dza ho: ( hrīX chagasapas ma gos dung ltar gsal: 'gro 'dul gzigs stangs bdun dang ldan: srid zhu mnyam rol 'dzum mdzes dpal: 'phags ma'i sku gsung thugs la bstod: bzlas dmigs ni bdag thugs las spros 'od zer ni: mchod pa'i tshul can dpag med pa: spos te lha tshogs thugs rgyad basmal bkrag mdangs gzi 'od 'bar bar dmigs: bsden sngags sham bu 'di bzhin gdags:

shā/ka/ zu aḥbapa tsami ta gyid yaḥswā hāḥ ting 'dzin brtan po'i yang yang brjod bsgyur kha spros te lha chogs thugs rgyud bskulaḥ 'khor 'das dpal yon dwangs bcud bstamasaḥ sgrub sngags sham du 'di ltar 'dogs pañtsa ra sa ya na a dṛ ta shrī shrī yo gi ni me: 'pho med tang nge 'dzan gyis bskul bsgyur kha spros te lha tshogs thugs rgyud bskul: grangs dkyil tshom bu rab spros te: stong khams gang bas gar 'khrab bzhin: 'dzab dbyangs sgrogs pas bdud dpung 'dul: srid pa g.yo 'gul byed par dmigs: las sngags sham bur 'di 'dogs so a ral+li sa ma ya pho phernyi ya ral+le sa ma ya pho phernyi shidzña puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭa swā hāḥ 'pho med rdo rje'i ting 'dzan gyis bzlas pa chu ba'i rgyun bzhin bskyar byan rlabs dngos grub char ltar 'bebs the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yu brgyad pa nyasto bsgrub pa ni trī spyo rten 'brel sgyu ma'i brda chos gar: yid bskangs 'dod pa kun 'byung dpal: bde skyong ka pā la yi nang: dza gad a dṛ thabs shes kyiḥ gsang stems sprar ba'i bcud chen po abot+t+waṃli rnam par gnas: ngo bo ste med chos kyi sku hri las snang ba mtha' yas dmar: longs sku'i rgyan

rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs:tshe mda' bum 'dzin 'od skur bskyed:rang bzhin 'gags med lo sa spyod rdzogs:rba0 lasagasang ba ye shes dmar sems ma longs sku'i cha lugs can:tshe bum pad+ma'i phreng ba 'dzin:zhabs gnyis yab kyi sked la 'khril:bde dang stong pa'i gzi 'od 'bar dwangs gsal 'ja' lus 'od skur bskyed:thugs rje rtsol bral sprul pa'i sku:āḥyig las skyes tā re ma:yid bzhin 'khor lo dkar mdzes 'dzum:longs sku'i rgyan rdzo gas phyed skyil bzhugs:pad sdong tshe mda' bum pa 'dzin:gzigs stangs yon tan bdun dang ldan:'ja' 'od phyogs bcu kun tu spro:sku dbyings dwangs gsal 'od klong du:lha mo sgeg 'gying glu gar ma:smin grub mchog ster dbyings phyug bzhi las byed lcags zhags sgog dril bu:tshe lha dpa' bo dpa' mo dang:rig 'dzin paṇa grub rgya mtsho rnams:ma 'dres gza' skar bkra bzhin gsal:kun gyi srog las 'od spros pas rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas:spran drangs gnyis su med par bstems:gsung mchog bdag po pad+ma'i lha:yab yum sbor ba'i chu rgyun dang:

zu 'phags ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun: byang chub sems kyi rnam pa ni: dkar la dmar mdangs chags par bab: bhan+ta ltem mer gang bar dmigs:/masaḥbho dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhartu pañtsa a dṛ ta sirnyi pha la lha: smra bcad yengs 'brul bral ba ru brgya stong la sogasaci 'grub bskyar mchod cing bstod la 'od zhu bya dngos grub rgya mtsho'i mdzod dmigs sa ma yā dgu nga mda' dar sgrub pa na yid ka tem na ya phaṭa: mi dmigs ste nga pa chos sku'i ngang: lhan skyes ye shes rol pa'i mdangs: kun la snyoms pa'i mnyam brdal ba: tshe 'a mchod tu mi 'gyur zhal: bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa'i dal: snyugs ma byang chub sems kyi rgyud: tshig gsum sku gsung thugs kyi klong: mda' stongadapa' nge rta na dmar: mde'u stong paphag mo yum: dar lnga rgyal ba yab yum klong: sgro gsum chos gzugs sprul pa'i sku: snying po 'chi med bcud kyis gtams: spros pa'i 'od rtser / byed kyi: pho nya 'bum 'bum 'gyed pa yis: 'khor 'das tshe dpal 'byung ba'i bcud: sib kyis bsdus la 'ub kyis dril: byin rlabs 'gugs sdud gter du dmigs

snyesaḥ/shā traX hrīX ā: t+t+waṃ n+ni dza sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ ā: smra bcad ti 'ad na g.yo med pas skabs dang bstun par gang 'os bskyar 'gugs sdud las kyi pho nya yis don kun gegs med yid bzhin 'byung sa ma yu bcu pa tshe nas tshe 'bra dang tshe rten thams cad sgrub pa ni bdag nyid rje btsun ma'i bskyed rim dang ldan pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer spros tshe rdzas thams cad la phog: de dag las 'od zer bsam yas su 'phros: 'khor 'das 'byung ba'i bcud dang: steng lha yi tshe bcud ā dkar po: bar mi yi tshe bcud rnyi:ljang sngon: 'og klu yi tshe bcud hrīḥdamar ser gyi rnams par 'ub 'ub bsdus nas tshe rdzas rnams la thim te mchog thun dngos grub kyi gter du dmigs la: snyed tshe hūṃ: g.yu hūṃ g.yu tshe byu: a yum na g.yu tshe rgyu: brgya sto pa sogs brjod 'bras bu tshe dpal bsod nam mchog thob 'gyur sa ma yu bcu gcig daro sa grub gsol gdab ni thal mo sbyar la 'di skad do kyi rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba mchog skye 'chi gnyis med tshe yi la:yid bzhin 'khor lo thugs rje'i gter: las mdzad pho nya'i 'du 'phro 'khrigs: kun nas dwangs ba'i blo yis ni dang po gcal nas bar du brtsams: tha ma sgrab pa'i mtha'

zu/ga/ ru phyin: dngos grub stsol len dus la bab yal yol btang snyoms mi mdzad paraḥ 'chi ba med pa tshe yi dbang nub pa med pa bsod nams dpal: 'dzad pa med pa gter gyi rgyun thun mong grub pa brgyad dang ni: mi 'gyur mchog gi dngos grub kun: rnal 'byor sgrub mchog bdag cag la: da lta nyid du stsal du gsol: thal mo dang bcas gsol ba gdab rtsa sngags sham bu dngos grub bskul dus su thog reg bral bar bya yon tan ma lus mchog thob 'gyur sa ma yā bcu gnyis dngos grub len pa ni snyan pa'i dbyangs kyas 'di skad do rkye he dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dang: gtso 'khor sprul bcas ma lus pa: dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma yis: dngos grub rgya mtsho stsol bar dmigs: rkye r+sā sku la skye 'chi gnyis med pa'i snang dang stong pa zung 'jug dbang bum pa lha yi dngos grub rgyun sgrub pa po la stsal du gsol: kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa saX gsung la 'gag pa mi mnga' ba: gsal dang stong pa gnyis med dbang: bhan+ta bdud rtsi 'chi med rgyun sgrub pa po la stsal du gsol: wak+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ thugs la 'khrul ba mi

dmigs pa: rig dang stong pa ro mnyam dbang: 'od 'bar mtshan bral dpe yi dal: sgrub pa po la stsal du gsol: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa (0 yon tan re skong 'bad med dpal: bde dang stong pa mnyam brdal dbangaX mchog tu mi 'gyur yon tan mdzod sgrub pa po la stsal du gsol: sarba gu ṇa a snyi ṣiñtsa /: phrin las 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dpal: zang thal ye shes 'ub chub dbang phrin las rgya mtsho'i gsang mdzod sgo sgrub pa po la stsal du gsol karma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ / hrī ༷ rdo rje grub pa sngags kyi gzi: yon tan rgya mtsho nor bu'i dpal: ma chags dri bral bde chen klong: kun gyi gsang mdzod dam pa'i sgo rigs ldan bu yi dpal du phyes: mkha' la thogs med bsgrod pa yi: 'phur ldan gshog pa'i dngos grub stsol: rgya mtshor mi 'byang 'dzul shes pa'i bsgrod stabs mthu yi dngos grub stsal: 'dod pa 'jo ba nor bu'i dpal: yid bzhin gter gyi dngos grub stsol: snang ba 'char ba'i a da〉: mi nub brgyan gyi dngos grub stsol: gang shar rang grol bde ba che: stogs pa krong yangs dngos grab stsol: gzhan snang ma lus zil gnon pa'i: nus

tsa mthu stobs kyi dngos grub stsol:grub mtha'i rgol ba tshar gcod pa'i: shes rab klong rdol dngos grub stsol: mkhyen gnyis ye shes rab rgyas pa'i: bde chen ragro /sal dngos grub stsal: yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal 'byor ba'i: grub pa brgyad kyi dngos grub stsol: bar chad nyer 'tshe'i 'phrang grol ba'i: rdo rje 'gyur med dngos grub stsol: tshe gcig sgrub la spyor 'bras bu: mngon par byang chub dngos grub stsol: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa yi: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags sham du kwa ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ āX rja sa rnams thams cad gnas gsum gtugs daro sa grub rgya mtsho thob pa ra 'gyur sa ma yā bcu gsum tshe yi rkyen bzlog dang dri bral rnam dag smon lam mi thal mo dang bcas 'ad skad do e ma ho: 'phags ma yi bzhin 'khor lo' dpal: sgeg 'gyeng glu gar smin grub dang: mchog ster dbyings phyug 'gugs 'ching sdom: myos ma la sogs gtso 'khor bcas:bskyed cing bsgom pa'i byin rlabs kyis bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams dang: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu sogs: glo bur mi 'dod nyer 'tshe'i rigs: dus ma yin

pa'i 'chi ba brgyad: tshe srog dpal la 'tshe ba yi: mi mthun phyogs rnams thams cad kun: chos nyid zhi ba chen por bzlog: skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal rnams dbyings rig 'du 'bral med par bzlog: sems rtog bzo bcos 'khrul 'khor kun: rig pa ka dag chen por bzlog: hrīḥ dus min 'chi dang 'jigs pa brgyad: mi 'dod nye bar 'tshe ba kun yid bzhin 'khor lo'i byin rlabs kyis thams cad bde legs mdzad du gsol: lha mo bsam 'phel bsgom 'bras bu 'chi med rig 'dzan myur thob shog lan gsum bskyar bar bya'o sku gsum smon lam zab mo na e ma ho bde chen rdul bral pad+mo bkod pa'i zhing: zag pa'i chos grol skye 'chi gnyis mi mnga': dri bral pad+ma'i zhal bzang snang mtha' yas: nye sras brgyad dang byang sems tshom bu 'khrigs: 'od zer mtha' yas bde chen bkod pa na/ lus sems gyes tshe bdag sogs skye bar shog: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa lam rtsal rdzogs nas: ma dag zhing kun 'dren pa'i dpal thob shog: ces chos sku'i smon lam dang e maho:dribral kun dga'i dpal ston char chen 'bebs: shel dkar brag 'byud

༷| nyi zla zung 'jug dal: byams dang brtse ba snying rje'i gter gcig pu: phyag na pad+ma 'dren ston phrin las phyug: gang 'dul mdzad pa'i sprul 'khor bsam mi khyab: yon tan kun 'byung ri bo ta la na bdag sogs 'di nas 'phos tshe skye bar shog skye nas phyir mi ldog cing sprul pa yis 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzad pa mthar phyin shog: ces lo sa sku' zhi du skye ba'i smon lam dang e ma ho: rngams brjed dpa' bo'i gzi 'bar bdud dpung 'dul: ḍāk+ki'i sprin 'khrigs bde stong char rgyun 'bebs: pad+ma'i 'od zhing chags pa'i dri tshogs 'joms: kun nas bde legs char 'bebs dal dbus su: rang byung rig sku snang srid zil gnon rtsal: brtse ba'i rang mdangs lo paṇa rje 'bangs 'tshogs: thugs rje'i 'od zer bye phrag brgya yis mgon: mi nub spro bsdu'i gter chen gcig pu'i drung bdag sogs lus sems gyes tshe byang chub nas: phrin las 'gro ba'i 'dren ston 'khru1ra bar regag: ces sprul sku'i smon las gdab po de lta ra mos gus tshad med pas smon btab 'bras bu chud mi za byin rlabs dpal gyi bum bzang yin ze tshom med do sa ma ma0 rgya rgya rgya e ma rgyal

ba'i dbang po rdo rje gshog rgod ngas shin tu zab pa thugs kyi thig le nyid bstan dang 'gro la phan pa' lag bsam gyis grub dbang khye'u chung ye shesablo la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen gter rgyas thob ma 'o sa snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan 'dus rtsal gyis mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang gshams nas rted 'gro ba'i dga' ston nyi ma rab tu gsal de bar srungs shigasman btsun g.yu yi lcam skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa 'di'ang lung zin dharma ku mud kyis bskul ba dang / zab gsang la las skal gyis 'byor ba mthu btsan pa'irnal 'byor kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyasakyisabaskul ba dang / smon lam rten 'brel bza po 'a nor dang ldan pa 'i rat+na sar rnamasakyis bskul ba'i ngor/ bdag 'dras( rgyan bsam gtan glang pasamakha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda mdzod las zhal bshus te dag par gtan la dbab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo le/klong chen lta ba'i ngang la skyid nyal du bzhugs kyang / 'gro 'dod gom pa nan bskul lcags tshan gyis zug rngus/ bskul ba sngon smon dbang gis ro snyoms su bzhag nas/ phan bde chos kyi char rgyun gdul bya la dbab so/ dbyings rig zung 'jug rgyal sar 'tshogs pa zhig smon lags/ dza yan+tu/

rjo/ / sman mchod ni dum gcig mi yi nor bu stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du rigs lnga yab yum kyi dam rdzas byang chub sems kyi bcud 'khyil ba las 'od zer 'phros 'khor 'das 'byung lnga'i dpal yon dngas bcud ma lus pa sib sib rug rug bsdus nas bhan+ta bdud rtsi la bstims pas dngos grub kyi mdzod chen por gyur bar dmigs la: rtsa sngags mthar pashāmi a mṛ ta spe pra we sha ya a be sha ya a ā nyer gcig brjod la gzhung ltar dngos grub bskul rjes skyes āḥhūṃ: bye sa sku snang ba mtha' yas de mchod da tsho ā:྅: longs sku thugs rje chen po de mchod do sprul sku pad+ma rgyal bo de mchod do mnga' bdag chos rgyal yas sras de mchod do las can rje 'bangs grogs lnga de mchod do rjes chags bzhad pa'i rdo rje de mchod do dgongs brda' snyan brgyud bla ma de mchod do rtsa rgyud rig 'dzin bla ma de mchod do tshe 'dzin grub pa'i rgyal ma de mchod do rig bdag 'od snang mtha' yas de mchod do lha mo sgegs 'bying glu gar de mchod do ma cig smin grub mchog dbyings de mchod do tshad med sgo skyobhe sa mkha' 'gro de mchod do

tshe yi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs de mchod do bka' srung rdo rje g.yu sgron de mchod do drod 'dzin sngags kyi bdag mo de mchod do bstan skyongs tshe ring mched lnga de mchod do gter bdag gnyan mo lha mdzes de mchod do 'khor 'das rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor de mchod do dus gsum pha ma 'gro drug de mchod do rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor de mchod ro/ sirnyi pha la a la la sgyu1 zhes myang la dngos grub ya mtshan chen po thob par bsam mo 'di yang nus ldan dpal bos so/
sgi zab chos 'od gsal thugashārnyi rdashaṃ shā: gsang sgrub nyi zla zung 'jug bde stong dngos grub kyi bang mdzod zab mo bzhugs so:

༷/ na mo ār+ya tā re tshe hūṃ a ma ra ṇa dzi warnyi ye: zo4rgyasgo 4/1 bde chen gar gyi sprin 'brigs shang byin rlabs dngos grub char rgyun 'bebs sku gsum mkha' 'gro yongs kya gas yid bzhan 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal las ldan sgrub la snying rus can bsod nams bsags pa can gyi ched gsang sgrub zab pa'i mthar thug pa bde stong nyi zla kha sbyor bstan sa ma mā rig 'dzan gong ma'i zhabs bcag sa byin rlabs gzi brjed 'bar ba' gnas rgyu 'grul glags tshol bral ba ru phyin de sa bslang bgegs tshogs bskrad bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rim brgyad bskor bde ba'i stan la bag phab gnas phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rgya sdoms blo gsal ting 'dzin brtan po yis thabs mchog zab mo 'dir 'jug bya sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya 'di la sbyor dngos rjes dang gsum dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni na 3sna: 'gyur med rig pa ka dag zhal: spros mtha' bral la skyabs su mchi: 'khor ba lug rgyud rten 'brel chos rang sar grol phyir sems bskyed do: lan gsum gnyis pa lha bskyed bya ba na ā blo 'das sems kyi rdo rje ni:yod med spros pa'i mtha' dang bralaḥ kun khyab rang gsal byang chub sems: nam mkha' lta bu mtha' dbus med rig pa chos rnams kun gyi rten phyogs ris bral bar kun

shā/ /ca la snyoms: hrī: chos sku skye med yum gyis mkha': mi gnas mi shig 'pho med klong: longs sku lhun grub zhing bkod pa: ye shes dag chen mnyam rdzogs dbus sprul sku rje btsun tā re ma: dkar gsal shel gyi ri bo la: nyin byed 'bum 'khyud gzi 'od 'bar: gnyis snang dri ma kun bral ba'i zhal 'dzum gdul bya'i yul la brtse:spyan dwangs gzigs stangs bdun ldan dpal: snyan gyi pad+mo rnam par bkra dung gi tshem phreng rnam par 'khrigs: chos kyi sgo 'byed ljags pad srab: gnag snum dbu sgra thor cog la: rin po che yi dbu rgyan mdzes: pad+ma'i sgod gdengs cod paṇa 'khyugs: zar bu g.yas g.yon mdzes par 'phyangs: rat+na'i snyan cha mgul phreng dang: do shal se mo do yas mdzes: phyag zhabs gdu bu mig ldan dpal: dar mthing stod g.yog smad sham dang: gar gyi phu dung dar dpyangs mdzes: zi sdir 'ja' sham rnam par bkra: phyag g.yas tshe mda' rigs lnga 'dzin 'khor 'das 'byung ba'i dwangs bcud 'gugs: g.yon pas pad sdong bum pa brten: 'chi med ye shes bcud kyis bkang: zhabs gnyis phyed pa'i

skyil krung gis: pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la rol: sku dbyings dwangs gsal chen po'i 1nga: lha mo sgeg 'gying glu gar ma: smin grub mchog dbyings chen mo dang: las mdzad 'gugs 'ching sdom myos ma: dkar ser dmar ljang 'dzum mdzes sku: tshe mda' bum 'dzin gar bsgyur mdzad: lcags zhags sgrog dril phyag rgya 'chang: rnal 'byer bla sgog nyams pa kun: sor chud tshe dbang dngos grub stsol rigs bdag snang mtha' yab yum dmar: zung 'jug pad+ma zla steng rol: nyams pa sor chud yon tan dpal: rab bskyed tshe yi ngo bor dmigs: gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas bskul: khyad par rnga yab dpal ri nas: o rgyan pad 'byung ston 'khor bcas: tshe dpag med kyi rnam pa na spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstims: ro gcig bde ba chen por bzhugs: lta ba don gyi lhar phyag 'tshal: ro mnyam kun bzang sprin mchod 'bul: gsang ba rdo rje'i klong la bstod: ma rig nyon shes dri ma bshags: dag tshangs mchog gi dngos grub stsolaḥ hrīḥ bdag snang ār+ya tā re yi: thugs gar pad+ma zla steng du:

༷yi/ca gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram sbubs: thabs shes dbyangs gsal ga'u na rig pa hrī:yig dmar gsal la: srog sngags gser gyi phreng bas bskor bzlas pas 'od zer kha dog lnga: phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten la spros te: rnal 'byor bdag cag sgrub pa po'i: bla srog 'thor zhig ral gas yal: bskus phrog zad nyams gyur ba'i tshe:aḥdh+riḥ(ཿgsum rnam par bkug: dwangs bcud srog gi ngo bor dril: lhag ma ba spu'i bu gar bstims: bkrag mdangs gzi brjid snum 'od 'bar: tshe dbang rig 'dzin brnyes par bsam: ces āX hūṃ badz+ra sa/ na ār+ya tā re a yu sarba sidhi pha la hūṃ āX bsnyen sngags chu bo'i gzhu bzhin du smra bcad 'bru 'bum bzla bar bya teng 'a na dmigs pa sa rno nus bskul rtags mtshan brtes par the tshom med sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya mos gus gdu ba drag po yis kyi: 'gro ba'i mgon po snang mtha' yas: bcom ldan rgyal ba tshe dpag med: gtso 'khor sprul pa dpung dang bcas sgrab mchog bdag la brtse bas dgongs: gsol ba lang lhang 'debs lags na: daro sa grub sprin ltar dbab tu gsol: nyams rtogs nyi bzhin gsal bar mdzod: tshe mi

'byur ba'i ka chen chugs: sgog ni g.yo med srung mda' bsrings: lus la gzi mdangs bskyed du gsol 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: gsol ba lan gsum btab pas 'khor 'das brtan g.yo thams cad 'od du mer re re byu ste sgrub pa po la bstims pa sa tshe bsod dpal yon bkrag mdangs gzi brjid thams cad rab tu rgyas par dmags la snyen āḥshā swā hā r+ghaṃ n+niḥdzaḥsarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ āḥsgrub sngags bar ma chad pa ra bzla ting 'dzan rno nus ldan pa yis 'bum lnga bzlas pa sa nyams rtogs rgyas don gnyis lhun gyis grub par 'gyur sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya de nas thugs dam gnad bskul ni hūṃ ༷sa thugs dam chen po'i dus la bab: tha tshig ma g.yel dam tshig can: sngon tshe bskal pa'i dang po la: dbang chen pad+ma brtsegs pa na bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas dang: shes rab dbyings yum gos dkar mos skye 'chi bral ba'i tshe dbang thob bsgres rgud med pa'i sku mchog brtes: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: de rjes bar gyi bskal pa la: ri bo ta la'i lho nub mtshams brag phug ma ra ti ka na slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng dang: dgyes bsted lha lcam man+da ras: ste 'chi med pa'i tshe dbang thob: bsres grod bral ba'i sku

shā/ /zu mchog brtes: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la babs: de 'og bskal pa tha ma la: rngams brjid srin po'i thod btegs pa'i: lhun grub pad+ma 'od zhing nas:gzhon nu khye'u chung ye shes blo: mkha' 'gro ting 'dzin dbang mo ches: skye 'chi bral ba'i tshe dbang thob bsgres rgud bral ba'i sku mchog brtes: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab:da lta snyegs ma lnga yi dus: las ldan sgrub mchog pho mo yis: gas ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'dir: rdo rje tshe mchog sgrub pa laḥ khyed rnams thugs rje'i dbang yang bskur:'chi ba med pa'i tshe dbang bskur: bsgres bral rdo rje'i sku 'grub mdzod: byin rlabs gze mdangs nus pa bskyed: nyams rtogs yon tan rtsal chen sbor: dwangs bcud bkra shis bum par bskyil: dab mchog sgrub pa po la bskur: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: lan gsum bskul la ma da' dar g.yab mos gus gdung sa ba drag po bskyed de'i che 'khor 'ad rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi da ja dang byin rlabs dang sa grub thams cad char ltar dbab ste skal lan sgrub — po la bstims nas 'chi med rig 'dzan rdo rje'i sku mchog grub pa ra dmigs la yin tshe sbyo: g.yu sbyo: g.yu tshe sbyo: a

561 na gasdo/ tshe hūṃ: smra bcad tang 'dzin brtan po yis bzlas pa chu bo' rgyun bzhin bskyar 'bum gsum grub pas nyams rtogs rgyas the tshom med do sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gsum pa mchod ci bstod pa ni dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten 'brel snying gsum gsum bzlas la lhag chad bskangs snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do hūṃ trī: gzung ba rnam dag kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin: tshogs drug rang grol 'dod yon lha mo'i gar: 'dzin pa klong sbyor rig stong mchod sprin gyis sku gsum lhun rdzogs 'phags ma'i dgyes pa bskangs bla ma hā pañtsa byu dza ho: shā nyi skyon gyis ma gos dri bral shel ltar dkar: 'od snang mtha' yas rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs: thugs rje brtse bas rtag tu 'gro phan sgrub: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lor phyag 'tshal bstod: de na smon lam ni hrī rnal 'byor khams drug 'dus pa'i rten: bla srog dwangs ma'i thig le la: mi 'gyur ye shes rgya yis thob: tshe sgog nub med ka ba tshug: lo brgya thub pa'i tshe 'dzug cig: ston brgya mthong ba'i tshe thob cig sa ni ste med chos dbyings rgya: sbyoḥni 'dod 'byang mnyam nyid rgya: tram̐X ni mi 'grur rdo rje'i rgya: hri ni smon bral pada'i rgya āḥni bya ba
