༷/ kun grub rgya: rgyal ba rigs lnga'iphyag rgya yis: yum chen lnga 〈 rnam par bstims: 'dir 'dus rnal 'byor pho mo rnams: tshe sgrub mthar phyin byang chub shog:dge ba bsngo zhi smon lam gdab mtha' ston dge mtshan rgya chen bya de ldan don rnams gegs med 'grub the tshom med do sa rma rwa e ma tshe bdag pad+ma thod 'phreng ngas bstan 'gror brtse ba'i lag bsam gyis 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo ya zab bcud tshe 'dzug rdzongs chen 'ad 'aprog mi khye'u chung lo tsar sbyan spel ba'i dus min brda la dril rdo rje'i bka' bzhin gter rgyas btab zil bcun chen mor gter bya gtad dus bab snyigs ma lnga yi dus dpa' bo nusaldan rdo rje yis bkra shis sgo mang gshams nas rted gdul bya'i lhag ma smin grol byed yid gnyis ma dgos rdo rje' bka' sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi ces pa 'di'ang chos bdag dharma ku mud da / lu zin kun bzang bstan 'dzan dar rgyas kyibaskur ngor/ bdag 'dra dpa' bo nusaldan 'dusapa rtsal lam klong yang bsam gtan gling pasamakha' 'gro'i gsang brnga zab mo dag pa ra pha ba pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo le/dge'o/ bkra shis/
rgi zab chos 'od ga/bye //sa thig las:dril skrub byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs so:

na mo gu ru we zarmya ba snyi dad ldan sgrub la snyi rus can gang zhag smin zhing grol ba'i phyir rje bcun myur ma ta re ya dril sgrub byin rlabs sprin phung bstan sa ma yā sgrub jos gyinang gsal ba dben par dam rgya bcad nas sgom bar chad rkyen las rgyal ba'i phyar bgegs la 'bras glud gto ba na hrīḥ bdag nyid skad cig gis gnyug ma'i lha dbang chen he ru ga: dmar po g.yas rdo dbyug pa dang g.yon zhags pa bsdams pa: dur khrod dpal chas kyi mdzes par klubs shing gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa spyi gtsug na rta skad bton pas 'byung po gas shing: gdon bgegs zil gyi gnon par byed pa'i sku rngams brjid bltar mi bzod par gsal la: bgegs btor byan rlabs na spyo las rin po che'i snod du oṃ las glu ra 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung po zad mi shes pa'i gter chen por dmigs la: sam bha ra dang a ka ros zad med gter du spel bar bya sa ma yu de nas gnyen po rgyad kyi lha bdag nyid chen gnas su gyur pa las: dran rdzogs gnyug ma'i lha mchog yid bzhin grub pa'i rgyal mo: dpal 'bar bzod par dka' ba'i bkrags mdangs dang ldan par gsal

ba'i: sku las rdo rje khro tshogs kyi rdul spros pas 'byung po bskrad gzhom brlag pa'i mthu dang ldan par bskyed do: gzhung bsnyo bka' bsgo zhing glud bsngo ba ni hūṃ /ཿ byang sgrub la 'tshe ba'i bdud: skabs blta glags tshol 'byung po'i rigs: sngon gyi lan chags slong ba dang: 'phral du glud la re ba rnams: sku glud nam mkha' mda' 'phang gtor skyu chang bu zhal zas dang mar me 'bras chan 'dod pa'i yas: ma tshang med pa mig 'phrul gter zad pa bral ba nam mkha' mdzod: sgyu ma'i rnal 'dre ra bdag 'bul: 'dir gnod 'byung po yongs la bsngo: pham rgyal 'thab rtsod ma dmigs par: zhi zhing byams dang brtse bas spyod: rgol 'che'i bsam sbyor log pa spo sa: mi ga byang chub sems la slob zhi bde rin chen gling spyod na: ci bsam bgrub po sa ma yā: gal te mi nyan 'tshe gyur na: de la rdo rje 'chang khros nas: lus srog dngos po bral byed: rnam smin rdo rje'i dmyal bar spyod: de bas ma 'tshe phyir dengs shig 〉 〉ཿsarba bisna gastso / bzhing sngag brjod thun gyis brab de nas srung gur ni hūṃ nyi steng 'og phyogs

bcu'i sa rnams la: dbang bsgyur khro chen he ru gaḥ / dar rnam rgyal gshin rje'i gshed: rta mgrin bdud 'khrul dbyug sngon can mi g.yo 'dod rgyal khams gsum rgyal srid gsum zil gnon chen po bcu: rang 'dra'i khro chung rdul ltar 'tshubs: za gsod pho nya glog ltar 'khyug: sbyor sgrol las rngams khra thabs bcas: phyogs mtshams gdon gyi gshed du shar: 'byung po bzhob bsreg rdul brlag mdzod: bde chen srung ba'i rwa gur dkrigs: o ha ha ru lu ru lu he ru bisne ta krita phaṭa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: de nas gags pa na e:sems nyid ye sangs rgyas mod kyang: rtog pa'i bdud sprin 'khrigs pa las lhan skyes 'phags ma'i zhal ma mthong mu bzhir gol ba dbu mar bshags: nyes badz+ra sa ma yu bhi shudhe āḥ de nas lha bskyed ni trī: spros bral chos sku dag pa'i mkha' dri med snying rje yongs su 'khyil: bde chen rdo rje rig pa hūṃ: rten 'brel rgyu yi ngo bor shar badz+ra sa ma dhi hūṃ hrīḥ stong chen yum lnga'i mkha' klong du: lhun grub thabs chen bkod rdzogs pa'i: dri med 'od gsal zhing gi dbus: ye shes sgyu 'phrul gzhal med khang sgo gru rta babs mtshan

༷/ nyid rdzogs chags pas ma gos pad+ma dang thabs shes nyi zla zung 'jug steng rig pa hūṃXyig las skyes pa'i: yid bzhin 'khor lo grub pa mo sku ni dung gi ri bo la: nyin phyed 'bum 'khyud bkrag mdangs 'bar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum mdzes sgegs: ye shes gzigs tshul bdun dang ldan: dar dang rat+na'i rgyan gyis mdzes: phyag g.yas pad sdong tshe dar 'dzin: g.yon pa 'chi med dpal bum brten: zhabs ni sems ma'i phyed skyil bzhugs: 'ja' 'od thig le 'khrigs pa'i 1nga snang stong ma 'dres sa ler gsal: rigs bdag 'chi med 'od mtha' yas: dmar gsal tshe dar bum pa 'dzin: longs sku'i rgyan rdzogs mtshan dpe 'bar kun khyab spyan ldan skyil krung bzhugs: tshe 'dzin grub pa'i rgyal mo yi: sku la gnas yul mkha' 'gro dang: dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma: rig sngags zhing skyes ḍāk+ki shar kun kyang ma 'dres 'od phung 'bar: mtha' 'khor rdo rje tshe yi lha: sgeg 'gying glu gar chen mo dang: smin grub mchog ster dbyings phyug ma: 'gugs 'ching sdom myos las byed bcas: ma lus 'ja'

tshon shar ba bzhin: brda don rtags rdzogs chen po gsal: thugs gar gser 'khorartsibs brgyad pa'i: dbus su hūṃ yig dkar gsal la: brten byed snying po zung gis brgyan: 'dab mar srog sngags 'bru zung bkod: bzlas pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas mchod: 'khor 'das dpal yon dwangs ma bkugs: ye shes lha la sib sib bstims:gnyis med bde ba chen por gyur: spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag mchod cing bstod de nas bzlas pa 'i 'brula'akhor ni trī rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs ka dza dbyangs gsal nyi zla kha sbyor sbubs gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad ster rig pa hūṃḥl āḥzloḥbarten: 'dab mar sngags phreng g.yon du bkod: bzlas pas tshe dang ye shes rgyas: bsod nams gter chen rdol ba dang snang grags rig gsum bde ba che: lha sngags phyag rgya chos sku'i ngang: ma tā re tut+ta re tu re ma ma āḥyuḥpurmye dzñā na puṣ+ṭi ku ru hūṃ: rig stong sor bzhag dgong sa pa skyongs sna srid chos skur rtogs pa na lhan skyes bla la 'pho 'gyur med rten 'brel gnod pas tshug mi 'gyur sa ma yāḥ de nas srog 'khar sgrub pa niḥ hrīḥ rang sgog sngags phreng mchod sprin gyis: 'phags ma'i gsang ba

shā/ka/ca gsum rdzogs dal: rtag tu mchod cing 'khor 'das kyi: dpal yon dwangs ma gcig tu bsre: ye shes sgyu 'phrul dam tshig gi: tshe rten srog rten bla rten ste:rten 'brel dpal gso don dam par: nyams rtogs 'phel rgyas dpal du dmigs: 37 tā re tut+ta re tu re ma ma ā yuXpurmye dzñā na puṣ+ṭi ku ru hūṃ tshe dang ye shes bsod nams 'phel ba'i rten du gyur cig badz+ra rak+ta rak+ṣa: dgongs pa ma 'gyur bzer ldan pas 'phro 'du phran las rta la dra sa 'khor 'das dang dwangs ma gcig tu bsre tshe bsod ye shes 'phel rgyas 'gyur sa ma rwa ཿ de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni kye: ye shes gzigs pa'i spyan ldan ma: yid bzhin 'khor lo grub pa mo: dang po bsnyen cing bar du sgrub: tha ma bsags spel rgya cher spros: bdag gis dka' ba dngas du blang ngal ba khyad bsad khyed sgrub kyis: 'chi med tshe yi gzi byin phob zad med nor gyi dngos grub stsol: mi rmong ye shes rgyas par mdzod nye brgyud pad+ma'i rang lugs la bshad sgrub bya ba mthar phyin nas: ma khyod thugs kyi dbyings klong der: bdag gi spyod pa'i skal bzang stsol: thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yā zhes gsol

ba kur tshugs su gdabs so sa ma yu skabs su nyunye bskrad dgos na du pa da tshang zag rdzas byug: gru gsum sgod gzhugs gtum rngams dang ldan pa 'i ngabhe nas e bskyed na yis ma((5 sbyo: mdun du lcags khang gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du: sgrub pa la 'tshe zhing dngos grub rku ba'i dam sri nyul+le thams cad nyam thag pa'i tshul du gnas par mos la: bden brjod na na mo: dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa ba gsum dang bden gnyis baspu ba med pa'i bden mthu dang: khyad par du rgyal yum yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bden pa'i mthus: sgrub pa zab mo la 'tshe zhing dngos grub rku bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad gzugs rū pa 'di la khug cig: lan grangs mang du brjod tri:a ga dza dza:dza hūṃ baṃ ho: rol mo mtshams rngams 4sate hūṃ bh+yo e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: 'bar ba gtum chen rngam pa'i sku khros pa'i nyams rdzogs sdang mig can: 'jigs byed kun thub rgyal mo yis: khams gsum tshogs su brgyar nus shing: srid gsum dam la 'dogs lags pas tshangs dbang bsod nams

༷ lus can 'dar 'byung po rnams la smos ci dgos: khrag 'thung rdo rje brtul zhugs can: gnad nas bskul lo da bzhengs shig 'tshe ba'i dam sri pho mo rnamashā: rdul du brlag te tshogs su 'bul: don dam dbyings kyi dgongs par bskyil: rnam smin 'khor ba ka dag mdzod: tri tri khur hūṃ rbad bse 'gong be ze ram̐ ram̐: 'gong po spun dgu'i sgog la hur rbad: gzer sum̐ ram̐ ram̐: sgrub pa zab mo la 'tshe ba'i 'gong po dam sri 'byung po thams cad ma ra ya nan: sto bha ya nan: na sha ya nan: bhan+ta ya nan ting 'dzin rdo rje' sgrom du bzhugs bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur sa ma yā de nas mar me' smon lam ni ho bde ba kun gyi rtser son pa ye shes gsang ba'i snying po ni blo bral so so rang rigs pas: kun gsal rtogs pa mngon gyur shog sku gsum rang chas rgyal srid la yid pa med pa'i lta ba'i klong: min pa med bral sgom pa'i bab: rtog ge grol bar gdengs thob shog rnam pa kun tu yang dag lam̐ gnyis ga'i mtha' grol spyod pa yisaḥ 'bras bu sang yang mngon sum bya: rdzogs pa chen por phyam brdal re ga thogs bcas

yul med zang thal bsgrod: dga' brod re dogs rdzun mtshang stong: thogs med 'dzin rtogs gzhi rtsa grol: snyems byed 'khrul ba cer grol shog: bdud 'dul sngags kyi rnal 'byer gyis: mkha' ltar dag pa'i ye grol mjal: lhun grub rang byu bde 1nga spyod: shar grol ro mnyam mngon gyur shog mngon sum snang ba lhug par mthong: 'khrul ba gtan ldog nyams snang grol: tshad pheb rgya grol rig gsang mthong kun khyab chos skur byang chub shog: ye zad yul zad kun zad nas: nang gsal kun tu bzang po'i klong:khyad chos drug ldan rgyal sa la: 'bad med lhun gyis grub par shog: 'khrul 'khor bkod pa dongs sprugs nas: du ma rang grol 'ub chub klong sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa dang /yid bzhin 'khor lor dbang bsgyur shog: gting gsal bum skur phyams brdal nas: sku thugs ye shes mdzad phrin stobs: gang yang nub pa mi mnga' bar: khyab brdal spros mtha' bral thob 31ga: de ltar smon lam gdab pa ra bya sa ma yu de nas rdul tshon bsdu ba ni e: dang po ka dag chos sku'i klong las byung: bar du ye shes sgyu 'phrul byin rlabs sprin: tha

zu ma bsgrub bya sgrub byed dbyer med gyur: dongs sprugs mdzad pa mi nub 'phel rgyas phyir rdul tshon dkyil 'khor ye shes tshos skur bsdu: kun khyab brdal ba por badz+ra hūṃḥ zhes thag tshon bsdu de nas bsngo smon na hrī: chos sku nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nyid las: lhun grub longs skur bkod pa'i gzi byin dang kun khyab phrin las sprul skur ‘da pa'i dge 'khor gsum yongs mnyam ka dag lhug par bzhag: 'khrul 'khor bzhir sangs bum skur byang chub sgo ga lan gsum gdab po de nas shis brjod ni na mo: rdul dri mas ma gos gangs ltar gsal: gdul bya'i rmongs mun 'bar ba'i 'od kyis sel: rnam kun mchog ldan dbyings kyi phyag rgya che: kun khyab yid bzhin 'khor 76) bkra / regag: de ltar grub pas don gnyas 'byung yid bzhin dpal 'phel ze ma tshom sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya yim rgyal dbang pad+ma thod 'greng ngas snyags ma'i 'gro ba snying rje' yul 'khor bar ma spob snye brgyud gter chos gang zag pha na bder bzhag sku dngos rje 'ab sa sprul pa yis bod 'bangs skyobs po ma 'ong sa rnams zab gter 'od gsal thugs thig skor bkra shis sgo mang gsham der sbas ma 'o sa dus kyi tha ma la nga sprulanus ldan

dpa' bo rnyed de bar srung shig sman btsun ma dam log lag tu bcud ma shor thugs kyi bu la sprad mdzod cig sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi zhes pa 'da'ang lung zin chos bdag rnams kyis bskul ba dang / grogs kya tshe 'phrang bsal ba' phyir du/ kho bo nus ldan rdo rjesamakha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las zhal bshus te/ dag par phab ba' yi ge pa ni chos bdagapo /rta bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga la/
༷/ zab chos 'od gsal thurteX dī/ gā// 'phags ma'i thugs sgrub gter gyi bum bzang bzhugs so:

zu na sna gu dzag we: tshanartenashā khe las ldan snying rus ldan pa yi 'phags ma'i bsnyen sgrub brtsam pa'i tshe dang po sa chog bya ba ni dkar gtor rnam lnga'i rgyan can bshams sngags dang phyag rgyas sa sbyangs spel snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad do e ma hoḥ ngo mtshar bkra shis kun gyi gzhi: yid bzhin grub pa'i rgyal mo yi: dkyil 'khor gnyan po bzhengs pa la: 'dir sa zo dor dregs can gyis: ru nga phrag dog mi mdzad par: sa yon mchod gtor skyems bzhes la: sa gzhi bdag zhu gnang bar mdzod: ma lo ka pā la bha lirnyi kha kha khā hi / : lan bdun gyi phul phrin las bcol de nas sa yi lha mo brngan pa na skyi( bhu mi pa ti sa ma ya dza zhes sa ya lha mo spyan dra sa kye: rgyal ba shākya siṅga dang: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po yis: mdo sngags na pa'i gzhi bzung tshe bshad sgrub byed po'i gnyer sgrub zhes: khas blangs sa yi lha mo dang: sa lha sa 'dzin sa bdag rnams thogs med stobs kyis 'dir byon cig:na mchod dga' ston 'di bzhes la: bdag gi byang chub skrub pa laḥ phyi nang gsang rkyen tha dag sol: dngos grub rgyang thags mi ring bar: dkyil 'bor 'dir 'grub brin

sdes/ zu las stsol: mtha' yas sems can thams cad kun: srid pa'i mtsho las dbugs dbyung ba'i: thabs stobs smon lam mnga' thang bskyed: byang chub spyod mchag mthar phyin nas: sku gsum rgyal sar mnga' brtes shog: snye bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wa ri e de bha lirnya kha kha khā hi khā hi: 'a na bdun gyas phul che lha mos 'dzum pa'i mdangs byung ste phyag byas nas sa la thim par gyur de nas thig tshon bya ba ni gzha steng tshon lnga bshams 'i mthar kun bzang zhabs bsil bzha skor bshams daro sa mtshan stong par sbya sa byas te ye bkra shis rat+na mjes pa'i snod: skyon bral yid du 'ong ba phu mkha' tshon mthing ga dbyings phyug ma: chu tshon dkar po sgeg pa ma: sa tshon ser po 'gyeng ma'i 1nga: me tshon dmar po glu ma'i zhal rlung tshon ljang gu gar ma ste: sna tshogs mdzes tshon smin grub dbyings: rdo rje tshe yi rang bzhin can rten gyi dkyil 'khor phun tshogs gyur: dbyings bzhugs yab lnga yum lnga bskul: dam tshig rdzas dang gnyis med bsre: bde chen 'byung ba'i gzhi ru spro: snyen (tswa hrīchosangat+na sarba puṣ+ṭi sirnyi pha la shā: nyer gcig brjod la sngags kya mchod bstod pa phyag rgya ldan

pa sa byas lha tshogs 'od zhu thig tshon rnam par gyur: de nas zig za bkye ni sbyo bde chen sang yangasabha ga la: rgyal kun gsang rdzogs bya chub sems ye shes lnga yi thig bkye'o: sgyu 'phrul bkod pa 'ub chub shog: e hūṃ rat+na baṃ le rta ye puṣ+ṭi maṇ+ḍal oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hāX ces brjod la thig bkye'o de nas ma tram̐ bsgral ba ni 'gug bstims byas pa 'di lha ra gyer hūṃ /: ma tram̐ bya ba'i sdig can khyodaḥ dug gsum ma rig las la skyes: gsang sngags bstan pa'i snying po bcom: rang 'khrul gzhan mnar a 'thas bdud: thugs rje thabs kyis ma bsgral na: rnam smin thar med ngan song phyong: de phyir chos kyi dbyings su phaṭaX sarba dra ༅ mā ra ya phaṭa: ( hūṃ: du tra bsgral ba'i phung khams kyisaḥ gsang sngags bstan pa 'byung ba'i phyir: dur khrod brgyad kyi bkod par bskrun rman byung rdo rje'i da la bzhengs: e spyo rat+na maṇ+ḍal spa ra ṇa phaṭa saṃ hā ra ṇa hūṃ: de nas dur khrod byin 'bebs ni sha yo dud btang rol mo sgrogs hri: ste med dbyings las 'gags med 'phrul bde chen rdo rjes gsang ba'i dal: dri bral bsil ba'i tshal du shar: yon tan lcan 'thug sna la rdzogs: ma chags bde

༷/— klong pad+ma brtsegs:las rnams mthar phyin 'jigs byed tshal: bde ba'i dpal rgyas ro gling tshal: spros pa kun dag bde chen rol:'bar ba'i rang bzhin laṅga brtsegs:cha snyoms mi g.yo gsang chen rol:phra yul snang ba mtha' bral la:phra rtog gcan gzan sha za sgyu: dngos 'dzin baṃ ro bcad 'phro ldan:rdul bral phyogs skyong chung mar bcas:snying stobs rnam dag zhing skyongs shing:mun sang mtsho dang na ga brgyad:khengs grol rdo rje phra min che: rang byung ye shes rig 'dzin dang:shes rab chen po grub pa'i zhal: rig stong he ru ka dpal gyi: rgyan du sems rtog tshogs brgyad bcas:brko da pa dur che da chen por bskrun:snang ba sku ru byin phob cig: grags pa gsung su rgyas thob la: 'gyu 'phro thugs su dbab bskur nas:sku gsum zhang bkod phun tshogs gyur:gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki ni sarba sarba hrīng hrīng a zhes che ba bskyed de nas rig 'ari na byin 'bebs ni /:byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: rang bzhin gsang ba chen po dra lhun gyi grub pa'i dngos grub brtes:ya mtshan rmad byung mthu thob pa:mtsho skyes pad+ma rgyal po rtsal:nyi ma

'char dkyil zer 'bar ba:shes rab mchog gi blo ldan pa:thub pa'i rgyal tshab shākya seng:sde gsum mdzod 'dzin saṃ bha wa 'jigs lta zil gnon seng ge'i sgra:snyigs ma'i skyabs mgon khro bo lod:gangs ldongs mun sel dbang po'i sde bde stong dpal sbyin so khyar grags:zab gter mdzad ston gshog rgod rtsal:dregs pa dam 'dogs mkha' lding rgyal:mkha' 'gro tshogs rje a tsār+ya:rak+ta'i rgyal po thod 'phreng rtsal:phrin las mtha' yas snyigs ma'i mgon:sa rgyan pad+ma gangs can mtsho:rdo rje bde rol grub pa'i rje:pad+ma mi nub bdud 'joms gling brtse chen ye shes gzigs pa can:mos ldan bdag gis khyod 'bod na:dpal gyi ri nas spyan 'dren byon:ging gi tshogs bcas gshegs su gsol:ston 'khor yongs rdzogs 'dir byon nas sgrub mchog rnal 'byor pho mo la:mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gzi byin phob:rig 'dzin rgya mtshos rtogs pa spor:ma sring rnams kyis bde stong bskyed:yid bzhin 'khor los tshe bsod spel:byin chen rnams kyi byin phob cig dbang chen rnams kyi dbang bskur cig:rtags mtshan

༷/ ma g.yel myur du ston: mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsol: o gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki ni sarba sa ma ya phe pho a we sha ya a ā: ces byan chen nan du dbab pa ra bya'o de nas lhag lha'i byin dbab pa spos bsregs rol mo dbya sa dang bcas hrīphebarta: chos sku spros dang bral mod kyang: ma ngas sku ye shes gzigs pa can: sprul ba sna tshogs thabs mkhas gar 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo ma: tshe dang ye shes bsod nams gter: mi g.yo ka dag gting klong nas: 'gags med gzugs kyi rgyar bzhengs nas: byin phob dbang bskur rtogs pa spor sku la sgegs mos 'khyud stobs rol 'gying mas pad phreng rgyan du 'bul: glu ma'i gsung mchog chos 'khor bskul: gar mas 'khor ba ka dag byed ye shes sgyu 'phrul ma chen rnams: 'dir byon dbang bskur rtogs pa sbor: smin mas snang stong gar du ngoms: grub mas gsal stong gzigs pa 'gyed: mchog mas bde stong dga' bzhi sbyin: dbyings mas rig stong ka dag ston: chos nyid mkha' las sgyu 'phrul gar: 'dir byon dbang bskur rtogs pa spor: lcags kyus 'khor ba gnas nas 'dren:

zhags pas srid zhi mnyam par sbyor: sgrog gis gzung 'dzin mtshan ma sdom: dril bu'i chos sgra kun khyab byed: dam tshig ldan pa'i ma chen rnams: 'dir byon dbang bskur rtogs pa sbor: rdo rje grub pa'i gzi byin can 'pho med gnyug ma lhan skyes zhal: yid bzhin grub pa'i 'khor lo mas: skye 'chi med pa'i dbang chen bskur: bsgres rgud bral ba'i tshe bcud stsol: lus la sku yi byin phob cig: ngag la gsung gi byin phob cig: sems la thugs kyis byin phob cig: yon tan re skong byin phob cig phrin las 'gro 'dul byin phob cig lha dang skal ba mnyam par mdzod: slo dzñā na ār+ya tā re sarba sa ma ya phe phernyi dzaḥ/ baṃ ho: ces byin dbab la bstod pa na hūṃ nyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin kun khyab nam mkha' la: rdo rje rin chen pad ma las rdzogs pa'i: rdo rje'i zhing khams dri med 'od kyi klong: rdo rjer bkod pa'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal bstod: rdo rje'i rgyar grub ye shes gzhal med khang: rdo rje rta babs rgyan bkod phun sum tshogs: rdo rje 'gyur med gzer bu kun nas gdab rdo rje'i khang par bkod la phyag 'tshal bstod: rdo rjer bde sbyin pad+ma 'dab

rngo/|/ stong khar: rdo rje ye shes lhun grub nyi zla'i khar: rdo rje'i snying po hūṃ:las byung ba yi: rdo rje grub pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod: rdo rje'i rigs can gangs la nyi 'khrud zhal: rdo rje ltar bzhugs bde ba'i zhal bzang ngoms: rdo rje phun tshogs ye shes 'khor lor sbyor rdo rje grub pa'i rgyal mor phyag 'tshal bstod: rdo rje'i sku sgeg mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur can: rdo rje'i glu dbyangs phrin las gar du g.yo: rdo rje smin grub mchog dbyings mdzad pa can: 'gying ba de'i khongs su bstan mapha rdo rje tshad med bskrun la phyag 'tshal bstod: rdo rje'i gzi yis 'khor ba kha lo bsgyur rdo rje rdul gyis bdud tshogs g.yul las sgrol rdo rje bde bar 'khor 'das mnyam par sbyor: rdo rje spro bsdu'i gzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod rdo rje'i gdung 'dzin rnal 'byor pho mo rnams rdo rje'i rang bzhin gnyug ma de kho na: rdo rje grub pa'i lha ru mngon sum byas: rdo rje bde brtsegs gsung gsang mchog thob 31ga: de ltar rdo rje'i bstod ri phul phyag rgya'i rig 'dzan rten 'brel bsgrigs sa ma yāḥ de nas lha sku'i gsal snang na hrī: ka dag dasgo ngas pa de bzhin nyid: so ma rang 17la snying rje'i

mdangs rig pa hūṃ yig bkrags 'bar ba:sna tshogs 'byung ba'i gzhi ru shar:37 badz+ra sa ma dhi hūṃ:hrī:'byung ba chen po nam mkha'i klong:bde mchog ye shes sgyu 'phrul gar:phun tshogs nam mkha' mdzod chen po:ting 'dzin rdo rje'i ltad mor shar rang byung lhun grub gzhal med khang:sgo gru rta babs mtshan rdzogs dbus:chags bral ge sar 'dab rgyas khar:bde stong nyi zla zhal sbyor dbus:hūṃḥyig las byung rje btsun ma yid bzhin 'khor lo gangs ltar brjid:mdzum mdzes sgeg pa'i rnam 'gyur can:ye shes gzigs tshul bdun dang ldan:zhabs zung sems ma'i phyed skyil bzhugs:dar dang rin po che yis brgyan:phyag g.yas pad sdong tshe dar 'dzin g.yon pa 'chi med tshe bum brten snang stong ma 'dres sa ler gsal rigs bdag 'od snang mtha' yas shar:sku dbyings dwangs gsal rtsa 'khor klong rgyud sde rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs:ro mnyam bde ba mchog gi tshul:zhi khro til gong phyur bzhin rdzogs spyan las lha mo sgeg pa ma:glog ltar 'khyugs pas tshe bcud 'gugs snyan las lha mo 'bying ba mo:sprin ltar

༷ ca gtibs pas bkrag mdangs gso: ljags las lha mo glu dbyangs ma: skar ltar bkra bas drod dpal bskyed: sku las la mo gar bsgyur ma: 'ja' ltar bkra bas dbugs rlung spel shangs las smin grub mchog dbyings mas: gdul bya'i tshe bsod stobs 'byor bskyed: yan lags las byung pho nya bzhis: bde stong gnyis med mnyam nyid ston: kun kyang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor las: zer rnams khyab brdal 'phro ba bzhin gtso 'khor dgongs pa ro gcig ngang chos nyid ye mnyam chen por gsal dab bskur rgyas bawa spyan 'dren nas bzhugs phyag mchod bstod gang 'os phul de nas bzlas pa'i 'byul 'khor ni hrī: 'phags ma'i thugs 1 nga nyi zla'i sbubs: chos kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dbus: rig panywa la sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas 'khor 'das dpal yon bskul 'byung ba'i dngas ma gcig tu dril: snang grags rig gsum 'phags ma yi: dkyil 'khor gsum du dag mnyam rol sgo tā re tut+ta re tu re ma ma mkhye ā yung na puṣ+ṭi ku ru sbyo: dgongs pa chos nyid don la bzhag 'phro 'du phrin la sde kha bsgyur sa ma yā de nas gsol ba gdabs pa ni

kyi: rgyal kun ye shes rdo rje che: 'chi med grub pa'i dbang phyug mo: yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel ma: sgyu 'phrul mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung bcas: kun nas brtse ba chen pos dgongs: mgon med bdag la thugs rjes zungs: re ltos gzhan na ma mchis pas thugs rje zungs shig bka' drin can: 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dbang bskur bsgres rgud bral ba'i sku thob nas: lha dang skal ba mnyam gyur cig: cesagasol ba lan gsum gdab so de nas thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba ni (ཿ thugs dam chen po'i dus la babs sngon tshe bskal pa dang po la: bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas dang yum chen gsang ba ye shes maḥ tshe 'dzin grub pa'i rgyal mo dang stong nyid nam mkha'i rgyal po dang: rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: mkha' 'gro lha lcam man+ta ra dga' rab dṛ seng hūṃ ka ra: bi ma nam mkha'i snying po dang: bde chen rgya mtsho dbyings phyug ma: rin chen zhi mtsho bde ldan ma: shel dkar rdo rje gza' sgon sogs: ste 'chi bral ba'i tshe dbang thob: bsges sgod bral ba'i ska mchog brjes: khyed rnams thugs dam dus la bab: deng 'dir sgrab mchog pho mo la

༷ / 'chi med tshe yi dbang chen bskur: lus la gze mdangs bskyed du gsol ngag la nus pa spel du gsol: sems la bde ba bskyed du gsol: gling bzhi srid pa'i tshe bcud bstims: bkra shis bum pa'i nang du bskyil sgrub pa po la nub med stsol: khyed rnams thugs rjes rtag tu zungs 'khor ba srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol: pad+ma'i rig mchog snang mtha' yi: gsang ba gsum la dbang 'dresar regag: smon lam rgyas btab gzhan du bya de ni tshe rang lang tsho dar sa ma yu de nas mchi bslu bta ba' rjes bla 'gugs ga'u gtad pa ni snyen:bde bar gshegs pa sras dang bcas: rdo rje tshe yi lha tshogs dang: bde ldan kun gyi thugs rje yis: deng 'dir bdag cag yon mchod kyi bla srog lha 'dres 'phrog dang rkus:'byung lngar yal 'khyams ral pa rnams: rdo rje'i pho nya rnams kyis bsdus: 'gyur med tshe rten ga'u bstims: 'pho 'gyur med par rgyas thob la: sha khrag drod dbugs sems rnams kyi: gsos su bskyed cig tā:re ma: thugs dam ma g.yel tshe yi lha: rdo rje grub pa'i gzi mdangs bskyed: e brgya rtsa brjod yo: ci 'grub be gang skabs le grang ldan

re: brgya sogs brjod la gatha 'ams byin gyas rlabs par ba'o sa ma yu de nas tshe 'gugs rgyas par bya bla gso dbus kyis ga'u gtad byas la /: skye med nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid: rdo rje dbyings phyug tshe yi lha'i phyag na dbyings kyi ga'u bsnams: tshe dang bsod nams dwangs bcud bskyil: rnal 'byor sems kyi tshe nyams na: nam mkha'i 1nga nas bcud bsdus la: tshe bsreng srog bskyed bla 'khyams gsos: 'chi med ye shes ka chen tshugs: e lo grangs brjod eḥ.a dhiṣ+ṭha na a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūṃ: lho yi ga'u gam la sa: sra brtan sa yi rang bzhin ni: rin chen dbyings phyug tshe yi lha'i: phyag na nyi zla'i ga'u bsnams tshe bsod dwangs ma gcig tu dril rnal 'byor sha khams tshe nyams na: sa yi klong nas bcud bsdus la tshe bsreng sgog bskyed bla 'khyams gsos: 'chi med ye shes ka chen tshugs: lam̐ḥ lo grang ya brjod leḥ.a dharnyi na bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āX/ཿ de nas bya ga ga'u gam la saX yang zhing g.yo ba rlung gi klong las rab dbyings spyag tshe yi lha'i: phyag nas g.yu yi ga'u bsnams tshe bsod dwangs ma 'ub bsdas pa: rnal 'byor dbugs kyi tshe nyams na: rlang gi khams nas bcud bsngas

༷/zu la tshe bsreng srog bskyed bla 'khyams gsos: 'chi med ye shes ka chen tshugs: ye lo gra sa brngo da ye a dhiṣ+ṭha na a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūṃ: de nas shar gyi ga'u gtad la /:rlan shad gsher ba chu yi slong: bde gshegs dbyings phyug tshe yi lha phyag na shel gyi ga'u bsnams tshe bsreng srog bskyed bla 'khyams gsos: 'chi med ye shes srog ka tshugs:rba lo gra sa brjod rba a dhiṣ+ṭha na a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥ/ de nas nub kyi ga'u gtad la shāḥ tsha shing bsregs pa me yi klong pad+ma dbyings phyug tshe yi lha'i: phyag na me yi ga'u bsnams tshe bsod dwangs bcud 'ub bsdus dpal: rnal 'byor drod kyi tshe nyams na: me yi khams nas bcud bsdus la tshe bsreng sgog bskyed bla 'khyams gsos: 'chi med ye shes ka chen tshug: re lo gra pas brjod re:a dhiṣ+ṭha na a bhi shikwa oṃ āḥ hūṃḥ snying ga lce dang rna ba dang kha dang mig la dwangs ma bsre dus la bab pa 'i mi yin kyang re zhig bsgol thob yad gnyas bral sa ma yu de nas shis brjod ni ga'u rigs lnga snyi gar 'dzin du bcug oṃ 'grub par gyur cig lha dang sngags smin par mdzod cig rig dang blo: grol bar gyur cig sgo gsum yul: rgyas par mdzod cig

tshe bsod nams: dar bar gyur cig bkrag mdangs dpal: 'byer bar mdzod cig phywa dang g.yang: 'phel bar gyur cig nyams rtogs sgo: thob par mdzod cig sku gsung thugs: yid bzhin 'khor lo'i byin rlabs kyis: smon lam gegs med 'grub gyur cig: lan gsum gdabs po sam pā de nas 'chi bzlog ni hūṃ nyi 'od snang mtha' yas byin rlabs dang: yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bden stobs kyis: 'jigs dang sdug bsngal mi 'thun phyogs: zhi ba chos nyid chen por bzlog: lan gsum brjod shes brjod la sogs spya ltar bya sa ma mā de nas sgrub pa grol ba' tshe gter sped bya ba 'di ltar ro e ma: bkra shis kun gyi rtser son pa: tshe dang ye shes bsod nams dpal: nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa nas yid bzhin 'khor los bskyed par byas: de las byung ba'i dge legs rgyun: mi nub phyogs bcu'i zhing khyab kun: gdul bya'i pad tshal rab rgyas phyir: sa yi lha mo' mkha' dbyings su:bsod nams phywa g.yang gter sted do: mu ges rgud pa zhi gyur cig: bkra shis tshe rten gter sped do: dus min 'chi rkyen zhi bar shog: 'bru sna dar zab gter sted do dbul

zu phongs rgud pa zhi gyur cig: sman sna sna tshogs gter sbed do: nad kyi rkyen kun zhi gyur cig bkra shis rdzogs ldan lang tsho la: skye rgyas rtag par spyod pa dang:bde chos kyi mdzad spyod la: kun kyang rtag tu gnas pa dang sku gsum lhun grub 'phags ma'i dru : bde chen byang chub mchog thob re ga shis pa brjod ci me tog 'thor de ni /sa bsam pa 'grub sa ma ya de nas sku drin gso ba ni e ma ho dag chen mnyam nyid bde ba'i dbyings: sgyu 'phrul gsal ba'i me ma nga ngor: ye shes gzigs pa'i zhal bstan nas:tan bkod pa ma 'dres par: gsal bar stsol ba'i sku drin can: brtse chen thugs rje bdag la dgongs sku gsum lhun grub rgyal srid gtad: rig pa ye shes lam la bsam gtan bde sbyin btsun mo dang shes rab chen po'i khyim bdag po: dad pa'i 'khor lo rin po che: snying rje yid bzhin nor bu'i dpal: gang shar rang grol rta ga dang: tshogs drug mnyam rdzogs glang po'i 'gros bdud bzhi zil gnon dmags dpon ste: phul byung dge ba'i srid 'byor ba dpa' bo khyod kyi sku drin yin: bum

gsang shes rab tshig dbang gis: snang stong gsal stong bde stong dang:dri bral rig stong rjen par 'jal: de yang nyid kyi sku drin lags: lugs 'byung snang ba bde slong spyor:sgo gsum mtshan ma ka nas dag: snang sems rig pa'i sang du sangs:rtog pa de ya nyid kyi mthu: mkha' ltar dag pa'i lta ba rtogs nyi ltar gsal ba'i sgom pa mjal:'ja' ltar mtshan stong spyod pa byung: de yang khyod kyi sku drin yin: sna tshogs ma 'dres sprul ba'i slong: sgrib med zang thal longs spyod rdzogs: ye shes gting gsal chos sku mthong: blo bral nyid kyi thugs rje de: stong gsum nor snas bkang na'ang: yon du gzhal ba mi 'os kyang: rig pa ye shes maṇ+ḍal dang: bde stong phyag rgya yid 'ong ma dri bral mtshon rdzas lha reg dang dza gad pañtsa a dṛ ta: dpa' bo' sku gsung thugs la 'bul brtse ba chen pos rab bzhes nas bdag sogs stso ba ma brgyud par bcas: khyed thugs bum bzang ga'ur bzhugs: mi ldog bde chen sa thob cing: spros bral thugs la mnga' brtes 31ga: ces sku drin gso ba'i pon ci 'byor 'bul zhing zhabs spyi bor bla nas gsol ba rtse

0sgo// gcag tu gdab po sa ma yu mar me'i smon lam rgya cher gdab rdul tshon bsdu zhing chu ru gshegs sbyan mas sngags bcas chag chag gdab tshe rabs sgrub pa mthar phyin cing tshul btsun thom gtsang nyams rtogs 'aze la dgos pa che phyir gzab par bya sa ma yāḥ ye ma zab pa lasakyang che gzab pa gsang ba las kyang gsang mchog gnad dam chos 'od gsal thugs thig skor rgyal dbang pad+ma snya was ma 'ongs gdul bya skyobs phyir bstan 'brog ban lo ༷'i dpal du shar spel ba'i dus tshig snyigs ma'i skabs rig 'dzan bdud mjoms he ru ka bstan 'gro'i dpa la du bzhe sa ba' tshe de ya pha nor zab pa 'i mazil mdo khams bkra shis sgo mang nas yi gas mdzod 'ad rnyed de phan bde'i nyi ma gsal bar byed de bar srungs shag sman btsun ma bka' log lag tu ma shor cig thugs sras chos rgyud 'dzan la spel sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu h+ya brda thim lja zhes pa 'di' lung zin chos bdag rnams kyis bskul ba da grogs kyi 'phral rkyen bsal phyir kho bo pad+ma nu ldan 'dusapa stsalagyisadag par phab pa 'i yi ge pa ni lung zin tham kārtisabagyas pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo la/

༷ /zu chos skyo mchod gtor byin brlabs na re ye kho: stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod sgyed kyi khar: spyo las bhan+ta ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dkar gsum dang mngar gsum 'bru sman gtso bor gyur ba'i bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib 'dod yon nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur: skyirngo a:snye ma hā ba lirnyi pañtsa a dṛ ta gu h+ya na ma ye swā hā: lan bdun mchod gtor rnams ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po la: rnam pa chos skyong rang rang gi yul spyod dang mthun pa'i mdzes pa gzugs: snyan pa sgra zhim pa dri: mngar skyur ro: 'jam mnyen gos: mchod bskang brten sgrub kyi rdzas ma tshang ba med pa mig 'phrul lta bu'i gter chen po gcig tu gyur: slo u( ha ho hrī: rang nyid yi dam lar gsal ba'i mdun du: ting 'dzin sprul pa'i gnas mchog gzhan 'phrul lha yi bkod pa las kya khyad par 'phags pa: mthong bas yid 'phrog cing mdzes bkod lta na sdag pa: ngo mtshar zhing gi bkod pa chen po phun sum tshogs par gyur: snyen badz+ra spra ra ṇa khaṃ de ltar ta re 'dzin gya sprin ngo mtshar bkod pa khyad 'phags 'thul sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya ces pa
'da'ang rnal 'byor kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas dgyes phyir/ khrag 'thung nusaldan rdo rjesagasang brda'i zhal bu las bshus de dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba laṅga le/
bye/ zab chos 'od gsal thugs thig ༷/sa/hūṃn btsun rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i gsol mchod dgos 'dod char 'bebs bzhugs so:sngags bdag ral gcig mo da tshe ri mched lca garter bdag bcas pa'i mchod zengathun

za|/— na mo gu ru we:shāX slo 'phagasama'i tshe sgrub nyams len la nges pa ra 'byor ba'i skal ldan gyis bstan srung rdo rje g.yu sgron ma' bsnyen sgrub gsol mchod gzab par bya sa ma yā de yang dben gnas nyams dga' bar phyin la phya nang dam rgya sdoms srung ma'i bla rdo dung ga shā mag bral ཿdrug gsal ba nyad bzang drug rin chen sna lnga dang dkar dmar bye ru'i me tog bcas za 'og khug mar bkod nas su dal bzhugs mkha' 'gro'i bla rdor shes mchod spran nam mkha'i mtha' klas spel 'bags rtsog bral ba'i zas sna sogs 'dod yon ci 'byer rgya chen bsags rang nyid 'phags ma'i bskyed rim gyis mchod gtor bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs rol mo sna tshogs sgra dang bcas rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal mdun:shel mkhar gru bzhi 'od 'bar ba'i:mtha' bskor rat+na'i rwa ba mdzes:gter bum bsam 'phel 'dod 'jo ba:bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun:yid 'ong bkod pa du mas mdzes:sa gzhi me tog gcal bkram pa'i:mdzes rgyan mtsho rjeng rte'u sang la:sman gyi phung po dpag med bkra:rta mchog glang po ma he ba:'dod yon dkor nor bsam mi khyab:'ja' 'od g.yu sbrang dal bur 'bebs:rat+na'i khang bzang de yi dbus dar 'bol sna

༷yi/ tshogs brtsegs pa'i steng: sman btsun rdo rje g.yu sgron ma: sku ni dung ltar dkar ba la: gzi brjed nyi ma 'bum 'od 'byug: radzi'i srog zhu mdzes pa la dar dkar chings rgyan pad phreng gi thod gdengs dang ni do shal byas: dar dkar na bza' g.yang lugs mdzad: 'dung ma be+eḍūr 'od 'bar ba: rin chen phreng ba du mas brgyan:phyag g.yas 'dod 'byung gter bum 'dzin: snang gsal pra 'bebs me long g.yon: 'od lnga'i mu khyud 'khrigs pa'i dbus: zhabs gnyis btsun mo rol thabs bzhugs: sman phran sprul pa bsam yas 'gyed: phrin las sangs rgyas bstan la gdung: rnal 'byor pa la brtse sems che: ngo bo yum chen kun bzang mo rang bzhina.e ka dza ṭi ste: thugs rje ma 'gags g.yu yi sgron: 'bod pas snyan gsang myur 'gyogs can: tha tshig rdo rje'i gnad dbab na: rang bzhin gar bzhugs pho brang nas: rdzu 'phrul thogs med stobs bskyed la: ma 'khyang rtags mtshan bzang por bcas: 'dir gshegs sgrub pa'i rdzas la bzhugs: slo badz+ra pra mo ha tsit+ta trīng hrīng ja dza: bzlas sngags rgyun mi ra par bgrangs 'od zer rdo

rje'i dra ba dkrigs gang 'dod phrin las de bcol ba thogs med yid bzhin 'byung bar 'gyur sa ma yu dkar ma ra 'o skyems bzang po dang 'byu sna'i dkar gtor brjed ldan bshams sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs ting 'dzin nam mkha' mdzod du spel hrī: ting 'dzin sprul pa'i gnas mchog 'dir: lcam mo g.yu yi sgron ma pyon: dgyes bskyed mthun pa'i rdzas la bzhugs: phrin las sgrub phyir gus phyag 'tshal: khyed kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas: ye shes sgyu mar rol ba'i 'phrul: mtshan 'dzin dag pas phyi mchod bdun: nyon mongs rang grol 'dod yon lnga:dug gsum rnam dag sman gtor raka: rdo rje zil ba byang chub sems: pad+ma rak+ta bde ba'i klong: nyams bskang ga ṇa tsakra dang: shar grol 'gag med rdo rje'i mdangs: ri dwags g.yung dwags chu gnas bya phra rtog rol pa gcan gzan rigs: zhen med 'bru sman dar zab gos: chos can rgyan du rol ba yi: chos nyid mnyam pa mchod pa'i mchog: re rtogs lta ba'i la dor nas: rig stong gsang ba'i gar bskyur ba: mi shig rdo rje'i mchod sprin gyis: kun tu bzang mo gsol mchod bskangs e ka dza ṭi rdo rje g.yu sgron

/ rigs lnga'i sprul 'khor yang g.yog bsam yas bka' nyan pho nya de ltar mchod pa'i byin rlabs kyis nad kha chod la rims kha bsgyur: bdud dpung zil na dgra sde sod: dus 'khrug nad mug gzings pa bzlog: sad ser btsa' than med par mdzod: mdo sngags bstan pa 'dzin bsrung spel: zab gsang chos kyi gzhi gas shing phyogs las rnam par rgyal bzhin pas: 'jig rten bde ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces grangs bsogs gtor skyems mchod de nas bstod pa 'di ltar bya hūṃ bh+yo: dri tshogs skyon / ma gos gangs ri la: rta bdun 'od brgyas 'khyud pa'i gzi mdangs can: khyed zhal mthong bas skye rgu'i skom sel ba'i: yid 'phrog rdo rje g.yu yi sgron mar bstod: tshe sa kun tu mi 'bral lha khyed kyis: rjes bzungs mkhyen pa'i blo gros gsal bor bskyed phyi nang 'khrug rtsod zug rngu med par mdzod: dgra sod bgegs thul 'jigs pa las skyobs: tshe dpal bsod nams 'byor ba rjang rta bskyed: lha 'dre mi gsum blo bsgyur mnga' 'og bsdus 'od gsal thugs thig bstan par dar zhing rgyas: de 'dzin

sde spel thugs mthun khrims gtsang bzhin: bshad sgrub dpal 'byor nyi ltar gsal bar mdzod don gnyis lhun grub sku bzhi'i dpal thob shog ces brjod phrin lasanan du bcol de nas 'dod don gsol gdab ni kyi: byang shar mtshams kyi mtha' rol na: dur khrod ha ha sgrogs pa nas: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso: rdo rje'i rigs la dam srung ma: gsang chen mnga' bdag mthu mo che: g.yu yi sgron ma gtso 'khor bcas: tha tshig gnad dam bsgrags lags na dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir bshegs bla rdo srog 'khor rten la bzhugs: bstan pa srung phyir gus phyag 'tshal: dkar mngar 'o phud skyems bzang mchod thugs 'gal nong pa mthol lo bshags: dgyes palizhal mdangs dung ltar ston: brtse ba'i gtam kyi lab grogs kyis mo bdag lag pas mo phob cig pra bdag rnams kyis pra ston cig: rdzu 'phrul mngon shes sems la stsol: mkhyen pa'iblo gros rab rgyas nas: shes bya mtha' dag kun mkhyen pa'i: mi rmongs gsal ba'i mngon shes dang: rdo rje'i mdud dam mi bsnga ba: brda lung gsal nges stsal du gsol: yi/ pra mo ye

rjo| ye: thig thig hab bha sha na: tsan+d+ra go mi sal sal phyes phyes swā hā: bzlas sngags chu bo' rgyun bzhin bskyar 'dod don gsal bar 'gyur nge sa so sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya de nasardo rje wa mo yi gsol mchod bya thabs dmar gtor da ja cha skyems bshams bsangs sbyangs spel rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis bh+yo: kun tu bzang 3 dbyings kyi yum: sngags bdag khro gtum ral gcig la: e ka dza ṭi mthu mo che 'dir gshegs mchod gtor skyems bzhes la zab gsang thugs jig bstan pa srungs: a ti sgom pa'i rnal 'byor la: sems dang rig pa shan 'byed cing: gol sa mtha' dag chod pa dang: sgyu lus 'od sku 'grub bzhin du: gzhon nu bum sku'i rgyal sa la: tshe gcig rdzogs sangs rgyas pa yi: phrin las sgrub pa'i ma ma mdzod:hūṃ e ka dza ṭi phedī ya ba lirnyi kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan bdun la sogs ci stogs phul phrin las 'grub pa ra the tshom med sa ma yu de nas che ring mched lnga la gtor ma phul ba 'ad lta ste rin chen snod du bzang drug gi gtor ma/ dkar skyems lnga bshams nas bsangs sbya sa spel bsgyur dpa ga yas bya rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis kye: chos dbyings spyo sa mtha' bral mod kyang: rang bzhin sgra 'phrul dra ba'i dpal:

'chi med tshe dbang stsol ba mo: sman btsun bkra shis tshe ring ma: 'dir gshegasagasol mchod thugs dam bskangs rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: bde stong spros pa bral ba'i sku:rdo rje rigs kyi yum chen mo: sman btsun mthing gi zhal bzang ma: 'dir gshegs gsol mchod thugs dam bskangs snang gsal pra yi dngos grub stsol: snang stong gnyis med rol ba'i sku: yon tan rin chen rigs grub dpal: sman btsun mi g.yo blo bzang ma: 'dir gshegs gsol mchod thugs dam bskangs: phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub stsol:gsal stong 'dzin pa bral ba'i sku gsung mchog pad+ma'i dgyes bskang ma sman btsun cod paṇa mgrin bzang dpal: 'dir gshegs gsol mchod thugs dam bskangs: zas skom gos kyi dngos grub stsol: rig stong mtshan 'dzin grol ba'i sku brin las rigs kyi mnyes bskang dpal: sman btsun gta' dkar 'gro bzang ma 'dir gshegs gsol mchod thugs dam bskangs: rta phyugs nor gyi dngos grub stsol: bka' 'khor la gnas rdzu 'phrul can bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis dang: sman phran sa ya dang bcas pa:

༷/ 'dir gshegs gsol mchod thugs dam bskangs: mtha' dmag dus 'khrug nad yams bzlog: gangs ljongs bde legs rgya mtsho yis: rnam par 'tsho ba'i phrin las mchosad: thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yā: ces pa grangs bsogs gtor skyems mchod gnad des phrin las gegs med 'grub sa ma yā de nasagater srung mchod gsol ni skyems gtor bas sa sbyangs byin rlabs nas bas: skye med chos sku ka dag kyang: rang bzhin snying rje ma 'gag pa: thugs rje'i rol gar zab gter dpal: gnyer skyongs dam tshig mkha' 'gro ma: la yi yul spyod mdangs ldan dpa la klu la dbang bsgyur yid 'phrog ma: gnyan mo rdo rje ke war ni: gtso 'khor sprul pa dpung dang bcas: 'dir gshegs gsol mchod thugs dam bska sa: dgra sod bgegs thul phywa g.yang stsol: gyod phur kha smras gleng mo bzlog: byad phur mnan gtad rbod zor thul: sgrub pa po la mthun rkyen sbyor: bstan dgra dam sri'i snying khrag rol dam chos lhar len byed pa po: tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa yi: phrin las rab 'byams gegs med sgrabs ma g.yel ma 'khyangs sa ma yā: ces pa gra sa bsogs

gtor skyems mchod bcol ba'i las rnams 'grub pa ra 'gyur sa ma yu de nas phrin las bcol ba na hūṃ trīḥ dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyis bka' bgo dam bzhag dbang bskur ba'i: rdo rje'i las mdzad chos skyong ba: sman btsun g.yu yi sgron ma dang: sngags bdag e ka dza ṭi ma tshe ring mched lnga gtso 'khor bcas: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho rnams dgyes brtses bdag la nye bar dgongs: phrin las gnyan po bcol ba ni: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang: dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod: dge 'dun dam tshig khrims gtsang bzhin zab chos 'od gsal thugs thig gis bshad sgrub bstan pa 'dzan skyongs spel brtul zhugs bya btang ri khrod 'dzin: nges don snying po sgom 'bras bu: sgyu lus 'od sku 'grub pa dang kun bzang rgyal sa zin par mdzod: yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad la: char chu dus bab lo legs shing dkar thogs rtsi bcud 'bru rnams 'phel kha g.yang bkra shis brjod pa bzhin zas nor longs sbod 'dod chu'i rgyan: nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par mdzod: 'jigs tshogs ming gi lhag mar gyur rgyad

/ pa mtha' dag zhi bar mdzod: skye 'gro sems can ma lus pa'i: rgyud la byang chub sems thob 'bras dge ba bcu la rtag spyod cing: byang chub lam la 'byor mdzod: lha 'dre mi gsum 'khor 'das kyi: snang ba dbang 'dus zil gnon mdzod: bde legs phun tshogs yid 'dod don: gegs med 'grub pa'i brin las kun:mdzod badz+ra sa ma yā: ces brjod gtor skyems gtsa sar mchod de nas bshags pa bya ba na ho: bdag ni kun rmongs 'khrul dbang gis: rtsa gsum srung ma'i thugs 'gal las: ci sa mi 'chab mi zed par: gnong zhing 'gyod sems drag pos bshags ya ge brgya pa sa bzod pa ra gsol 3 sabo dharmā pā la: k+ṣe ṭa pā la badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes brjod bla rdo srog la brtan pa ra bzhugs gsol me tog 'thor snyen 81 ka pā la sarba gasne zhes brjod 'jig rten pa rnams kun rang gnas byon pa ra gan ba sbyin de nas bkra shis bya ba na na 31 thabs kyi rang bldan brgyad dang shes rab dbyings yum ma drag sde: gnyis med ma ning rigs lnga la gtogs pa'i dam can rgya mtsho yis: bkra shis bde legs dpal 'bar ba'i: dngos

grub dam pa stsal du gsol: nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs: nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa: phun tshogs rdzogs ldan snang ba yis: sa gsum kun khyab bkra shis 31ga: dge ston rol mo sna tshogs sgogs gnad 'di bral na dngos grub dbul brtson pas 'bras bu gegs med 'byung the tshom med do sa ma mā ye ma tshe bdag pad+ma 'byung gnasangs ma 'ongs 'gro la phan sems kyis snyang 'dra'i gdamasazab rmad byung ba 'brog ban khye'u chung lo tsār gtad da lta ma spel brda la bstims mdo khams bkra shis smon grub la rgyas thob sman btsun chen mor gnyer ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga yi dus nga sbrul nga dang mi gzhan pa yo rgyan nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal dpa' bo gang gis rted gyur de nga yi gdul bya'i lhag ma skyongs 'gro don bsam gyis mi khyab po bslu ba med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda tham snyi snyi snyi ces pa 'di'ang lung zin dharma ku mud dang / chos kyi bdag bo kun bzang bstan 'dzan dar rgyas gnyas kyas bskul ba dang / grogs rat+na saras nan bskul ngor bdag 'dradapa' bo nusaldan 'dusapa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag pa ra phab pa'i gnas/ gling pa' me tog gi ra ba bkra shis skyo sangs byed pa' gnas yo 'bogs bde ba'i da la nas dag par phab pa dge'o/ legs so/ sarba ma le/

༷ / g.yu sgron ma' sngags mchod ni oṃ badz+ra pra mo hā sa pā ri wa ra pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: ma hā ba lirnyi kha hi: ho: sman btsun rdo rje g.yu yi sgron ma 'khor ma sring rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs: sems can la phan bde spel: rnal 'byor ba'i sku tshe bsrings sbyin bdag gi bar chad sol: dadro chos byang chub sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sgo kun nas spel: nad mug 'khrugs rtsod kyi gzeng pa bzlog: mdor na ci smon pa dab re ba'i 'bras bu thams cad thogs pa med par 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: kye: dkar gsal gangs la nyi 'khyud bkrags mdangs can: yid 'phrog rdo rje g.yu yi sgron ma yis:'khor 'das srid pa'i dpal yon dge mtshan kun: 'dir khug 'dir 'dus sgrubs pa po la stsol: sarba rat+na bā su na na kha dhe a ra ya dza zhes pa'ang nus ldan rdo rje blo mtshor shar ba'o/

btsasdo: zab gsang rdo rje'i snying po las bstan srung yongs rdzogs kyi gsol mchod nyung ngur bsdus pa phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so:gas/: na re gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye:zod ra nyid gtum po'i nga rgyal gyis mdun du bka' srung dregs tshogs gsal mchod rdzas bsang sbya sa byin rlabs nas 'dod pa'i yid kyis brjod par bya yin āX/ཿ rang mdun ā las dum gcig bhan+ta dza 'dod yon bza' bca' btung ba sha khrag rigs: yo re khoḥlas byung bas bsregs gtor bkrus: sha lnga bdud rtsi zag med ye shes rdzas: rnam pa dgra bges bsgral ba'i phung khams kyis: dbang drag shan dmar ma hā de wa'i sku: tshogs kyi bdag po legs ldan phyag bzhi pa bdud mgon seng gdong las byed bya rog gdong: gur zhal phyag drug ma ning tsi ma ra: dregs chen bco brgyad sde dpon sum cu dang: mi mgon dkar po ya ma ra tsa dang: shan pa kus 'deb zangs ri dgra 'joms rtsal: gza' mchog chen po dam can rdo rje legs: lha srin sde brgyad pho rgyad dpa' bo'i sde: gsol ma mchod rdo thugs dam gnyan po bskangs: e ka tsa rte yakra

nag mo dang: dpal ldan lha mo sha za kha mo che: rdo rje g.yu sgron tshe ring mched lnga dang phur srung bcu gnyis myur mgyogs nges nus ma: dmag zor rgyal mo dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: brtan ma bcu gnyis lha mo mo rgyud rigs: gsol lo mchod do thugs dam gnyan po bskangs: klu bdud btsan dang sbu gra bdud po thod pa'i phreng ba gnod sbyin mo nyi zla'i do shal can lasamagon stag zhen seṅge mgo can mchan mched gsum sde: drag mo spun gsum thang lha rma chen spom: dge bsnyen nyer gcig 'brong ri smug po dang rdo rje legs pa rnga la stag rtse sogs:gter bsrung phyi nang gnyis skyong sde tshogs bcas: gser skyems phud bzang rin chen ngar btab pa sha khrag dam rdzas 'dod dgu'i longs spyod kyis: gsol lo mchod do thugs dam gnyan po bskangs: zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las rnams sgrubs: sangs rgyas bstan skyongs dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod: dge 'dun sde spel slob dpon sku tshe bsrings: rnal 'byor don bsgrub sprin bdag bde rgyas mdzod: khyab par ba gsang rdo rje snying po'i chos: phyogs bcu kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa dang: nad mug mtshon 'byug ming

gtsa( gi lhag par gyur:legs tshogs bkra shis rdzogs ldan ltar smin nas:dus gsum kun nas dge zhing bde legs shog:bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā:ces brngo da phran las rab 'byams 'grub the tshom med do sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya zhes pa 'di' chos kyi bdag po dharmā'i mtshan can gyis bskul ngor bdag 'dra nus ldan rdo rjes bris pa dge'o/dge'o/dge'o sarba mad+ma la/badz+ra: bh+yo:dbyings dang rig pa ye dag kyang:glo bur gzung 'dzin 'khrul dbang gi:phyi nang bstan srung thugs 'gal ba:rtog bral bde ba chen por bshags:ṭ+wāṃX pardo / ༷mas chags 'gal 'khrul nongs:ma lus mi 'chab bzod par gsol:ma badz+ra sa twa hūṃ:brgya stong la sogs ci 'grub bskyar de yis phrin las rab 'byams 'grub sprul mingakun nyas

stiju za ngu ni kye: dregs pa'i gtso mchog gnod sbyin yangs le bar: dgra dang bgegs la rbad do za ngu mdzod: mi phyug dkor nor mtha' rtsa skye rgyud bcas: ming gi (do mar byed pa'i phrin las mdzod: bstan gzhi chos 'khor bshad sgrubs mel rtse'i skyongs: rnal 'byor bzhed don 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: 'di dgos skabs kyi do gal che bsnyams nas nus ldan pas gus phul/

༷/cha zab chos 'od gsal thugs thig las: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i chos sde dang 'brel ba'i bshags pa mun sel sgron me bzhugs so:dza/ na mo gu ru pad+mā kwa ra ye: rgam gi/ 'phagasam mdun mkhar gsal gdab ste mos gus gdung shugs tshad med pas ho: gting mtha' bral ba'i chos sku kun bzang mo: rang bzhin 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul wa ra hi: 'gro ba'i rmongs mun sel mdzad tā re ma tshogs zhing rdul snyed khyon la gus phyag 'tshal brtse chen thugs rje'i lcags kyus bdag bzung nas: gzung 'dzin brgal dka'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: sna tshogs sems kyis bzos pa'i 'dzin stangs ngor: mi dge bcu spyod mtshams med las kyis gos: rtsa lhung sbom po phog pa'i nyes sgrib kun: mkha' ltar dag pa sprul sku'i dgongs klong bshags: mnyam nyid ye dag chen bo ma mthong nas: rten mongs rang mtshan 'khrul zhing rtog ge byas: blang dor rmongs shing dag mnyam gnas ma mthong: shin tu gsal ba'i dri ma longs snar bshags: yin pa med pa'i lta bar blo ma gtad: min pa med pa'i sgom par yid

ma ches: gnyis ga'i spros bral spyod pa'i bog ma thon: thams cad chos sku spros dang bral bar bshags: don la mi dmigs bde chen rgyal po'i sa: 'da' nyams srung mtshams bral ba'i rdzogs pa cher bshagadro bya bshags byed bral bar mnyam bzhag nas: rgya grol chos zad blo bral mngon gyur re/ga: de ltar bshags pas chag nyams byas ma rig rmongs pa'i dri ma sangs: nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel zhing rgyas rgyal kun thugs kya gsang mdzod mthong sa ma mā ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma sa bha wa'i gdul bya brtse ba'i thugs rje yis thugs bcud zab mo snying thig skor 'brog ban lo tsa'i bgo skal shar bstan 'gro'i dpal du gnyer rgyas btab rten 'brel dus la bab ba' tshe dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje yis mdo khams sgo mang tshal nas rted re zhig dgongs par rgyas btab kyapa chos bdag du ma phun tshogs nas bsod nams lhun kyis grub pa'i skabs rin chen shog skyar pheb pa'o sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang re zhig brda gsang ma mthong ba dus su rten 'brel phun sum tshogs skabs kho bo nus ldan rdo rjes smras te yi ge pa ni chos bdagabaka kurtas brgyas pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga la/

༷|ca zab chos 'od gsal thugs thig las: 'phags ma'i dgyes bskang rdzas bzhi'i mchod 'bul tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho bzhugs so:༷/ na mo ār+ya tā re de wi ya: za10)ska rje btsun 'phags ma gsal gdab ste rja sa bzha phul la dgyes pa bskangs sa āX hūṃ rten 'brel rdzas kyi gong bu brgya rtsa na ma rigs sangs phyir sgron me bltam te 'bul dum gcig snod bskyil pañtsa a dṛ ta: dngos kun bdud rtsir 'char phyir 'bul gyis bzhes: nyon mongs chags pa bsgral ba'i dmar chen po: 'khor ba dbyings su stong phyir bzhes su gsol: 'dod yon bcu rdzogs ma hā ba lirte mtshan 'dzin zhen par dag phyir bzhes su gsol: dpa' bo dgyes bskyed dza gad skyems bzang po: bde stong ye shes bskyed phyir bzhes su gsol: rje btsun 'phags ma'i sgyu 'phrul zhal bstan nas: rang snang 'od gsal zhing la mnga' brnyes 31ga: de ltar phul ba'i tshogs chen rdzogs sgrab dag den gnyas lhun grub po pad+ma'i pha nor zab pa'i skor las can thugs kyi sras la shar sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: gu h+ya brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang re zhig dgongs
mthil du gab pa rten 'brel dus la bab tshe bdag 'dranusaldan rdo rje dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos bdagapo kairte bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba masgo la/

༷/ tshogs bsdus ni hūṃ nyer bzhi'i zhing gi ya gyal gnyi ga rigs lnga 'khor lo'i dbang phyug chos kyi dal: grogs mchog dhu ma tha la'i dga' ston nas: 'du ba tshogs kyi rje mo wā ra hi: tshe 'dzin grub pa'i rgyal mo rdo rje'i rigs khams gsum dbang bsdud sgo' dmar gsung gi gtso 'jigs pa las sgrol rje btsun tā re ma: ston zla nya gang zhal bzang dbyangs can sogs: nyer gcig la mo rigs sngags zhing skyes kyi: dpa' bo dpa' mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: kun kyang 'du ba tshogs la gshegs su gsol: nyi zla zhal sbyor dga' bzhi'i tshogs ston rol mtshan bcas spros pa chos nyid dben par bshags: blo bral 'od gsal sprin gyis thugs dam bskang: gal te g.yo na khams gsum ror+sha bar bsgral: mas brtan dwangs ma'i 'khor lor bstabs byas te phyi nang nyer rgya mdud pa kun grol nas: spangs rtogs mthar phyin nang gsal bum sku'i dbyings:phra ba'i sku thugs zung 'jug mngon gyur regag: ces chos nyid bde ba chen po' rol ston lan skyes mkha' 'gro'i bdo glu sgrogs ltaranus ldan pas grogs ga re smon ltar don ldan du bris so/ maṅga le/

༷/ tshogs bsdus kun bza sprin mchod bzhugs so āḥ blo bral phyinang gsang ba'i tshogs ye grol yid bzhin 'khor lor 'bul nang gsal rig par dbang thob nas:mtha' bral 11nga yang mngon gyur thegag: ces brjod tshogs rdzogs rtogs pa 'char don gnyis lhun grub the mi tshom sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya 'da'ang gsang sgrub kyi brda phran bu lasakhobanus ldan pas spel ba masgo lo/
/ zab chos 'od gsalardo /// ṭ+wāshe las 'phags ma'i tshogs mchod bsod nams sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

che'i na mo ār+ya tā re hṝ ye: tshanagarwa gakhyo dzo/ du gsumargyal ba thams cad kyi sras gcig dpa la ldan pad+ma skyes snying gi pa d+mo 'dab brgyas btud 'bral med rig pa 'i dngos grub stsal sa ma yā rnal 'byor nyamasapa gso ba dang tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho' bre kha dgangs dngos grub bde blag thob pa'i phyir dam bskang ga ṇa tsakra bstan sa ma yu ma dwa na dang me sa lnga bu la zla rgyas zla phrum da bdug pa sna ba la sogs pa 'a sna tshogs bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs nyer spyod yo spyad rol mo'i rigs thams cad 'tshogs par byas nas su las la 'jug pa rim bco lnga dang po byin gyis rlabs pa ni hrī: mtshan ldan bhasto cadan yangs dbus sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can: 'dod yon tshogs kyi sprin dpung la: mtshan mar 'dzin pa re yi kho: hrī: ma skyes stong pa chos dbyings khyon: sku yi tshogs 'khor mtshan ma med: gsung gi mchod sprin 'gag pa bral thugs kyi dga' ston kun tu bzang: ro mnyams chen pos yongs su bkang: dgyes bskyed rdo rje'i rol rtsed gyur:67 āḥhūṃ ha ho hri: gnyas pa tshogs zhang spyan 'dren ni rta: ste med 'od gsal zhing dbus nas: ma 'gags yid bzhin 'khor lo dang: 'chi med tshe yi la tshogs rnams: zhal zas

༷/ tshogs kyi rol ston la: rdo rje glu gar stobs bsgyur bcas: tshur gshegs ār+ya tā re dza: slo ār+ya tā re dzña na mu drwa sarba sa ma ya dza dza: gsum pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni trī: ma 'gags 'chi med tshe yi lha: yid bzhin 'khor lo sprul dang bcas: dgyes bskyed tshogs kyi mchod sprin 'bul: dam bskangs tshe dbang dngos grub stsol: tsha ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: bzhi pa bshags pa 'bul ba ni ho: tshe dbang dngos grub kun ster dgongs: bdag rmongs sor byang sngags sdom la: nyams zhig ral 'das ci song yang: tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: 31 badz+ra sa ma yā a: lnga pa bsgral bstab 'bul ba ni hūṃ nyi nga bdag mtshan ma'i 'khrul rtog kun: rig stong rol pas rab bsgral nas: sku gsum klong yangs ngang du bstabs: 'khrul ba ka nas dag par mdzod: sarba rā tra mā ra ya phaṭa: sarba ha hi hūṃ kha re khā hi: drug pa lhag ma 'bul ba ni pernyi chos nyid dag pa'i dam srog 'chang rngo rje'i mkha' la gar gyis 'gro: legs nyes sngangs 'dzin rdza 'phral can: bsngan la 'khu ba'i srog dbugs sngad: rnal 'byor pa la gdung sems che: brnga dang ba ga

glu gar la dgyes: rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' nyan pa: ma sring dbang phyug lhag sdud rnams: 'dir gshegs dkyil 'khor mtha' skyongs shig: brngan mchod pham 'bab 'di bzhes la: 'dod pa'i brin las gang bcol ba: thogs med yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod: ma ma hrīng ma ma trīng ba lirnyi kha kha khā hi: bdun pa thugs dam bskul ba ni hūṃ hrīḥ chos dbyings rol pa chen po las thabs shes lha snang bkod mtha' yas: ār+ya tā re yid bzhin dpal: 'od gsal dgongs brda dag pas bskul: byi nang 'byung khams rgud pa sol: tshe dpal dbang thang bsod nams bskyed: nyams rtogs yon tan lo 'bras smin: 'ja' lus 'od sku grub pa yi: phrin las brngan gyis drangs bskul na: gsol btab 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: brgyad pa chad tho bsgrags pa ni hūṃ bh+yo rdo rje rgyal po he ru ga: bde gshegs pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: thog mtha' bar gsum thams cad du rang rtsal lha srin dam rgyas gzir: sgog lhud mna' bor dam khas blangs: rje yi rigs dang bran 'bangs 'khor: gtsug tu bkur zhing gang bcol las: thogs med yid bzhin stsol lo

zhes: sngon gyi tha tshig dran gyis la dpa' skyems mchod gtor dgyes par rol: zab chos 'od gsal thugs thig gi: bstan pa yar ngos zla ltar spel: de na thugs mthun khrims gtsang zhing bshad sgrub nyin mo rab gsal nas: dus ldan gdul bya mdzad phrin dpal: mi nub 'phel zhing dar rgyas mdzod: dgu pa bstan skyong baju na pa trī: rten 'brel srid pa'i chos khams kun: kun rdzob mdzad pas mnga' dbang brgur: don dam stong pas rgyas 'debs dpalaḥ brtan skyong ma yam mched 'khor bcas:da yon bde stong gtor ma'i ro: rol la srid pa'i rgong rgya gtor: sku gsum klong yangs mngon gyur mdzod: sarba ba lirnyi khā hi: r+sā pa rta bro brdung ba ni (ཿ rang bzhin mnyam pa 1nga du: gzung 'dzin bcom pa'i rta bro brdung thabs shes ro mnyam gar bsgyur ro: 'khor ba ldog med chos skur rgya: rū tra stum bha ya nan: dam sri mā ra ya rna rna brgya gcig grub blang ba ni hri: gdod nas ma bcos ska gsum zhal thams cad rig stong dbang gi gsang: lhan stes 'phags ma grab 'bras bu: basmrar thob bral ba spi blags kyis

dbang dang dngos grub bcud stsol la: rtogs grol dus mnyam mdzad du gsolaX sirnyi pha la a la la ho: bcu gnyis bzod pa ra gsol ba ni ho thams cad sems kyi cho rol ste:sems ni gzhi med rtsa ba bral: bshags dang bshags byed gnyis su med: rmad byung rdo rje'i dgongs pas gzir: sa ma ya ā: yig brgya bzlas pa sa nyams pa bska sa bcu gsum bsngo ba smon lam ni ho: ma bcos klong yangs rig rtsal dge: sgyu 'phrul 'gag med ga snang ba: 'khor gsum yongs dag chen po ra bsngo: rdzogs pa chen por byang chub shog lan gsum bcu bzhi bsdu lda bya ba na ā: chos can snang ba chos nyid 'phrul: thams cad mi dmigs ka dag ngang: byed stsol bral yang lhun grub mdangs: 'gag med gzugs sku'i phyag rgyar spyod: a ā: phaṭa phaṭa: bco lnga bkra shis bden badro da ni na mo: chos sku ka nas dag pa'i zhal: 'od mtha' yas pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku snying rje khyab brdal ba: nam mkha' rgyal po'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku gzhan phan phrin las phyugs pad+ma 'od 'bar bkra shis shog: skye 'chi med pa tshe yi sku: yid bzhin 'khor lo'i phyi na rten 'byung rnam

༷/ dag dpal gtso 'khor sprul ba'i 'khor 'das kun khyab thugs rje'i gter: rdzogs pa chen po'i chos can bkod pa rdzogs ldan ltar: bde legs spyod pa'i chos nyid spros pa'i mtshan ma grol: blo 'das chos zad bkra shis regag: ces brjod dge mtshan me tog bkrams bsngo ba smon lam rgya yis gdab gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag don gnya~X dpa la la dab 'byor ba'i las smon lan pa'i spyod yul 'di gsang sngags zab pa 'i rno nus yin skal man rnams la ring bar 'gyur tshogs smon 'dzom pa 'i dpa la du 'byung sa ma yā ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma thod phreng gas bstan 'gror ga — 'i thugs bskyed mthu zab bcud rno nus ya mtshan can 'brog ban lo tsa'i bgo skal shar bstan 'gro'i gsos sman gter du bkod smon lam dus sad nusaldan pas ma do khams bkra shis sgo mang nas rted nas phan bde'i ya ma tshan spepa sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya ban thim ñtsā ces pa 'da'ang chos bdag rnal 'byor kun bzang da / grogs rat+na sar bskul ro ra/ bdag 'dra gleng pa nu ldan rdo rje spel ba dge legs ze la/ sarba ma be tsho / dgebo/ bkra shis/

dza/ca bska rdzas byin rlabs ni o ā sno nam mkha'i dbyings phyug dpal mo btsun gyi mkhar: bstan g.yos snang ba bde ba chen por sbyor: dga' dang stong pa'i 'gros rims rlabs g.yos te: thams cad dwangs ma ye shes bdud rtsir zhu: yid rig ye shes phyag rgya bde ba'i gzugs: lha klu mi yi nor sna 'phrul bsgyur 'gyed: rgyal ba'i zhings ༷//sdu ༵༷pa ༷ ༷mas dgyes bskangs shing: 'khor ba gnas stongs srid pa'i sa bon skems don gnyis 'bad med yid bzhin 'byung gyur cig: nam mkha' mdzod sngags kyi spro 'di

༷/ zab chos 'od gsal thugs thig las 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khe ra 81'i bskang ba shel dkar phreng mjes zhes bya ba bzhugs:che/ na mo ār+ya tā re shrī ye: shā 44(slob du gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi sras mchog pa d+ma kā ra la mthon mthang ral ba'i cod pa ṇa gyis btud de gus pas phyag bgyi'o ma 'ongasal ldan pho mo yi dam tshag nyams chags byang ba da dngos grub bde blag zob pa 'i phyir bskang ba shel dkar phre mdzes bstan sa ma wā de yang dngosa'adzin rnam dag pas bska sa bar 'os pa 'i mchod sprin kun rdo rje'i rol rtsed kun bzang gis dkyal 'khor la tshogs dgyes bskang na rol mo sna tshogs sgra sbir zhing snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do hūṃ ༷ nub phyogs bde chen pad brtsegs nas 'chi med mgon po'i thugs dam bskangs: byams dang snying rje'i gter chen 'chang nam mkha' rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangs phyogs med phrin las bsam mtha' yas: pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs dam bskangs: kun mkhyen kun gzigs che ba'i mchog dga' rab rdo rje'i thugs dam bskangs: chos kun ma 'dres rdzogs chen ston: bri shing ha'i thugs dam bskangs: snying thig

dgongs pas 'ja' skur sbyor: bī ma mi tri'i thugs dam bskangs: thogs med gzigs shing brtul zhugs 'gyed hūṃ chen ka ra'i thugs dam bskangs: rdo rjer grub shing phrin las 'gyed nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs dam bskangs: bstan pa'i gzhi la dge 'dun mchog bho dhi sa twa'i thugs dam bskangs: gzhon nu smra ba'i dbang phyug dngos: chos rgyal chen po'i thugs dam bskangs: rgya bod chos kyi zam pa 'dzug: be+e ro ska cog thugs dam bskangs: sgra tshad shes bya'i gzhung lugs mkhas: rma gnyag lang gro'i thugs dam bskangs: grub pa'i rtser son 'gro phan sgrub: 'brog ban lo tsa'i thugs dam bskangs: thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mdzod mkhar chen bza' yi thugs dam bskangs:gangs chen bod kyi mun pa sel: lo paṇa rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang: byin rlabs char rgyun gdul byar 'bebs: brgyud pa'i bla ma'i thugs dam rang sems sangs rgyas mngon byung ston rtsa ba'i bla ma'i thugs mchog thun dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnas: yi dam lha tshogs thugs sa lam ma lus mthar phyin pa: 'das pa'i sangs rgyas thugs

༷| ngo mtshar mdzad pa rmad byung ba:da lta'i sangs rgyas thugs dam smon lam mtha' yas 'gag med 'byung:ma 'ongs sangs rgyas thugs bde nas bde ba'i sa lam ston byang sems rgya mtsho'i thugs hūṃ hrīḥskye 'chi med pa tshe yi lha:yid bzhin 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskangs:chos rnams ma 'dres brgyan du 'chang:rdo rje sgeg ma'i thugs dam zhen med thabs mkhas rol la dgyes:rin chen 'gying ma'i thugs dam bskangs:tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi chos char 'bebs pad+ma glu ma'i thugs dam bskangs:rdo rje 'gros kyis 'khor ba gnon las rab gar ma'i thugs dam bskangs:chos nyid zhi zhing chags pa bral:smin ma dkar mo'i thugs dam bskangs:ro gcig mnyam nyid ston mdzad ma:grub ma ser mo'i thugs dam bskangs:dga' chen brtse ba'i bdag nyid can:mchog ma dmar gsal thugs dam bskangs:mtha' bral dbu ma bde chen klong:dbyings spyag mthi ga'i thugs dam bskangs:snying rje tshad med zhi ba'i sku 'gugs byed dkar mo'i thugs dam bskangs:byams pa chen po rgyas pa'i mdangs:'ching ma ser

mo'i thugs dam bskangs: tshad med dga' ba dbang gi zhal:sdom ma dmar mo'i thugs dam bskangs: btang snyoms thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dul:myos mdzad ljang nag thugs dam bskangs: thugs rje phrin lasabasam mi khyab tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs:shugs chen mgyogs ma rdo rje ging:pho nya rnams kyi thugs dam bskangs:ji ltar smras pa'i don kun sgrub: dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs: dkyil 'khor mtha' dbus dpag med pa:rdo rje yangs pa'i thugs dam bskangs: ka hrīX dgyes bskyed thugs dmabaskangs ba'i rdzas 'dzan pa dag pa'i nyer spyod bdun:nyon mongs grol ba'i 'dod yon lnga dug gsum ye mnyam sman gtor rag:rtogs tshogs bsgral ba'i shes rab mtshon bcu drug dga' ster rigs ma'i tshogs: lugs 'byung zhen grol ting 'dzin mchod: tshogs brgyad ka dag bkra shis rtags: rkyen snang lam slong phyag rgya gar: rig stong rjen grol rgyal srid bdun: gzung ba rnam dag phyi yi tshogs: 'dzin pa rang grol nang gi tshogs: zang thal shes rig gsang ba'i tshogs: yongs rdzogs chen po de nyid

༷/ tshogs: thams cad ma 'dres gsal bkod de: bskang bya skong byed bral ba yis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs: dngos po chos nyid yangs par bskangs: snang ba ye shes chen por bskangs: gsal ba shes rab 'bar ba'i bskangs: bde sdug ka dag ngang du bskangs: 'khor 'das ro mnyam chen por bskangs: thams cad mi dmigs cherdogs pa che: gnas sdo/gas khyab brdal ngang dugs: de ltar phul bas tshogs chen rdzogs sgrib dag dbang da dngos grub 'phel nyams rtogs yon tan rab tu rgyas don rnams gegs med gsab — ra 'gyur tshogs bsags bsod nams zheng bzang 'di skal ba can gyi spya nor yin nyams pa bskang ba'i man ngag 'di rnal 'byor rnams kyi brtson pa sa zungs sa ma yu ye ma tshe bdag pad+ma thad phreng ngas bstan 'gror lag bsam rnam dkar bas 'pha gas ma' sgrub skor zab mo 'di thugs nas brtsal de gter du sbas 'che ga ban lotsār gtad rgyas sbyin ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga yi dus mdo khams bkra shasasgo mang zhes a shā'i smon grub mchod rten nas sman btsun chen mo brda sprad nas gdul bya' dpal du chos sgo 'byed bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel bar nges mi basmu tha tshig rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zim snyi ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi

bdag po kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyisaya yang bzhed bskul dang / grogs rani sarasas yang bskul ngor/ bdag 'dra yo rgyan bsam gtanagling pa'am nus ldan rol ba'i rdo rjes dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo la/

rjo / gnam phud bska ba na tshogs ston phul la 'di skad do bh+yo: dbyings bzhugs kun tu bzang mo yi: rnam 'phrul ma 'gagasa.o ka dza: mdzad phrin thabs mkhas tshe ring ma:nyid las mi gzhan mkha' 'gro bzhi: srid gsum gsal byed g.yu yi sgron: bstan ma bcu gnyis ma sring tshogs 'du ba tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: ga ṇa tsakra'i tshogs ston bzhes: rnal 'byor nyams bskang rtogs pa spor khyad par zab gsang gnyer skyongs ba'i: gnyan mo rdo rje ge war ni: lha klu gnyan dang sman byi tshogs: bka' 'khor sprul bcas 'dir byon la: bde stong tshogs ston mchod pa bzhes: zab gter bstan pa 'dzin srung spel: dgra bgegs smon log rdul du rlog: sgyu lus 'od sku grub pa sogs: tha tshig khas blangs phrin las sgrubs: ma g.yel ma 'a4)ngas sa ma yā: ces brjod phud skyems gtsa sar phul phran las thogs med yid bzhan 'byu sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di' re zhig du gab pa dus la bab tshe sa ldan pas smras rte yi ge pa na garma rtas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

de nas tshogs la rol ba ni e ma ho: myong grol ye shes bdud rtsi che: gtsang sme mtshan rtog spros bral ba: byang chub sems bcud sprin chen po: gnyis med rol pa po yis: de bzhin nyid spyod bdag phyag 'tshal: gdan gsum dkyil 'khor dgyes bskangs nas bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs: don grub sku gnyis mngon ba'i: chos can mtshan grol chos nyid ngang sku gsum mnyam sbyor klong thob regag: a ho ma hā su kha sidhi pha la a la la ho: ces spyod pa ra bya'o sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa tshol 'byor kun bzang bstan 'dzin gyisabaskul ro ra/ gter ming 'chol bonus ldan rdo rjesabris pa dge legs 'phe la/ dge'o/ bkra shas/

༷/ smon lam ni na mo gu phu bde stong tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mthus: lus gnas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro tshim 1 gyur cig: byang chub sems kyi tshogs chen phul ba'i mthus: rgyal sras 'phags rnam dgyes shing tshams 2 gyur cig dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dgyes ston phul bas mthus 'di yi dam mchan sngags kyi dam tshig 'dzin kun tshims 3 gyur cig: dus drug tshogs dang gtor ma phul ba'i mthus: rdo rje'i srog ldan 'di mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa 'a mo bka' srung mas bka' sdod tshims 4 gyur cig: mngon spyod bsgral 'dren rol ston phul bas mthus: 'khrul ba ka dag gdul bya tshims 5 gyur cig: spyod lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor phul ba'i mthus: rang rig mngon gyur skal ldan tshims 6 gyur cig de ltar tshims pa drug gi glu mchod 'dis: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dgyes bskangs shing: rnal 'byor lam gyi tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag nas: rang snang mkha' sprod zhing la spyod par regag: 'di ya nyams gya sgrom las shar ba'i mod lanus ldan pasaso/

༷/ smon lam ni hi ra wi ra phernyi lus thabs kyi rgyu la brten bcas te: 'bar g.yo ba'i dam tshig phyag rgya yis: gnas gzhi ka yi sgo 'byed nas: 'dzum pad+ma 'bum bzhad mjal bar shog: dbyings zla ba'i thabs la so dkar 'grigs yum nyi ma'i mkha' gsang sen dmar 'khrungs: des drangs ba'i bcu drug phyed phyed 'jal: lam spangs rtogs yon tan 'bar bar shog: khams lnga 'dus kun rdzobs gzhal med dbus: lhan skyes pa'i don dam nam mkha'i gzugs: dpe nyi ma 'char kha'i dkyil lta bu'i don snang gsum zag kun zad par 31ga: lus la bzhugs de las ma skyes pa: dpal bde mchog nam mkha'i rdo rje dang: 'dzum zla gsal yid bzhin grub rgyal mo'i: zag kun zad sbyangs smin rdzogs par shog: dpe khyung gshog rgong nga'i sbubs nas rgyas: don mtshon pa khams drug rdo rjer smin lus rgong rgya 'byung ba'i rdul dang 'dres: nang gnyug ma phyag dzhas skur ldang shog: nga'i lus la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'dus: su'i mi mthong bde stong 'gags pa med: don sbas pa'i rnal 'byor bde ba'i dpal rje so khya de wa'i sku

thog thegag: snang ba stong sgron lha mos bstod bsngags phul bsaku su lu pa sur+ya'i yi ger bkod pa dge/dza/ kun thub liṅga la 'gugs gzhugasad tshogs kyi kha ltar bsgral ba dang / oṃ ram̐ dz+wa la ram̐: ye shes kyi me dmar nag rdo rje tshwa tshwa 'khrugs pa rab tu 'bar zhing 'ur 'ur tsheg sgra dang bcas shing khro chung las byed kyi bu yug 'tshubs pa'i dbus su: lisgo bstabs tshag gis phul la sangs rgyasakyi bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde skyid 'phrog pa'i dam sri gdug pa can ༷/sdu ༷༷ nu ༷ ༵/ pa bye yi klong du bstabs pas dgra bgegs 'byung po'i gnas stong shing bkra shis dge mtshan gyi snang ba rab tu 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cigaḥ de tsam mkho
rgi zab chos 'od gsal thugs thig 1sgoldi(gas ma yid bzhin gsar lo sgrub pa'i thabs:dus bzhi'i nyams len phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so:

༷ — na mo ār+ya tā re la'o: gag sa sgo dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi sras mchog pad+ma rgyal po la mthon mthang ral pa'i cod paṇa gyis bayo de gus pas phyag bgyi'o las can sgrub la mos gus thob snying rus sdug sran che ba dang 'khor ba blos dor 'dod pa chung ngo lkog bral ba'i dam tshag can gtong phod che zhing byams brtse ldan ga gi bgo skal snya po' chos zab chos 'od gsal thugs thig bstan sa ma yā skye 'gro'i rgyu 'grul dben pa yi gong ma'i byin rlabs bsgrub pa' gnas dur khrod g.ya' gangs mtsho gling sogs stabasabade bkod mdzes yid 'ong sar phyan la phya nang dam rgya sdoms nye bar 'tsha ba kun dben bya blo sems bag phab dang ba yis 'phags ma'i bsnyen sgrub 'di la 'jug sa ma wā dal sogs yo byad bzhung bzhin bsags bsangs khrusagatsang sbra grub pa yis thun mong chos kyis rgyud sbyangs nas thun min rlung da 'bar 'dzag bsgoms lus sems ngal klod bsam gtan skyongs sa ma mā don dngosabazhe las rim la rnam gra sa bzhi yi sgo nas bstan snga gro zhi ba' bskyed bzlas ni blo sems klod la rig par gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sgom pa ni na mo:bcing grol med pa'i gnas lugs zhal:skabs gnas kun 'das ngo bor sgab 'bral 'khor sngang ba'i chos so cog:mtha' bral rdzogs pa chen por sbyor:lan

༷| gsum de nas lha bskyed bya ba ni ā: chosasku ye dag nam mkha' che: longs spyod rdzogs ldan thig le'i klong: sprul sku bde ba chen po'i zhal: sna tshogs gnyis med 'dzin bral sgom sna cha dpa' bo yab kyi dal: stong nyid shes rab dpa' mo yum zung 'jug zab gsal phyag rgya che snod bcud 'dzin pa rnam dag 1nga: 'od gsal thig le lnga ldan dbus: chags bral shes rab pad rgyas khar: gu ru pad+ma bde sbyin dpal: dri bral dung gi dkyil 'khor 'dra chags bral bde ba'i dpal mdangs 'khyud: sgrib bral gcer bu 'dzum mdzes sgeg: phyin drug rgyan 'chang rus pas spras: dar sna ye shes lnga dpyangs 'phur: thabs shes phyag gi dkyil 'khor na: tshe mda' 'chi med ka pā la:'gugs sdud pho nya'i sprin 'khrigs 'dzin: zhabs zung rgyal po rol thabs bzhugs sku ni mi g.yo stong gsal ngang: gsu dbyangs chos kyi 'gyur khug ston: thugs 1nga mkhyen brtse nus stobs 'bar: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sprin rab 'byams: rdul bral rdo rje'i bkod par rdzogs: thugs gar mi 'grur dpal be'ur: yid bzhin 'khor lo

tshon gang ba: rgyan bral gcer mo skyil krung bzhugs: mnyam gzhag 'chi med bum pa 'dzin 'khod 'das dwangs bcud 'ub 'ub bsdus: bla sgog rten 'dus aX〉ཿrdi 'chi med tshe yi ngo bor bskyil: mi 'gyur brten pa'i rdo rjer gnas: sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon las: 'od spros 'og min gnas mchog dang: rnga yab gling nas ye shes pa: kha ba bu yug mtshubs pa bzhin spyan drangs gnyis med ro gcig bsre de nas sbyan 'dren bzhugs phyag 'tshal mchod bstod 'dzab kyi bzlas pa ni ris bde chen klong yangs pad 'od nas: gu ru pad+ma tshe yi lha: 'dir byon dam ye zung 'jug bzhugs mtshan rtog bral ba don gyis 'dud: gang shar rang grol mchod sprin 'bul: sku gsum klong yangs rdo rjer bstod: gnyis 'dzin sems kyi dri ma bshags: sa ma yā.a: rang dang mdun bskyed pad+ma 'byung gnas su gsal ba'i thugs grong pad zla'i gdan la: rgyal yum yid bzhin 'khor lo rgyan med tshon gang ba'i thugs gar blo steng gser gyi rdo rje'i lce bar: nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbor ba'i bar rig pa'i ngo bo trinakar gsal smra yis bris pa tsam gyi g.yas su sgog rten ānakar

༷/ po la g.yon du tshe bsod nams kyi rtenasneḥljang sngon gyi mtha' mar rtsa ba'i sngags kyi bskor bar dmigs la bzlas pa bya sngags kyi phreng ba las 'od zer ngang sga ra ra byung lus ngag yid gsum gyi mtshan 'dzin rnam par deg: gnyis snang ma rig pa'i bag chags mun khams thams cad sangs kyis dag: tshe sgog bsod nams la dbang za ba'i 'byung po sngon las 'phral rkyen gyis bsdus pa thams cad la: sdig sgrib bkrus pa'i khu ba rnams bstabs ste ngom shing tshams la gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor zhi nas: dri bral rkyen byang bde ba chen po'i sku mi g.yo ba'i rgyal por dmigs la bzlas pa bya yang 'od zer dkar po' spro bsdus gzi byin gyis 'jigs tshogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs nad gdon bgegs dang nye bar 'tshe ba: nad mug mtshon 'khrugs dus kyi ru 'dzing ngan pa: tshe 'phrang bar chad thams cad zhi nas bde ba chen po'i sku 'grub par dmigs la bzlas pa bya:yang 'od zer dkar po' gzi 'od phyogs bcu'i zhing thams cad la khyad par 'byugs pas bde gshegs sras bcas kun gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan brin las kyi mnyes pa

bskangs: byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer skar ma'i phreng ba ltar byung nas bdag nyid la thim pas 'chi med bde chen rdo rje'i sku 'grub par bsam la bablos pa bya yang 'od zer dpag yas su spros te khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la phog: lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib nyes lhung dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag cing sbyang bar byas rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i tshogs gral la 'khod pa'i smon lam rten 'brel byi mthu grub: gsang ba sngags kyis rig mdangs sam byin rlabs zab mo'i mthus: skye 'arte ma lus pa gu dza pad+ma'i gsang ba gsum du dag smin chenags par bsam la: snyen āX/ badz+ra gu ru a yu sarba sidhi hūṃ hrī: yid bzhan nor bu dang mtshungs pas gsang sngags rgyal po 'bru bco lnga 'bum phrag bcu ru bzlas pa na rkyen zha tshe 'byor nga yis bka' sa ma yu de ltar sngags yang yang bzlas pa'i byin rlabs kyis zhi ba'i phrin las rab 'byams thams cad thogs pa med par 'byub par bsam la: nad gdon dus min 'chi rkyen sarba shiṭ+wāṃ ku ru ye swa ha: brgya rtsa la sogs ci 'grub bzla de nas gsol ba gdab pa na thal mo sbyar la 'di skad do kye: 'gro ba'i mgon po

༷| sangs rgyas pad+ma'i zhal: shes rig ngo bo ma bcos dwangs ma'i sku: skye 'chi gnyis spangs bla ma tshe mtha' yas: mnyam rol thig le pad+ma bde sbyin dpal: gang shar rang grol dgongs pas bskul lags kyis: 'pho med dbyings las thugs rjes rtsal byung la: mos ldan yid 'tshor rol ba'i rten 'brel gyis: rab rib gnyis snang mun pa kun bcom nas: nyams rtogs yon tan lo 'bras rab spud bzhinaḥ sems rtags lus shar bsgres rgud mi mnga' ba: tshe dbang rigs 'dzin grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: ā yu sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ trī lan gsum brjod de nas mchod ci bstod pa ni hrī: mi g.yo ka dag dgongs pa'i rtsal: rang grol rol pa 'dod yon chos: kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gyis: ma hā gu ru'i gsang gsum bskangs: 31 ma hā pañtsa pū dza ho sne —8 skye 'chi gnyis spangs sangs rgyas pad+ma'i rigs: rus rigs las 'das mi g.yo sku gsum zhal: phrin las mi nab 'bo ba sku ngas kyi mgon: 'chi med pad bde smin dpal la bsngod: ces da bsngo smon rgyas 'debs bya bkra shis mtha' brtsan bcas grub nas tshogs rdzogs sgrab dag don gnyis 'byub the

tshom med do rdo rje' bka' sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu h+ya bdo thim las rim da ngo zhi ba'i sgom sgrub so snyi sgorgarku nyin gong rgyas pa'i bskyed bzlas ni skyabalo'agro sems bskyed gong ltar gtong dgongs pa ro mnyam ting 'dzin gyis lha sku sgom pa'i rim pa ni ā: ga ga ma ka dag chos kyi sku: rang bzhin mnyam glong longs spyod rdzogs thugs rje ma 'gags sprul pa sku'i: rang mdangs dag chen dkyil 'khor bsgom: snang cha mnyam nyid bde chen yab: stong nyid gar dbang phag mo yum zung 'jug bstan g.yo rnam par dag ye shes lnga rdzogs gzhal med khang sgo gru rta bab mtshan rdzogs dbus: chags sogs dri bral pad zla'i khar rgyal ba kun yum rnam rgyal ma: gser zhal mthong bas yid 'phrog sku: 'dzum sgegs brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur can: mtshan dpe'i rab 'khyud ye shes mdzod: zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa: dar gyi chas lnga rin po che'i rgyan brgyad sku la rnam par rol: dang pos 'chi med 'od mtha' yas: shes rab snying rje'i mda' gzhu 'chang: 'og ma lcags kyu tshe bum 'dzin: skye 'chi gnyis med dngos grub sbyin: zhabs zung sems ma'i phyed skyil bzhugs:

/ dwangs ma lnga klong stong gsal sgom: sku la 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro rdzogs: 'khor 'das tshe dpal bsod nams sdud thugs nar dpal kyi be'u'i klo : yid na 'khor lo tshon gang ba rgyan bral gcer bu skyil krung gis: pad zla'i gdan rol tshe bum 'dzin: spro bsdus pho nya 'bum 'bum gyis: 'khor 'das tshe dpa la bsod sa kun: 'ub bsdus sgog rten 'bru gsum la: thim pas 'chi med tshe dbang thob: khyad par gnas gsum yi ge las 'od spros rgyal ba sras da bcas: spyan drangs gnyis sgod par gyur de nas spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag 'tshal mchod cing bstod pa 'dzab bzlas ni hrī: ma skyes brjod pa bral 1nga nas: dngos mtshan spros rtog bral ba'i sku: gtsug tor rnam rgyal ra gshegs la: dam ye 'du 'bral med par bzhugs: lhan skyes mkha' 'gro'i lhar phyag 'tshal rang grol rig pa'i mchod sprin 'bul: khams gsum klong sgrol ma la da: mu bzhi sems kyi 'dzin stangs bshags: dag tshangs mtha' bral dngos grub stsol: badz+ra sa ma yā ā: bdag dang mdun bsted thams cad rnam rgyal ma'i gsang ba

gsum du gsal ba'i thugs gar pad zla'i gdan la: ye shes sems dpa' yid bzhin 'khor lo rgyan bral gcer bu tshon gang ba'i thugs 1nga tsan+d+ra'i dal steng du ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' gser gyi rdo rje rtsa lnga pa'i lte bar nyi zla dbyangs gsal ga'u kha sbyor ba'i dbus su: phra mo'i sems dpa'ahrī yig gser gyi mdog can bkrag mdangs 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i g.yas su sgog gi rtena.u yig dkar po dang: g.yon du tshe bsod nams kyi rtenartsi ljang sngon gnyis kyang bkrag 'od skar chen shar ba tsam yod pa: de yi mtha' mar rtsa ba'i sngags sbrul 'khyil ba ltar bskor bar dmigs la bzlas pa byasngags kyi phreng ba las 'od zer gser gyi mdog can dpag yas su spros te: steng lha yi tshe bcud thams cadapha:dkar po'i rnam pa: bar mi yi tshe bsod nams thams cad rje:ljang sngon gyi rol pa 'og klu dang lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshe bsod nams kun kyanga3 mthing gsal gyi tshul du bsngas nas bdag mdun bum par thim nas 'chi med kyi dngos grab thob par dmigs la bzlos pa bya yang sngagasakyiphreng ba las 'od zer ser gsal sgos rte

che/ phyi 'byung ba bzhi nam mkha' nyi zla brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud dpal yon thams cad bsdus nas bdag mdun la thim par dmigs la bzlas pa bya yang sngags phreng las 'od rab tu spros nang rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga'i dpal yon dwangs bcud ma lus pa yang yang bsdus te bstims la bzlas pa bya yang 'od zer bsam yas su spros nas: phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams mu mtha' med pa na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi thugs mkhyen brtse nus stobs kyi gzi byin dngos grub thams cad bsdus nas bdag mdun la thim pas rgyal kun ye shes rdo rje mngon du gyur bar bsam la bzlas pa bya yang bdag mdun las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis 'gro khams dong nas sprugs te rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i tshogs grwal du 'khod pa'i smon lam dang rten 'brel yongs su grub par bsam la bzlas pa bya: tshe āḥhūṃ swā hwa: sgro ār+ya bi dza ya tshe sbyo rji dza sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ āḥ yid bzhin ror bu dang mtshungs ba' gsang sngags rgyal po 'byu nyer lnga grangs na 'bum phrag lnga bgra sa na tshe dpal rgyas 'gyur nga yi bka' sa ma

mā de ltar sngags yang yang bzlas pas byin rlabs kyis rgyas pa'i phrin las rab 'byams thams cad thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub par bsam la tshe dpal bsod nams ye shes yon tan sarba puṣ+ṭi ku ru s+t+waṃ: brgya stong la sogs ci 'grub brjod de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni thal mo snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas te rkye: rgyal kun bskyed mdzad dbyings phyug gser gyi zhal lhan skyes shes rig ma 'gags dengs ma'i sku: skye 'chi las 'das 'phags ma gtsug tor rgyal: chos nyid klong las dgongs rgyud g.yo med kyang: dad mos smon lam 'brel bas bskul lags na: 'pho med rtsal las thugs rje'i mdangs byung la: gdul bya'i yid mtshor rol ba'i zla zhal gyis gnyis snang mun pa mkha' ltar dag sangs nas:nyams rtogs lo 'bras mi nub gong 'phel rgyas: sems rtags lus la shar ba ye shes sku: tshe dbang rig 'dzin thob pa'i dngos grub stsol: a yu sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ hrī: lan gsum brjod de nas mchod ci bstod pa na dhi: dngos mtshan 'dzin pa rnam dag pas kun khyab rdo rje'i rol rtsed las: spros pa'i phyi nang gsang mchod kyis: 'phags ma'i dkyil
