༷/ 'khor mnyes pa bskangs: o ma hā pañtsa byu dza ho: / nyi skye 'chi'i mtshan grol sangs rgyas rat+na'i rigs: grol 'brul rtogs pa'i tha snyad las 'das pa'i: smra bsam brjod bral dbyings kyi bha ga la: so so rang rig rjen pas phyag 'tshal bstod: gzhan yang bsngo ba smon lam dang shis pa rgya cher brjod pa na tshe dpal bsod nams 'byor ba rgyas don kun grub po yi bka' sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim las rim gnyis pa rgyas pa'i sgom grubalha zlorna241 dgongs mo dbang gi bskyed bzlas ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed go ltar gtong 'pho 'gyur bral ba' ting 'dzin gyis phyag rgya' dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa ni ā: blo 'das chos sku nam mkha' che kun khyab ye shes byang chub sems: zang thal bde chen rol rtsal las dag pa mnyam rol dkyil 'khor shar gsal ba 'gag med yab kyi klong: stong pa rgyas 'debs chen mo'i zhal: zung 'jug bkod chen bsam mi khyab: mtha' bral de dbus mdangs lnga yi: dpag tshad las 'das gzhal med khang: dbang gi dkyil 'khor bde sbor smong: chags bral padu 'dab rgyas khar: dbyangs gsal nyi blo zung 'jug steng: rgyal ba kun yum tsachu grwa: bcu

drug mdangs 'bar tshul dgu'i 'khyud: phyag g.yas lcags kyus 'gro blo bsgul: dar lnga 'phan gyis snang srid g.yo: g.yon na tshe bum bcud 'khyil bsnams: bla sgog tshe nyams sor chud byed 'ja' sham pad phreng dar dpyangs dkar rat+na'i phreng ba sum rim mdzes dbu skra thor cog zar bu 'phyangs: rin chen rtse phran pad+mas bcings: snyan cha gdu bu cod paṇa 'phur: tsog pu bsnol ma'i 'dug stangs can pad+ma rā ga'i gzi 'od 'khyugs: zhal 'dzum spyan dwangs chags nyams 'bar: nu 'bur gsang ba'i pad+mo rgyas:bde la stong pa'i rgyas 'debs dpal: 'od lnga'i gur klong 'ja' lus sku: sgyu 'phrul dwangs ba'i gsal mdangs su: dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas rdzogs: tshe dbang las kyi phrin las 'gyed: thugs gar dpal be'u 'gyur med klong: yid bzhin 'khor lo rgyan bral ba: tshon gang pad zla'i gdan la rol: phyogs bcur spro bsdus ḍak+ki ni:sems kyi cho rol sa ya 'bum: mi g.yo rig pa'i mthus bskul nas 'gugs sdud dbang gi phrin las stsol: khyad par gnas gsum sa bon las: 'od 'phros gnas yul

༷sko dur khrod dang: rang bzhin dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas: rgyal ba sras bcas rtsa ba gsum: spya drangs dam ye ro gcig gyur de nas spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag 'tshal mchod bstod 'dzab kyi gzul 'khor na hūṃ nyi zla gam dbang gi dkyil 'khor dang: sna tshogs pad+ma brtsegs klong nas: rgyal yum bde klong rnam rol ma: dbang gi dpal 'khrud tsan+d+ra phyi:'dir gshegs dam tshig rten la bzhugs: lhan skyes mkha' 'gror gus phyag 'tshal: 'dzin yul rnam dag mchod pa'i mchod: dpal yon 'khod 'das rdzogs la bstod: so sor blta ba'i kun rtog bshags: mchog tu mi 'gyur dngos grub stsol:badz+ra sa ma ya ā: bdag mdun bum pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang dbang gi lha mo tsan+d+ra li'i gsang ba gsum du shes pa'i thugs gar pad zla'i dal steng du: ye shes sems dpa' yid bzhin 'khor lo rgyan bral gcer bu tshon gang ba gsal ba'i thugs klong zla gdan la: ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' gser gyi rdo rje rtsa lnga pa'i lce bar dbyangs gsal kyi ga'u'i smrabs su: phra mo'i ting nge 'dzinatre+e:yig pad rā ga'i mdog lnga bu gzi 'od rab tu 'khyag pa'i

g.yas su sgog gi rtena.ā yig dkar po dang: g.yon ngos su tshe bsod nams kyi ngo bornyi:ljang sngon gnyis kyang bkrag mdangs gzi brjed skar chen shar ba tsam yod pa: de yi mthar rtsa ba'i sngags 'khor sbrul 'khyil ba ltar dmar kyi li li 'khor bar dmigs la bzlas pa bya rtsa ba sngags kyi phreng ba las 'od zer dbang mdog lcags kyu'i dbyibs can bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros te 'khor 'das 'byung bzhi'i dpal yon thams cadasadzāt+t+waṃmakhye rnam par sib rug rug bsdus te bdag mdun bum pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim pa ra dmigs la bzlas pa bya yang 'od zer dmar po dpag yas su spros te lha 'dre mi gsum dregs pa sde brgyad kyi srog 'phrog dpa' zil bcom nus stobs mthu byin thams cad bsdus nas bdag mdun la thim pas gzhan snang zil gnon gyi nus mthu chen po thob par bsam la bzlas pa bya'o yang 'od zer dpag yas su spros te sangs rgyas byang sems paṇa grub rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i thugs mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi dbang byin dngos grub thams cad bsngas te bdag mdun la thim par bsam la bzlas pa bya yang 'od

༷/ zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag yas su spros te rgyal blon 'bangs gsum gyi mnga' tha stobs 'byor ma lus pa 'od sna tshogs pa'i rnam par sib sib rug rug tu thim par bsam la b.le sa pa bya yang 'od zer dmar po dbang gi lcags kyu bsam yas su spros srid pa gsum gyi zas nor lo sa spyod tshe bsod nams kyi dngos po thams cad yi ge gsum gyi rnam par bsdus bdag mdun la thim pas tshe bsod rgya mtshos yongs su gang zhing 'khyil bar bsam la bzlos pa bya yang 'od zer pad+ma rā ga'i rnam rol can bsam yas su 'phros: dam chos byang chub sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen legs tshogs kyi dngos po gang 'dod thams cad gegs med yid bzhin du brtsal ba da : khyad par 'gro khams dong nas sprugs te rig 'dzin paṇa grub 'tshogs pa'i grwal dbus su 'khod pa'i rten 'brel dang smon lam gyi mthu bzang po yongs su grub par dmigs la: yid pā sho de 'i tsasmo lī baṃ sarba tshe sbyo ā sdoms na pukhye ma hwa sitrī pha la ṭ+wāṃ āḥ bsod nams gter bum da mthun pa 'i gas sngags rgyal po 'bru nyer brgyad 'bum gsum bzlas pas khams gsum gyis dpal 'byor dbang

du 'byer bar nges sa ma yu de ltar rtsa ba'i sngags yang yang du bzlas pa'i byin rlabs kyis dbang gi phrin las rab 'byams thams cad thogs pa med par yid bzhin tu 'grub par bsam la: khams gsum srid gsumazas nor ma ngas spyod wa shaṃ ku dzag ste: brgya stong la sogs ca 'grub brjod de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni thal mo mos gus tshad med pas bye: chags pas ma gosapad+ma rgyas 'dra'i zhal: bde ba'i mdangs 'bar shedro rig dwangs ma'i sku: skye 'chi'i g.yul rgyal kun khyab rdo rje'i dpal: dbang chen zla gam 'khyil slong mnga' mdzad pa'i:lha tho tshe yidapal sbyin tsaṇ+ḍa lī: chos nyid dbyings la dgongs pa mnyam brdal yang: dad dam mos gus smon lam mthus bskul na: 'pho med rtsal las thugs rje'i mdangs byung la: mos ldan gdul bya'i yid mtshor rtag rol nas: sems zhal lus la shar ba ye shes sku: tshe dbang rig 'dzin grub pa'i dngos grub rgyun da lta nyid du rnal 'byor bdag la stsol: ā yu ratā ba su na na kha dhe sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ hrī: lan gsum brngo da de nas mchod cing bstod pa ni hri: gzung ba rnam dag dbyings kyi khyon: 'dzin pa rang grol mchod

/ sprin gtibs mtshan rtog rnam dag mchod chen po dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes phyir 'bul ma ma hā pañtsa pū dza ho: shā hrī mu bsgornam dag bde gshegs 'i rigs sdang sred blo las dben pa'i don dam gshis: yang dog gnyis med yum gyi mkha' klong la kun gsal rig pa rjen pas phyag 'tshal bstod gal ya bsngo ba pam dang shis pa rgya cher brjod pa na khams gsum dbang du bsdus pa sogs don kun grub po yi bka' sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim las ram gsum pa dbang gi sgom sgrubalha tre 14487/ sgod rngo ga po'i bskyed bzlas na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed go ltar la g.yo ba bral ba'i ting 'dzin gyis phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor bsal ba ni ā: skunanas rnam dag chos kyi dbyings lhun mnyam 'gag med /sa dpal: thol byung shes rig ngo bo las: phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor mnyam nyid shar: snang zhing shar ba yab kyi dal: stong la bdag med yum gyi klong: zung 'jug bde stong da chen dbus: ma stes brjod bral mdangs lnga yi: gzhal med khang chen rab gsal krong: bag chags dri bral pad rgyas khar: bde gsal zhal sbor nyi rna'i steng: rgyal ba

kun yumarnal 'byor ma: ljang gsal gzhon tshul lang tsho'i 'khyud dar dpyangs pad phreng rus rgyan can: 'ja' sham mdzes rol dor stabs bzhengs: dbu sgra thor cog rat+nas brgyan: pad+ma'i thod gdengs rnam par bkra phyag g.yas gri gug mkha' la phyar g.yon pas bhan+ta bdud rtsi brten: mchan g.yon he ru ka dpal 'chang: gdos mtshan bral ba ye shes sku: 'ja' lus sgyu ma'i dal gsal ba'i sku la 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro bgyed mi 'gyur thugs kyi dpal be'i sang: yid bzhin 'khor lo tshon gang ba: rgyan bral gcer bu pad zlar rol: spro bsdu phrin grub pho nya yis: tshe bsod bsdud cing dgra bgegs sgrol: 'khor 'das 'byung ba'i dwangs bcud bskyil: khyad par gnas gsum yig 'bru las 'od 'phros gnas yul dur khrod dang: rnga yab ḍak+ki'i tshogs dbus nas: bcu drug dga' ster sa ra dza: rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas: spyan drangs gnyis med ro gcig gyur: de nas spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag 'tshal mchod cing bstod la 'a ba bzlos ni hūṃ hrī rngam brjid rnga yab dpal gyi ri: bde spyod mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dbus nas: ḍak+ki'i rje mo

༷/ca mkhar chen bza': 'khor bcas dam tshig sna la byon zung 'jug mnyam rol chen por bzhugs: zang thal rig pas phyag 'tshal lo: kun bzang mnyam brdal mchod sprin 'bul: dag mnyam 'khor 'das rol la bstod: bya rtsol blo yis bslad kun bshags: sgrib med tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: badz+ra sa ma ya ā: bdag mdun bum pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang gsum bde ba chen por sad pa'i thugs klong pad+ma dang zla ba'i dal steng du: ye shes sems dpa' yid bzhin 'khor lo rgyan bral gcer bu tshon gang ba gsal ba'i thugs gar zla gdan la: ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor ba'i nang khongs su: phra mo'i ting nge 'dzin hrī:baṃḥ.in+d+ra ni la'i mdangs 'od 'bar ba'i g.yas su sgog gi rten ā:yig dkar po dang: g.yon ngos su tshe bsod nams kyi ngo bo ::ljang sngon gnyis kyang bkrag 'od skar chen shar ba tsam yod pa: de yi mthar rtsa ba'i sngags 'khor sbrul 'khyil ba ltar ljang gu'i gzi brjid 'byug bzhin 'khor bar dmigs la bzlas pa

bya rtsa ba'i sngags kyi phreng ba las 'od sna lnga spros te snod kyi 'jigs rten bcud kyi sems can 'byung ba'i dpal yon 'khor 'das gnyis kyi dwangs ma thams cad 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te bdag mdun bum pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim pas gnyis med ye shes chen po'i yongs su kheng par dmigs la bzlas pa bya yang 'od zer ljang sngon bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros: dam chos byang chub sgrub pa la nye bar 'tshe ba'i rgyal bsen dam sri dus mtha'i 'gong nag thams cad rdul du brlag: lha srin dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad dbang du bsdus srog 'phrog nus ngar bcom la mnga' 'og tu bsgyur nas phrin las gang bcol sgrub pa'i grogs byed par bsam la bzlos pa bya yang 'od zer bsam yas su spros lha rnams thams cad dbang du bsdus: mi rnams zil gyis gnon cing chos la bkod: 'dre bgegs dam la btags shing zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par byas ma rungs sgol ba ngan pa ston pa'i zhing bcu changs ba la sogs dgra sde smon log mtha' yi dmag dpung: dus 'khrugs mtshon chas gzing ba nad dang mu ge'i rgud pa:

༷/ mi 'dod pa'i nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad rtsad bcad drung nas 'byin: mtha' bral dbu ma chen po'i dgongs klong du: mi gnas bde ba chen por bsgral bar bsam la bzlas pa bya yang 'od zer ljang gsal lcags kyu'i dbyib can dpag yas su spros bstan g.yo 'jin rten gyi tshe bsod dpal yon thams cad 'bru gsum gyi rnam par bsdus te zim pas 'chi ba med pa'i rig 'dzin gyi sku 'grub par bsam la bzlas pa bya yang 'od zer bsam yas su 'phros rnal 'byor sgrub pa po la chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba gang 'dod thams cad thogs med du stsol ba dang: 'gal zla dam sri 'byung po thams cad ming gi lhag mar gyur: tshe bsod 'phel zhing nyams rtogs thams cad rab tu rgyas:khyad par 'gro ba'i khams rgya mtsho lta bu dong nas sprugs te rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs grwal tu 'khod nus pa'i rten 'brel dang smom lam gyi mthu bzang po grub pa'i phrin las 'byung bar bsam la: tsa( badz+ra 81 gi na garma mu tra sarba ma hwa su kha ā sdoms na sirnyi pha la hūṃ ā: zogs med las myur lcags kyu bzhin phrin 'grub gsang sngags 'bru nyer drug sum 'bum

bzlasapas tshe bsod rgyas dgra bgegs 'byung po tshar gcod 'gyur sa ma yu de ltar rtsa ba las kyi sngags bzlas pa'i byin rlabs kyis drag po'i phrin las rab 'byams thams cad thogs pa med pa lhun gyis grub par bsam la: gnod byed dgra bgegs ma ga 'dren 'byung po thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa:swā hā: brgya stong la sogs ci 'grub brjod de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni snyan 'byur zi waṃ gling bu'i sgra gdung shugs mos gus tshad med pas kye 'pho 'gyur mi mnga' phrin las 'dus pa'i zhal: 'khrul rkyon ma gos shes rig dwangs ma'i sku: skye 'chi bsgres rgud mi mnga' rdo rje'i gar: las rnams lhun rdzogs 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i rje: tshe bsod chos kyi dpal ster rnal 'byor ma: chos sku'i klong las dgongs pa 'pho med kyang: dad dam mos gus smon lam mthus bskul na: dgongs pa'i dbyings lasathugs rje'i mdangs byung la: mos ldan yid mtshor snang gzugs shar 'bras bu: sems rtags lus la grub pa'i dngos grub rgyun: 'chi med tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin sku da lta nyid du bdag gis 'byub gyur cig: ā yu mkhye sarba sirnyi trī: lan gsum brjod de nas mchod ca bstod pa ni trī:

༷| bde chen tshos sku'i mkha' klong du zhen med rang grol mchod sprin gtibs: kun tu ye shes mchog stsol ma'i: gsang gsum bskang phyir gus pas 'bul: sa ma hā pañtsa pū dza ho: ka ༷ mthong bas yid 'phrog mtshan dpe'i zhal bzang ngoms: thos pas rab grol 'gag med chos char 'bebs: dran pas rnam grol bde stong dga' bzhi 'char: ḍak+ki'i rje mo rnal 'byor ma la bstod: de ltar bstod la dge ba bsngo smon lam shis pa rgya cher brjod tshogs rdzo gas sgrib dag re 'bras 'grub mngon spyod grub po yi bka' sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zim las rim bzhi pa drag po mngon spyod ltar sgrub pasnyi ye ma che dbang rig 'dzin rdo rje gshog rgod sa ma 'ongs 'gro la shan tu brtse bsam gyis snya dang 'dra ba 'od gsal thugs thig bskor grub dbang 'brog ban khye'u khyod la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda la thob mdo khams bkra shis sgo mang bya ba ru sbas rgya sdom la sman btsun chen mor gnyer du sa kyi snyigs ma sum cu kha ral skabs nad mug dmag 'khrug gzeng pa cher g.yos tshe nga sbrul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje da 'phrad nas bstan 'gro'i bde skyid spel bar byed chos kyi bdag po skyes mchog bco brgyad 'byu kun bzang ming can rtogs pa mtho dharma'i mtshan 'chang shes rab che kirti zhes brjod sgrub la

brtse rgya mtsho' ming can sbob pa rgyas pad 'byung zhes pa tshe blos dor dri med bya ba dam tshig gtsang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho 'dul khrims ldan rin chen bzang po chos kyis phyug dge legs dpal bzang yon tan 'byor grub pa'i dbang phyug mos gus che de dang de yi char gtogs pas rigs lnga'i rtags 'chang rnam brgyad 'byung smon lam lasakyi dbang skal can rat+na'i mi la 'di zab rgya dam tshag can gyi lde'u mag lags chos rgyud rigs kyi myu gu lnga mi nub gong 'phel bstan pa' srog de dag 'phrad nas sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'dzin 'gro don rgya cher 'byung ba'i rten 'brel yod bka' 'di srungs shag gnyan po ge war btsun bka' log lag tu ma shor a tham rgya dam ldan thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad pa ra shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu byu brda thim snyi ces pa 'di'ang lung zin dharma ku mud kyis rdo rje' gsung gi zur chags pas bskul ba dang / chos gya bdag po kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyis gsang brda ma bkrol na 'gro 'dod kyis ldog pas bsnun cing sprang gtams rgyu med pas lo rgyus ya mug gas btsog la gzir/ dbyings kya gsang mdzod bkrol na ngo so de tsam mi mtho pas zur can sbrel mas bskul na'ang/ sngon smon rten 'brel che bas thams cad ro snyom su bzhag la dgyes bskong gi thabs su e 'gro bsnyos pa'i 'dun pa bzang po dang / grogs rat+na sa ras nan bskul rnams rtags rten 'brel bzang po ru shes nas/ bdag 'dramarngo rgyan bsam

yasgo/ gtan gling pas/ mkha' 'gro dbyings kyis gsang mdzod zab po don gyi sprel lo bdo' rgyud nub pa med pa 'i sgo dag pa ra gtan la dbab pa dge'o/ dge'o dge'o legs so sarba ma la / zab chos 'od gsal thugs thig ga bstan pa sprul sku' khams su spel skabs rten 'brel gyi sna kha du ma 'dzom tshe ro mtshar skyid pa' glu chung bcu gsum spro ba/ a ho skyed pa' rten 'brel zhig brjod na/ rnam dkar gzhichos gsalamachan brtsal phrin las kyi zhing sa/ thabs chen snyug gugun chos mchan bde ba ya rmos dor/ shes rab snag mtshal thub dbang mchan gsal byed gyi sbra char/ brtson pa' lcags brabakun bzang mchan las ldan gyi bskul ma / 'bum mingabade ldan mchan 'bru bcud gso yul gya dga' ston/ dar lngapad+ma mchan ye shes gsang thag de ngo mtshar/ yang ya so nams mkhas dab gi grogs lha rman/ sad ser bsru ba'apad chosamachan mkhan po de mthu che/ grags pa chos grags mchan can de khyab che ba'i rten 'brel/ ma bsgrigs rang 'grigs chos stsol ba zung ru dang kirta mchan bcas/ bkra shis las smon bzang po yi mthu des/ dad zhing bya sems myu gu te smin phyir/ nus ldan bsam gtan gling pa yi legs spel/'gyur med 'gyur rgyam mchan mos gus rgya mtsho ru smin shog sarba maṅga la/ dge'o/
༷/— zab chos 'od gsal thugs zig las mkha' 'gro'i me mchod phrin las lhun grub zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

na mo ār+ya tā re de wi ya: 281 dza)snyo rgyas pa' shang gi me hom brtsags thab rgya thag tho rgyas pa bya mar dang yam shing dur wa dang 'brasadang shing tog so ba nas dkar gsum sa la bsregasadakyil bca' rang nyad lha mo' bsnyen sgrub bskyar de nas bsregs rdzas byin brlabs ni oṃ āḥ(: rat+na mdzes pa'i snod mchog rgya che bar tshe dpal 'byor bskyed rgyas pa'i ga rdzas bkod rnal 'byor lha sngags ting 'dzin stobs kyi spel sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i rol ston mtha' yas gyur oṃ hūṃ swā e hā: hūṃḥshā rmāX bye ྅ sarba puṣ+ṭa ku ru ye swā hā:/dun brjod la sbyangs spel bsgyur de nas me thab sbar ba ni hrī: rgyas pa lhun gyis grub pa'i me: btso ma'i mdangs 'bar 'od chen 'khyugs rnal 'byer nyams rtogs dpal bskyed phrin las las kyi bskul ma bya: rma rat+na sarba ram̐ bha ye swā hā: de nas thab khang lha bskyed spyan 'dren dang hrī: mi dmigs ngang las me thab nyid rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor mtshan sa dbus chags bral ge sar rna rgyas khar: rig pa rte:las ye shes ma: mdun bsted yid bzhin 'khor lo dkar zu)2) mdun bskyed lha bskyed spyan 'dren dang bzhugs

༷/ gsol phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bzhes byon skyems phul bar bya ba na 37 ā&: thabs shes lto sbyor las byung ba'i: 'bru bcud snying po rtsi yi mar: byang chub sems kyi mdangs 'bar ba: 'phags ma'i dgyes pa bskang phyir 'bul: tshe dbang bsod nams stsol phyir bzhes: rtsa sngags mthar pañtsa a dṛ ta khā hi nyer gcig brjod 'a gus pas phul de nas rdzas rnams 'bul ba ni hūṃ nyi snang ba brdal khyab yangs pa na srid pa'i dpal 'byor dga' ston sprin ye shes dkyil 'khor bskang phyir 'bul tshe dbang bsod nams nyams rtogs bskyed rtsa sngags mthar je rnyi ṣ+ṭṛk+ṣa ye swā hā: dpal 'byor spel phyir yam shing 'bul yin a dṛ ta kha hi: 'byor ba bskyed phyar mar khu 'bul badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ya swā hā: longs spyod rgyas phyar 'bras dkar 'bul sarba saṃ ba de swā hā bde ba bskyed phyir zas mchog 'bul badz+ra bi dza ye swā hā: 'bru nor 'phel phyir so ba 'bul ma hā be ga ye swā hā: bsam — myur 'grub nas 'bul lo badz+ra a yu ṣe swā hā: tshe ring phyir du dur wa 'bul ma ha bā la ye su hwa: stobs dang ldan phyir sran ma 'bul a pra rte ha ta badz+ra ye sā ha: srung ba 'dzom phyir ku sha 'bul lnga gru ni gru gru ni bi lo ki ti ye swa hwa: rigs dang chos

rgyud rgyas phyir 'bul badz+ra ma phye puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā shes rab rgyas phyir dkar gsum 'bul badz+ra rat+na waṣ+ṭa ye swā hā gosargyan rgyas phyir reg bya 'bul pañtsa a bṛ ta khā nyi: khams 'dus rgyas phyar bdud rtsa 'bul bar bar 'dod gsol gdab pa ni rdo rgyal ba kun yum ye shes dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma sgron dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshogs kyi zhing mtha' yas par bdud rtsi sreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs ye shes yon tan thams cad yar ngos zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas te: nub pa mi mnga' bar phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dge zhing bkra shis par mdzad du gsol: rol mo sgrogs shing 'dod don gsol de nas rdzas 'dus 'bul ba ni ho smon lam grub pa'i zhing sa dza 'phel rgyas 'bru sman zas kyi rigs: 'os pas dga' ston bsam yas pa: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs: tshe bsod dpal 'byer nyams rtogs sogs: mi nub rtag tu rgyas par mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar rat+na phyu dza sarba sa ma ya ho: legs tshogs dpal yon puṣ+ṭi ku ru swā hā:

brgya stong khri 'bum gang skabs brjod de nas bstod pa rgyas par bya tshogs dang bskang gsol thabs la brtson slar yang gtang rag 'bul ba ni las byang gzhungs gi mchod pa 'bul de nas gshegs sna 'bul ba ni hūṃ nyi rtsi bcud snying po 'bru yi mar: las rnams mthar phyin gtang rag tu: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dal du 'bul: dgyes bzhes bde chen zhing du drongs: rtsa 5 mthar pañtsa a dṛ ta khā hi: nyer gcig brjod la phul bar bya de nas bstod bsdus tsam bya phye mar daro sa grub tshul du zhu bzod gsol bshags pa bya ba ni ho: dkyil 'a nar lha chesags batshugabs nges bdag ni ma rig 'khrul bas las: thugs kyi mi bzhed nongs pa'i rigs: ci bgyes 'gyod sems drag pos bshags yig brgya gsum brjod lhag chad bskangs de nas bsngo re ho: skye 'gags shā dmigs chos sku las mdzad phrin 'phags ma'i zhing bkod ngoms: bsags sbyangs spel khyab grub pa'i dge: mkha' khyab 'gro ba yongs la bsngo nga 'jin 'khyal ba'i rgya grol nas: sna gsum dgongs par byang chub 31ga: lan gsum de nas bsdu rim bya ba ni ā: ka dag 11nga las rang shar ba'i: skya 'phrul 'phags ma'i

zhing bkod kun: mtha' bral chos kyi dbyings su bsdu: dam tshig rig pa'i ga'ur bskyil: a ā phaṭa phaṭa: de nas bkra shis bya ba ni na mo gdul bya'i zhing sa bzang po ru bsod nams dpal 'byor lhun grub phyir ye shes sgyu 'phrul bkod pa bzhengs: don kun grub pa'i dge legs stsol: nyin yang dpal 'bar ta la la: mtshan yang bde spyod kyi li li: rtag par dge mtshan rab rgyas pa'i: bkra shis dam pa phun tshogs regag: gzhan yang shis brjod bsngo smon bya phran las gang bsam thogs med 'grub don gnyis lhun grub dpal la 'byor the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma mā ye ma rgyal kun phran las gcag bsdus pa o rgyan pad+ma sa bha was ma 'ongs bstan 'gro'i don phyir du shin tu zab pa thugasakyi mthil da lta 'aprog ban khyod la gtad phyis su snyigs ma lnga yas dus nad mtshon rgud pa ldang ba'i tshe zab mo'i pha phog 'ad nyid na mdo khams sgo mang gshams nas rded gdul bya lag ma de dus skyongs 'brel tshad nga yi zhing du 'god don grub phrin las bsam mtha' yas de bar zab gas rin po che skal med lag tu ma shor bar dam rgyas srungs shig gnyan chen mo thugs kya sras la 'ad sprod cig sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda tham snyi zhes pa 'di'ang snga sor nas phab rgyu lhag song ba gzhan gyi

yasgo/— g.yeng dab du shor bsnyams kyang /ring nas rten 'brel 'phro rgyas kyi dgos pa yod phyir/mthar de yi dus la bab tshe ldan rdo rje dag par phab pa'i ye ge pa nitshasakyi bdag po sku skyes garma kirtis bgyis pa dge legs 'aze la/sarba masgo le/

༷/ lo rgyus rab gsal don gyi me long bzhugs so:zwa1 na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki ni ye: shātsa / dus gang gi tshe skal bzang sgron me bkod pa'i zhing 'dir: mi mjed bye ba phrag brgyar mdor ltar rgyal dbang shakya'i tog dang: sngags ltar gu ru gangs can mtshos lung rtogs snying po'i chos sde rgya che la grangs mang ba zhig phye ba las 'dir pad+ma'i rang lugs snying po'i sgo dar tshul: gangs ljongs bod khams skyong phyir mkhan stsogab chos gsum sprul ba'i lo paṇa thams cad gdong 'dzom nag phyogs gdug pa'i lha ma srin 'byung po thams cad dam la btag: dkar phyogs la gnyer byang gtad 'jig rten khams kyi mun pa bsal: bla dor la mkhas pa'i sgron me sbar grub thob rig 'dzin gyi lung pa bkang: zab dang rgya che ba snying po'i smor nyi zwa smar tshogs lngar gsal bar mdzad bye chen gtsug las khang bsam yas mi 'khyar lhan gyis grab pa'i gzhal med khang phun sum tshogs par mdzad: nang jen rgya chos

ma lus bod du drangs:yi ge ris su bkod nas dag ther zhib tu bton: glegs bam brag ri brtsegs pa'i rnam par bkod: gsang ba 'chad nyam sgom sgrub kyi gzhi btsug:yang gsang gter gyi skrub pa sta gon mdzad:dgyes sde mo dang mkhon sbre rtse mang rnams kyis brda yi ris su phab gu rus dag ther zhib tu bton nas rin chen gyi sgrom du bcug:'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ma mo mkha' 'gro dregs pa can thams cad la gnyer kha gtad:dus kyi phung rgud dang 'tshams par gso byed sprul ba'i gter ston rigs rus mtshan dang chos bdag bcas ji ltar ba bzhin du lung gi bsngags:bsam yas kyi che brjod dang sku tshab kyis bsngags pa:gter dang 'phrad pa'i skyes can rnams la sha tsha dang snying gtam bkod bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa dang skye bdun sha yi lung bstan gzeng bstod mdzad bod spyi'i bsod nams bskyed phyir yid bzhin nor bu rin po che rnam gsum gter du sbas gdong dmar srin po 'dul bar bka' bsgros mdzad:yon mchod rje 'bangs rgya mtsho skyel mar 'tshogs te ngo mtshar rdo yi mchod rten chen po'i drung

༷yi/ca nas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs da : zhal gdams bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsungs: gzhan yang rje 'bangs mi re la gdams ja ga sna re rtsal bar mdzad nas mang yul gong tha la rtser pheb: de nas dpa' bo sde bzhis bsu ma byung ste chibs kyi ste gi nam mkha' nas bod 'bangs la brtse bas zhal chem sna tshogs dang dad pa can la 'du 'bral med do zhes rdo rje'i zhal gyis bzhes: bde ba'i gsang lam ye shes lnga dang lta sgom spyod pa'i lam bsgrod nas: rten 'brel tsam du 'gro tshul las don la 'gro sdod gnyis med kyi rgyang glu sgrogs nas gdoja dmar srin rjer pheb par mdzad do: bod 'bangs yongs kyi chos khrims bsdams nas gu ru'i bka' ltar sgrub par byas: rjes su bstan pa la 'phel 'grib re byung tshe o rgyan chen po'i thugs kyi 'od zer las bskrun pa'i gter chen rnam lnga gling pa bcu gsum gter phran bsam yas rnams byon nas 'gro don rgya cher mdzad: rang rang gi gdul zhing tshom bu 'bum dang bcas nas rig 'dzan gyi sa la khyu ded nges par mdzad do: khyad par skabs kyi gdams pa 'di nyid byung tshul yang: o rgyan

chen po' lung las nga nyid dpal chen khro bo 'chol ba nyid: lug gi gar la mtha' mi'i gnya' gnon 'gyur: de yi rig su chos rgyal myu gu bltams: phan bde'i nyi ma mtha' dbus kun tu brdal yang cig gdung las byung ba'i he ru ga: mtha' yi smon log ho ban skang khra 'khrug: mtha' nas dkrugs shing dbus rnams cha shas rtsod bstan pa'i smra phab sems can bsod nams 'jigs de yi dngos gnyen khams kyi smon 'grub gnas: bkra shis pad brtsegs sgo mang bya ba nas: pad+ma'i thugs bcud 'od gsal snying po 'di: 'char ga'i mdangs can byi ba'i 'dzum bzang la: dgongs brda rigs kyi bu la gtad do rgya: zhes gsungs pa ltar bslu ba bral bar gu rus bsngags pa'i gnas de las kho bo rig 'dzin gyi rgyal po bde chen mchog gi rdo rjes zab mdzod rin po che'i sgon me 'di gdan drangs tshe ma dang mkha' 'groliglu dbyangs kyis bsngags pa brjod nam mkha' la 'ja' sprin ya mtshan pa shar: sa gzhi la sbrang char rgyan dus su 'bebs: gter bsrung dngos su 'ong nas brda shog bstims: chos bdag la las 'phro sad: rang

bstan la mtha' mi'i 'jigs pa zhi: rten 'brel gyi sna kha ma log byin rlabs kyi nus pa ma nyams: dngos grub zab mo'i rno ma rdul dam sel gyi lhung ba ma 'brel tshad don ldan gyi gdams pa thabs kyi cha yi sgog shing: shesarab kyi tshe rten: myu gu rnams kyi dga' tshal: sbyin bdag gi mchod gnas bkur ste bya ba'i yul 'dzin rnams gyi gsang lam: gdul zhing yongs kyi spyi nor dam pa 'di rin chen shog skyar pheb pa lags so: 'di'i brgyud pa ni: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas: longs sku nga ba 'dus pa: sprul sku tshe dbang rig 'dzin pad+ma rgyarlo po: dbang gi lha mo tsan+d+ra li: bde mchog klu yi dbang po: mi nub rgyal ba'i blo gros thogs med stobs ldan rdo rje mchog bzhad pa rtsal: dbang chen rol ba'i rdo rje bkra shis nyams med dam pa'i bar ro: de lta bu'i tshogs mchog rig 'dzin dam pa de rnams las brgyud pa'i sgrol dkar bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'dzin grub pa'i rgyal mo'i rtsa dbang tshe yi ljon bzang zab mo zhu ba la sna srid stong khams blo yis blang nas yon dang rin thang gi tshul du maṇ+ḍal phul bar

'tshal de ltar lo rgyus dad bskyed 'di skal ldan pho mos nyamasasu longs dbang gi drangs nas ye shes mthong de 'bras sa lam rtsal rdzogs nas 'phags ma'i gsang gsum mngon sum mthong sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim dzi zhes pa 'da'ang lung zin dharma rnya dza bzhed ngor/ bdag 'dra nus na rdo rje bskal ba chu lug zla 5tshes 13dge bar dgongs brda phab pa sarba maṅga lo/
rgi zab chos 'od gsal thu/༷ ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ /rdo rtsa dbang pad+ma'i phreng mjes tshe yi ljon bzang lo 'bras rab spud zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

/— na mo dzña na dhartu shrī ye:gagrwa༄/sgortenas dusagasum rgyal ba thams cad kyi sras gcig pad+ma kwa ra la mthon mthing ral ba'i cod paṇa gyis gus pas btud de phyag bgyi'o sa ma yu la ldan / la snying rus can dad pa'i nor phyug shes rab zab gang ga dpal du shar ba yi zab lam dab ga ram pa bstan sa ma yā de yang dkyil 'khor mda' gang ba gru bzha khod snyoms mdzes pa 'i khar bum pa sku tsaka bhasto rdo rje'i rig ma 'ja' shel dang gtor ma mtha' rten rnam gsum bcas legs par bkod cing nyer spyod bkrams snang ba'i me sbar spos da spro slob dpon dang spros dgyes brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur sto dang ldan pa yis mdun bum bzlas tshogs bskang bya rig me dor 'jug grub pa'i rjes slob ma grwal 'khod khrus bgegs bskrad bsrung 'khor bsgom zhing bden don bshad maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol gdab ni kya ho:rab 'khu1mas la 'khor gsang rdzogs gar:rdo rje'i bla ma dgongs su gsol yon tan kun 'byung tshe yi dbang:byin rlabs mchog stsol gnang bar zhu:de nas bla mas lan gnang ba e ma ho: tshe yi dngos grub mchog:thob na don gnyis ba nga gi 'byung:'di bral dus min rkyen dbang 'byur:de phyir gsang chen dpal sprin na:'phags ma'i bsnyen sgrub lhur len

༷| mdzod: phun tshogs las rung gnad brten dang rgyu gnyis rkyen bzhi'i dbang bskur bgyi: de nas rgyud sbyangs skyabs 'gro ni na mo bcing grol med pa'i gnas lugs zhal: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsang mdzod ste: 'phags ma'i dkyil 'aX ra rdzogs pa'i dpal: rang ngo rig pas skyabs su mchi: de nas rtsa ba sems bskyed ni ho: lugs 'byung srid pa'i chos rnams kun: dngos por ma grub rtog pa'i mdangs: sems ni gzhi med rtsa ba bral: ma skyes ye rig sems bskyed do: de nas tshogs bsags rgya mtsho ni na mo chos nyid rig sku 'phags ma la mngon sum mjal ba'i phyag 'tshal lo: ma spang dag chen mchod pa 'bul: gnyis snang sems kyi dri kun bshags rdzogs pa chen por rjes yi ra : sku gsum mnyam rdzogs chos bskor bskul: ka dag zang thal chen por bzhugs: dge rtsa 'khor gsum dag par bsngo: phyam gcig kun bzang sa thob shog: de nas sdom bzu rim pa ni ho: brtsechen thugs rje'i gter 'chang ba: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bdag ni 'di nas byang chub bar: dam tshig rgya mtsho'i gsang gnad mchog

rang byung ye shes dkyal 'khor las nam yang 'da' bar mi byed na: smin zhing grol ba zab mo'i dbang: ma lus gnang ba'i bka' drin stsol: lan gsum rjes dam chu sbyin pa ho:dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi: gsang sgog rdo rje mna' yi chu: rigs ldan khyod kyi lce la bzhag dam bsrung 'di phyi'i dngos grub thob: nyams na rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'gro:phung 'tshengs gnyis las gsum pa dben: rmad byung gsang ba'i gnad don las: 'da' bar ma byed rigs kyi bu: sa ma ya na ra gan dam 'bogs rjes su me tog sbyin mig dar bkab la slob ma rnams ye shes lha ru bskyed pa ni 3 ma hā shu h+ye ta dzñā na badz+ra swā hā wa at+ma ko3nya: gzung 'dzin gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad rtag chad gnyis su ma gyur ba'i dbu ma chen por gnas pa de mngon du bya'o: lhun grub kyi snang ba bde chen pad+ma brtsegs pa'i zhing bkod yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su: pad zla zung 'jug gi gdan la rig pa hrī:dkar po 'od 'bar ba las: 'od zer 'phro 'dus zhu ba las slob ma rnams: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dkar la dmar ba'i gzi 'od rgyas pa: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan

༷/ bdun rnam par bkra zhing zhabs skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa:longs sku'i rgyan cha bcu gsum gyis rnam par mdzes shing tshul dgu'i lang tshos 'khyud pa:g.yas mchod sbyin gyis pad+ma'i yu ba nas 'dzin zhing rab tu gyes pa'i khar mda' dar rigs lnga bsnams shing phyogs bcu'i tshe bcud 'gugs pa:g.yon dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgyas pad+ma'i sdong po bsnams pa'i yal ga lo 'dabs rgyas shing pad+mo snyan thad nas kha gyes pa'i steng du tshe bum 'chi med bcud kyis bkang ba brten pa:'ja' 'od mu med pa 'khrigs pa'i klong du snang stong zung 'jug rol pa'i sku ru lam gyis bskyed do:gzhan yang phung po khams dang skyed mched thams cad rdo rje tshe yi lha tshogs rnams ma 'dres til gong phyur bzhin lam gyi bzhugs par dmigs:rigs bdag 'od mi 'gyur ba tshe dpag med gsang ba ye shes dang 'khril sbyor mdzad pa'i sku gsang la byang chub sems bcud dkar dmar chi li li byung ste slob ma lar gsal ba'i spri bo nas zhugs lus ngag yid gsum bde chen ye shes dang 'dres parngo bsgom mo slar yang rdo rje'i slob ma rnams

kyi dpral mgrin snying ga nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros pas 'og min stug po bkod pa nges pa lnga ldan gyi zhing dang:rnam dag dbug chen 'byin pa sprul sku'i zhing rnams dang:khyad par rnga yab kyi gling dang ri bo po ta la rnam mdzes g.yu lo bkod pa sogs gnas yul so so nas:rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad thugs skye ba med pa ka dag gi dbyings las:mdangs 'gags med phyag rgya tshom bu shig shig:thugs dgyes brtse'i rnam 'gyur du ma dang bcas byon de skal ldan rnams la 'chi med tshe yi dbang byin dngos grub thams cad stsol bar dmigs la thod rnga snyan pa 'i glu dbya sa da bcas nas ye shes dbab na trī:ma bcos dag chen chos sku'i klong:lhun grub sgyu 'phrul tshom bu 'khrigs:blo 'das rig pa gsal rdzogs kyis:rdo rje'i tha tshig bskul lags na:dbyings mnyam gzugs sku rdul mtha' yas:gang zhig nub med dor de snang:kun la bzhugs pa'i dam tshig par:ye shes dbab cing bsre lags so:'od gsal sgon me nang nas sbor:mkhyen gnyis shes rab thogs med pa'i:dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas yis:byin

༷/ rlabs dngos grub dbab tu gsol: sgrib dag dbang bzhis smin grol nas: sku gsum mngon gyur bde legs stsol: sa ār+ya tā re dzñā na dhartu mu tra sarba sa ma ya ja ja: a we sha ya a ā: ye shes dbab bstims bya ba'o dzñā na tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: zhes pas brtan bzhugs bya ba'o de nas mig dar dbye ba ni hūṃ rdo bde btagags snyeng po sku gsum zhal: sgrib byed ma rig 'dongs ba'i mig: ye shes gsal ba'i spyan dbye na: rang byung lha zhal mjal gyur cig: sa dzña na cak+ṣu pra we sha ya phaṭa: de nas lha ngo sprod pa ni ho: sems can ngo bo chos kyi sku: sangs rgyas rang zhal khyab brdal ba: phyogs ris bral ba bde chen zhal: tshe yi dkyil 'khor chen po yin: 'di ma gtogs pa'i yi dam lha: log na ma grub shes par mdzod: a a a: de nas me tog dor ba na ye maho: sku gsum 1nga yangs dkyil 'khor la: bdag gi rig pa'i me tog 'bul sngon nas 'brel ba'i yi dam lharaḥ mdzes pa'i me tog dbab 5 gsol: puṣe pra nyi tsa ho: de nas dang sa gzhi' dbang bskur la thog mar tshe 'gugs rim pa ni mda' dar g.yab cing 'di skad do bdag nyid che dpag med gsal ba'i sma yi ba spa'i

bu ga thams cad nas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa phyogs thams cad la spros pas: bdag dang bsrung bya'i bla srog 'khyams pa yal ba zhig pa chad gas thams cad dang: gdon chen gyis 'phrog pa: gdon phran gyi brkus pa: byad ma lha srung gis bkug pa thams cad tshe yi rang bzhina.āsdusatshwa gsum gyi rnam par me re re bkug la byung ste rang gi snying gar bstims pas rdo rje tshe yi dbang dang dngos grub thob par dmigs la tshe 'gugs bzhu bgo rgyas par bya de nas bum dbang bskur ba ni hūṃ nyi chos dbyings bum pa zlum 'khyil nang: 'chi med tshe yi bcud chen bskyil skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: lus ngag yid gsum smin zhing grol: rdo rje tshe yi dbang thob sgo ga rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: de nas 'phags ma'i sku gto la hūṃ hrī gzegs pa bdun ldan gdul bya la phrin las bdun ldan chos 'khor bskor: tshogs bdun rang bzhin 'gro ba'i khams: dong sprugs 'phags ma'i dbang thob re ga: rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ de nas snang mtha'i sku gto la hūṃ nyi ma chags rā ga'i gzi mdangs 'bar: bcu gsum rgyan 'chang snang mtha' yas:

༷ 'gro 'dul mgon po tshe yi lha: 'od dpag med pa'i dbang skur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa tshe: de nas sgeg ma'i sku gto la hūṃ nyi chos nyid zhi mnyam spros las drodas: 'khor ba klong rol chags pa bral: rdo rje gar gyi mkha' dbyings bcod: sgeg ma'i dbang bskur tshe dpal bskyed: rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa tshe: de nas 'gyi sa ma 'i sku gtad la shā hrīḥ bde chen ye rdzogs rig pa'i klong 'khor 'das snang ba rgyan du 'chang: gsal 'grib bral ba'i gzigs stangs can: 'gying ma'i dbang bskur tshe bsrings shig: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a snyi ṣiñtsa ma: de nas glu ma' sku gtad la hūṃ nyi grags pa'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid: mtshan 'dzin rtogs pa dbu mar bcom: zab rgyas chos kyi brda sgo 'byed: glu ma'i dbang bskur srog mthud cig: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa tshe: de nas gar ma'i sku gtad la hūṃ nyi zhi la brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur can: yangs pa rlabs gcod shugs dang lngan: khams gsum rol ba bde stong spin: gar ma'i dbang basmar mdangs bsted cig: rtsa sngags mthar ka ya a spri 〉〉 sa: de nas smin ma'i sku gto la hūṃ ni mi

g.yo nam mkha' ltar brtan zhing: chos khams chos nyid rgyas 'debs dpal rdo rje bde bar gshegs pa'i yum smin ma dkar mo'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a dhi ṣiñtsa tshe: de nas grub ma'i sku gto la hūṃ hrī zag pa rgya mtsho lta bu zad: cir yang ma 'gags sa ler mkhyen: zhing khams rgya mtshor mchod sprin spro: grub ma ser mo'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ma: de nas mchog ma'i sku gto la ka hrīḥ stong chen yum gyi ba ga la: snang ba thabs kyi bkod pa ngoms: don la ngo mtshar spros dang bral: mchog ma dmar mo'i dbang bskur ro rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a snyi ṣiñtsa oṃ de nas dbyangs phyug sku gtad la hūṃ hrīX rdo rje nam mkha' phyogs mtha' bral: bde chen ye shes nub pa med:bsgres rgud med pa las rab yum: rgyas 'debs ljang mo'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa de nas 'gugs ma'i sku gtad la hūṃ trī zhi ba thugs rje chen po'i mdangs: thams cad zhi mjad 'gro phan sgrub: rmad byung gangs kyi mdangs 'byud dpal 'gugs mdzad chen mo'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a snyi ṣiñtsa tshe: de nas

༷/ca 'chi ma'i sku gtad la hūṃ nyi rgyas pa dpal ldan rnam zos sras: tshe bsod dpal 'byor spel ba mo: rin chen dang po'i mdangs 'od 'byugs: 'ching mdzad chen mo'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa tshe: de nas sdom ma'i sku gtad la hūṃ nyi dbang gi lha mchog rta mgrin rgyal: khams gsum mnga' dbang byed pa mo: pad+ma rā ga'i zhal mnga' ba sdom mdzad chen mo'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa de nas myos ma'i sku gtad la hūṃ sgyi gnyis snang dri ma kun bcom zhing phan dang bde ba'i dpal sbyin mo: in+d+ra mdangs 'khyud mdzes pa'i zhal: myos mdzad chen mo'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: de nas gu ru'i sku gtad la hūṃ nyi mdzad pa mtha' yas mi mjed khams: bye ba phrag brgyar sprul pa 'gyed gsang chen sngags kyi bstan pa sgrogs: pad+ma kā ra'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ༷༷sa ma: de nas gsang dbang bskur ba ni: bhasto bdud rtsi lcer bzhag la hūṃ gyi mtshan ldan bde smong stsod kyi nang: bla ma yab yum sbor ba'i rgyan byang chub sems kyi bcud chen gtams: gnyis med mnyam

sbyor rdo rje'i 'phrul: skal ldan bu yi lce la bzhag: myang bas gsal stong gnyis med pa'i: ye shes chen po mngon gyur nas sku dang yon tan mchog thob shogs: rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: de nas sngags 'khor gto la hūṃ trīḥ gsang chen bde ba chen po'i gdangs 'gag med rdo rje nā da'i sprin gsung gsang sngags kyi 'khor lo yi: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: de nas bgrang phre gtad la hūṃ hrīḥ bde gshegs rgyal ba rigs brgya yi: rten mchog 'dus pa shel dkar gyi: dri bral phreng ba brgya rtsa yis bzlas sngags rgyun gyi dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhi ṇiñtsa ā: de nas tshe rten gsum gtad la hūṃ rdi 'byung ba'i dwangs ma dbang ba'i rdzas: nad sel gi waṃ sman mchog gis skal ldan bu yi gnas gsum du: tshe rten aXdṛX(ཿbkod la: mi 'gyur mi shig rgyas gdab po: tshe srog brag bas brtan gyur cig: hūṃ tra tra shag: mu tra ho:tiṣ+ṭha lhan: tshe yi rgya bzhi gdab la hūṃ hrīḥ yoX sbyomi yi gzhal yas kham: treḥni lhun grub zad med gter: hrīḥni ye shes snying po'i sgog ā0 ni skye med chos nyid don: rgyal ba rigs

༷| lnga'i phyag rgya yis: phung khams rnam la rgyas gdab po skye 'chi med pa'i tshe thob shog skye ༷ sbyoḥspotrīḥ.āḥ skye ba med pa 'chi ba med pa na ba med pa rgas pa med pa rgud pa med pa 'chi med che la dbang ba'i dngos grub dam pa thob par gyur cig: de nas sher dab bskur ba mi bra dzñā mu khri sku gtad la hūṃ ༷ lang tsho'i dpal gyis rab 'khyud cing: bcu drug dga' ster pho nya mo: rdo rje'i rigs 'cha shes rab gzung gsang chen nye lam bha ga'i dpal: rigs ldan snying nor khyod la spyin: brtse chen rol pa'i brtul zhugs kyis:rdo rje pad+mo bsre ba yis: dbab bskyil 'dren dgrams thabs zab mos: wan skyes ye shes rang zhal mchog: gcer byung rjen par mthong ba dang zung 'jug rdo rje dpal thob nas: phrin las 'gro ba kun 'dul ba'i dbang chog dam pa thob par thegag: rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta pradzñā dzñā na a bhi 144 /: de nas phyag mtshan rnam lnga gtad la hūṃ 28 ma chags skyon bral pad+ma 'dab stong ldan: yid bzhin nor bu chos kyi 'khor lo dab : mi 'gyur rdo rje las rdzogs rgya gram ste: bde gshegs rigs lnga'i rtags kyi dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar

tsit+ta pra dzñā dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa (: de nas mda' dar gtad la hūṃ hrīḥ rdo rje'i tshe mda' bkra shis rten: las byed pho nya'i 'du 'phro 'khrigs: ye shes lnga mtshon 'phan yab mdzes: dung g.yu shwa dang mgron bu bkra: lha dang pho mo byis pa yi: tshe srog bla rten 'dus pa'i rdzas: bal ni longs sprod g.yang gi rgyu: kun 'dzom dbang chen yab yum dal phun tshogs tshe yi dbang bskur ro rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta bra dzñā dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: de nas tshe bum gam la hūṃ trī bum ni 'dod pa tshang ba'i dpal: pa ni bkra shis dge ba'i rdzas: tshe dang g.yang gi 'od zer 'khrigs byin chags gzi 'bar rat+na'i mdzod: rten 'brel rdzas kyi dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta pra dzñā dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa nyu: de nas tshe chang gtad la hūṃ hrīḥ snod bzang yid bzhin ka pā lar: bcud bzang dza gad skyems kyis bkang: mthu bzang tshe dpal bsod nams bstims skal bzang slob ma rnams la sbyin dpal bzang phun tshogs dbang 'byor shog: rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta pra dzā dzña na a bhi ṣiñtsa shā: de nas tshe ril gtad la hūṃ hrīḥ 'byung ba 'dus pa'i dwangs bcud dril: dam rdzas ts+tsha yi ril bu ni: lha dang

gnyis med byin dbab pa'i: dbang bskur rtsa khams smin grol shog: rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta pradzñā dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: de nas tshe nas gtad la hūṃ hrīX bkra shis g.yang la snod kyi nang: bsod nams dpal rten sngon mo nas: tshe bsod bkra shis smon lam bcas: dbang bskur tshe bsod dpal 'bar shog rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta pradzña dzña na a dza/ :: de nas tshe 'bra gtad la hūṃ hrīḥ zla gam dbang gi zhal mdzes par bkra shis tshe rten nyi zla shar: dpal 'byor sdud pa'i tshe bya zung: 'gyur med 'od dkar tshom bu gas skal ldan rnams la dbang bskur ro: la dang skal ba mnyam gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta pradzñā dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: de nas tshe rten gtad la hūṃ hrīḥ skye 'chi med pa tshe yi 'bru sman rat+na rnam pa lnga: lan tshwa ka pur mtshal gi cha: dza gad skyems kyi dbang bskur bas bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'bar ba dang: tshe dbang bsod nams 'byor shog: rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta pradzā dzā na a bhi ṣiñtsa 〉 de nas go khrab gtad la: 〉 hrīḥ gzhom gzhig bral ba rdo rje ltar: 'pho 'gyur med pa'i rgyas thebs phyir: sra bstan go khrab

mdzes pa 'di'i: dbang bskur bdud las rab rgyal shog: rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta pradzñā dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: de nas zhi chas gtad la hūṃ hrīḥ nges pa lnga la dbang 'byor zhing: lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i phyir: longs sku'i rgyan chas bcu gsum 'di: skal bzang slob ma rnam la sprin: bcom ldan snang mtha' tshe dpag med mi 'byur mchog gi sku thob shog rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta pradzñā dzñā na a snyi ṣiñtsa ྅: de nas khro chas gtad la hūṃ trīḥ zhi ba chosasku spros bral yang: rnam rol thugs rje 'gag med pa bdud 'dul dpal gyi chas rnams kun skal bzang slob ma rnams la sprin: gzhan snang zil gyis gnon pa dang: he ru ka dpal mngon gyur shog: rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta pradzña dzña na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: de nas lcags 'gas sgrog dril gto la hūṃ hrīḥ tshad med rnam pa ba zhi ldan pas: 'gro 'dul phrin las rgya mtsho yis: 'khor ba dong sprugs brda rtags 'dis dbang bskur yon tan mchog thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta pradzña dzña na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ de nas tshag dbang bskur ba ni 'ja' shel mdangs ldan gtad la hūṃ trī ka dag dri ma'i ma gos pa: rang byung ye shes zang thal gshis: dpe brjod mtshon yul

༷| bral mod kyang: brda don rtags rdzogs dpe yi dbang: rab mdzes 'ja' shel 'di gtad pas: mtshan ma tshag bral mngon gyur shog: rtsa sngags mthar sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa trī: de nas me long gtad la hūṃ ༷ kun nas zlum la 'khyil ba'i sang: spros pa'i grwa zur kun dang bral sems nyid sangs rgyas mtshon pa'i dbang: rigs ldan bu mchog rnams la sbyin: mnyam gnas bcing grol med pa'i zhal: mngon gyur tshe gcig sangs rgyas shog rtsa sngags mthar sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: de nas a mthi gtad la hūṃ nyi chos dbyings nam mkha' rgya tshad bral mu bzhi mtshan ma'i rba rlabs grol: skye med don ston spro bsdu'i dbang phyag rgya chen po'i dngon grub sbyin: rdzogs pa a tir ro gcig shog: rtsa sngags mthar sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: de nas rma bya lug rgyud gtad la hūṃ nyi dug gi dug 'joms byen las grol rig pa'i rlabs kyis 'khrul rtogs kun: sku gsum dgongs klong mngon sangs rgya: bla med don gyi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar sarba a snyi ṣiñtsa hrī: de nas 'od lnga'i thig le gtad la hūṃ nyi lhun grub sku dang ye shes gsang dwangs gsal skyon gyis ma gos pa

shes rab rang gdangs sgon me yi: dbang bskur sa lam thod brgal nas: 'bras bu bla na med pa'i dbyings: rdzogs pa chen por byang chub shog: rtsa sngags mthar sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa trī: de nas mtha' brten gtor dbang ni hūṃ nyi brdal khyab gzhong pa rat+na'i snod lhun rdzogs brjid ldan gtor chen bshams byin rlabs tshe yi sprin 'phro ba 'dod 'byung dpal gyi bkod pa rdzogs skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: lus ngag yid gsum smin grol nas: tshe dbang bsod nams 'phel rgyas 31ga: rtsa sngags mthar maṇ+ḍal ba listo a d+ngha shings byung ām sa: ces brjod mtha' rten rdzas rtags gtad dga' ston tshogs kya 'khor lo bskor dge ba bsngo zhi smon lam gdab gnad kyis bskyed rdzo gas sgom la dab dus min 'chi ba'i rkyen sna sel tshe chos mdzad pa mthar phyin nas ra sna zhi la byang chub po sa ma wā ye ma tshe bdag pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas ma 'ongs bstan 'gror phan pa 'i sman tshe sgrub zab pa'i rno nus can 'brog ban le tsā nyad la gdam sa da du spel cu ra ma yin pa sa rin chen bdo la bstems nas su bkra shes a shwas smon grub la sbas rgya sman bcun chen mor gnyer ma 'o sa snyigs ma lnga yi dus nga sprul nu ldan rdo rje da 'phrad nas bstan 'grori na bde spel the cham mi mang rdo

masgo/ rje'i bka' sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya gu rgya bdo thim snyi ces pa 'di' lung zinadharma ku mud da / chos kya bdag po kun bzang bsnyan 'arin dar rgyas gnyis kyi bskul ba dang / grogasarat+na sar nan bskur rnams rtags rten 'brel bzang po ru shes nas/ bdag 'dratsan rgyan bsam gtan gli pa'am nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda zab mo dag par phab pa'i gnas/ nor bdag 'dod rgyal dmar bo'i byin chags pa' rten gyi ba gam chen po sgrub gnas shin tu dwa sa spro 'phel ba'i rang bzhin/ gling pa'i me tog gi ra ba yo 'bogs skyid pa 'i tha chen po nas bskal pa sa yos lo'i zla7 tshes 15 dge bar bras pa'o/ dge'o/ dge' / dge'o/ legs so/sarba mape le/
༷/— zab chos 'od gsal thugs thig las:bsang mchod kun bzang sprin dpung zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

che / na mogu ru ye: po grusgri/spyo sgaspyo/ rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi ye shes rdo rje 'gro ba'i mgon rigs 'dus padh+wa ka ra la sgo gsum gus pa'i phyag 'tshal lo ma 'ongasalas ldan pho mo yi tshogs gnyis gegs med rdzogs pa'i phyir bsangs mchod kun bzang sprin dpung zhes dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bstan sa ma yā lha shang sna tshogs dud sprin spro phye mar ja chang shel tshig brlan bas sasbyangs byin gyis brlabs par bya dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni na mo bla med bla ma yi dam lha gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la: bdag dang 'gro ba sems can rnams sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum gnyis pa byang chub sems bskyed ni hoḥ pha ma 'gro ba sems can rnams yang gsang lam la 'god bya'i phyir: smon dang 'jug pa'i sems mchog bskyed: 'gro khams dong sprugs nus par regag: lan gsum gsum pa bdag bskyed rim pa ni ā: bdag snang mi 'gyur rig pa hrī: 'phros 'dus yongs gyur skad cig gis: 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang sku: dkar gsal zhi 'dzum lang tsho rgyas 'ja' 'od thig le 'khrigs pa'i dbus: stong nyid snying rje'i rang mdangs bskyed sa ma ḍi pad+me hūṃ hrī:

༷/ bzha pa bas rdzas byan rlabs ni mdun du me thab mi dmigs pa: stong pa nyid kyi rol par gyur: de yi ngang las skad cig gis zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor zlum la 'khyil:'bar ba me yis mtshan rtog bsregs: du ba lha mo sngon po ni: rus pa'i rgyan drug mdzes 'dzum bzhad phyag g.yas sman gyi bzhong pa bsnams: dri zhim ngad pa phyur phyur byung:sa bdag klu gnyan mgon skyabs la'i: nyams grib rlugs pa kun bsal nas: dgyes zhal gzi mdangs phun tshogs gyur: phyag g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa las: byung ba'i bsang rdzas kun bzang sprin nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga sman gtor rak+ta byang chub sems: ri dwags g.yung dwags chu gnas bya ras phrug snam ther sbrang khang zas: bya gcan mtshon cha gru gzings sogs mdor na 'khor 'das mgron rnams kyis: thugs dang mthun pa'i longs spyod gter: thogs med yid bzhin 'byung gyur cig: o ā hūṃ a ka ro sogs swā hā: lan bdun brjod la byin gyis brlabs lnga pa mdun bskyed bsgom pa ni mdun mkhar pad+ma zla ba'i steng: longs sku rnam snang gangs chen mtsho'i: gtsug gtor mgrin

pa'i bar dag tu: dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron rnams rdzogs thugs ka lte ba'i bar dag tu gnas gsum dpa' bo'i mkha' 'gro rdzogs gsang ba bol gong yan chad du:dpal mgon yon tan mgron rnams rdzogs: pad+ma'i 'dab 'khor la brten pa'i: bgegs rigs lan chags mgron gyi bskor mtha' bskor nyi rdul 'khrigs pa ltar:rigs drug snying rje'i mgron gyis bskor: kun gyi sgog las 'od 'phros pas: 'khor 'das mgron rnams spyan drangs bstims: drug pa spyan 'dren bya ba ni rol mo snyan pa'i sgra dang bcas hūṃ trīX semasacan ma lus kun gyis mgon gyur zhing bdud sde dpung dang bcas pa 'joms mdzad lha: dngo/ rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i: gcom ldan 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol o: dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron dang yon tan mgron bgegs rigs lan chags mgron dang snying rje'i mgron: ma thogs gsang ba'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs dam tshig rten gyi lha la bstan par bzhugs: 3 badz+ra sa ma ya dza: dzā na tiṣ+ṭha lhan: bdun pa bsangs mchod 'bul ba ni hūṃ 38 ka dag spros bral rdzogs

dza/ sangs rgyas: phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs sa sa rgyas stong: dus gsum gshegs byon rgyal ba la bsang dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul: lung dang rtogs pa'i dam chos ni: mdo sngags rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bsam mi khyab par bcas pa la: bsangs dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul: 'phags pa nyeba'i sras chen brgyad: byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal da : rig 'dzin dge 'dun rgya mtsho la: bsangs dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul: gdod nas rnam dag kun tu bzang: ma bcos rang grol bya ba mo: bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis wa tshogs la bsangs dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul: khrag 'thung tshemachog he ru na: dbyings phyug kro ti shwa ri ma: lnga bcu rtsa brgyad lha tshogs la: bsangs dang zhi ba'i 'dus pa mdo be+e lha tshogs dang: sgyu 'phrul rgyan dang sems kyi lhar: bsang dang zhi ba'i gsang 'dus ma hā ma ya dang: bde mchog kye rdor dus 'khor lo: 'jigs byed ya ma ra tsa la: bsangs dang zhi ba'i 'jam dpal sku dang pad+ma gsung: yang dag thugs dang dpal yon tan: phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs la: bsangs dang zhi ba'i jod

gtong ma mo rig 'dzin slob mchod bstod dmod pa drag sngags dang: sgrub sde dgu yi lha tshogs la bsangs dang rgyal dgongs brda snyan shog ser tshig: smon lam gtad rgyas brgyud pa yi:rtsa rgyud bla ma thams cad la: bsangs dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul mkha' 'dza las kyi dbang mo che:rdo rje phag mo khros ma nag: bdud 'dul ma dang las byed mor bsangs dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul mtsho rgyal man+ta ra ba dang gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: rig lnga'i dam tshig ṭāk+ki la: bsangs dang zhi ba'i mchod yum chen mo dang spyan bdun ma: rje btsun 'phags ma tā re dang: tshe 'dzin sgron dkar dpal spel dmar bsangs dang zhi ba'i mchod pa myur dpal dbyangs can bsod nams dbang:rnam rgyal rigs byed 'jigs byed dang: gzhan mi thub dang rab rgyal dmar: bsangs dang zhi ba'i nags kyi sgro la dang khams gsum rgyal:nor ster bkra shis dgra dpung 'joms khro gnyer rab zhi 'od can la: bsangs dang zhi ba'i mchod pa rab garten rma bya mi pham rgyal ri khrod lha mo 'od zer can:gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa la:

za/ /— bsangs dang zhi ba'i mchod pa bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha mo dang:dbyings gsum skyong ba'i ḍak+ki dang:gnas yul he ru'i mkha' 'gro la:bsangs dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul: mchog gsum rtsa gsum sku gsum gyi:1ri du rdzogs shing bsdus pa yi:dkyil 'khor lha dang slob dpon la:bsangs dang zhi ba'i mchod pa dpal mgon ma hā ka la ni:tshogs bdag legs ldan phyag bzhi pa:gur mgon ber nag drag shad can:bsangs dang zhi ba'i mchod pa ma ning phyag drug zhal bzhi dang:bdud mgon seng gdong rnam thos sras:dpal ldan brag wa mgon po la bsangs dabhe zhi ba'i mchod pa phyogs bcu sde brgyad mgon po dang lha dmag bye ba dung phyir dang:phyag brnyan sprul pa lce sbyang ma:bsangs dang zhi ba'i mchod pa sngags bdag e ka tsa ṭi ma:dpa la ldan rang byung rgyal mo dang:sngags srung mched bzhi ma mo drug:bsangs dang zhi b.ri mchod pa 'bul: sprang zhen mched gsum ngas nus ma:dmag zor rgyal dang kha mo che:drag mo mched gsum king gcig mar:bsang dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul nyi 'od

'bar ma g.yu yi sgron:lha mo tshe ring mched sde lnga:phur srung ma mo bcu gnyis la:bsangs dang zhi ba'i mchod brtan ma bcu gnyis dpon dang g.yon:ma mo 'bum phrag yangs pa ni:gtso 'khor sprul pa dpung bcas la:bsangs dang zhi ba'i nor bdag dzam dkar 'brug zhon dang:dzam ser dzam dmar dzam lha nag:nor bdag bsam mi khyab pa la bsangs dang zhi ba'i drang srong gza' bdud rā hu la:gdong bzhi gza' brgyad rgyu skar sde:sprul 'khor g.yog dang bcas pa la:bsangs dbang phyug ma hā de wa dang lha mophra ma dgyes bskyed dpal:ma bzhi dpal mgon bdun cu la:bsang dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul:dbang drag shan pa dme ru rtse:yum mchog gsod byed dmar po dang:sprul 'khor bka' sdod bsam yas la:bsangs nga zhi ba'i gnod sbyin ci'u dmar po ni:ru 'dren sde bzhi btsan chen bdun:bka' nyan btsan dmag 'bum sde la:bsangs dang zhi ba'i stes mchog rdo rje legs pa ni nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi'i bdag:mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu la:bsangs dang zhi ba'i sgog bdag rgyal chen

be har la: sku lnga blon po nyer gcig dang: yang 'khor bye ba sa ya la: bsangs dang zhi ba'i mchod pa dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu la: las mdzad bco brgyad phrul bdag: sangs rgyas bstan srung dam can la: bsangs dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul:sa yi lha mo bstan ma dang tsang kun lto 'phye klu chen brgyad 'dzam gling klu gnyan da 'khor la: bsangs dang zhi ba'i mnga' ris skor gsum la gnas pa'i: gzhi bdag dregs can dkar phyogs skyongs: ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa la: bsangs dang zhi dbu gtsang ru bzhir rten bcas pa'i pho mo ma ning dregs pa'i tshogs: tha tshig la gnas thams cad la: bsangs dang zhi ba'i mdo khams sgang drug dbang bsgyur ba'i:ra nag gnyis skyongs dregs pa'i tshogs: bka' dam bsrung mdzad thams cad la: bsangs dang zhi ba'i myur mgyogs thang lha rma spom ra rdza rgyal 'phan phyug ri bkra dang: bsnyen 'brong ri yum blon 'khor: bsangs dang zhi ba'i dge bsnyen g.yu rtse gser khrab dang: g.yung drung lcags rtse yum blon 'khor: bka' sdod rdo rje drag rtsal la:

bsangs dang dgra 'dul rnga la stag rtse dang:tsa ri tsa gong tsa 'dra dang:bkra shis rdzong gnas dam can la:bsangs dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa dang:glo bur lhag pa'i sde tshogs ni:bsam yas nam mkha'i khyon bkang la bsangs dang zhi ba'i pho gdon mo gdon glu gdon dang:bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang:byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga la:bsangs dang zhi ba'i 'phrog ma ma bu lnga brgya dang nad rims yams gyi bdag po dang:lan chags mgron du gyur rnams la:bsangs dang zhi ba'i dmyal ba yi dgas dud 'gro dang:lha min lha dang mi yi gnas:che phra chung ngu'i sde rigs la bsangs dang bar dor gnas shing khas dbang chung:nyam thag 'byung po'i sde tshogs ni dus ngan snyigs ma'i gdon tshogs la:bsangs dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul:thams cad ngoms shing tshim gyur nas:bde ba mchog dang ldan par shog:brgyad pa smon lam gdab pa ni ho rtsa rgyud bla ma'i lha tshogs la:bsangs mchod phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis:gdod ma'i gnas lug rtogs pa dang kun tu bzang po'i sa

༷/— thob shog:rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam la bsangs mchod phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis:gnyug ma'i lha sku mngon gyur nas:mchog thun dngos grub thob par shog:gnas gsum ma dang mkha' 'gro la:bsangs mchod phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis:bde stong ye shes mngon gyur nas:dga' bzhi'i ro la spyod par shog:mgon po yon tan mgron rnams la bas sa mchod phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis:phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa dang:tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob par mdzod dregs pa dam can rgya mtsho la:bsang sa mchod phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis:bstan dgra drungs nas 'byin pa dang nad mug dus 'khrug rgud pa sol:nor la gter bdag thams cad la:bsangs mchod phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis lo legs 'bru 'phel zas nor rgyas:rdzogs ldan lang tsho rgyas gyur cig:bgegs regs len chags mgron rnams la:bsang mchod phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis:bu lon sha mkhon kun byang ste:'tshe bral byang chub sems ldan shog:rigs drug snyang rje' mgron rnams la:bsangs mchod phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis:las

snang sdug bsngal kun bral nas: bde ba mchog dang ldan gyur cig: bdag gis bsangs mchod phul ba yis: dge ba 'khor gsum dag par bsngo: phyam gcig kun tu bzang po yis rgyal sa mchog la sangs rgyas sgo ga: lan gsum dgu pa rlu rta dpal bskyed ni kye: mkha' la rta bdun rgyas pa bzhin: lha srung dbu 'phang mtho ba'i phyir: dmu thag dkar po yar la bstod: rnal 'byor tshe dpal rlung rta bskyed: dbyings la ri bo 'dzin bzhad bzhin: lha srung dbu 'phang mtho pa'i phyir: dmu thag mthing ga yar la bstod: rnal 'byer dbang thang rlung rta bskyed: klong la thig le brdal ba bzhin: lha srung dbu 'phang mtho ba'i phyir: dmu thag khra bo yar la bskyed: rnal 'byor sgog lus rlung rta bskyed: gangs la seng ge 'gying ba bzhin: lha srung dbu 'phang mtho ba'i phyir dmu thag dpal rgyas yar la bstod: rnal 'byor che grags rlung rta bskyed:nags la rgya stag 'phyo ba bzhin: lha srung dbu 'phang mtho ba'i phyir: dmu thag dri bral yar la bstod rnal 'byor 'phan phyug rlung rta bskyed: mkha' la khyung chen ldeng ba bzhin: lha srung dbu 'phang mtho ba'i phyir: dmu

༷/ thag dmar po yar la bstod rnal 'byor gtsan dar rlung rta bskyed: dgungs la g.yu 'brug ldir ba bzhin lha srung dbu 'phang mtho ba'i phyir: dmu thag dpung rgyan yar la bstod: rnal 'byor kha rje rlung rta bskyed: snyan grags 'dzam gling khyab pa dang phul ba po la bsrung skyobs mdzod: mi dang dgra bla ma bral cig kha rje dab thang rlung rta bskyed: nad mug dus kyi rgud pa sol: phyogs las rnam rgyal snang ba stsolasnye bde skyid chos bzhin spyod pa yi: bkra shis dam pa stsal du gsol: bcu pa bshags pa bya ba ni rta mgron bzhi'i lha tshogs thams cad kyis: thugs dang 'gal ba'i las bgyis pa: gnong zhing 'gyod sems drag pos bshags: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: bcu gcag bsdu rim bya ba ni o: ye shes 'jig rten mgron bzhi'i tshogs: dgyes bskang phrin las kun 'grub pa'i: da ni rang rang gnas su gshegs: slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol badz+ra ṭ+wāṃ: bcu gnyis shas brjod rim pa na na mo byin rlabs mchog stsol rigs gyi bdag: bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis shog: dbang byin dngos grub kun gyis gzhi: yi dam

rgya mtsho'i bkra shis re ga: bde stong dga' bzhi'i gdul bya smin: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis sgo ga: bstan pa'i rgud pa sel mdzad dpal: dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis regag: yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde spel ba'i: phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis 31ga: de ltar smon pa 'i re 'bras 'grub tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag nyams rtogs rgyas dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub 'bebs ze tshom med do sa ma yu ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma thod phre ngas ma 'o sa 'gro la brtse sems kyis rgud gso sman mchog dam pa'i sgo 'aprog ma lo tsa khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus ma yan bdo la thob cag sa ra bye mdo khams phyogs su dgongs rgya sdom ma 'ongs snyigs ma rje yi dus sprul nga da ma gzhan pa ra: nus na rol ba'i rdo rje yis bkra shis sgo ma gsham nas rnyed bstan da 'gro la phan bde spel the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya thub par srungs shig thil btsun ma gu rgya lha ces pa 'di'ang chos bdag kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyasakyi bskul ba dang / grogs mo rat+na saras dbang skal du gyur pa 'i rten 'brel gyi yang yang bskur ngor bdag 'dra yo rgyan nu ldan rdo rjesaganas mchog bkra shis sgo mang nas sbyan dra sa ba'i shog ser las zhal bshus te dag par phab dge spegs 'phel/ sarba ma lam̐/
༷/— zab chos 'od gsal thugs thig las:tshogs bsags chu sbyin bdud rtsi'i bum bcud zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

ste| namo gu ru we: (11skyarnyes/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi spyi gzugs pad+ma ka ra la mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lor mchod chu sbyin bdud rtsi'i bum bas bstan sa ma yu dkar gsum mngar gsum bsres pa yis ril bu grangs ma dril nas su rin chen sgod du bsags pa ra bya bas sa sbyangs ting nge 'dzin gyis spel de nas phul ba'i rim pa ni na 31: dmasan ma31ga gsum dang rtsa ba gsum la sogs: skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi 'gro kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa thob phyir: mnyam brdal byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: rang nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug gsal ba yis: phyag mthil yi ge shes āḥshā gsum gsal: de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros: rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes mchod 'bul thugs rje gzi byin dbang dang dngos grub bskur: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rnam par byung: chu sbyin la thim zag med bdud rtsi ni dkar dmar mthing ga'i rnam rol chen por gyur: kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs mi zad nam mkha' mdzod du byin brlabs nas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dkon mchog gsum: chos longs spral dang

sangs rgyas byang sems sogs dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron rnams kun la 'bul: dgyes bskangs bdag gzhan tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag nas: mchog thun sa grub ma lus stsol bar dmigs: byargo na ma sarba ta thā ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra (: brgya stong la sogs bskabs dang mthun par bya de nas yon tan mgron rnams bskangs — ni lha da klu brgyad gza' brgyad phyogs skyong bcu: 'jigs byed dgu dang rgyal chen sde bzhi dang: rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa'i: dpal mgon yon tan mgron gyur kun la pa: bdag sogs 'gro ba'i tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag nas: phrin las rnam bzhi gegs med 'grub par bsam: sam bha ra'i sngags dang chu thig gra sa nas su bgra sa phul lo brgya stong la / skabs da ma thun pa ra bya de nas lan chags ma/gron rnams bskang ba na pho gdon mo gdon glu gdon la sogs pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i sde rigs ni: che phra chung gsum sa cad kun la bsngo: dgyes bskangs ngoms tshim lan chags kun byang zhing: bu lon sod la gnod gdug bsam pa bral: phan pa byang chub sems dang ldan par dmigs:

gong bzhin saṃ bha radang chu sbyin phul brgya stong la sogs skabs dang mthun par bya de nas rigs drug mgron rnams brngan pa ni dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'a17 lha ma yin: la dang gling bzhi'i bsdus pa'i mi rnams dang bar dor gnas dang khas zhan dbang chung rnams: ngoms shing tshim phyir bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul rang rang so so'i las snang sdug bsngal bral: bde mchog chenags ldan dpal la spyod par dmigs: go bzhin sa bha radang chu sbyin 'bul brgya stong la sogs skabs dang mthun par bya de nas yi dwags tshogs rnams brngan pa ni phrog ma yi dwags kha 'bar ma la sogs: phyi nang sgos khur sgrib pa can rnams la: bdud rtsi chu sbyin 'dod yon mchod pa 'bul: mos 'dun dang mthun thob la re ba bskangs: gnod gdug chags sred 'dzin pa kun bral nas: phan pa byang chub sems dang ldan par dmigs: gos bzhin saṃ bha radang chu sbyin kul brgya stong la sogs skabs dang mthun par bya de nas da ma la'i chu sbyin bya ba ni: stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma zla ba'i steng: rjeḥlas bskyod pa'i ar+ya rdza bha la: dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'brug la zhon phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pa'i je'u le bsnams: dar dang

ca rat+na'i rgyan rdzogs mdzes 'dzum chags: zhabs gnyis phyed pa'i stabs kyi khri la rol mtha' 'khor nor rgyun lha mo rigs lnga dang: dzam lha nyer gcig nor ga phye phrag brgya: stong gsum ram̐ bha la yi 'khor gyi bskor gnas gsum 'od kyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa: spyan drangs gnyis su med par sib sib bstim: sangs rgyas na pa bsrung phyir gus phyag 'tshal: gdu dbyangs ting ting sgra yis rnam par bstod: 'gal 'khrul dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: j-isap+ta'i ljags kyi sbu gu'i 'od gyis bdud rtsi'i bcud drangs sku gsung thugs mchog bskangs: dgyes pa chen po'i sgrub mchog bdag cag la 'dod rgu'i longs spyod char du brnyil bar bsam: dbul sa rgud pa mtha' dag bsal byas te: dpal ldan rje la'i gter la spyod par dmigs 31 ār+ya rja bha la hrīḥd ya sarba puts+tsha kha hi: sarba rat+na bā su kha dhe na na sidhi pha la hūṃ: nga khri 'bum la sogs dag pa ra bzla 'o chab rgyun gyi la tshogs dgyes pa bskangs de nas 'dod gsol gdab pa 'a rim pa ni hūṃ hrīḥ bde btagags sprin pa'i pha rol mthar son zhing: gzugs kyi sku

sprul ār+ya rja bha la: gtso 'khor sprul pa zhing gi rdul rnyed la: bdag sems rnam par dag pas phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas dngos grub len par bya ba ni hūṃ hrīḥ yid bzhin gter mdzod dpal ldan bum pa bzang: 'dod rgu'i char rgyun ga lha yi bcud: nub med rnam thos sras kyi dbang daro sa grub: sgrubs mchog skal ldan bdag la stsal du gsol: sarba sirnyi hrī: gong gi mgron bzhi'i lha rnam dgyes bskang tshe dmigs bsam 'dod don bcol na 'di ltar ro sri zhu'i mgron rnams sku gsung thugs mchog bskangs: 'gro drug tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag sangs rgyas shog: dkon mchog dad gshin dkor la spyod pa dang: sdom gsum dam nyams bshags pa dag tshangs stsol: lan gsum mgon po yon tan mgron rnams mnyes pa bskangs: bdag sogs phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa dang: phyi nang gsang ba'i nyer 'tshe ming med gyur: don gnyis mdzad pa rmad byung dpal thob re ga: lan gsum bgegs rig lan chags mgron rnams tshim par 'bul: lan chags bu lon sha mkhon byang ba dang: gnod gdug sems bral byang chub sems mchog gis rgyan brlan 'gro khams

dong sprugs nus par shog: lan gsum rigs drug snyeng rje'i mgron rnams tshim par 'bul: rang rang so so'i las snang sdug bsngal bral: bde ba mchog ldan chub sems rgyas nas: gdod ma'i kun bzang rgyal sa zin par shog: lan gsum de nas bshags pa bya ba'i rim pa na he bdag ni ma reg 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur te: mgron nge thugs dang 'gal ba'i las ci bgyis gnong zhing 'gyod sems drag pos bshags bgyi'o: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol: yig brgya lan gsum bzlas la lhag ska sa de nas bsngo ba smon lam ram pa ni he 'di'i mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge rtsa kun: gcig tu bsdus te ma gyur 'gro la bsngo: bdag sogs 'brel thog ma gyur sa can kun: gdod ma'i kun bzang rgyal sa zin par shog lan gsum de nas bsdu rim bya ba'i rim pa ni ā snang cha thabs su shar ba'i dkyil 'khor wa: dgyes bskangs ma rdzogs sgrib pa kun dag nas: 'khor gsum dmigs med chos dbyings lhug pa'i ngang: smra bsam brjod bral de bzhin nyid du ā de nas bkra shas bya ba' rim ni na mo

byin rlabs mchog stsol rtsa rgyud bla ma dang: dngos grub bum bzang yi dam zhi khro'i lha: phyi nang rkyen sel gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dang phrin las lhun grub srung ma'i bkra shis regag: gzhan yang bsngo smon shis brjod mtha' rgyas bya gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag phran las kun gegs med yid bzhin 'grub pa'i rno nus lan byin grobs stobs da ya mtshan khyad par 'phags sa ma yu ye ma grub pa'i rags 'dzin rdo rje gshog rgod ngas ma 'ongs 'gro la snying brtse rjes chags pas srog dang 'dra ba'i man ngag zab pa' sgo 'brog mi lo tsā khye'u chung ye shes blo paṇa grub rig 'dzan rgya mtsho khyed la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brdar thob dang ma 'ong snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bonu ldan 'dus la gyis mdo khams bkra shis sgo ma gshams nas rnyed bstan dang 'gro la bde skyad nya ma 'byu the tshom med do rdo rje rgyal po'i bka' sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya dzi zhes pa 'di'ang sngags kyi dbang phyug rnal 'byor bkun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyas bkra shis lha regs dkar po gangs ra'i mdog 'cha cod pa ṇa la rdzas gtsang ma bkra shis ku mud mang du bcas yang ya bskur ngor/ bdag 'dra dpa 'a bonu ldan rdo rjes sbas gnas bkra shis sgo mang gi gsang bdo las zhal bshus te btsun mo dngul rgod kyi gnas mdun bdud btsan 'du ba' ba gam nas dag par phab ba dge legs
ma|/— 'aze la/yi ge'i ris byed 'khor ba stobs 'dzin gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga le/
sbru// zab chos 'od gsal thugs thig las: phung po mchod sbyin du spel ba dzashags chen rab rje gas zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

je / na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye za'i /sgosto/:/11 rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas kyi ye shes rdo rje 'gro ba'i dpal rigs 'dus pa dh+wa ka ra la mazon mtha ral bas bayo de 'anu da ma 'ongs las ldan skye bu yis tshogs gnyas yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir lus kyi mchod sbyin byed pa 'i thabs bar chad bsal ba'i thab mchog bstan sa ma yā da po lta ba'i zil gnon na phaṭa: nga bdag gzung 'jin 'khrul ba'i gdon: rang grol rigs stong mkha' 'gro mas: ye shes chen po'i ngang du bshigs: srid gsum zil gnon dpal thob shog: gnyis pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed na phaṭa:rang byung rig pa bcos med 'di: skyabs kyi dam par 'dzin byas te: 'khrul snang dmus long ma rigs 'gro: sku gsum dgongs klong la 'god do: gsum pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni phaṭa: ma brtsal rdzogs ldan nam mkha' la: 'ja' 'od zig le 'khrigs pa'i klong: bla ma he ru ka pa'i sku: dmar gsal mdzes 'dzum rgyan chas rdzogs: phaṭa: sku gsum 'dus zhal bla ma la: dad brgya'i gsol ba 'debs lags so: dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun mdzad med gter: sgrub mchog bdag la stsal du gsol: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: bzhi pa spar sbya sa

shā/ka/— spe' bsgyur ni:phaṭa:rang gsal rnam shes 'od thig te:dbu ma'i lam nas mda' ltar 'phang:dbyer med steng gi nam mkhar 'dres:'ub chub dgongs pa mngan du bya phaṭa:mkha' las glog 'od 'khyug pa bzhin:rig pa dbyings las bzhengs pa ni:rdo rje phag mo'i rnal rol gar:ye shes sgyu 'phrul rol bar bskyed:phaṭa phyag g.yas gri gug tshad cam gyas:lngags pa bshus te sa bzhir brdal slar yang thod pa rgar gyis spar:rang byung thod pa'i sgyed pur bab de nang baṃ ro ltems kyis bzhag:yeḥlas bskyod pa rlu g.yos nas:a thung re:las me mched de:bhan+ta'i bdud rtsi ltems kyis zhu:sbu ba phyir lud sha ri khrag:tshil zhun skang dang mar khu 'khyil:go ro tsa na byang chub sems:dkar dmar mthing ga'i a mṛ ta:myong grol ye shes bdud rtsir gyur:gzhan yang ri dwags g.yung dwags dang:chu gnas bya rig gcan zan dang:nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga:sman gtor raku dkar mngar sman:'bru zas dar gos ras 'phrug ther:sba khang gnas mal them skas sogs:'khor 'das mgron rnams thams

cad la: gang 'dod gter du der 'phrul nas: dpag yas nam mkha'i khyon bkang spel: 31 aḥ( ha ho hrī lan gsum lnga pa spyan 'dren mchod 'bul ni phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: ka dag skye ba med pa'i dbyings: lhun grub mtshan rdzogs pho brang nas: dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas sogs: dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron rnams gshegs: lha klu gza' skar rgyal chen bzhi: dpal mgon yon tan mgron rnams gshegs: dug gsum las kyi bskyed pa yi: bgegs rigs lan chags mgron rnams gshegs: khams gsum las nyon dbang gyur ba'i rigs drug snying rje'i mgron rnams byon gtan gyi longs spyod 'di la 'dus: ma thogs ma 'khrungs ma phyi bar: myur gshegs brtse ba chen pos bzhugs: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: gces 'dzin blos gtang phung po 'di: sgyu ma'i gter du byin rlabs nas: las byed mkha' 'gro'i gar bsgyur bcas: mgron bzhi'i lha tshogs dgyes pa bskangs phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs chos sku longs sku sprul sku sogs: dkon mchog srid zhu'i mgron rnams mchod: phaṭa phaṭa

shāka phaṭaḥ lha brgyad klu brgyad gza' chen brgyad: phyogs skyong bcu dang 'jigs byed dgu: dpal mgon yon tan mgron gyur ni: che 'bring chung ngu'i sde rigs mchod phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: yas mgron bde stong ros tshim nas: bdag sogs 'gro ba thams cad kyis: tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag dngos grub stsol:don gnyis lhun grub sangs rgyas shog:phaṭa phaṭaphaṭa: zhe sdang pho gdon rgyal po'i sde 'dod chags bse mo'i dam sri'i rigs: gti mug klu gdon sa bdag sogs: bgegs rigs lan chags mgron rnams mchod:phaṭa phaṭaphaṭaḥ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang: lha min la dang mi yi rigs:'gro ba rigs drug sems can ni: snying rje'i mgron du gyur la bsngo:phaṭa phaṭaphaṭaḥ mas mdza na thams cad dga' zhing mgu bde ba mchog dang ldan gyur nas gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor kun dang bral: byang chub sems thob sangs rgyas re/ga:phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: lhag ma myong grol bdud rtsi yis khas zhan dbang chung nyam thag kun:ngoms shing tshim par gyur nas su: bde ba mchog dang ldan par sgo ga:phaṭa phaṭaphaṭa: gartses

'jin phung po sbyin btang mthus bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs gyur cig: yi dam lha tshogs dgyes gyur cig: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro bskang gyur cig: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaX dregs pa dam can dgyes gyur cig: bgegs rigs lan chags mgu gyur cig: rigs drug 'dod pa bskang gyur cig: phyam gcig rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur cig phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ drug pa bsdu rams bya ba ni mchod spyin gnas yul thams cad kun sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'dzadar zhig pa ltar: smra bsam brjod bral mkha' dbyings su lhum zhugs sku gsung thugs dza/ ā: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: dge ba bsngo zhi smon lam gdab 'khor gsum yo dag chen po ra bzhag gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag nyams rtogs yon tan 'phe la zhing rgyas the tshom med do sa ma wā ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma saṃ bha wa' ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis snying 'dra'i thabs mtshog zab pa' skor 'brog mi lo tsā khyod la gtad da dung spel ba' dus ma yin brda la thob cig sa ra bye snyi gi bu da 'phrad pa ra shog skal med lag tu ma shor cag thub pa ra gyis shig g.yu btsun lcam sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim sto ces pa 'di'ang chos bdagakun bzang bstan 'jen dar rgyas dang slob bu dad ldan smon sems/ chos la dab ba'i grogs

rat+na sa ra rnams kyis yang yas bskur ro ra/ bdag 'dra dpa' bo nusaldan rdo rjes mdo khams bkra shis sgo ma gi zab gter btsun mo g.yu lcam chen mo' sprad pa 'i brda ris las zhal bshusate dag par phab pa spegs 'phe' / sarba maṅga ma//

rgalaris grurgyasamigathog gzaga'isgo byu541chisgi zab chos 'od gsal thugs thig las:'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tsha sgrub nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dgos chos:'chi bslu dpal mi 'gyur grub pa'i mdos bzhugs so:

rtergo na mo gu ru ār+ya tā re a yudzñā na mkhye hṝ ma hā mu dra ya: rtsa che rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum phan da bde ba kun gyi gzhi rta re yad bzhin 'khor lo la mthon mthi ral ba'i btud de 'dud tshe bdag pa d+ma thod phreng sa bstan 'gror phan pa'i lhag bsam dag lan pas dus min 'chi bzlog thabs mi 'gyur grub pa'i mdos chen bstan sa ma shā 'ad la spyi don bco lnga'i bstan dang po bca' thabs bstan pa ni zangs lcags la sogs sgod yangs par 'jim pa las ni khod snyoms rdal glud gzhi re mig dgu ru bya gtso mo 'chi bdag gshin rje ni ma he gla rgod zhon pa'o shar du gong tshe khrab gyon da sto ru bdud 'bum nag po la nub tu rtsis mkhan dmar po dang byang du gru zam ljang nag go shar lho skya ring spug po la lho nub mig dmar rdil thogasaser nub byang rdzong bdag sngon po dang byang shar gshin rje gdong dgu ni thug nag rab 'bar khro ba'i nyams rang rang bshos bu 'brang rgyas da dkar dmar ting lo khrag skong zung 'ja' rgyang nor rgyang khram rgyang bu pho gdong mo gdong mda' dang 'phang bal rgyang stag gzig dar sogs ris nam mkha' sna lnga me tog ris re re bzhan du rgya cher bya phyi nas shar glud dkar po la lho nag nub dmar byang lngang gu shar lhor spug po lho nub ser nub byang sngon po byang shar du spug nag byas pa sa pho glud dang mo glud bla glud byas pa'i glud

spyod yul la: dkor nor cha ma cho dgu 'byung: zad med yid bzhin gter du gyur:lha shing shug pa'i byang bu la sku lnga lhun grub 'ja' ris 'khyugs phung po nyes skyon kun las grol: bde chen 'gyur med lnga don ston: bslu med mchod sprin rnam dag gyur: dgra shing stag ma'i byang bu la:lo zla zhag dus pho mo'i khram: ris su bris pas gegs sri brub:dus min khram kha rkyen ngan bzlog:nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur:tsan+tan 'om bu rgyas pa'i shing: mnyam brdal dwangs ba'i me long ngor: ris su bris pa'i nor sna yis: lha 'dre'i re ba skong nus shing / sbyin bdag bar chad bsal gyur cig:mdzes pa bkra ba'i ri mo can: dmar ser thig le 'chang ba yi lngags pa ris su bkra ba dag:'phan gyi tshul du rnam par byas:lha 'dre 'gu ba'i rdzas su gyur yon gyi bdag po'i bkrag mdangs dang:stobs gzi nus pa phun tshogs byed:mda' bzang snyug ma chos kyi dbyings: ltong ka dbang chen bde ba'i dpal: mde'u shes rab dga' chen klong: dar sna phrin las kun 'byung sgo rdo rje yis ni sgog dbugs brtan: bhan thod 'chi ba med

'o///— pa'i rdzas sgro ni sku gsum mtshon byed de yon tan can gyi mda' bkra yang:lha 'dre pho rnams tshims byed gyur:sbyin bdag dus min 'chi las skyobs:'phang ni ngams par byed pa' rdzas srogs thur chag gas yo 'khyogs bral:gru gu kha dog lnga dang ldan:'byung lnga bskyed pa'i rten 'brel grub rin chen gser gyi 'phang lo yis:lha 'dre yid kyi gzugs can tshims yon bdag 'phral rkyen gegs las sgrol:pho gdong skyes pa stag chas can:rkang pas bro gar khrigs se khrig lag na kun dga'i 'dod yon thogs:mdzes pa'i rgyan bzang du mas spras:dga' 'dzum bzhin dwangs 'od 'bar ba:mthong bas lha 'dre'i yid spyod bskangs:byams brtse'i ngang la gnas gyur cig:mo gdong bud med dar chas can:rkang lag brtse gar shig se shig:ngag nas snyan pa'i glu dbyangs spro 'dod pa'i yas sna bsam mtha' yas brtse ba'i nyams rgyas blta na sdug mthong bas dga' bdes yid tshim byed:lha 'dre rnams kyi re bskangs shing:lan chags bu lon byang gyur cig:snang bsla'od 'byed ting lo ni:byang chub sems bcud yongs

su 'khyil: mun sel shes rab sgron me 'bar: 'byung po kun gyi sa lam gsal: yid bskang 'dod pa'i rdzas su 'bul: ngoms tshims sbyin bdag bde ldan gyur 'byu sna lnga yis 'brang rgyas ni: kha dog dkar la 'od zer 'bar: me tog ris ldan 'ja' 'od 'byugs reg myong bde ba mchog sbyin dpal: 'byung po rnams la 'bul lags na: zhen med tshul gyis spyod bzhin du: bdag cag lan chags bu lon byang: bde legs dpal gyis 'tsho bar sgo ga: rak+ta byugs pa'i khrag rkong bu: chags pa ma lus sel ba'i rdzas:bde ba thams cad sbyin pa'i nor: bkrag mdangs rab tu rgyas byed rtsi: dpa' bo bskul ba'i dgyes bskyed mchog: re zhen chags pa'i lha 'dre la: brngan bstabs bu lon byang bar shog: gtor ma rat+na lnga las grub: kha dog dkar dmar mthing nag sngo: ljang ser khra bo la sogs pa: che ba ri rab dpang rgyar mnyam: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan:'od mdangs nyi ma'i bkrag 'bar ba lha yi dkor la klu gnyan nor: mi las 'phrul ba'i 'dod 'byung 'di: srid pa'i lha 'dre kun la 'bul yon bdag bu lon byang gyur

༷yitshi cig: chang bu chigs pa drug dang ldan 'dod yon drug gi longs spyod spro: dkor nor brgya stong khri dang 'bum: bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun: bkod mdzes rnam pa bsam mi khyab: lha rnams bska bar 'os pa'i gter: sde brgyad brngan par byed pa'i rdzas: lha 'dre'i 'dod pa tshim byed yas 'byung po rnams la 'bul lags na: ro mas tshim gdug rtsub byang bar re ga: 'theb skyu nye zla'i 'od 'bar ba 'ja' 'khrugs ris la dkor nor tshang: dga' 'khyil ris la yas rnams rdzogs: bskang brngan 'dod pa tshim byed 'di: 'byung po'i dbang po'i yid spyod du: phun sum tshogs par 'byung gyur cig shar kyi sku glud dung ltar dkar: bro gar bsgyur zhing rgyan cha ldan 'dod pa'i yas sna lag pas spro: zhi bar byed pa'i glud bzang gyur: lho yi sku glud be+eḍūr mdangs dpa' rngam bro brdung khrigs se khrig: 'dod yon dkor nor byur bur spro: dpa' skong ba yi glad bzang gyur:nub gyismra tshod byu ru'i mdog: dga' 'dzum brtse nyams ya la la: dar gos ratā bsam yas 'gyed: ngoms par byed pa'i glad bzang gyur:byang gi

sku glud in+d+ra'i mdangs:lag na 'dod pa'i yas thogs shing:'dzum bzang dpal 'khyud lang tshos sgeg:mthong bas glud bdag ngoms par byed:shar lhe'i sku glud dmar smug mdzes:drang sgong me lha 'byung po'i tshogs:ngoms par byed pa'i yas bzang po:'dod lnga lhun grub gter du mos:lto nub sku glud gser gyi mdog:srin po pho mo mgu byed cing:sngon las 'phral rkyen sod nus pa'i glud ni zad med mdzes ldan gyur nub byang sku glud sngon po de:rlung dang 'tshams pa'i 'byung po rnams:ngoms shing tshim byed mthu ldan ba:sgyu ma'i dga' ston zad med gyur:byang shar sku glud smug nag 'bar:bgegs kyi yid spyod dang mthun pa'i zad pa bral ba rin chen gter:zag med yid bzhin phung por gyur:skyes pa pho glud stag chas can:rin chen go khrab rgyan gyis brgyan:dpa' bo'i rang bzhin dro gar bsgyur:'chi ba bslu ba'i yas su shar:za ma mo glud sman shar tshul dar zab g.yu byur mdzes pas brgyan:dpa' mo'i rang bzhin glu dbyangs len 'chi ba bsgru ba'i yas su shar:bsko da mjes ban btsun sngags pa' glud bla gos

༷/ sngags chas sna tshogs brgyan: bde chen rang bzhin chos sgra sgogs: 'chi ba bslu ba'i yas su shar: rtse gar bsgyur ba byis pa'i glud: me tog mu tig dar gyis brgyan: bro brdung shag 'byed ston mo byed: 'chi ba bslu ba'i yas su shar re re bzhin du rang 'dra ba: bsam yas glud bdag grangs dang mthun ting 'dzin dkor la zad pa med: sgyu ma'i nor la bdag 'dzin dben nam mkha' mdzod la rin thang bral gshin rjes nyo tshong bzlog pa'i byir yon bdag mi nor 'khor bcas kyi sku yi glud du yas 'bul ma : ngag gi glud du yas 'bul ma : sems kyi glud du yas 'bul ma : tshe yi glud du yas 'bul ma : srog yi glud du yas 'bul lo: dbugs kyi glud du sha yi glud du drod kyi glud du khrag gi glud du 'byung bzhi sgyu ma'i phung po 'di: 'byung lngar grub pa'i tshab glud bsngo: khyer cig las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs: sbyin bdag khram kha bsgyur du gsol: rtsis rdo sprugs la shwa kha gtor: bzung ba thong la bcing pa khrol: bsdam pa klod la mnan pa khyog yo ba bsrengs la ral ba grub: gas pa sbyor la chad pa mthud: 'chi
