med tshe skyabs sgrom du chug: gshin rjes nyo tshong dgra la bzlog: gsum pa cha mang bsngo ba na oṃ a dṛ te hūṃ phaṭaḥ 3 swā bha was sbya sa stong pamingang las sbyin bdag gi sku glud rat+na lnga las grub pa: 'dod pa'i yas sna tshogs lag nas 'gyed cing snyan pa'i glu dbyangs ngag gis spro ba: mdzes pa'i chas rgyan lhab lhub tu bkra zhing: bro gar sdem 'gros sna tshogs su bsgyur ba'i glud gtor sgon me chang bu 'bras chan zad pa med pa'i gter chen po 'di 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje'i rgyal po la 'bul lo yon bdag gis sdon nas lan chags ma sod pa: 'phral gyi bu lon ma byang ba thams cad byang ba dang: tshe glud sgog gi tshab mar bzhes nas dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las bskyab tu gsol: de ltar gtso gcor dgu la bsngo bzhi pa gser dngul sogs sra la bkyags nas 'ad skad do kye: rin chen srang la gzhal byas te gser dngul zangs lcags dong tse ni: brgya stong khri 'bum sa ya sogs 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po dang las mkhan bka' sdod bcas la 'bul: yon bdag sku yi glud du khyer: lan chags bu lon sbyangs phyir bzhes: shwa khram rtsis la bab pa

de/ bzlog: gshin rjes nyo tshong dgra la bsgyur dus min 'chi rkyen bsal du gsol: lnga pa da mar sha thud rgya ma la bkyags nas 'di skad do kye yon bdag bsod nams 'dre ra ldan 'dis: bza' ba sha thud la phug dang: mar tshil tshod dang khams zas rigs: rgya ja zla rgyas la sogs pa: rgya mar 'jal nas grangs bsam yas: 'chi bdag ga na rje khyod la 'bul: sngon gyis lan chags sbyangs phyir khyer: 'phral gyi bu lon sod phyir longs: lus ngag yid kyi glud du bzhes: shā khram rtsis la bab pa bzlog: gshin rjes nyo tshong dgra la bsgyur sbyin bdag dus min 'chi las skyobs: kun rdzob bden mthu chud ma gsan: las gshin 'khor bcas tsham gyur cig: bzung ba thong la bcing ba khrol bsdams pa slod la mnan pa khyogs: zos pa skyugs la dus min gyi: 'chi ba chos kyi dbyings su bzlog: dam tshig ma g.yel sa ma yā: drug pa 'bru sna mang po bre da phul la 'jal nas 'ad skad do kyi: bkra shis 'bras dkar khre dang nas: gro sran bra bo yungs dkar nag: so ba til dang yug dkar dang: rin chen phye ma 'bru sna tshogs bre dang phul la gzhal

byas te: khal du brtsis nas brgya khri 'bum: bye ba sa ya grangs med pa: sbyin bdag glud du 'bul bar bgyi: 'chi bdag 'dzadar dang bcas pas bzhes: shā khram rtsis la btab pa bzlog: gshin rjes nyo tshong dgra la bsgyur: bzung bsdams bci mnan kun las khrol: yon bdag bsam pa lhun grub cing: rnal 'byor sbyin gtong chud ma gsan:las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: bdun pa dar sna phrug ther gos yug phul te kye: rin chen rgyan bzang spras pa yi: thabs shes pho mo rgyan ldan pas: phrag par brgyangs te 'jal ba yi: dar zab gos rigs snam ras dang: phrug ther rnam pa sna tshogs pa: yug chen dos bu bsgrigs pa ni brgya stong khri 'bum brtsegs pa 'di: yon bdag tshe skyin srog glud du 'chi bdag 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: thams cad ngoms shing tshim gyur nas: sngon gyi lan chags sbyangs bar shog 'phral gyi bu lon sod par shog shwa khram rtsis la bab pa bzlog: bzung bsdams mnan dang bcing pa khrol: dus min 'chi rkyen bar chad bzlog: tshe ring nad med bde ldan nas: dam chos byang chub mchog spyod sgo ga: brgyad pa sha yi glud

༷ / du pañtsa 'bul ba ni kye: skye med chos sku'i ngang nyid las: 'gags med bde ba'i mchod sdong ni: rin chen sa las grub pa'i rten: sgyu ma'i phung po rkyen bral phyir:chos nyid dag pa'i 'phrul du byung: chos can bde legs 'dzom phyir bzhengs: 'chi bdag gshin rje 'khor bcas kyis: 'dzin zhen rtog pa rnam dag nas: nga rgyal mtshan ma rang sar grol: sa la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams: mnyam nyid ye shes don rtogs nas yon bdag sha khams bkrag mdangs 'phel: nad gdon rkyen las thar gyur cig: dgu pa khrag ga glud du 'o chab 'bul ba ni kye: 'byung ba rnam par dag pa'i dbyings: bde chen ma mā ki yi klong: 'bri zam 'o ma'i chab dang sbyar: mgrin par bde zhing ljags la 'jam:sems la phan pa'i skyems bzang 'di: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po ni: 'khor dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi: ngoms tshim gnod 'che'i sems bral nas: zhe sdang 'khrul ba ka nas dag: chu la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams: me long ye shes don rtogs nas yon bdag khrag khams 'phel zhing rgyas: nad gdon rkyen las thar gyur cig: bcu pa drod kyi glud

du mar me 'bul ba ni bye: ma rig bsal ba'i mdangs dang ldan: ye shes sgron me 'od po che: sgyu rkyen rten 'brel phun sum tshogs: sa lam gsal zhing phan bder spyor de 'dra'i snang gsal ya mtshan can: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po dang bgegs rigs 'byung po rnams la 'bul ngoms tshim gnod sems gdug rtsub zhi: 'dod chags mtshan 'dzin rnam par dag: me la gnas pa'i lha 'dre yis: sor rtog ye shes don rtogs nas: yon bdag drod khams bde legs 'bar: bar chad rkyen las thar gyur cig: babyu gcig pa dbugs kyiglud du rlung sgo dbugs dang 'byu snas bkang ba 'bul ba ni bye: rgyu ba thogs med stobs dang ldan: mthong yul ma yin reg tu srid stobs ldan kun la 'gro ba'i yas: rlung gis bkang ba'i skyal ba la phun tshogs 'bru yis bum gter bcas: skye med 1nga las 'gags med 'phrul rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i rdzas: 'chi bdag gshon rje'i rgyal po yi: blon 'bangs yi dwags tshogs la 'bul: zhen chags gtum rngam 'khrul ba stong phrag dog mtshan 'dzin rnam par dag: rlung la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams: bya grub

je / ye shes don rtogs nas: yon bdag dbugs khams bde ldan zhing: mi mthun rkyen las thar gyur cig: bcu gnyis pa sems kyi glud du ma thi shog la e bris pa 'bul ba ni kye: 'byung ba chen po nam mkha' ni: skye ba med cing mtshon dpe bral: rten 'brel gdul bya'i re skong phyir: kha dog be+eḍūr rang bzhin gzhir: skye med dbyings kyi yi ge e: ra byung chos kyi gzugs su bkod: mtshan 'dzin spros pa dag byed 'di: rnal 'byer rtogs ldan phyag rgyas 'phrul: rigs pa sngags kyi gzi byin phab shin tu phun sum tshogs pa'i yas: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po ni las gshin g.yog 'khor bcas la 'bul: gtum drag gdug rtsub rngams yus byang: lan chags bu lon kun kyang sod gti mug rtogs pa rnam par dag: mkha' la gnas pa'i la 'dre rnams: chos dbyings ye shes don rtogs nas: yon bdag sems nyid bde ldan cing: dam pa'i chos la spyod gyur cig: skar ma rab rib mar me bzhin: chos kun rdzun pa'i rang bzhin can: 'chi ba kun gyis ngo shes nas: stong nyid snying rje'i dpal sgod bzhin: gzhan phan las la gnas

gyur cig bcu gsum pa 'chi ba baspu phyir yas rdzongs gdab pa ni kye: rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas rnams: dri za'i gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig:grul bum gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs lan chags bu lon kun sod nas na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig:srul po'i gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs lan chags bu lon kun sod nas:na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: sha za'i gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: grib gnon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: gshin rje'i gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: chu lha'i gdon las rgyal

shā/ /— ba'i phyir: srad pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: gnod sbyin gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig me lha'i gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: srin po'i gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: rlung lha'i gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: dbang ldan gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzo sa su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: nyi zla'i gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir:srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul

las thar gyur cig: gza' skaragadon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig:lha minagadon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig yi dwagasagadon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: nam gru'i gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: skems pa'i gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: g.yel pa'i gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs:lan chags bu lon kun sodanas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: 'byung po'i gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon

kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: 'og gdon rkyen las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun nas na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig gyen rgyu'i gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i pa las thar gyur cig:thal sol gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur pho sri'i gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig:mo 'dre'i gdon rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig 'gong po'i gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir:pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig:be+e the'u gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams

rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: gri bo'i gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs:lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: rgyal btsan gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: gnyan gtod gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: klu yi gdon las rgyal ba'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnams rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: gzhan yang stong phrag brgyad bcu'i bgegs: 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dang: gdon chen bco lnga sri yi tshogs: thams cad ngoms shing tshim pa'i phyir: srid pa'i yas rnam rdzongs su 'debs: lan chags bu lon kun sod nas: na 'chi'i g.yul las thar gyur cig: 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe thob shog bcu bzha pa 'chi bzlog ni kyi: mkha' la

༷/— gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams:sems med sems kyi thugs dam bskangs:'dzin stangs dri ma rnam dag cing:na 'chi nam mkha'i dbyings su bzlog:sa la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams sha med sha yis thugs dam bskang:gdos mtshan 'khrul ba ka dag cing:na 'chi spyan ma'i dbyings su bzlog:chu la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams khrag med khrag gis thugs dam bskangs:a 'thas mtshan ma ka dag cing:na 'chi mā ki'i dbyings su bzlog me la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams:drod med drod kyis thugs dam bskangs:chags sred 'khrul ba rnam dag nas:na 'chi gos dkar dbyings su bzlog:rlung la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams:dbugs med dbugs kyi thugs dam bskangs:snyems byed 'khrul ba rnam dag nas:na 'chi sgrol ma'i dbyings su bzlog:stong nyid spros dang bral ba la:rnam rtogs nad gdon mi dmigs kyang:'on kyang tha snyad rten 'brel ngor:kun rdzob sgyu ma'i rgud tshogs bzlog:skye ba chos kyi dbyings su bzlog:rgas pa dbu ma chen por bzlog:na ba 'od gsal dgongs slong bzlog:'chi ba ka dag chen por bzlog:

thogs bcas mtshan ma med par bzlog:thogs med gzhi rtsa bral bar bzlog: dga' brod re dogs dben par bzlog:snyems byed de bzhin nyid du bzlog: lugs 'byung bde ba chen por bzlog: lugs ldog sku gsum dgongs par bzlog sems ni rig pa chos skur bzlog tha snyad spros bral chen por bzlog: skye med dbyings kyi bha gar bzlog: 'gags med gsal dag dwangs sang bzlog rtsol bral mnyam pa nyid du bzlog: mtha' grol bde ba chen por bzlog kun khyab btsun mo'i mkha' ru bzlog:bzlog bsgyur spros bral don rtogs na: skye 'chi mi dmigs byang chub thob: eḥyeḥ ཿreḥlam̐ḥ.a la la bh+yo: bzlog bzlog thal brdab dmod bor don dam skyongs bar chad g.yul rgyal the tshom med sa ma yu bco lnga lam bstan bya ba ni e: ka dag skye med nga nyid las: 'gags med sgyu 'phrul ltad mo'i gnas: yid bskang 'dod pa tshang ba'i yas: lha yi dkor las lhag pa'i gnas: mi zad nam mkha' yangs pa'i mdzod rnal 'byor rig pas ltad mor bskrun: gang shar rang grol mdos mchod 'di: yon bdag sku ya glud du 'bul:mtshan

'dzin spros dang bral bar spyod: re chags zhen pa med par longs: dga' mgu yi rang tsham gyur nas: gshin rjes nyo tshong dgra la bzlog: yon bdag 'chi ) kha las thar: shwa gtor khram bzlog rtsis kha bsgyur za rngam gdug rtsub rnam 'gyur ni za 'dre phung sri dgra la ston: da ni glud bdag mdos mgron rnams: rgya mtsho chu yi phyogs su: lam bstan de ru zhugs nas songs: dpag tshad mang po'i pha rol dengs: klu yi dkor dang mnyam por spyod: gnyan dang thugs mthun dam tshig bsrung gtod sa 'bangs su brten bcas nas: zad med mdzod chen 'di la spyod: phan pa byang chub sems mchog bskyed: zab mo stong nyid don la stos: yang dag nges pa'i don rtogs sa lam yon tan mthar byin te: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i spyan sngar 'khod: de don rtogs mdzod glud bdag rnams 'di ltar mi nyan 'tshe ba'i rigs rdo rje 'chang chen khros nas: lus sgog dngos po rdul brlag nas: de bzhin nyid du bsgrad 'gyur ro: de bas da lta nyid du dengs: sarba bisnye gtsā dge ba bsngo zha smon lam gdab dab bskur tshe

'gugs rbab bstims bya bkra shis brjod cing me tog 'thor de ni nad gdon rkyen las grol sa ma mā ma 'gyur 'grub pa'i sku glud 'dis 'phral snyen sngon las bu lon bya de ri 'chi nges mi yan kya lo gsum bar du bshol theb 'gyur tshe 'phrang 'chi ba'i 'jags las skyobs bzod dka' ngan 'gro'i 'phrang las sgrol ci'i phyir zhe na rje btsun ma thugs bskyed smon lam ldan phyir dang gdul bya bsod nams 'dzom pas so de phyar de la yad ches bskyed gsang sngags mos pas grub pa la khyad gsod ma rung nges shes brten don gnyas 'grub pa' rgyu ru shar the tshom med do sa ma yu gca' gzhi gzhud ltar grub par bya 'chi bdag bskyed 'gugs gab brgyad ltar gzhan rnams sbyar tshul rig pas dpog 'di btang yon tan bsam mtha' yas sa ma mā e ma rgyal dbang pad+ma sa bha wa' skal bzang gdul byar thugs brtse bas mtha' dbus rin chen gter gyis bkang bstan 'gro'i rgud sel gsos su smin de yi nang tshan khye'u chung ba gang zhag 'gro ngor bsam yas bzhengs bdud 'joms mched lnga'i ya gyal grags khrag 'thung nu ldan rdo rje yi bgo skal 'od gsal thugs thig 'di bkra shis sgo ma gsham nas rted bstan 'gror phan pa' gsos su 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma yā bka' 'di srungs shig sman btsun ma dam nyams lag tu ma shor cig thugs sras gdul zhi yo sa la spel sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu h+ya brda thim snyi

sde'i— zhes pa 'di'angalung zen chos bdag ral khur gsum gyis thugs bzhed skong ba'i phyir da /grogs kyi tshe 'phra bsal phyimango bo nusaldan 'dus pa rtsal kyis mkha' 'gro'i gas mdzod las zhal bshus te dag pa ra pha ba pa'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi bdag pob kwartes brgyas pa dge legs 'phel/sarba masgo la/

༷/ mang gi rgyugs byang ni snyen a a mṛ tehūṃ phaṭa: snyen swā bha was sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las sbyin bdag gi sku glud rat+na lnga las grub pa: 'dod pa'i yas sna tshogs lag nas 'gyed cing snyan pa'i glu dbyangs ngag gis spro ba: mdzes pa'i chas rgyan lhab lhub tu bkra zhing: bro gar ldem 'gros sna tshogs su bsgyur ba'i: glud gtor sgron me chang bu 'bras chan zad pa med pa'i gter chen po 'di 'chi bdag ga na rje'i phyag brnyan gong tshe khrab gyon 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul lo: yon bdag gis sngon nas lan chags ma sod pa: 'phral gyi bu lon ma byang ba thams cad byang ba dang: tshe glud srog gi tshab mar bzhes nas dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las bskyab tu gsol: zhes da 'chi bdag gshin rje'i phyag brnyan bdud 'bum nag po 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul lo: de bzhi du 'chi bdag gshin rje'iphyag brnyan rtsis mkhan dmar po 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag brnyan gru zam ljang nag 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag brnyan skya ring mig gcig 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag brnyan mig dmar rdul thogs 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag
brnyan rdzong bdag sngon po 'khor phyag brnyan gshin rje gdong dgu 'khor dang bcas la 'bul lo:sgo chung gsar bur phan pa'i phyir gter ston rang gis sbyar ba 'o masgo le/

che/ gtor ma 'bul dus 'gugs bstims na atshobs gru gsum lcags khang 'bar ba'i nang du: dro dngatreḥlas yid brnag dgra bgegs dngos su gsal la:na re :brgyud ldan rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i bka' bden pa dang: tshe 'dzin grub pa'i rgyal mo'i lha sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin zab mo'i mthus: bstan pa la 'tshe zhing yongs la gnod pa bdag la rgol ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig lan gsum/ patshu me ho: dbyings nas mched thun gyi char bab pa sa gzugs phung khrol bur gtubs te sha rus khrag gsum nam mkha'i khyon da mnyam par gyur: yin ma hā ba lirnya me sa rak+ta king ni ri ti swā ra ṇa phaṭa:yin anywa: lan gsum brjod la sbya sa bsgyur spel 'di ya 'gyur med rgya mtsho'i ngor nus ldan dpa' bos spel ba dge sarba masgo le/

bye brag rus pa'i glud du rdo dkar 'bul ba ni kye: sra brtan mi 'gyur gsal ba'i rdzas: dri ma med pa'i kha dog can: 'od lnga rang chas lhun grub pa'i: bkra shis dung rdo ra po 'di: yon bdag rus pa'i glud ched du 'chi bdag gshon rje 'khor bcas la bsam yas 'bul ba'i byin rlabs kyis: ma rigs 'khrul ba rnam dag nas: nad na rkyen las rgyal gyur cig: zhes sha glud kya rjes su sbyar rung bar mngon brda sgrom la mi 'dug kya dgongs pa 'i gtad rgya la 'dug pa sa sbas ma sbob paranus ldan pas so/ sarba maṅga la/
༷/ dpal 'chi med grub pa'i mdos kyi gab don gnad byang brgyad palja:

༷yi/ na tho ār+ya re ya: thasko/je) dang bo ༅na rje bskyed chog mi sto ba ra sbyang sa te de'i ngang las e: chos nyid stong pa'i ngang nyid las: rang mdun gru gsum e yi klong: rngam brjid gshin thang ya nga ba sod rgyob 'byug sgra stong bzhin sgrogs gcan spyang sha za 'byung po rgyu: rak+ta 'phyo zhing me rlung 'tshubs ging rus laṅka sdig phag 'phro: de dbus thod mkharagru gsum pa: gnam lcags 'ur mos gzer gdab pa: zhag dang khrag gi zham chu g.yo: zhing chen bla bre ba su tas drwa ba drwa phyed mig sbril 'phyang: lag pas mdo 'dzan the tso dang: ne tsos mdzes rgyan du mar bkra: nyi zlas sang skar me rlung g.yo: dug gsum gdon 'dul ka gdung bkram: bzod dka'i gzi mdangs rab 'bar klong:ya:las༄1ba pa'i gshin rje ni: spug nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis me longs thod phreng 'dzin: g.yon gnyis bhan dmar zhags pa bsdams zhal gdangs ljang 'dril spyan gsum bsgrad: khro gtum gar dgu'i nyamasakyis 'khyud: zhing g.yang stag sham sbrul do byas: khams nag ral brdzis thod skam brgyan: nyi zlas snyan cha 'od dang

༷/ ldan: zhabs gnyis gyad kyi stabs 'gying gis: ma he glang rgod gdan la rol: me dud rlung nag 'tshubs ma 'phyo: legs nyes ltong 'dzin chen por gsal:shar du las gshin gong tshe ni: dmar nag khro nyams ldan pa la: lcags kyi khrab rmog mdzes par brgyan: spu gri zhags pa phyag char 'dzin: skye 'gro'i sgog la dbang za ba'i:brda rtags gom pas bsgrod thabs bsgyur: 'jigs byed las kyi pho nyar gsal: lho ru bdud 'bum sngo nag gtum: mi lpags gzig sham mgo phreng brgyan: lan na khram shing zhags pa 'dzin skye 'gro lo zla'i khram la 'debs zhag dang dus tshod grangs su 'dzin: mi srun bgegs steng gyad thabs rol: phyag brnyan rlung gi bang ldan gsal: nub tu rtsis mkhan dmar smug sgegs: ral 'phyings sdang mig glog ltar 'khyugs: glang ko mi lngags gos su klubs: rtsis rdo dang ni zhags pa bsnams: skye 'gro rtsis la 'debs par byed gom pas stabs bsgyur me rlung g.yo: las gshin sgog bdag 'bar ba gsal: byang du gru zam ljang nag ni: me yi ral pa glog ltar 'byugs: dug gi kha chu sprin ltar

'phyo: mche ba gangs ri ltar du gcigs: mi lpags rlon pa rgyan du klubs: rkang pa rdo rje'i gar du bsgyur: lag na nad skyal sbrul zhags bsdams: thogs ser bu yug 'tshubs slong gsal shar lto skya ringaso ba smug: dpral bar mig gcig stong khams gsal: rgyab nas gshog gcig thogs med rta: rkang pas 'khrul 'khor rlung gcig ldan sku la stag lpags thul ba gsol: brdung byed tho ba klad khrag 'dzin: skye 'chi ston pa'i kha lo ba: phyag nyan dus 'dzin 'bar ba gsal: lto nub mig dmarardel thogs ser lcags kyi sgra la spu gri'i so: zangs kyi mig ni glog ltar 'byugs: rin chen snyan cha mi lngags klubs: mgo phreng sbrul do stag sham mdzes rkang pa bsgol 'byud tshul du rol: lag na dkar nag rde'u thogs thog zer 'phro zhing me rlung 'byugs: rab 'jigs bzod dka'i dkyil 'dor gsal: nub byang rdzongs bdagasku mdog sngo: khro gtum 'bar ba'i rnam 'gyur can g.yas g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ zhags pa 'dzin: dur khrod dpal chas rgyan du klubs: zhabs bsgrad me rlung 'tshubs ma 'phyo: khrag 'thung rngams pa'i sku ru gsal: byang shar

༷/ gshin rje gdong dgu ni dbus gsum khro zhal rngam brjid 'bar: g.yon gsum ma he bzhad pa'i gdong: g.yas gsum rab 'bar stag gi mgo: 'byung po rnams la za rngams g.yo: zhing chen stag sham dar dpyangs klubs: zhabs gnyis gyad chen thabs su rol: g.yas pa sa thod zor tsit+ta 'dzin: g.yon pa lcags kyi gri gug bsdams: 'jigs byed srin po'i sku ru gsal: rang rang g.yog 'khor bsam mtha' yas: rab 'jigs me rlung 'tshubs dbus su gsod gcod las la hab thob rgyu:gshin bya sna tshogs sha la rub gshin glang ro bkal mang po dang: gshin khyi mang po ngu zug 'ur rngam pa'i chu sgra 'u ru rtsa 'jigs pa'i rlung nag 'chubs se 'tshubs: 'bar ba'i me dpung tho ro ro: 'jigs pa'i dud rlangs da la la shin tu skyi g.ya' nyam nga'i gnas bzod par dka' ba'i dal du gsal: gnyis pa bden stobs brdar ba ni na mo: drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang: yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug gi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang: gnas gsum ma dang

mkha' 'gros bden pa dang tshe 'dzin grub pa'i rgyal mo'i sku gsung thugs yon tan brin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bden pa da : bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden pa'i mthus: rgyu spyor ba pon gyi bdag po mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe sgog la dbang za zhing 'phrog par shom pa'i 'chi bdag gshin rje gtso 'khor dgu dang las mkhan phyag nyan g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa dmigs pa'i rten 'ad la mchis par gyur cig: dzaḥ/ baṃ ho: lan gsum ( 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrogs shing: bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms pa'i bdud: dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha: he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: srid pa gsum po 'gugs gyur na: dmigs pa'i 'byung por smos ci dgos sems med pa yang 'gugs byed na: lus sems ldan pa smos ci dgos: gzugs med pa yang 'gugs nus na: gzugs dang ldan pa smos ci dgos: 'di la dug gsum 'byung po 'gugs du gsol: phaṭa: thams cad ma lus 'gugs byed pa'i: khro chen rngam pa'i lcags kyu can: gnad nas bskul lo 'chi bdag ni: gshin rje 'khor bcas mchis gyur

༷/ cig: dzaḥshā baṃ ho: nyer lnga'am gang 'os brjod gsum pa mda' dar bcas nas spyan 'dren pa ni /: lto phyogs gshin thang dmar po nas thod pa lcags kyi sku mkhar slo : mi rta bam chen bsnol steng nas: 'byu po yi dwags kun gyi gtso: ya: las grub pa'i stobs po che: 'chi bdag gshin rje 'khor dang bcas: glu yis 'bod do da tshur byon: dar dkar g.yab po da tshur byon: rol mo'i sgras bskul da tshur byon: rkang gling bshud pas 'bod do byon: yon bdag 'chi rkyen bsal phyir byon: dga' ston tshogs dang shag la byon: lan chags bu lon 'jal la gshegs: glud bdag mdos bdag 'khor bcas kyis: ma tshor ma rig ma smra bar: khams gsum srid pa'i spyi mdos la: dga' 'dzum dang spro bcas te 'dus ma phyi ma 'gyangs sa ma yu: ya ma rā dza sarba badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: dza hūṃ baṃ ho: na mo sa ma ya ho: bzhi pa mdos dzos phyin brlabs ni skyo las brdal khyab snod nang du: spyo las dkon nor bsam mtha' yas tra:las rin chen dar zab rigs: hri:las zas sna bsam mi khyab: ā:las bkra shis rdzas rtags sogs: zad med nam

mkha'i rgyan gyur ba: rnam rgyal lha yi dkor las lhag: skyes pas mda' 'phen sha ra ra: bud med 'phang bsgril si li li: dpa' bo'i stag chas da la la: dpa' mo'i zhi chas ya la la: bal rgyang 'ja' tshon me re re nor rgyang bsam 'phel kyi li li: khram rgyang ri mo sha ra ra: sku glud smra mkhas ljags ljags byed 'gro mkhas de ni ldems se ldem: nam mkha' chos dbyings 'od gsal klong mar me mun sel mdangs dang ldan: khrag rkong bde ba'i dpal ster yas: gtor ma bcud ldan ri ltar brjed: chang bu tshim pa drug ldan dkor mtheb skyu 'dod pa ster ba'i mdzod glud 'brang 'byung po ngoms pa'i rdzas: mi srid dgu 'phrul srid pa'i mdos: yas glud cha ma cho dgu ni: rnal 'byor rigs pa'i 'phrul du bkod: sgyu ma lta bu'i lha 'dre la: ngoms pa bskang ba'i nor du spel: nam mkha' mdzod la mthongs spyod regag: sngagasadrug phyag rgya drug gas brlabs mi zad nam mkha' mdzod du sgo sa ma yu lnga ba dkar nag dbye ba ni shā dkar lha la phul te bswo: bkra shis lha yi nyi ma la: dge mtshan phywa g.yang 'phel ba dang: dam can ngo so mtho ba dang: sbyin bdag tshe srog brtsan pa'i

shā/ / phyir rin chen dung shwa mdzes pa 'di: lha chen tshangs pa'i phyag tu phul 'phags ma grub pa'i rgyal mo mchod: pho lha dgra bla thams cad bskangs: sman btsun mched lnga'i ngo so bstod: gnod sbyin shan pa'i dbu 'phang bstod: wa mi mthun spyor bkra shis shog rgyal lo spyin bdag lha rgyal lo: shwa nag 'cha bdud la phul nas kyi las las grub pa'i ma rig pa 'chi bdud tshe 'phrog dam sri yis: log lam mi dge bcu la spyod: rnam smin ngan song don gnyer mkhan: 'di yis nyes pa sna dgu bstan: de ring pham zhing sma phab phyir: shwa nag 'chi bdag khyod la 'bul: shwa gzhi gnod byed steja du sprugs: pham mo dgra 'dre gnyis pham mo: de nas lha rdo phul la kye: bkra shis lha rdo dkar po 'di:lha klu mi la bslang ba'i dkor: bkra shis tshe ring grub pa'i rdzas: dge mtshan dpal gyi mchod pa 'di: yid bzhin grub pa'i rgyal mor 'bul: pho lha dgra bla srog lha bskangs:sman btsun rdo rje g.yu sgon brngan: chos skyong gnod sbyin rgyal por bstod: tshe sgog ka ba brtan pa dang: rdo rje grub pa'i gzhi tshugs shig: rgyal lo bkra shis lha rgyal lo: de nas rdo

nag 'chi bdud la bstabs te kyi: 'dre rdo 'chi bdag bskang ba'i rdzas lha 'dres nyo tshong 'byung ba'i yas: gdon sna rang gnas bsgyur ba'i dkor sgog bdud nag po khyod la 'bul 'dre gdon nyo tshong dgra la bsgyur: pham mo 'dre gdon gnyis pham mo de nas lha shing phul la e: dbang sngon 'dab yangs stong khyab gzhir mi 'gyur bde ba mchog brten phyir bkra shis lha shing sba snyug 'di: ma sring mnyes pa'i dam rdzas mchog: gnam gyi 'ju thag brtsan phyir bstod: sa yi rten phur brjed phyir 'dzug: tshe srog ka ba rgyas phyir bsrings chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzug phyir bkod 'phags ma grub pa'i rgyal mo mchod 'go ba'i lha srung thams cad bstod: rgyal lo dge legs dpal 'bar ro: de nas 'dre shang 'chi bdud la bstabs te kye: 'dre shing tsher nag mtshon rtse can dug gsum gdon dang mthun pa'i yas: 'dre bdud rang gnas bsgyur ba'i dkor 'chi bdud nag po khyod la 'bul: gdon bgegs 'dre yi za kha bsgyur: sbyin bdag gegs las thar bar mdzod: pham 57 dam sri gdon bgegs pham: de nas dmu thag dkar po 'bul la badza : dza sa

༷nyizu dbyings mi 'gyur nam mkha' la: 'od gsal bkra ba'i me long ngor: ro mnyam sgyu ma'i dga' ston 'di bde ba mchog las g.yo med cing: grub pa tshe rgyud rtogs pa'i phyir: bkra shis dmu thag yar la bstod: phywa yi rten phur 'gyur med brtsan: g.yang gi mtsho mo rtag par bskyil bkra shis chos kyi ba dan phyar: 'di la grub pa'i rgyal mo yis: kha 'dzin sdong grogs mi g.yel bar: rtag tu thugs rjes srung skyobs mdzod: rgyal lo don gnyis lhun grub pa'i: rnal 'byor 'di phyi gnyis shar rgyal: de nas dmu thag nag po 'chi bdud la bstabs te kye: 'dre dang gdon gyi rgyug lam te: gri bo gshed kyi za lam yin: skye 'chi ston pa'i las lam de: 'chi bdag khyod kyi rang gnas bsdus: dus min nad gdon 'chi ba bzlog: gdon dang 'dre yi rgyug lam chod: 'byung po yongs kyi za kha chod: pham mo bdud bgegs thal bar rlog: de dag dkar nag dbye bsal lo rten 'brel bsgrags pa'i cho ga'o: sa ma yā drug pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni 'gugs bstams sbyangs spel grub nas su 〈stes man+ta ka sarba sa pā ri wa ra 6sde rda bha lirnyi kha kha khā nyi khā hi: lan bcu ru bsngos te kyai 'chi

bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po yi phyag nyan kong tshe 'khor bcas la: gtor ma 'di dang dgra bo gnyis: gtad du 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes: yid brnag dgra sde stong par mdzod phyag nyan bdud 'bum nag po la: gtor ma 'di dang dgra bo gnyis: gtad du 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes: yid brnag dgra sde stong par mdzod:phyag nyan rtsis mkhanadamar po la gtor ma 'di dang dgra bo gnyis gtad du 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes:yid brnag dgra sde stong par mdzod:phyag nyan gru zam nag po la:gtor ma 'di dang dgra bo gnyis: gtad du 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes: yid brnag dgra sde stong par mdzod: phyag nyan skya ring smug po la: gtor ma 'di dang dgra bo gnyis gtad du 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes yid brnag dgra sde stong par mdzod: phyag nyan mig dmar rdil thogs la: gtor ma 'di dang dgra bo gnyis: gtad du 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes:yid brnag dgra sde stong par mdzod phyag nyan rdzong bdag sngon po la: gtor ma 'di dang dgra bo gnyis: gtad du 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes yid brnag dgra sde

༷| stong par mdzod: phyag nyan ga na rje gdong dgu la gtor ma 'di dang dgra bo gnyis: gtad du 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes: yid brnag dgra sde stong par mdzod: 'chi bdag gcin rje nag po la gtor ma 'di dang dgra bo gnyis: gtad du 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes: yid brnag dgra sde stong par mdzod: bka' nyan 'khor chogs rgya mtsho la gtor ma 'di dang dgra bo gnyis: gtad du 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes yid brnag dgra sde stong par mdzod: dgra bo'i pho rgyud rtsad nas chod: mo rgyud mngal skems chung rgyud stong: thams cad ming gi lhag mar mdzod: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas: 'chi bdag bdud las rab rgyal te: phung po bde legs dpal gyis 'tsho: nyon mongs sgrib pa mkha' ltar dag: don dam skye med mngon gyur regag: de ltar brngan rdzas gtor ma 'bul las kyi gshin rje'i mnyes pa bskangs khram phyi shā gtor byad thag gcod rgyug byang 'bul zhing zhus len bya sa ma yā bdun pa zhal bsgyur bya ba ni kye: dza sa nyid don dam stong pa la: 'khor 'das gnyis med bde ba che: spros bral ka dag kun tu bzang: de don ma rig

'khrul ba'i ngor: lugs 'byung khams gsum 'khor ba bkod: nga dang bdag tu mtshan mar bzung: skye 'chi'i snang ba lugs rgyud byung lha 'dre rang mtshan bden par bltas:re dogs chags sdang nyer len byas: 'thab rtsod pham rgyal sna dgu brtsams de ltar kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i ngor rten 'brel bsgru med bden 'byung phyir: brgyan brgyan btags btags bsags spel brdzangs: sgyu ma'i tshogs chen rdzogs par bya: sngon gyi lan chags byang bar 'bul: 'phral gyi rkyen gegs bsal phyir ster: mgron rnams ngoms shing tshim par byas: dmigs pa'i yon bdag rin gyis nyos: tshong dang shag gi bya ba grub da ni gshin sgo dam du sdoms tha ram lcags zhun rgya yis thobasnye gshin gson sa mtshams phyag rgyas bgo: dga' ston nor sna gshin yul khyer: tshe dpal bsod nams bdag la stsol: 'jigs rngam snang ba rang gnas su: mi dmigs bde ba chen por hūṃ: de dag bsgyur bzlog rim pa'o sa ma yā brgyad pa thar yag bya ba ni 'o: 'chi med grub pa'i dkyil 'khor mthu e che: gshin gson gyi nyo tshong 'dun ma e 'byub: phyag nyan pho nya rnams yas

༷|ca kyis e tshim: 'dre gdon dam sri 'byung po rnams rdul du e brlag: yon bdag gi bla tshe gshin sgrom las e lon: rnal 'byor pa'i bskyed rdzogs nus mthu dang e ldan: rang gzhan gyi bsam don lhun gyi e grub: de ltar phun sum tshogs par phran btab po e: grub po bkra shis bya ba mtha' ru phyin: rgyal lo rgyal lo lha rgyal lo: de ltar bkra shi thar yag brjod: khyad par ga'u sgrub pa ni: rta: 'jig rten gnas su 'byung ba lnga: rang bzhin dbyings su yum chen lnga: dam tshig bkod mdzes ga'u lnga: ye shes lhun rdzogs dkyil 'khor lnga: phung khams 'byung ba gso ba'i rdzas: rten 'brel rtags kyi rdzas su dmigs: eḥrbaḥleXreḥyeḥtsakra tiṣ+ṭha a yudzñā na tshe t+t+waṃ de ltar sgrub ci rab tu gnas mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba gsum du mos dmigs bya rnams la tshe dab bskur gnad des rkyen zhi tshe dpal rgyas 'phral sna nad gdon dbyangs su grol ze tshom med do sa ma yā ye ma rgyal kun phrin lasagacig bsdus pa ཿ o rgyan pad+ma saṃ bha was gdul zhang phan bdes 'tsho ba'i phyir gangs ljongs rin chen gter gyis gtam de 'don rgyal tshab mi nub 'byung snyigs ma'i dmu rgod 'gro ba skyobs mdzad pa sbyor sgrol ma nges spyod don la phan bde mchog gi

gzhi mi nub rgyun mi chad pa las khrag 'thung nusaldan rdo rje zhes 'brog ban rgyal tshab skyes bu 'byung de yi bgo skal mdo khams nas zab chos 'od gsal thugs thig rnyed gdul zhi yongs la phan bde ngoms 'brel tshad pad+ma 'od du 'pho de bar srungs shag sman btsun ma bka' log lag tu ma shor cag sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhes pa 'da' lung zin rnams kyi thugs bzhed skong phyir da / grogs kya 'phral rkyen bsal phyir/ kho bo nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod lagazhal bshus te dag par phab pa' yi ge pa na chosabadag gan zhirtisabagyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

/ dpal 'chi med grub pa'i mdos kyi kha bskang gzer tig bcu pasnyi:rku8)37 dang po dgyes mchod dkar po ni kyi: 'chi bdag gshin rje nag po dang: phyag gnyan las mkhan mched brgyad po: rang rang dam tshig ldan pas dgongs bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas: shwa khram rtsis btab bsal ba dang: dus min 'chi ba bzlog dros dbyings nam mkha' 'ja' tshon ris: pho gdong mda' ni thabs kyis yas mo gdong 'phang bkra shes rab rdzas: bdud zhags chan dur yas rnams: pho rog ngang ngur shug gu dang: chang bu lo grangs mtheb skyu sogs: rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i yas glud 'di: dka' ser gyis nyos nas 'bul: skya 'phrul zad med gter chen 'bul: ngoms par byed pa'i yas su 'bul: tshim par nus pa'i glad du

'bul grol bar byed pa'i chos su spel las gshin 'khor dang bcas pas bzhes: dga' ston rang gi gnas su khyer: yi dwags rnam ni tshim par pyos: za rngam lto zhal dgra la ston: dmigs pa'i bla sgog khyer ba de: sngags 'chang mthu ldan bdag la sprod: bdag cag 'dun ma gtam pa de: gegs med bden 'gyur gtan tshigs yin zhes brjod dkar yas gshin rjer 'bul gnyis pa brngan yas gtong ba ni kyi de reng bdag cag yon mchod kyis rmi ltas pra mtshan ngan pa dang: 'byung po yongs kyi rgol ba dang: sde brgyad za kha bstan pa dang: byad phur rbod gtong g.yo zhabrugs dang: dus min 'chi rkyen ldang ba dang: lha 'dres nyo tshong 'dod pa dang: bdud khram rtsis la bab pa sogs: bsal zhing bzlog par bya ba'i phyir: yas glud nag po mar la 'jal: 'dre lam gcod pa'i nam mkha' dang: ra dang rus pa mar gyi lkog: sgog pa sol khram tshwa g.yer dang: zho lad kham tshig mu kha'i rdzas: cha ma cho dgu yas su 'debs dal 'dre'i za ka dgra la bsgyur 'byung po'i 'gong kha dgra la bzlog the'u rang bla 'byer dgra la bzor: bse rag thab nyal dgra

che/ la bh+yo: bsrung bya na 'chi'i g.yul las rgyal: ngan dgu dug bcu bh+yo bzlog bsgyur: zhes brjod yasanag gshin rjer bsngo gsum pa khram phyu bya ba ni gser skyems mchod la 'di skad do e: sku mtshog grub pa'i rgyal mo la: dam tshig dag pas phya ga bgyi'o: gzu dang dpang du bzhugs su gsol: bdud rtsi phud mchod 'di bzhes la: las kyi shan drang dbye bar mdzod: deng gi sgyu sbyor yon bdag 'di: gshin rjes khram la btab pa phyungs: phyag gnyan gyis khram la btab pa phyungs: sde brgyad kyis khram la btab pa phyungs: lha 'dres khram la btab pa phyungs: dam tshig ldan pa'i phyag rgyas bkrol: 'chi ba chos kyi dbyings su bsgyur: na ba ka dag dgongs par bsre gegs bdud rtsis khram dgra la bsgyur: bzhi — khram/ shi phyi ba ni shā: sngags 'chang rnal 'byor he ru ga: che ba'i dbang phyug nga nyid kyi: sku la rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: g.yas pa thabs kyi rang bzhin la:rig stong mtshon pa'i rdo rje gdeng sa: g.yon pa shes rab rang bzhin can: chos dbyings dril bu gsung snan 'dzin: gtam chen me 'bar sngang mig gis: bgegs kyi tshogs

rnams dbang du byed: ye shes 'od zer rab spros pas: khram gyi byang bu phyag tu bkug sbrul thag dmar nag ral gris bcad khram sna gcan gzan ngar mas bsgyur: khram yig dgongs sngon chab kyis bkrus:rdo rje'i phyag rgyas khram byang bcag: yon bdag 'chi bdud kha las thar: tshe srog 'gyur med srung du bcug: lnga pa khram sna gtor ba ni bh+yo:shar bdud pho mo'i khram sna de: dpal gyi dar nag 'bar bas gtor: lho bgegs gshin rje'i khram sna de: ngar ldan gri shu la yis gtor: nub bgegs nā ga'i khram sna de dug mtshon sbrul nag zhags pas gtor: byang phyogs gnod sbyin khram sna de:rno mtshon spu gri ngar mas gtor:shar sto me yi khram sna de khrag chen bhan+ta 'bar bas gtor: lho nub laṅka'i khram sna de: phyag mtshan gnam lcags rdo rjes gtor nub byang rlung gi khram sna de: brdung byed thod dbyug phyag rgyas gtor: byang shar bgegs kyi khram sna de: ru mtshon ngar ma'i dbal gyis gtor: nyi zla tshangs pa'i khram sna de lcags kyi drwa bas dbyings su gtor: bar nas sde brgyad khram sna de: ban bon phyag rgya 'bar bas gtor: sa bdag

༷/ gnyan gyi khram sna de: khyung chen rngam pa'i nus mthus gtor: bla tshe sgog gsum khram las 'byung: las gshin khram kha dgra la bsgyur: mi mthun mi 'dod phyogs kun bzlog: ra ya k+ṣe ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog: ya k+ṣe ya tsa bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog: kā la rū pa bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog: phyogs mchams steng 'og kun tu gtor drug pa bla sgrom phyu ba ni kye: nga ni grub pa'i rgyal mo ste: sgron ma'i spyan gyis gzigs tsa na: gshin rje'i bla sgrom smug po mthong: thabs kyi phyag rgya lcags kyus 'gugs shes rab lde'u mig 'byed mkhas kyis:bsdam pa'i gzi rgya da 'byed do: srung bya'i bla g.yu bla yig dang: bla shing bla dwags blang bar bya: tshags su dgra bo'i gzugs phung dang tshe bla sgog gsum brub byas te: byad thag chi sa bcing rgya yis bsdams: bla sgrom gshin rje'i phyag tu 'bul: dgra zin brje ba'i rten 'brel 'grigs: sngags pa'i rgyal rtags a la la: bdun pa byad thag bcad pa ni kye lha tsho gnyan gtod sa bdag dang: gshin bdud ma yams gnam sman sogs: dregs pa pho mo thams cad dang: ban bon mu sdegs phra men gyis: byad mthil bcug pas gtad

khram dag: rang rang thag pa dum bur bcad: (ཿ khro chen mi g.yo mgon po yi: rang bzhin shes rab ral gri 'dis: lha klu gnyan gyi thag pa bcad: dmu gtod sa bdag thag pa bcad: bdud btsun srin po'i thag pa bcad: gza' the'u rgyal bsen thag pa bcad: ma gshin drang srong thag pa bcad: dri za 'byung po'i thag pa bcad: dgra bgegs dam sri'i thag pa bcad byad phur rbod gtong thag pa bcad: 'bar ba ye yi nus pas bcom: mi gnas stong pa'i 'khor lor brdal: byad zor g.yul las sngags mkhan rgyal:brgyad pa gzhi sprugs dmod pa ni kye bdag cag dpon slob srung bya rnams: dus min na 'chi'i g.yul las rgyal: dgra gzhi nag po mar la sprug: nad gzhi gyod gzhi mkhon gzhi sprug dme gzhi khrag gzhi dgra la sprug: dgra bo pham pa'i gzhi ru phud: bgegs tshogs gnon pa'i dmu gab 'geb: dam sri 'dul ba'i dro ra bca' gzhi sprug dang pos dgra bo pham: gnyis pas byad ma lha srung 'dul: gsum pas 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur: thabs mkhas gto sgrub phun tshogs nas: sngags mkhan rgyal zhing dbu 'phang mtho: bde

༷ / ca legs dpal yon mthu rgyas shog: dgu pa khrus kyis bkru ba ni hrī:dri med shel dkar bum pa rtsa 'phags ba'i byin rlabs bcud chen 'khyil: skal ldan rnams la khrus byas pas: lus kyi sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: 'phral byung nad gdon byang gyur cig: ngag gi digs skug grol gyur cig byad mas ngag mnan sangs gyur cig: yid kyi rmugs 'thibs dag gyur cig: kun btags 'khrul ba zhig gyur cig: 'phags ma'i gsang gsum mngon gyur shog: yeho shusashud+dhi: yoho shud+dhi shud+dhi: le7 shud+dhi shudhe 2ho shud+dhi shukhye: rbaḥho shudhe shudhe: sarba ro ga bisnan dz+wa ra durmi ta dusab a ka la bṛ du tsit+ta bye kul+le shud+dhi shud+dhi a ā swā hā: nan du bkru zhing dag par bya bcu pa bla rten gtad pa na sa: skyemed chos dbyings dag pa la: 'byu ba chen po nam mkha' ni rten 'brel yongs kyi phun tshogs gzhi: sems ni 'pho med nam mkha' la mi 'gyur srog nilha:yig ste tshe gzugs yi gedṛ ljang sngon bla nitswa:gi drwa gur byas don dam ste 'chi bsgres bral kyang kun rdzo ba tsam du bla nyams na: 'phags ma'i thugs rjes 'gugs byas te: bdag cag srung bya'i

dpal du dril: chos dbyings ka dag 'khor lo'i rgya: yang cig dwangs ma'i tshe nyams na: 'phags ma'i thugs rjes 'gugs byas te: bdag cag srung bya'i dpal du dril dri med ye shes rdo rje'i rgya: bdag gzhan sgog gi ka yo na: 'phags ma'i thugs rjes drang bsrengs te: bdag dang srung bya'i srog dbugs brtan: 'gyur med bde chen pad+ma'i rgya:3 spyo ye shes lnga klong tshud: ( sgro rgya gram snying por dril: tswa spyo las kyi sems dpas srungs: nyispyi dbang chen glog zhags 'khyugs: ā dzha 'pho med rdo rjer gyur hūṃ tra tra shag:mu tra ho: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: brgya rtsa brjod lo brgya' bar du 'chi ba med pa'i tshe thob par bsam mo rten snyang brjod la me tog 'thor shis pa brjod pas tshe bsrang zhing bla gso srog mthud dpal yon 'phel sa ma yu phrem rgyal dbang pad+ma' thugs thig skor lasacan bu ya dpal shar ba mdo khams bkra shas she mang nas rgyal tshab thugs pras bu yi rted zab bcud srungs shig zil btsun ma chos rgyud bstan pa 'dzan skyongs spel sa ma 2 rgya rgya rgya gu kyi brda tham snyi zhes pa 'di'ang grogs kyi 'phral rkyen bsal ba' phyir dang / chosabadag rnam gsum gyis bskul ba don dang ldan phyir/ba tha nu ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda las la bdus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma le/
༷| zab chos 'od gsal ṭ+wāṃ// rdog las: 'phags ma'i tshe rgyud rdo rje grub pa'i snying po bzhugs so:

zanam zu) yid bzhin grub pa'i rdo rje'i klong la phyag 'tshal lo: rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i dbyings nyid du mi shig grub pa'i rdo rje'i tā re yis: ma 'gags sgyu la rol ba'i 'khor tshogs la nyag cig gsang mdzod rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di: dus ston ka nas dag pa'i 'khor lo ru dgongs pa mnyam nyid ye shes rol pas so: e ma ho: sems kyi rang na ye nas 'od gsal ba: dri ma rnams ni glo bur rdul du byung skye 'gro snod bcud 'ja' tshon bzhin du 'phrul skyes pa nyid na skye ba med pa'o: gnas pa nyad na gnas pa med pa'o:gas pa nyid na 'gags pa med pa'o: de don rtogs na rgyal ba thams cad kyi: thugs dgongs rmad byung gsang ba rtogs pa'o: dri med dbyings las rten 'brel 'god pa'o chos nyid klong chos can tsam du bkod 'phrul ba nyid na ka nas dag pa'o: gzhal bya sgro btags mtshan ma mi dmigs par: ye shes nyid la ye shes ma ngas spyod pas snang gsum dri ma ka nas dag : sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: e ma ho: 'byung chen lnga yi tshe rten yi ge lnga: ngo bo 'gyur med rnam pa 'pho bsgrod can: rnal 'byor rig pa can gyi stobs su shar kun rdzob rten gyi yi ge srog tu

bzhugs de ni kun la khyab pa'i nam mkha' bzhin: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya bcud kyi 'gro ba yongs kyi srog gi rten: tshe yi rang bzhin zag pa can du gnas rang bzhin ye rnam par gnas pa las: stobs su bskyed na bkrag mdangs bsod nams 'phel khams kyi yi ger rgyas thebs 'byung ba snyoms: nad med tshe dang lang tshor mnga' brtes 'gyur: srog gi ra 'khor 'das phywa bstim nas: tshe yon dpal bskyed rnal 'byer bsam don 'grubaḥ sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: e ma ho: sde brgyad dregs pa'i sgog snying yi ge'i gzugs 'phel stobs bsgyur nus pa mchog dang ldan tshe yi rten can srog gi sa bon te: mthu ldan grub pa'i rgyal pos 'gugs pa'i tshe: rdo rje'i pho nya 'bum phrag drug bcu bzhis: sha yis stobs sdud khrag gis 4 sa ngoms shing drod kyi gzi ngar dbugs kyi kha lo g.yo sems ni cha snyoms du ma du mar gyur 'bu ldog 'da' ba'i rnam 'gyur cher g.yo yang: srog gi yig ges bzung te gnad la ba: tshe rten 'gyur med rgyas gdab brtan pa gtad tshe srog 'dzin pa 'i gnyer kha bu la bzhag rnam 'gyur rtsubs shing gshe tshe srog la rbad dam tshig rgya la gnad dbab mal 'og gzir

che btsan dregs pa'i tshe sgog mnga' dbang bsgyur: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: e ma ho: sangs rgyas byang sems tshe dang ye shes ni dpag med bsam gyis mi khyab brjod las 'das: ngo bo 'dus ma byas pa chos kyi sku rang bzhin gsal la mi nub longs sku'i rten: thugs rjes tshad med dpag yas sprul sku'i gsang ye shes 'dus ma byas pa mkha' ltar yangs: tshe yun rgya che khyon yang zad med mdzod gdul bya'i mthun snang gang 'dul mdzad pas skyongs phan bde'i rgyal mtshan bstan pa' gzha 'dzug go sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: e ma ho: spros pa can gyis zag pa'i chos du 'dod spros pa med pa'i zag med don la blta dngos bzung bral kyang ldog pa tha dad tshul: rnam bzhag 'dod tshul rnam pa mtha' yas kyang: don la rten 'brel tshad gyi chos nyid du: tshe yi rang bzhin n+d+ra yig ljang gur gnas: srog gi rang bzhin 'gyur med aḥdakar po bsod nams lhun po yi ge hūṃ ljang sngon: de la srid pa gsum gyi dwangs ma bsre de la 'byung ba lnga yi dpal yon bskyil:de la lha sran dregs pa'i sgog dbug sdud: de la 'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad bstim: 'khor 'das phywa blang nus pa mchog ldan byed:

༷/ca de lta bu yi yon tan bsam mtha' yas: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: e ma ho mi 'gyur 'dus ma byas pa chos kyi dbyings: tshe yi rang bzhin 'gyur med bcom ldan 'das: srog gi rang bzhin yid bzhin 'khor lo ma: 'gyur ba mi mnga' rnam par rgyal ma ste: ris su ma chad mnyam pa nyid kyi klobhe : zad med nam mkha' mdzod la dbang 'byor zhing: gzhan phan thugs rje'i nyi ma 'od stong bdal: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: e ma ho: gang la chags pa bral ba'i bcom ldan 'das: gang zhig gzugs dang gzugs med las 'das shing gang la rdul sogs spros pa'i dri ma bral: mtha' la mi gnas mnyam pa nyid du gnas: srid pa dbyings su sgrol ba'i tā re ma: bdud bzhi'i mtshan ma sgol ba'i tā re ma: nyon mongs rba klongs skems pa'i tā re ma: tshe dang ye shes bskyed pa'i yid bzhin ma srog dang lang tsho bskyod pa'i yid bzhin ma bla tshe yar nyams gso ba'i yid bzhin ma: gdon bgegs kyis 'phrog 'gugs spel yid bzhin ma bla tshe bsod nams sgog bskyed yid bzhin maX mi nub dam pa chos kyi 'khor lo ma rnal 'byor nyams rtogs grub mjad 'khor lo ma: legs pa'i yon tan kun 'byung 'khor lo ma rmongs pa ma rig

'dams sgrol 'khor lo ma sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lor rtag tu 'dud: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: e ma ho: de bzhin nyid dbyings mkha' ltar dag pa la phyogs ris mi dmigs bde ba chen po'i zhal: kun la snyoms pa'i 'od gsal mtha' dbus bral ye shes gzigs pa'i spyan la sgrib g.yog bral tshogs drug rang grol dgongs pa 'pho 'gyur med ji snyed mkhyen gzigs chags thog bral ba la ngo bo sgrib bral rnam pa 'dzin tshul can lugs 'byung srid pa'i rten 'brel chos so cog skad cig gcig gis srid pa dbyings su stong sgyu ma'i g.yar khang mtshan ma'i rba klong kun shes rab chen pos skad cig nyid la mthar khams gsum rol rtsed bsgyur ba'i chos so cog lhag med rdo rje dgongs pa' dbyings su bsre gza' gtad bral ba'i ye shes zang ma thal kun gyi sgog ldan kun gyi dbyings su bsre don dam mtha' bral rdo rjes dgongs pa'i 1nga: nyag gcig spros dang bral la rtag tu blta sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya e ma ho rdul dang bral ba dag chen bde ba'i klong ma chen dgongs mdzod ye shes gsang ba'i srog dwangs ma'i ze'u 'bru shes rab rang byung sgron rgyang zhags 'bar ba chu yi bcud rdzogs pa: ye shes gsang lam shel

༷/ gyi sbu gu can: dbyings kyi rang bzhin rgya tshad spros dang bral: thig le kun snyoms dwangs ma lnga yi dpal rig gdangs ma 'gags rdo rje lu gu rgyud: thogs med gzigs pa'i shes rab rtsal ldan na: gzungs dang 'dzin pa'i 'ching ba kun grol te: nyag cig 'od gsal don gyi lha sku mthong gdos mtshan rtog pa lug rgyud thad gar grol snang bzhi'i yon tan yar ro sa zla ltar 'phel thob pa'i yon tan sdod pa'i rtags tshad 'byung: ma dag rgyu ba skad cig nyid la grol: ye shes rtsal rdzogs nang dbyings rgyal sar spyod: gzhan don phrin las gzigs pa gnyis kyis byed 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzad pa mtha' yas 'byung sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: e ma ho: tshe yi rang bzhin rdo rje lta bur brtan: srog gi ngo bo mi nub nam mkha' che: ye shes rtsal chen kun la thog med bdal: de lta bu yi yon tan bsam mtha' yas: mchan 'dzin gdos grol las dang smon lam can bskal ba bzang po 'dzom pa'i spyod yul las: dman pa 'dod sred can la 'chor mi rung sgro skur sbyor la bka' yi chad pas chod: bka' 'di rtag par srungs shig e ka dza sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu h+ya brda thim lha rdo rje grub pa'i slong la phyag 'tshal lo

tshe yi rang bzhin grub pa'i gzi byin can dri med ye shes brjod pa'i mtha' las 'das: gdod nas 'dus ma byas pa chos kyi dbyings: lhun grub rang 'od gsal ba bde chen klong thugs rje gdos bral dwangs ma sprul ba'i sku dbyer med mnyam rdzogs yid bzhin 'khor lo ma: tshe dang ye shes tshad med bcom ldan 'das: ye shes gzigs pa mtha' yas thugs rje'i gter gzhan phan phrin las mi nub nam mkha' mdzod 'di mthong ngan song 'khor ba'i skye sgo khog 'di sgrub srid pa'i gdos po dbyings su grol 'dir brtson phyi nang bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal 'di sbyangs dag pa'i zhing khams yongs la dbang 'dir brtson sku gsum lhun grub dpal la spyod 'dir 'bad don gnyas lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya e ma ho tshe yi srog shing rdo'i bum sgo can las byang rin chen bsgrig pa'i tshal la gtugs tshe yi bum bzang dngos grub kun gyi mdzod: phyi yi sgrub pa 'od 'bar nyi ma'i zhal: dgos 'dod kun 'byung dpag bsam shing lta bu: nang sgrub bsil ldan zla ba lta bu'o yid bzhin dpal ster bsam 'phel lta bu ni gsang sgrub nyi zla kha sbyor dam pa'o kun gyis bcud bsdus dwangs ma lta bu ni rtsa

༷ / ba'i sgrub pa yid bzhin nor lta bu'o ma byung rdo rje'i gsang srog mthar thug pa thugs sgrub mun sel sgron ma lta bu'o gcig dril sgrub pa mdo rgyud bstan pa ni: chu brgya zam 'og tshud pa'i man ngag go: tshe yi nye lam phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyi ma'i zer bzhin cha lag bsam mi khyab rnal 'byor rig pa can gyis dang blangs na: sku gsum klong yangs bde chen rdo rjer spyod: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: e ma ho: bde ba'i ting 'dzan yid bzhin 'khor lo ma: tshe yi dpal stsol sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gsang: mtha' bral stong pa rdo rje'i thugs klong las ma 'bad ye rdzogs nges don rtags kyis mdzod phyogs ris mi dmigs bde chen rgyal po'i zhal gang yin kun yin min pa med pa'i klong mkhyen gzigs ye shes 'od chen nyi ma'i dkyil: gang yin kun snyoms srid pa 'i 'dams las sgrol yid bzhin 'khor lo'i gsang mdzod dang du longs sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: e ma ho: srog shing gsum la 'khor lo gsum gnyis ldan: shing du dwangs ma ye shes klong gsal ni tshe yi dpal mdzod yid bzhin 'khor lo ma 'du 'bral mi dmigs grub pa'i rdo rjer bzhugs phya nang dwangs ma tshe gzugs yi ga'i tshul: rtsa la rlung bsgrod thig

ler bde stong bskyil bcu drug 'gros kyi byed las la brten nas 'khor 'das yongs kyi dngas ma gcig tu bsdu dkar dmar kus mi nyams stobs su bskyed bde stong klong yangs rtogs la mngon gyur byed rgyu ba nye rgyu che rgyu rab sangs nas g.yo thob kun brtan mthar phyin nyams rdzogs te snyigs ma'i sgyu lus grub pa mthar phyin tshe dwangs ma'i sgyu lus yid bzhin 'khor lo spyod mi ldog bde chen rdo rje'i sa la 'byor don gnyis lhun grub skal ba bzang po ldan sa ma yāX rgya rgya rgyaḥ e ma hoḥ bkra shis grub pa'i tsakra dpe ris bzhin khyims bzang phun tshogs 'phrod la brten byas te gtsug tu bkur na bsam don lhun gyis grub 'dod don 'bad med bkra shis lhun gyis grub: grub pa'i tsakra stobs ldan 'phrod dang sbyaraḥ dbra la bar sbyar nas 'khrugs rtsod gar phyin kyang: don de grub nas rgyal kha thob par 'gyur yid bzhin 'byung pa'i tsakra dpe ris bzhin dngos grub 'grub sbyor phun sum tshogs pa sgrub rin chen sgrom gzhug rang gi mgul du 'chang yid 'dod thogs med grub par the tshom med: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya e ma ho tshe rgyud dpal bum grub pa'i rdo rje yis mtshan bcas gnyis snang rdu tir sgrol byed cing

ca rdu ma tha la'i dga' ston rgya chen po spyod nas mkha' 'gro'i gas mdzod mngon gyur te: drug ldan bde ba chen po'i rgyal sar 'khod nyi ma'i zer bzhin phrin las phyogs yas: mtha' dbus yongs kyi mdun pa sangs bar byed: sprul ba'i 'od zer sprul gzhi nyid la 'dud don gnyis yid bzhin 'khor lo phun tshogs 'gyur: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: gu rgya:trem:snyi: de bzhin nyid la rol ba'i ston pa dang 'khor da ye she sgyu 'phrul gyi bkod pa thams cad chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'i nang gsal lhun gyis grub pa'i 'khor lo mnyam pa nu 'jug cing 'byams su klas par gyur to: gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gas rgya e ma: ye yin don gyis rgyal sa la spyod pa'i rig pa'i bu chung bdag gi blo bde byung mi mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod la spyod 'di: rtog ger 'dzer kyang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chos kyi gzhi bzung man ngag gi sgon me phyogs rnams yongs la khyab brdal 'di ngo mtshar rang sbos pa'i che brjod ni min da pha gcag pad+ma'i zhal bzang de ngom bzhin: man ngag bdud rtsi'i zil mngar gyi mchid 'di phyogs med yo sa la pha phog su 'gyed do dang 'dod yid

khas blang na ni kun spyod dang len med pa'i bha ka ra glen 'thum skal bzang dben pas ci bya rang ma mchis de don go bde'i shog phrin bzhin spreng ngo sa ma yā mu tā:snyi zhes rdo rje'i lung zin kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyis bskul ba dang / grogs rat+na'i ming can gyi tshe 'phrang bsal phyir/ kho bo nus ldan bdus pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las zhal bshusade dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni lung zin garma kirtis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/
rten— zab chos 'od gsal thugs thig dīṭ+wāṃ/sgo//snas ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dang 'brel ba'i maṇ+ḍal tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho dngos grub dpal bum zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

༷/ na mo ār+ya dzñā na dhartu mu drwa tā re shrī ye: muthashi skye med chos dbyings kun bzang mo ma 'gags bde chen wa ra ha spros bral bde chen rnal 'byer ma lhan skyes snying dbus pad+mor sim:las ldan sgrub la snying rus can bsod nams sbyangs 'phro can mchis na de yi bgo skal zab pa'i lam tshogs bsags daro sa grub dpa la bum bstan sa ma yu de yang maṇ+ḍal mda' gang ba grub bzhi khod snyoms 'jam pa la dri bzang ba byung rnam pa lngas chag chag legs btab de ya dbus lding bra mañdzu dpag pa'i khar sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bkrams rnam lnga nyer spyod rgya chen dang bkra shas dzos rtags rgyal srid bdun spos me skyon bral ci 'byor bkod zhal zas dkar bshos zhal shes bzhin phri gang yo 'khyog reg skyon bral khyad par 'phags pa'i rnam bkod pa ma 'dresalhun gyi grub par bya sa ma yu rnal 'byor bde ba'i stan la gnas ting 'dzan g.yo ba'i skyon bral bzhan dwangs shi dad mos tshad med pas las kyi gzhung 'dir 'jug pa ra bya sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs gnas dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i sprin rab 'byams mngon sum du gsal la na mo: gdod nas dri bral rdzogs sangs rgyas 'gags med dam pa chos kyi sgo gzhan phan dpal phyugs byang chub sems: dkon mchog rgya

mtshor skyabs su mchi: lan gsum gnyis pa sems bskyed bsgom pa ni ho: mtha' yas pha ma mkha' mnyam 'a11: zhakhrul snang srid pa'i rba 〈snang las: mngon rdzogs byang dror 'god phyir: rin chen sems mchog bskyed bgyi'o: lan gsum gsum pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni 37 a3: dngos 'dzin rtogs pa'i chos rnams kun: mtha' bral stong pa por gzhig: lhun grub snang cha dag chen dpal: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du gyur: mchod pa 'i sprin gzungs lan bdun brjod bla āzhwa/ badz+ra spra ra ṇa sa: bzhi pa zhing khams gsal gdab tī : chos dbyings mtha' bral nam mkha' la: lhun grub 'od lnga yum chen klong: brda rtags rdzogs pa'i gzhal med khang: dri bral dwang gsal pad zla'i khar: rgyal ba kun sa bcom ldan 'das: kun tu bzang po nam mkha'i mdog: mnyam gzhag skyil krung mtshan dpe 'bar bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gis bskor: gser zhal rta bdun da pa'i mdangs: ye shes dwangs ma 'od skur bskyed g.yas su byams pa mgon po la: sras brgyad byang sems rgya mtshos bskor: rgyab tu shes rab phar phyin la: 'bum

phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi dang: sde gsum glegs bam 'od drur gsal: g.yon du mchog gzungs rnam gnyis la: nyan rang dge 'dun tshogs kyis bskor: mdun du dga' rab rdo rje la: rigs 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor: kun kyang snang stong zung 'jug sku: gdos mtshan dngos por ma grub pa: dag chen ye shes dkyil 'khor gsal srog gis bskul de ye shes pa: spyan drangs du ma ro gcig gyur: lnga pa spyan 'dren bya ba ni hūṃ nyi dag chen mi g.yo thugs rje'i gter: mdzad pa mi nub phrin las dpal: gdul bya'i skyabs mgon dkon mchog gsum: dad pa 'i mos ngor spyan 'dren gshegs: byin rlabs mchog stsol rig kyis bdag: dngos grub char 'bebs lhag pa'i la: wan skyes bde ster ḍak+ki'i tshogs: rang snang dad pa'i mos ngor gshegs: ka dag chos sku dri ma bral: lhun grub srid la longs spyod rdzogs thugs rje mdzad pa mtha' yas dpal mos gus yid kyis dal du byon: thams cad mnyam rdzogs klong yangs la: gshegs bzhugs mtshan ma bral mod kyang gdul bya'i mos pa bskang ba'i phyir: bsod nams tshogs bsags

༷/ zhing du byon: o sarba budha bho dhi sa twa gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki ni dharmā saṃ bho nirma ka ya sa ma ya dza dza: drug pa bzhugs su gsol ba na ( ni chags pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i:pad+ma 'dab rgyas gdan khri la bde gshegs sras dang rtsa ba gsum: tshogs kyi zhing rnams bzhugs su gsol: tshe pad+ma ka ma la ya sto: bdun pa khrus kyis bskang ba ni trī: ji rnyed rgyal ba sras bcas la: rin chen bum pa dri bza chu'i: phyag dang zhabs bsil sku khrus 'bul: rdo rje glu gar rol mo'i bstod: o na malabo ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ga te sa ma ya shrī hūṃ:brgyad pa na bza' phul ba mi hrī: srab 'jam yang bde lha yis gos: pañtsa li ga reg bya'i mchog rdo rje lha mo'i sor rtser sgron rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul: o waṣ+ṭa byu dza ho dgu pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni oṃ āḥ/: rin chen maṇ+ḍal 'bru sman dang: rat+na sna tshogs bkod mdzes pa: stong gsum mi mjed yongs rdzogs sprin: bla ma sangs rgyas sprul skur 'bul:rang lusamaṇ+ḍal dbang pos brgyan: rtsa khams rnam dag mchod pa'i spin gzung 'dzin mtshan ma rnam dag dpal: bla ma sangs rgyas longs skar 'bul sems nyid maṇ+ḍal 'od

gsal ba:'gyu 'phro kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin rnam dag rig pa'i bkod mdzes pa:bla ma sangs rgyas chos skur 'bul:bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs nas:dam pa sku gnyis mngon gyur te 'khor ba dong sprugs mthu thob shog:1 rat+na maṇ+ḍal badz+ra byu dza te a hūṃ r+sā pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni hrī:rnam dag rig pa'i zer ngar las byung ba'i kun bzang sprin mchod ni:'dzin pa dag pa'i nyer spyod bdun:nyon mongs grol ba'i 'dod yon lnga:dug gsum rnam grol sman gtor raka:thabs shes rol ba bde sbyor bcud:rtogs pas bdag dang thugs rjes gzhan:sgrol ba chen po bla na med:thams cad ro gcig mnyam pa'i mchog:rig pa 'od gsal gsang ba'i dal:thabs chen kun rdzob gar du rol:mtshan ma tshig bral snyan pa'i glu:gnyis mdzin bdud btul gnyug ma'i bro:chos nyid stong pa de bzhin nyid:mchod bya mchod byed dag pa yis:rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes pa bskang:gdul bya'i tshogs chen rab rdzogs nas:lhan skyes ye shes mngon gyur de:sku gsum dgongs klong byang chub mdzod:snyen ma hā sarba pū dza khā hi:bcu

gcig yan lag bdun mchod ni na mo: dri bral bde chen ye shes dbyings: rgyal kun gsang mdzod bla na med: dus gsum mnyam nyid chen po la: rnam dag lta ba'i 'tshal lo: ma bshams ye rdzogs mchod sprin kun: 'dzin zhen bral bar gus pas 'bul: gnyis 'dzin sems kyi dri ma kun: kun mkhyen mgon po mchog la bshags:nga 'bras bu'i dge spyod la: snying nas rjes su yi rang ngo: gang 'dul lung dang rtogs pa'i chos gdul bya'i dpal du bskor bar bskul: sangs rgyas byang sems rig na tshogs: mi 'da' rdo rje'i khrir bzhugs gsol: zag dang zag med dge spyad kun: 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por bsngo: 'khrul 'khor ma rigs 'phya grol nas:ra gshegs rgyal ba'i srid thob shog bcu gnyas phyag gi mchod pa ni na mo: sangs rgyas sku la phyag 'tshal lo rdul dang bral la phyag 'tshal lo: mi zad pa la phyag 'tshal lo:'gyur bral la phyag 'tshal lo: g.yo med zhal la phyag 'tshal lo: seng ltar snang la phyag 'tshal lo: glang po'i stobs la phyag 'tshal lo: mtshan ma bral la phyag 'tshal lo

gdos po zhi la phyag 'tshal lo:chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo:cir yang sprul la phyag 'tshal lo:'gyur med klong la phyag 'tshal lo:ngo bo nyid la phyag 'tshal lo: sangs rgyas gsung la phyag 'tshal lo: skye med dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo:ldems dgongs brda la phyag 'chal lo:rdo rjer ston la phyag 'tshal lo:ye shes nyid ston la phyag 'tshal:dkri grangs brgyud la phyag 'tshal lo:tshad med dbya sa la phyag 'tshal lo:tshangs pa'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo:rdzu 'phrul 'gyed la phyag 'tshal lo:brjod bral gdangs la phyag 'tshal lo:chos nyid sgra la phyag 'tshal lo:'gag med dpal la phyag 'tshal lo:tha mi dad la phyag 'tshal lo rdo rje'i gdangs la phyag 'tshal lo ha he'i gad mor phyag 'tshal lo:rnam par bzhad la phyag 'chal lo:chos kyi dung la phyag 'tshal lo seng ge'i sgra la phyag 'tshal lo: sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal lo:nam mkha' ltar la phyag 'tshal lo:dri ma med la phyag 'tshal lo:chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo: mnyam pa nyid la phyag 'tshal lo:mkhyen gnyis rgyas la phyag 'chal lo:

༷|— chos nyid 1nga la phyag 'tshal lo:kun tu gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo:rnam par snang la phyag 'tshal lo:tshad med 'od la phyag 'tshal lo:bde ba'i klong la phyag 'chal lo:ro gcig rol la phyag 'tshal lo: kun tu snyoms la phyag 'tshal lo: ye shes rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo 'khrugs pa bral la phyag 'tshal lo: nyi ma'i dkyil la phyag 'chal lo zla ba'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo mun sel sgron mer phyag 'tshal lo: ka nas dag la phyag 'tshal lo: lhun grub gter la phyag 'tshal lo: 'ub chub rol la phyag 'chal lo: spros pa bral la phyag 'tshal lo bcing grol med la phyag 'tshal lo: rang rig ngang la phyag 'tshal lo: byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo: sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal lo skyobs pa chos la phyag 'tshal lo dge 'dun sde la phyag 'tshal lo: bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: skyabs gnas yongs la phyag 'tshal lo: lus btud gus pa'i phyag 'tshal lo gdung dbyangs ngag gi phyag 'tshal lo: dad gus sems kyi phyag 'chal lo:o na ma

te hūṃ: cha na ma me hūṃ: tshe na mo na ma hūṃ bcu gsum bstod la glu mchod ni hūṃ hrī: ston pa bder gshegs bcom ldan 'das skyobs pa bla med dam pa'i chos: 'dren pa 'phags stogs dge 'dun sde: dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal bstod: chos sku nam mkha' ltar dag khyab longs sku nyi ma'i 'od bzhin 'khyugs sprul sku ma 'dres 'ja' tshon bzhin: sku gsum dbyings la phyag 'tshal bstod: brgyud ldan bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs: yi dam rgyud sde'i sprin rab 'byams: shes rab dbyings kyi phyag rgya che rtsa gsum lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: khyab chen thig le'i zhing khams na: rdul dang bral ba'i ye shes sku: ston gnas chos 'khor tha mi dad bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku ni rdo dze+erdul mtha' yas gsung mchog 'gag med ye shes ston thugs ni 'od gsal sprin mtha' yas:rdo rje yangs par phyag 'tshal bstod: rdul rnyed rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la: de rnyed spral ba'i lus ngag yid: 'dud gus 'byur dbyangs dad mos bcos: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing la bstod: bcu bzhi skyabs gsol gdab pa ni rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang

bcas pa'i thugs rje'i skyabs 'og tu bdag sogs sems can thams cad tshud nas thar lam byang chub dam pa thob par bsam la: bla ma la skyabs su 'chi'o:5 rjes bzu du gsol: 'jigs tshogs 'phrang las skyabs nas thar lam byang chub dam pa thob par mdzad du gsol: sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'chi'o: thugs rjes bzubhe sol: 'jigs tshogs 'phrang las skyabs nas thar lam byang chub dam pa thob par mdzad du gsol: chos la skyabs su 'chi'o: thugs rjes bzung du gsol: 'jigs ga 'phrang las skyabs nas thar lam byang chub dam pa thob par mdzad du gsol dge 'dun la skyabs su 'chi'o: thugs rjes bzung du gsol 'jigs tshogs 'phrang las bla nas thar lam byang chub dam pa thob par mdzad du gsol: skabs da bstun la ci nus bskyar bco lnga smon lam gdab pa ni na mo: rgyal ba sras bcas brtse ba'i dgongs: rnam dag pham 'grub par mdzod: srid pa'i rba 1nga 'tshubs ma rtsa las nyon zug rngu'i mnar ba rnams: rang snang log 'khrul ngo shes nas zhen 'dzin gting nas ldog gyur cig:

nyon mongs gdung ba'i me chen ni:kun nas 'bar zhing tshig pa la:thugs rje bsil ba'i chu rgyun gyis:rang grol chen por bcom par shog:ma reg mun pa'i rmag rum du:gti mug gnyid kyis myos pa rnams:shes rab ye shes sgron me yis:bag chags dri ma bsal bar shog:masang byed mig dang rdul 'dres nas:ma rig gsum la rtag 'khyol rnams:nang don gnyug ma mngon gyur nas 'khrul snang rab rib bsal gyur cig:brgyud ldan byin rlabs sim pa yis:rjes bzung shes rab rnam gsum gyis:lung rig man ngag khung chub nas bla ma'i thugs bzhed 'grub gyur cig:rgyal bstan spyo dang nang don sngags:a ti 'bras bu' theg pa rnams:bshad bsgrub mkhas pa'i yon tan gyis 'dzin skyongs spel bsrung nus par shog:mi rmongs shes rab zab mo yis:gsang ba'i yang gsang gcer mthong nas:sa lam nyams rtogs mthar phyin te:kun tu 'od la spyod par shog:rab gsal mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis sprul pa'i khams la dbang bsgyur zhing:mdzad pa phrin las mtha' yas bzhin:rdo rje 'chang gi sa thob shog:shin tu phra ba'i

༷/ ye shes kyis: spang bya'i dri kun bral mod kyang: thob bya'i yon tan mthar phyin nas: drug rdzogs bla ma'i sa thob shog: sku gsum rtog pa'i rdo rje yis: gdul bya ma 'dres gsal ba'i ro ra mdzad phrin 'gyed pa'i yon tan ni: nub med rtag tu 'byung bar re ga ces sogs mtha' rgyas bya ba'o sa ma yu thog mar bde gshegs mchod pa'i ram palha rgya rgya rgya 'phags pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la las kyis rim pa bco lnga las da po skyabs su 'gro ba ni mdun gyi nam mkhar rgyal yum rje btsun ma'i lha tshogs mngon gsum du bzhugs par bsam la: na mo: mtha' bral lta ba dag pa'i zhal: lhun grub mtshan dpe rdzogs pa'i sku: sgyu 'phrul yid bzhin 'khor lo'i dal: rang ngo rig pas skyabs su mchi: gnyas pa byang chub sems bskyed mi ho: sna dzashags snang ba sems kyi chos: sems nyid gzhi med rtsa ba bral bsgral bya'i dngos mtshan rnam dag kyang: ka dag rig pas 'ub chub bya: gsum pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni sa āḥ&: sna tshogs rdul gyi bkod pa ni: chos nyid klong la bsam yas sprin: thams cad dag chen kun bzang gis: dgongs pas ro mnyam mchod chen spel bla

badz+ra byu dza spra ra ṇa khaṃ bzhi pa rten dang brten bskyed pa hrī shes rab ye shes me bo ches: mtshan 'dzin snang ba dbu mar bcom: lhan skyes ye shes dag chen cha: ma bskyed ma sgom rang byung shar: stong pa yum lnga'i mkha' klong du: snang ba thabs kyi zhing khams ni: brda don rtags kyi mtshon pa yi bkod rdzogs dag gsal de yi dbus shes rab rang byung gzhal med khang rgyu rkyen las 'das ye shes mdangs: stong pa'i rang bzhin rang 'od gsal: dag mnyam thugs rje ma 'gags pa: bde chen bkod mdzes de yi dbus:chags bral pad+ma gyes pa'i khar: sdang 'dzin rnam dag zla gdan la: rmongs pa'i dri bral 'od lnga'i klo : don dam mi shig rdo rje'i sku: yid bzhin 'khor lo gangs ri la: nyi 'khyud lta bu'i bkrag mdangs 'bar: gzhon mdzes brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur can: tshul dgu'i lang tshos rnam par 'khyud: gzigs stangs yon tan bdun dang ldan phyag g.yas mchod sbin phyag rgya yis pad+ma'i sdong po 'dzin pa'i khar: tshe yi mda' dar rigs lnga 'chang 'khor 'das 'byung lnga'i dpal yon sngad g.yon pa dkon mchog gsum mtshon

༷/ gyi: pad+ma'i yu ba thugs gar brten: 'dab ma snyam thad gyes pa'i khar 'chi med tshe yi bum pa las tshe dpal sgog gso'i 'od zer 'khrigs zhabs gnyis sems ma'i phyed skyil bzhugs: longs sku'i rgyan cha bcu gsum mdzes: nu 'bur bde ster pad+mo rgyas: regs bdag tshe dpag med mgon dang gsang ba ye shes 'khril sbyor rol: che dang dpal gyi 'od zer 'bar: snang stong zung 'jug 'od skur gsal: de yi phyi rim 'dab bzhi la:lha mo sgeg 'byeng glu gar ma: dkar ser dmar mthing phyed skyil bzhugs: mdzes 'jum longs sku'i rgyan cha 'chang: mtshams 'dzin pad+ma 'dab steng du: lha mo smin grub mchog ster ma: phyogs mdog gar bsgyur stangs stabs rol: bcu gsum rgyan 'cha 'od skur bskyed de rgyab pad+ma 'dab bzhi la: lha rtse 'gugs 'ching sdom myos ma: dkar ser dmar ljang rang rtags 'chang sna tshogs gar gyis gdan la rol: kun kyang 'ja' 'od thig le'i klong: snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa: dag chen 'od gsal dal du bskyed: gzhan yang che lha rig 'dzin dang: sangs rgyas byang chub sems

dpa' rnams: dpag med nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin gsal: kun gyi gnas gsum sa bon las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas: spyan drangs rigs lnga'i dbang bskur bas:sku gang dri ma kun dag gyur: ma (ཿ/ hrīḥ.ā: kwa ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba a snyi ṣiñtsa oṃ āX: hri: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra slar yang 'od 'phros rgyal ba yi: dkyil 'khor ma lus rten brten pa: spyan drangs 'phags ma'i gsang gsum dang: gnyis med bde klong ro gcig gyur lnga pa spyan 'dren bya ba ni rta: skye med 'od gsal thig le'i klong: 'gag med za thal ye shes sku:rtsol bral yid bzhin 'khor lo ma: rang grol 'khor kyi tshom bu 'khrigs: bshegs bzhugs mtshan ma bral mod kyang: nyams rtogs rtsal chen rgyas slad du: tshur gshegs ār+ya tā re dza: yo dzñā na ār+ya tā re ma hā mu drwa sarba sa ma yā dza dza: drug pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni hrī: ma chags dri ma rnam dben pa'i: pad+ma dkar po'i gdan phul khar: mkhyen dang brtse ba'i rang bzhin can: rig par shar ba'i lhan skyes lha: yid bzhin 'khor lo sbrul 'khor bcas dad pa'i mos ngor bzhugs su gsol oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ye sa ma yā sto: bdun

༷ zu pa khrus kyi mchod pa ni hrī: yid 'ong bum pa dri bzang chus: legs bkang lha mos glu gar bcas: 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la: rnam dag khrus mchog gsol bar bgyi ma sarba ta thā ga ta a bhe ṣe ga te sa ma yā shrī ye hūṃ:hrī:gribral lha mo'i sku gsung thugs: rdul skyon mtshan ma med mod kyang bdag sogs gnyis snang dri bral phyir: gtsang ma chab kyis 3 sarba ta thā sogs brgyad pa na bza' 'bul ba ni hrī: 'jam mnyem yangs srab bde ba'i gos lha yi reg bya pañtsa li: dri bzang bgos pas na bza' mchog: yid bzhin 'khor lo'i dal du 'bul: ma badz+ra waṣ+ṭa ā hūṃ: dgu pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni 37 atshu phyinang snod bcud 'dod yon kun: dngos zhen mtshan rtog spros bral ba:rnam mdzes phyi yi maṇ+ḍal mchog: rje btsun 'phags ma'i sku la 'bul: bdag lus phung khams skye mched kun: bag chags dri ma rnam bral ba: ro mnyam nang gi maṇ+ḍal de: rje btsun 'phags ma'i gsung la 'bul: sems nyid 'byu 'phro'i rtog tshogs kun: rig pa rdo rje'i gzi brjid can: kun bzang gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal nyid: rje btsun 'phags ma'i

thugs la 'bul:dgyes bskang tshogs chen rdzogs pa dang:rtogs pa mthar phyin dngos grub stsol:sa rat+na maṇ+ḍal byu dza te a hūṃ bcu pa phyi nang gsang mchod ni hūṃ hrī:kun bzang dgongs pa klong yangs las:nyer byung rdo rje rol rtsed mchog:gzung 'dzin dri ma rnam dag pa'i ro mnyam phyi nang gsang gsum gyi:mchod pa chen po rdul bral ba ting nge 'dzin mchog g.yo med pa 'od gsal rang bzhin mtshan ma med:yid 'ong lha mos rtse gar bsgyur:mdzes pa'i ku mud char ltar 'bebs:ngad ldan bdug pa sprin ltar gtibs:dbang gi sgron me 'od stong 'khyugs:bde chen bde mchog dri yi chab:ro ldan bcud mdzes zhal zas dang:grags stong rol mo chos kyi sgra:'dzin zhen nyon mongs rnam grol ba:'dod yon lnga ldan byu dza dang:'khor 'das mnyam sbyor a dṛ ta nyon mongs chags pa bsgral ba'i khrag:'dod pa'i sprin 'khrigs ba lirnyi thabs shes spyor ba bde ba'i rgyun:mtshan 'dzin bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus:rdo rje'i bro gar chos nyid gla:ngo mtshar bde chen ḍak+ki yis:mnyam pa mchog gi rol rtsed bcas:nam mkha' gang ba'i

༷/ca sprin chen po: 'phags ma'i sku gsung thugs mchog bskang bde chen ye shes rtogs pa yi: mchog tu mi 'gyur gnyug ma'i zhal: rjen par mthong ba'i dngos grub stsol: snyen ma hwa pañtsa pū dza ho: bcu gcig phyag gi mchod pa ni na mo chags sogs rdul gyiskyon bral ba gangs la nyi 'byud bkrag mdangs 'bar gdul bya'i skom sel yid bzhin dpal: 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo: chos sku mnyam pa'i gzigs stangs can: 'gugs dang sgrol ba'i phrin las 'gyed: snyeng rjes zin zhing ye shes gsal gzigs tshul mtha' yas phyag 'tshal lo: gzhon nu'itshul dgu'i rnam 'khyud cing: mtshan dpe'i zhal bzang yid 'phrog dpal: bde ster rnam 'gyur du ma'i 'byud: 'phags ma yum la ut+pa la yi dri 'thul zhing sgeg bzhad g.yo ba'i rnam 'gyur can: chags thog rmongs pa'i dri kun bral 'phags ma yum la rat+na'i dbu rgyan mgul 'phreng ba: do shal phyag zhabs gdu bu dang: se mo do yis rnam par 'khyud 'phags ma yum la yeshes lnga mtshon cod pan dang: zi ldir gar gyi phu dung mdzes: dmar ser sham thabs stod

g.yog mthing 'phags ma yum la tshe mda' rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dal:bum pa 'chi med bcud kyis bkang:thabs shes phyag rgyar brten mdzad pa'i:'phags ma yum la 'khor 'das tshe dpal sprul pas 'gugs:sgrub la 'chi med dngos grub sbyin:don kun yid bzhin stsol mdzad dpal:'phags ma yum la khyed zhal dran pas mod la ni 'jigs tshogs sdug bsngal mtha' dag sel:legs yon phun tshogs dpal kun 'byung 'phags ma yum la sku yi 'od zer bye ba brgyas:mi mjed 'jig rten khams rnams la:'dzad pa phrin las thabs mkhas 'gyed:'phags ma yum la gsung dbyangs chos kyi 'gyur khug gis:gdul bya'i blo gros pad+mo bzhad lung rtogs dam chos 'byung ba'i sgo:'phags ma yum la thugs ni mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis shes bya'i gzhung lugs kun mkhyen zhing:ye shes kun la snyoms par brdal 'phags ma yum la yon tan dpag bsam ljon bzang las:'o/ 'bras bsod nams dpal kha kun:gang yang nub med chu rgyun 'bebs:'phags ma yum la phrin las gter 3 bum bzang las

— dgos 'dod dpal lud thugs rje'i mdangs: mi nub 'gro ba'i yul la bgyed: 'phags ma yum la tsha grang dmyal ba'i khams rnams kun thugs rje la drod rgyun gyis gso: rang byas las sgrib bsal mdzad pa'i: 'phags ma yum la bkres skom yi dwags sde ba'i yang: 'gag med bdud rtsis gdung ba skyobs: bde sa 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu: 'phags ma rmongs pa dud 'gro bying kha 'thor: gcig la gcig za gdug rtsubs nyams: thugs rje byams pas skyobs mdzad dpal:gas ma skye rga na 'chis mnar ba'i mi: 'gro ba rigs bdun skye ba'i bsdus: thams cad kun gyi skyabs gcig pu: 'phags ma 'thab rtsod phrag dog zug rngu can: lha che chung rigs dgu yang: brtse shugs thugs rjes skyobhe mdzad pa'i: 'phags ma khengs sems nga rgyal gdung bas gzir: bag med ngang la dus 'da' bas: yid bzhin la ster 'gro ba'i mgon: 'phags ma sdug bsngal 'gyur ba 'du byed kyis: kun nas gtses pa'i rmongs khams rnams: byams brtse nus stobs dpal gyis skyobs:

'phags ma snang srid gzhir bzhengs dkyil 'khor kun bde chen yum gyis sang las bskyed:rol pa chen po 'ub chub yum:'phags ma 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bskyed pa mo:da ltar bzhugs pa kun gyi gzhi ma 'ong rnams kyi yum mchog dpal:'phags ma ngo bo ka dag kun bzang po rang bzhin mtha' bral wa ra hi thugs rje rtsol bral tā re'i gsang:'phags ma yum la snang ba mtha' yas pad+ma'i rigs:thugs rje'i gter chen pad dkar 'chang:phrag brgya'i bla ma mtshan brgyad dpal:'phags ma yum la sku ni rdo rje'i 'od zer can:gsung dbyangs 'gags pa med pa'i gter thugs na rdul bral kun la khyab 'phags ma yum la thabs mchog dpa' bo rta mgrin dang:shes rab gsang ba ye shes gar:rū tra bsgral ba'i dpa' rtags can:'phags ma yum la mjam pa'i blo mtsho mtha' yas pa:ngag dbang dbyangs can yid mtshor skyes:shes rab kun gyi 'byung gnas che:'phags ma yum la mdzad phrin rab 'gyed nyi shu gcig spran gzim khro gnyer yid bzhin dpal:ston 'khor shar bas gangs ljongs smobs:'phags

— ma yum la skyodan ma rnam bam da zhing khams su:bskal bzang sangs rgyas byang sems sogs:lung rtogs chos kyis 'byung gnas dpal 'phags ma yum la ga lus rdul rnyed grangs sprul zhing:ngag gi glu dbyangs 'gyur khug bcas:sems ni dad gus 'pho med bcas:yid bzhin 'khor lor gus phyag 'tshal:bcu gnyis bstod pa 6da ni hūṃ nyikun mkhyen yeshes me bo ches:sgrib gnyis bag chags dri ma kun:bsreg cing bsal bar mjad pa yis lha mo ston ga'i zla ba la'o:mi'ajigs skyabs kyi sbyin dpal seng glang me sbrul chom rkun dang:lcags sgrogs rgya mtsho sha za sogs:'jigs skyobs rdo rje'i go cha la'o:mchog gidangos grub dpal sbyin gter gnas sa tshe dpal bsod nams bskyed mthar thug sa lam rtsal rdzogs pa'i:yid bzhin re skong nor bu la'o chags pa kun bral bde sbyin rgyas:khams smin yi ge lha ru sa:sa gsum dag pa chen por sbor mnyam rol bde chen rgyas 'debs la'o:kun nas byang chub mdzad pa mo:bde ba chen po sbin la dgyes:'khor 'das mnyam rol

ma chen zhal: brtse chen thugs rjes skyong mdzad la'o: kun khyab shes rab 'od po ches: ma rig gsum gyi snang ba bcom: mkhyen gnyis lo 'dab rgyas mdzad pa'i: lha mo rta bdun zhal mnga' la'o: ji snyed zhing khams rgya mtsho la: rdul snyed sku gsum zhal mnga' bas: de snyed mdzad phrin bsam mi khyab: rdo rje rgya zla'i mkha' klong la'o: ma ni sbyin pa chen po'i dpal: tā ni tshul khrims rnam par dag: re ni bzod pa'i go cha ste: snying rje byams srung gtong mkhas la'o:twe ni brtson chen shugs ldan dpal swā ni ting 'dzin g.yo med pa: hā ni shes rab pha rol phyin brtson chen g.yo med ye shes la'o: pad dkar rgyas 'dra'i zhal mnga' ba ut+pa la yi dri bsung 'thul: dri med dung gi dkyil 'khor can:lag pa'i lha mchog 'phags ma la'o: yid 'dod re ba sbyin pa'i dpal: 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo chos skur bshig: 'gro drug sgrol mdzad gdul bya'i ma: zhi mdzad dkar mor phyag 'tshal brdo da: bcu gsum phyag bstod gsol gdab na bka' las byung ba'i nyi shu gcig gnyis gsum bdun du brjod pa'am yang na 'di ltar bskur bar bya yin:ro la dkar ri la nyi 'tshogad zhal

che/ phyag 'tshal yid bzhin 'khor lo ma: ston ga'i zla ba nya gang dpal rab gsal 'od brgya'i phrin las 'gyed: 'jigs tshogs skyobs mdzad tā re yum ā yu skye 'chi med pa 'i lha: dzñā na ye shes kun gyi gsang: pukhye bsod nams dpal ster ma: tshe hūṃX pho nyas tshe srog gso: n+ni dzaḥbla srog khams 'dus brten: sarba 'khor 'das gnyis kyi dpal: sirnyi dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i: pha la dri bral bzang po rtsa ka āḥbaskur thob bral bar bskyil: de ltar che ba mtshan sngags kyis: bstod pa lus ni rdul rnyed phyag ngag gi glu dbyangs snyan 'gyur smra yid ni dad gus mos ldan pas: 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo: rtags par thugs rje brtse bas skyongs: bdag dang 'gro ba sems can kun: 'khor ba srid pa'i gtson khaṃ las: da lta nyid du bsgral ba dang: rnam mdzes rang snang dag pa'i zhing: g.yu lo can du lam sna drongs: mngon sum 'phags mas rjes bzung nas: 'gro 'dren ded dpon 'khyar bar shog: go gi grangs dang mtshungs par brjod brgya bzhi bzlas sngags bya ba ni bdag gi mos gus byas pa'i 'od kyis basmal te grol yum yid bzhin

'khor lo'i thugs rje'i skyabs 'og tu rang dang sems can thams cad tshud: 'jigs tshogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs dang sdig sgrib nyes lhung thams cad sku yi 'od zer gyis dag cing sbyangs la zhi bar bsam: bla tshe bsod nams nyams rtogs ye shes yon tan thams cad gong nas gong 'phel du 'khor pho nya las mdzad rnams kyis bskyed cing rgyas par dmigs rlung sems ting nge 'dzan la rang dbang thob cing lha 'dre mi dreg pa sde brgyad thams cad 'phags ma'i thugs rjes mnga' dbang du bsdus par dmigs: dgra 'dre bdud bgegs mtshan rtogs thams cad mi gnas chos sku chen por bsgral nas mtha' bral dbu ma chen po mngon du gyur bar bsam dmigs bya rnams la tshe dang bsod nams zas nor longs spyod kyi gter chen po rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor los stsol bar dmigs la: o tā re a yudzñā na pubye tshe s+t+waṃ n+ni dza0sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ āX brgya stong la sogasaci stog bskyar skyabs dang go cha bdud rtsi' rgyun dngos grub tshul du dang len bya de yis don kun gegs med 'grub bco lnga smon lam gdab pa ni kye: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las maḥ ār+ya tā re gtso 'khor

༷| bcas: thugs rje brtse ba chen pos dgongs: bdag gi smon lam grub par mdzod: yongs su grub pa'i dkyil 'khor lo: rnam par gsal ba'i dge ba yis:'khrul 'khor snang ba'i bkod pa kun: dag pa chen por smin par shog: tsha grang skom pas gdung ba la: thugs rje bsil drod ldan pa'i mthus: zug rngu ma lus drung 'byin nas:bde ba chen po thob par the ga: bkres par zas da skom pa la: btung ba zhim mngar 'byor ba dang mthu med mthu ldan mya ngan can: kun nas bde legs phun tshogs shog:bcing pa rnams ni grol ba dang: brgal 'dod shing rta gru gzing skas: 'gro ba nad kyis gzir ba rnams: myur du phan dang bde 'byor shog: sbrum ma gargod sted btsa' ba dang:sha za srin po snying rje ldan: gos med gos dang nor med nor 'byor ba phun sum tshogs thob shog: gso sman nus mthu ldan pa dang: bzlas sngags yongs su rab grub shing:'gro ba drug gi sems can kun: rang snang zug rngu kun bral shog: bu 'dod pa la srid dkar dang: dpal 'dod rnams la bsod nams gter: rtsol sgrub lhur len mi dgos

par:nam mkha' mdzod la longs spyod re ga:mi mjed 'jig rten khams rnams kun:bde skyid lha dang mnyam bzhin du:lus rten lha bas lag thob nas:dam chos snying po lon par shog:skye nas tshe rabs thams cad du:dal 'byor rin chen thob pa dang:dpal ldan bla mas rjes zin nas:man ngag bdun rtsi thob par shog:bdag nai masang thos dran reg dang:bzang ngan gtam gyis 'brel ba kun:las ngan sgrib pa'i rgyun chod nas:'dren pa'i ded dpon bdag gyur cig sku gsum gdul zheng mtha' yas par:smon lam mdzad phrin bsam yas bzhin:mdzad spyod dka' ba thams cad kyang bdag gi yongs su 'grub par re ga:srid pa nam mkha'i mthar gtug pa:gang yang smon lam sems bskyed mdangs yongs su smin par rab zin nas:'khor ba dong sprugs nus par 31ga:sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang:sems can bde skyid ldan bzhin du:skye rgu chos la spyod gyur nas:don gnyis lhun gyi grub par shog: a/ rgyan pad+ma'i rang lugs mchog:zab gter bstan pa rin po che:mi nub yar ngos zla ba bzhin:gong nas
