gong du 'phel bar shog srid pa yongs su ru bzlog nas: nang gsal sku gsum rgyal sa la: mi ldog bde chen dpal thob nas: gzhan phan phrin las mtha' thegag: ces kya yongs su dag pas gdab tshe gcig byang chub mchog thob 'gyur sa ma yu bar du 'pha gas ma mchod pa'i rim palha rgya rgya rgya gu rgya bdo thim de nas kha bskang rim pa la rnam gra sa bdun gyi sgo nas dang po gtor ma cha bzha las byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa ni o ā:sno yang dag rat+na mdzes pa'i snod: rgya che khyon brdal phun tshog dbus: gtor ma 'dod yon phung po ni: zad yid bzhin gter du gyur: ma a:shā lan gsum dang ni a ka ros zad med yid bzhin gter du spel rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis oṃ ār+ya tā re ma hā purmye tshe s+t+waṃ d+dhi jamisarba sa ma ya dza dza: dzñā ṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo na ma ho: mkha' 'gro'i ljags gri gug gi rnam pas gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bas zag med bde ba chen pos dgyes pa bskang bar bsam la: ka twa re sa pā ri wa ra e rda ba 21 ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan bdun rgyas phul dgyes pa bskangs 'dod don phrin las bcol ba ni rta rgyal yum rje btsun sgrom ma 'phags ma yid bzhin

'khor lo: las byed mkha' 'gro ma tshogs: bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs rnams kyis mchod gtor gnyan po 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi tshe bsrings: dpal bskyed brgyag mthud ji srid byang chub snying po la 'chis kyi bar du srung skyobs mdzod: 'tsho ba sbyor nyams rtogs bskyed: 'jigs tshogs zhi: dpal 'byor rgyas mos bzhi bsdus dgra bgegs sgrol: ci re ba dang ci smon pa'i las myur du sgrub la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur du stsol cig: de nas yon to mgron bskang ba gtor ma byin rlabs gong ltar bya lar gsal ting 'dzin bstan po yis oṃ sarba dharmā pā la k+ṣe ṭa pā la lo ka pa la sarba sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: dzñā na tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo na ma ho: las byed pho nya rnams kyi ljags ral gri'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bas mnyes pa bskang nas brin las rab 'byams thams cad sgrub par bsam la 33 badz+ra dharmā pā la k+ṣe ṭa pā la ma ka pā la sa pā ri wa ra e de ba lirnyi kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan bdun gyas phul dgyes pa bskang 'dod don brin las bcol ba ni ho: ye shes kyi mgon po rnam par snang mdzad: legs ldan

༷| tshogs bdag gur zhal phyag bzhi phyag drug ber nag ma ning drag shad las mgon gha ya dha ra la sogs pas dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu la sogs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dang: stod mnga' ri skor gsum: bar dbu gtsang ru bzhi: smad mdo khams sgad drug: gangs dkar nyi shu rtsa gcig: ldongs lnga gling drug gi bdag po: bod skyongs bstan ma bcu gnyis phyi nang gsang ba'i sde brgyad: bka' nyan dkar phyogs skyongs mdzad thams cad kyis: mchod gtor gnyan po 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs: sems can la phan bde spel: rnal 'byor sgrub pa po la mthun rkyen sbyor: 'gal zla bzlog dgra bgegs dam sri'i 'tshe ba gzhom: chos dang mthun pa'i 'tsho ba ma lus pa sbyor: gang dang ji smon pa'i 'bras bu thams cad gegs med yid bzhin du stsol ba'i phrin las mdzod cig: de nas lan chags mgron rnams la gtor ma 'bul ba'i rim pa ni bsangs sbyangs byin gyis rlabs par bya rang nyid lha yi rgyal gyis snyen sarba snu ta ā ra/sgo dza dza dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas bkugs par bya

37 sarba bisno sa pā ri wa ra e rda bha lirnyi kha kha khā hi kha hi: lan bdun gyis phul 'dod gsol ni ho: dug gsum las lasaskyes pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi tshogs rnams la: zad med 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa'i longs spyod 'di 'bul lo: dga' mgu yi rang gi bsam pa dang ldan pas longs spyod la gnod 'tshe bsam sbyor rtsub mo zhi nas: phan pa byang chub kyi sems dang ldan te 'a11 khams bde la sbyor ba'i phrin las mdzod cig: sarba bisne ghadzā se gol gtogs pa sa bsdu rim bya de nas snying rje'i mgron rnams la gtor ma 'bul ba'i ram pa ni bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs gong ltar bya rang nyid lha ya rgyal gyis skyid aswābyeb jitshogedisatshogarba badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: dzahūṃ baṃ ho: bkugs pa'i rgya yi 'gugs bstams bya yin yiXlja dza ༷ preḥsadza sarba sa pā ri wa ra e rda ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan bdun gyis phul 'dod gsol ni hoḥ ma reg 'khrul snang las skyes pa'i 'a17 ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la:'dod yon mi zad pa'i gter chen po sprul ba'i gtor ma 'bul lo chags zhen bral ba'i tshul du spyod la bde ba chen po dang ldan nas rang byas las kyi zug rngu mtha' dag dang

bral te sku gsum gyi dgo sa klong dam par byang chub nas 'khor ba dong sprugs nus par gyur cig ces dang 'dod gsol gdab par bya sa ma yu gnyis ju bzod gsol bya ba 1 : ma rig las nyon 'khrul rtog gis: nongs pa kun rmongs bag chags gzeb gnyis mdzin sems kyi dri ma kun: ma lus bzod gsol bshags bgyi'o: 31 badz+ra sa ma khye āḥ gsum pa bsngo ba 'di ltar bya hūṃ trī: lhag bsam rnam dkar dge 'bras bu: ji rted bsags pa'i bsod nams mthu: kun tu bzang po'i smon lam dang: 'jam pa'i rdo shes rab sgo: phyag na pad+ma'i thugs bskyed 'bras: mthu chen dbang phyug nus stobs dang: sangs rgyas stong gi thugs bskyed bzhin: gegs med yid bzhin 'byung ba dang:ra ba dong nas sprugs gyur cig: lan gsum bzhi pa smon lam gdab pa ni hūṃ hrī: zag dang zag med dge rtsa kun: 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por bzhag: bdag ni mthong thos reg gi: rgyud smin yongs grol byang chub shog: sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang: sems can ma lus bde sted ldan: nyin mtshan rtag tu chos sprod nas: rang gzhan don

gnyis 'grub gyur cig: lan gsum lnga pa bsdu ldang bya ba ni a āḥ 'phags ma gces 'dza ra sprul par bcas: 'od zhu bsgrub pa po la thim: gnyis med lhan skyes ye shes zhal:mngon gyur kun bzang sa thob bsam: a ā: phaṭa phaṭā drug pa bkra shis bya ba ni na mo kun khyab nam mkha' mtha' dbus bral bde chen rdo rje btsun mo'i klong spros pa'i gzeb las rnam grol ba: kun tu bzang mo'i bkra shis shog: bde stong 'du 'bral mi dmigs pa dga' chen rol pa chen po'i dpal: 'khor ba chos nyid dbyings su sbyor rdo rje phag mo'i bkra shis shog ji ltar mkhyen zhing ji rnyed gzigs ye shes kun gyi gsang ba 'dzin: mchog tu mi 'gyur gnyug ma'i zhal: yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bkra shis shog: zag pa skye med dbyings su bcom mnyam slong rgyal ba kun gyi gsang bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i zhal: sgeg 'gying glu gar bkra shis shog: zhi ba thugs rje can gyi ngang: rgyas mdzad rnam sras dbang rta mchog: drag po stobs mchog thal 'byin lha: smin grub mchog dbyings bkra shis shog: snying rje brdal khyab chen po la byams pa rol

mkhas dga' chen brtse: btang snyoms 'dzin tshul mtha' yas pa: las mdzad ma bzhi'i bkra shis shog: kun dga'i tshal bzang g.yo ba la: ku mu ta yis rnam mjes: nyer byung gdul bya'i dpal du rol: gtso 'khor sprul pa'i bkra shis shog: smon lam las skyes thugs rten 1nga: zab bcud pad+ma'i sgyu 'phrul ba: tshogs smon 'phros bskul 'bras bu: 'od gsal thugs thig bkra shis shog: phan dang bdeb 'byung ba'i gnas: bstan pa spyi dang khyad par sngags: yun gnas de 'dzin zhabs pad na: bla na med pa'i bkra shis shog: nyin yang dpal 'bar ta la la: mtshan yang bde skyid kyi li li: bar med rtag tu dge legs pa: bkra shis mchog gsang stsal du la: ces da shis brjod rgya chen bya gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag 'gyur bdun pa bsgyur kha 'di ltar bya dze+ebatsun yid bzhin 'khor lo yi phyag g.yas mchog sbyin phyag rgya nyid: skyabs gyur pa'i 'og tu ni: bdag dang bsrung bya tshud bsam la: mtshams su phyag 'tshal gnyas re brjod 'phags ma yid bzhen 'khor lo yi: sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab nas: bdag

dang sems can thams cad kyi: sdig sgrib nyes ltung dag par dmigs: motshams su phyag 'tshal gsum re bya'o 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo yi: 'chi med ye shes bum bzang las:tshe bsod nyams rtogs yon tan kun: yang ngos zla ltar 'phel rgyas bsam mtshams su phyag 'tshal bdun brjod na 'dod pa thams cad yid bzhin 'byung sa ma yu rjes kyi man ngag mtha' brgyan da bcas pa'o rgya rgya rgya ye ma yo rgyan rig 'dzan rdo rje gshog rgod ngas ma 'o sa 'gro la shin tu brtse sems kyis snyang dang 'dra ba thugs kya zig le nyid 'grog ban khye'u chung grub pa'i dbang por gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bstims ma 'o sa snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul grub pa' dab phyug dpa' bo dang 'phrad nas bstan 'gro'i dpal bde spel bar 'gyur de bar srungs shig sman btsun g.yu lcam ma skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya gu h+ya snyi ces pa 'da'ang lung zin dharmā kumud dang chos kyi bdag po kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyas dga' sdug ga lcag dang / 'gro shor gyi dbyug pas bsnun pa ma bzod nas/ bdag 'dras rgyan bsamagatan gling pa sa mkha' 'gro'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa' rat+na sar sogs gnyes par gyur cig sarba mar+sha la/ dge'o/ bkra shis/
zhe rdo dag snang las 'a baglu 'tshibadag g.yul bzlog bzhugs:

/rdorwa na mo dzñā na ḍak+ki ni ya: r+sājusgosnye11 srung bya'i lus drag kha snab lud skra sen bsres pa'i sku glud ni mthang dkar ser dmar ljang gu bya chang glud theb skyu lo grangs byed nam mkha' mda' 'pha glu( 11 bkrams 'bru sna ja mar sha dum bsags rang nyid mkha' 'gra'i ting 'dzan gyis na mo: chos nyid rke stong ka dag dang kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu med mthu: sngags dang ting 'dzin bden pa'i stobs: skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs kyis med snang stong gzugs 'khrul ba'i gdon: sgyu 'phrul ltad mo bkod la 'dus tri a ra ya dza dza hūṃ baṃ ho lan bdun nam dgu brjod byin rlabs ni hrī: mi srid dgu 'phrul srid pa'i mdos: ting 'dzin nam mkha' mdzod kyi dkor: lha 'dre'i yid spyod skong ba'i rdzas: ngo mtshar ltad mo phun tshogs gyur: ma āX hūṃ sngags dang phyag rgyas zad med spel spyan 'dren ni kye: mtho ste chos dbyings nam mkha'i klong dma' ste rin chen gser gyi gzhi: yangs ba gling bzhi srid pa'i dkor:mi zad mdos la da tshur byon: rin chen dkor nor phun sum tshogs: 'dod pa'i yon tan lhun gyis grub: 'phrul gyi srog chags ya mchan can bkod mdzes mdos la

7༷ gzigs shing bzhugs:sems la gang 'dod de ltar snang:yid la re smon chags thogs bral:mtho dman ngo srung med par mnyam:nam mkha' mjod la ༷dī byeg 'tshal:zhi zhing byams sems ldan par gyis:cha badz+ra sa man dza hūṃ dza:mdos mchod ni kyai:stong pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las:gnam mtha' lcags gyi thabs chen dang:sa mtha' zangs kyi shes rab ma'i:'phrul gyi thog ma gdon chen lnga:de las gyes pa brgyad cu dang:gzhan ya khri brgyad bzhi stong ste:nyon mongs las las skyes pa rnams tshogs yul rang grol glud gtor 'dis:ngom zhing tshim nas grol gyur cig:kun gzhi'i gnyid kyis myos gyur te:chos dbyings ye shes ma rtogs pas gti mug rmongs pa'i bgegs rig rnams:nam mkha'i rang mdangs glud gtor 'dis:ngoms shing tshim nas grol gyur cag:nyon mongs yid kyi dbang gyur te:mnyam yid ye shes ma rtogs pas:nga rgyal rgyas pa'i bgegs rigs rnams:sa khams 'dzin med glud gtor 'dis:ngoms shing tshim nas grol gyur cig:phra gsal rnam shes kyis 'ching ste:me long ye shes ma

rtogs pas: zhe sdang 'khrugs pa'i lha 'dre rnams: chu khams 'gegs med glud gtor 'dis: ngoms shing tshim nas grol gyur cig dwangs gsal yid la bdag bzung ste:sor rtogs yi shesam rtogs pas: 'dod chags 'tshub pa'i gdon bgegs rnams: me khams 'bar g.yos glud gtor 'dis: ngoms shing tshim nas grol gyur cig las rlung 'dzin pa a 'thas te: bya grub ye shes ma rtogs pas: phrag dog 'tshubs pa'i gdon bgegs rnams: rlung khams 'gegs med glud gtor 'dis ngoms shing tshim nas grol gyur cig: rigs kyi dkyil 'khor ma rtogs te: phung po lnga la bdag bzung bas: rten 'brel las gyur bgegs rigs rnams lugs 'byung rgyu ma'i glud gtor 'dis:ngoms shing tshim nas grol gyu cig: se bha ras sngags ci rags brjod la glud gtor bsngo skyed med dbyings las shar ba yi: 'gags med sgyu ma'i glud gtor 'dis: zhen med rang ngo rtogs mdzod la: 'khrul med rgyal ba'i rjes su snyogs sa bha ras sngags brjod la glud bsngo lam bstan pa na rkye: rang snang log par 'khrul pa'i gdon: ma rig dbang gyur lha 'dre

shā pa rnams: sgyu ma'i nor gyi mgu byos la: chos dbyings stong pa'i klong du gshegs: skye 'chi'i bdag 'dzin mtshan ma bor: stong nyid snying rje'i ngang la gnas: so so1 1nga rig rgyal ba'i yum: don dam rtogs mdzod glud mgron rnams: 'khor ba 'das pa'i pha rol phyin: grol ba'i shul lam zin par gyis: 'di ru ma 'dug rang sar dengs: nyu hūṃsngas tsu ta ya phaṭa: ces brjod la glud gtor lo bdud phyogs su bskyal phyi nang tshe yi bar chad 'di yis sel sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya gu h+ye rda tham lha zhes pa 'di' nus lan pas so dge'o/ sarba ma le/

ste/— tshom bu bkod pa ni skye med nam mkha' lta bu' 1 nas ye shes gzigs pa ro mas pa 'i rgyal yum yid bzhin 'khor lo dam tshag rten gyi dal du bzhugs par mos pa sa tshod tā re a ma ra ṇa tshe hūṃ a yu dzña ṇa oṃ āḥs: tshe a mi dhe wa a yudzñā ṇa oṃ āXhūṃ tshe badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma sirnyi oṃ āḥs: cha hāḥbadz+ra ḍak+ki ni oṃ āḥs: rgo ra rat+na ḍak+ki ni oṃ āḥhūṃ rgo nyiḥpad+ma ḍak+ki ni oṃ āḥlha:oṃ sarba garma ḍak+ki ni oṃ āḥs: tshe badz+ra la phye hūṃ oṃ āX hūṃ: tshe badz+ra ma phywa tram̐ oṃ āX:: tshe badz+ra ghirti trī oṃ āḥlha tshe badz+ra nirti a oṃ āḥhūṃ: tshe badz+ra adru sha dza oṃ āḥ/: ma rat+na pa sha hūṃ oṃ āḥs: tshe pad+ma sbo ṭa baṃ oṃ āḥ/: ma garma ghan+ḍi ho oṃ āḥhūṃ: tshe badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki ni oṃ āX( sa ma ya ste: bum pa 'ang de ltar rja sa blugs bya'o hūṃX bkra shis tshe dang bsod nams la dbang phyiraḥ pad+ma'i phreng mdzes so shi mdzes pa dor sngon bsags dri ma mi gnas dag sangs 'gyur: tshe badz+ra ha sa ha: hūṃ bkra shis tshos dang las dbang mthu mdzom phyir lha mo dri med shel gyis kong bu yisaḥ khyod kyis da ltar bsags pa'i las nyon khru: me long rdul bral ltar du dag par gyur: hūṃḥ bhi shud+dhi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūṃ

bkra shis rtsa rlung thig le las rung zhing: tshe dang ye shes bde ba mchog thob phyir 'phags ma'i rang bzhin srad bu'i phyag rgyal gdabaX rlung sems 'khrul ba dbu ma'i dbyings su bcil : sarba bhud+dha e be kun+d+ra rak+ta rak+ṣa hūṃ: rta: bkra shis ku sha'i gdan bting mngon byang chub: myur lam mchog brten tshe gcig sangs rgyas pa'i: rten 'brel rtags kyis brda' dbang bslu med stsol: sa badz+ra tigru sirnyi trī: hūṃ: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo yi bdag la rten 'brel brda' rtags ston: tshe ā:hūṃ ma hā sirnyi 〉: lta gon dbang gi gsol 'dab na kye: mkhyen dang brtse ba'i nyi ma can: bdag la rjes su chags par mdzod: sgo gsum gus dbul brtse ba'i zungs: lta gon dbang nas smin grol mdzod: lan gsum kye ho: theg chen chos ni gyur ba'i lamaḥ thabs mang dka' ba med na yang: lta spyod grub mtha' 'dzin nus sam: dam khas blang na dngos grub sbyir: skyabs 'gro na na mo rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas dang: zhi ba chags bral dam pa'i chos: tshogs mchog phyir mi ldog pa la: bdag gi gus pas ho: byang chub sems dpa'i dge slo dabhe : sngags kyi rig

༷/— pa 'dzin pa dang:rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la bdag ni gus pas ho:gnas lugs spros bral chos kyis sku:mi gnas mi dmigs de bzhin nyid:so ma rang gsal kun tu bzang:sku gsum ye shes skyabs su 'dzin:sems bskyed na ho:theg chen rtsa ba byang chub sems:smon dang 'jug pa'i rims pa'ang:sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs bzhed ltar bdag gi yongs su bsgrub par bgyi:spyod pa mchog la yang rabs gnas:phan bde kho nar 'bad khur len tshogs bsags ni gzhu ltar btang sdom bzu ni hūṃ:tshe 'dzin grub pa'i rgyal mo dang rdo rje slob dpon brtse ba'i dgongs:bdag ni theg chen sgor bzhugs nas:rigs lnga'i sdom pa dam tshig dang sor byang sngags kyi bslab bya dang:dag mnyam lhar bsgrub lta ba las:rnam par mi 'da' thugs rjes zungs:byin gyis rlobs la smin grol mdzod:mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni ā:stong pa chos dbyings brgyan gyur lha rdzas sprin:phyi nang gsang mdzod sman raka bā ling ta:dngos bshams yid sprul ting nge 'dzan gyis dkor:rje btsun 'phags ma'i gsang gsum bskang phyir spel sa
badz+ra pu dza spa ra ṇa kho: 'di yang nus ldan rdo rjes so/

ra byu// 'chi med grub mdos kyi zin bris zhal rgyun ltar bgod pa la gab don gnad byang las e: chos nyid stong pa'i sogs ma ngas spyod 31ga: sngags drug phyag drug gis spel/ grub mdos las mi dmigs chos dbyings sogs gnas gyur cig sa bskang gzer tig las/ e: sku mdza ga grub pa'i sogs a ā: gtor 'gugs ldeb shar 'don/ gab don las yis ya man+ta sogs mngon gyur re ga: kha bska las kye: lha klu gnyan gtod sogs a a swā hā: grub mdos las/ kye: rgyu sbyor yon bdag sogs bzlog bzlog: gab don las/ kyi chos nyid don dam sogs chen por hūṃ: grub mdos las/ e ka dag skye med sogs bisne ghasne de nas ga'u sgrub pa ni gab don las hūṃ 'jin rten gnas su sogs tshe t+t+waṃ: sngags ci 'grub bzlas thugasosgrub lasacas: bde bar btagags sogs bskyed: e: sogs ya ge lnga po brgya rtsa dang rten snyang su pra tadzi'i bstan par bzhugs/ tshe 'gugs ni/ zab sgrub las/ hūṃ hrī: rang snang sogs dza phyi nang gsang gsum gyi gsol gdab 'am gang 'os dang / hūṃ thugs dam chen po sogs hūṃ: thugs sgrub las hūṃ skye med nam nam mkha'i ngo bo sogs a /: zab sgrub las hūṃ hrī: yid bzhin dpal

sogs lhan: kha bskang las o skye med chos dbyings sogs tiṣ+ṭha lhan: gsang sgrub las/ rnal 'phyor kham drug sogasashog hrī: lha dang rig 'dzin tshe gzungs zab sgrub lasatshan sku la sogs cig: thugs sgrub las skyid 'grub par sogs cig: nang sgrub las ma ma rdo 'phags ma sogs thob 31ga: thugs sgrub las hūṃ hrī: 'od snang mtha' yas sogs bzlog:

——— dag snang las sgrol ma'i maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa 'od gsal sgron me bzhugs:51 namo gu ru ya thaspamāṃ khyed shes dad pa'i 'di skad gyer hūṃ: rang mdun nam mkhar 'ja' 'od thig le'i klong: rgyal ba'i yum gyur rje btsun tā re ma ut+pal 'dī bzang in+d+ra'i mdangs bzang ngoms: sems ma'i zhabs bzhugs longs sku'i rgyan chas rdzogs: ye shes gzigs pa'i zhal bzang mos mtshor rol: 'di phyi'i re ltos skyabs mgon dam par dmigs: rta: lha mo in+d+ra'i zhal bzang khyed mkhyen no: 'jigs pa kun las dbugs dbyung skyabs du gsol: gnyis gsum/ bdun rims pa ra brjod e: 'di phyi'i re stos rgyal yum phrin las gter: rje btsun 'phags ma 'khor ba las sgrol ma gtso 'khor sprul bar bcas la gsol ba 'debs: mi 'bral 'phags ma'i zhabs drung ste bar shog: lan gsum rta srid las rnam grol zhi las dbug dbyung zhing: rang snang 'od gsal zhing la mnga' brjes phyir: rgyal yum 'phags ma'i snying po lam khyer na:

'khor 'das mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i dngos grub rtsol: ma tā re hūṃ swā hā: yengs med chu bo' bzhung ltar bzla smon lam gdab pa ni na mo gu na rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan chos dbyings sang ye shes bde ba sbyin pa'i tā re ma'i: sa lam yon tan mdzub mo'i brda' ston bzhin: rang snang 'od gsal zhing du lam sna drongs phyi nang bar chad bdud las rnam rgyal te: 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon bdag gyur cig: bsdu rims ni lha mo 'od zhu bdag la thim pa'i mod: 'jigs pa kun las dbug dbyung rnam grol myur: shis brjod ni na mo:rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig phrin las ma shes rab phar phyin bde ba kun gyi gsang 'gro ba ma lus 'dren pa'i dpa' gdeng can: 'phags ma myur dpa la lha mo'i bkra shis regag de ltar tā re la brten nas maṇ+ḍal bzhi chog 'dir brtson na phrin las rnam bzha lhun grub cing dge legs dpal gyi yon tan 'byor sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhe papa'ang dad ldan 'gros ba nas bkra shis lha regs dang bcas te bskul ba da / slob bu a rdo nas yang yang bskur ngor/ nu ldan pas spelab maṅga le/

shā o tā re: rgyal ba kun yum rje btsun tā re ma: 'phags ma nyer gcig lha mor gsol ba 'debs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: bsam pa lhun gyis 'jes par byin gyis rlobs: zhes rje btsun ma'i gsol 'debs 'di chos ldan nas bskul ngor nus ldan pas gsol ba btab pa dza yan+tu sum̐: kyi: 'bod do phywa g.yang gter bdag rje btsun ma: khyed shes dad pas 'bod bskul gsol 'debs na: thugs rje myur mgyogs lcags kyus nyer bzungs la: 'khor 'das dge mtshan ma lus 'dir stsol cig: tshe sā sti sidhi maṅga le: zhes pa 'ang ka bzhi' chos ldan nas bskur ngoranus ldan pa' bris pa dza yan+tu —11 tshe 'gugs ni o su sti: lha mo zla ba'i zhal can tshe dang ye shes dpal 'dzin ma'i: sgrub mchog bla tshe srog dbugs yal 'khyams lha 'dre'i brkus 'phrog kun:thabs stobs thugs rje tshad med lcags kyu'i rang bar 'gugs byas te: lhan skyes bla tshe sgog la phri ba med par 'phel rgyas mdzod: dus min skye rga na 'chi'i rgud pa'i tshogs

kyis mi gdung bar: tshe dang ye shes dpag med nam mkha'i gter la mnga' brnyes shog 67 ār+ya tā re tut+ta re ma ma a yumarnye tshe s+t+waṃ ṇi dza a ma ra ṇi dzi brnyi ye swā hā: ci rigs bzlas pas bla tshe nyams pa sogs sor chud pa ra 'byur ro 'de yang mthar phyan nas bskul ngor nus ldan pas smras te slob bu spros bral gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel/

shā dag snang las: spros med rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg tshe bsod dpal 'phel bzhugs:—13 na mo ar+ya ta re yabye 14tsho ces rdzas la shing tog nas 'bras mar so ba yam shing zas mchog gtso rgyas pa'i shing ga me r+ṣa ni gru bzhi 'bar re rlung g.yab ser 'bru gsum sngags da phyag rgyas spel re mnyam brdal rgyas pa'i me thabs ser gsal sang: phan bde'i dpal ster rje btsun tā re ma ut+pal mdog 'chang skyabs sbyin pad sdong 'dzan: bcu gsum rgyan rdzogs phyed skyil pad zlar rol: 'ja' 'od 'khyil klong snang stong ma 'dres shar: 'phags ma nyer gcig 'du 'phro skar ltar 'khrigs kun gyi gsang srog las spros 'od zer gyis: g.yu lo can nas ye shes spyan drangs bstims: gnyis med brtan bzhugs dad pas phyag bgyi'o: bla med mchod pa chen po 'bul byis bzhes: 'jigs tshogs zhi zhing nyams rtogs rgyas par mdzod: mabadz+rapu dza ho: rnam lnga da sman raka gtor mchod 'bul rtsa sngags mthar pañtsa.a mṛ ta khā hi: nyer gcag brjod la byon skyems 'bul rdzas rnams stobs shi sa

sgrub mchog rnams 'byoradapon slob 'khor bcas kyis: nad gdon 'jigs pa brgyad sogs zhi ba dang: tshe dang bsod nams nyams rtogs yon tan kun: yar ngos zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pas phyir: bdud rtsi sreg blugs mchod pa 'bul gyis bzhes: bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol: rtsa sngags mthar sarba a yu mkhye dzña na pha la puṣ+ṭi ku ru swā hā brgya stong khri 'bul skabs bstun 'bul bar bar 'dod gsol gdab pa ni ho rgyal ba kun yum rje btsun sgrol ma la: yon tan bskyed pa'i sreg blugs 'di kul bas tshe dang bsod nams legs tshogs 'phel ba dang sa lam mthar phyin 'bras bu thob gyur cig: swā puṣ+ṭi ku ru ye swā hā: slar yang sngags mchod ni o badz+ra brtse sogasashap+ta pañtsa a dṛ ta rak+ta bā lirnyi khā hi: rtsa sngags mthar pañtsa.a dṛ ta khā hi nyer gcig brjod la gshegs skyems mar khu 'bul bstod pa ni twe: ngan song 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgol mdzad ma: 'jigs pa kun las rtag tu sgrol mdzad ma: skal ldan bdud kyi dpung las sgrol mdzad ma rgyal yum bka' drin can la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzod gaphol ni ho sems kyis gol sgrib bag

r+shaX'i chags las nyon kun: mi gnas mi dmigs gting gsal chos skur bshags sa ma yā ā: bsngo smon ni lha dus gsum dge bsags 'khor gsum dag par dro11nang dbyings gdod ma'i chos sku mngon gyur shog: bsdu rims na ho ye shes me yi las ni mthar phyin pas lha tshogs mi dmigs nyams len ngang la bzhag: a āḥsbyinasreg za ba'i gdon rnams bde chen 'bar ba'i me yi 'joms par gyur: shis brjod ni na mo rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang: skye rgu ma lus chos la spyod bzhin par:rang snang 'od gsal zhing khams mngon gyur ba'i: dge legs phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis 365: de ltar rgyas pa' sregs blugs 'bul tshe dang bsod nams yar zla ltar nyams medago nas gong 'phel rgyas don gnyis lhun grub gdon mi za sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu byu bdo thim snyi zhes pa'ang rong sngags grub sde chen po nas skyes mchog 'tshams pa rin po che nas bskur ro ra/ kho bo rgyal khams kyis sprang smyon nus ldan rdo rjes zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul brda' las bsgyur ba dge zhang bkra shas par gyur cag sarba maṅga lam̐/

sgo dag snang las sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgom bzlas 'od gsal sgron me bzhugs:/(14 na mo dzña na ḍak+ki ni byed tho phyotshanaste| rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum yid bzhan 'khor lo tshe 'phel ma 'dod 'byung dbang gi rgyal po ltar gsol ba btab pa'i dgos dgu shāng sa ma yu 'de la spyor dngos rjes gsum las dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni na mo rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i rang gzugs bla ma dang: rnam dbyer ma mchis 'phags mar skyabs su mchi:gzung dang 'dzin pa'i 'ching ba rang grol phyir rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo bsgom par bya: lan gsum gnyis pa la bskyed ni ā: gzhi snang dag pa stong chen chos sku'i klong: lhun grub 'gags med bde chen 'od kyi zhing: ngo mtshar yid 'ong bkod mdzes 'dod pa 'jo: lha klu mi yi dga' ston bsam mtha' yas: rdo rjes lha mo mdzes pa'i mchod sprin spro:de dbus sna bdun rahā'i gzhal med khang sgo gru rta bab mtshan nyid phun tshogs dbus: byang chub ljon shing me tog lo sdong bkra: domadun pad gdan zla ba nya gang khar: rig

pa twetsho'ig spro bsdus zhu ba las: rgyal ba kun dngos rje btsun hūṃ re ma yid bzhin grub pa'i rgyal mo tshe 'phel ma dkar gsal zhal gcig spyan gsum 'dzum mdzes sgegs:phyag gnyis spyan mtshan pad+ma'i sdong po 'dzin: 'dab ma snyan gyi thad gar gyes pa'i steng: gter gyi bum pa chos 'khor rtsib brgyad mtshan: gnyen lhugs 'khril ldem gzhon tshul dgu yi 'khrud: dar dang rat+na bcu gsum rgyan gyi spras zhabs gnyis skyil krung gzigs pa'i spyan gyis mtshan: 'od lnga 'khyil klong 'ja' lus sgyu ma'i sku: snang dang stong pa zung 'jug sa ler gsal: rigs gyi bdag po bcom ldan snang mtha' yas: tshe dang ye shes dpag med mkhyen brtse'i gter: phyag g.yas tshe mda' g.yon pa'i bum pa bsnams:bcu gsum rgyan rdzogs 'ja' lus sgyu mar shar: gzhan yang drang srong rig sngags grub pa dang: lha klu mi yi paṇa grub rig 'dzin tshogs: bsam mtha' yas pa'i bshad sgrub mngon brjod 'ur 'phags ma'i thugs sgog las spros 'od zer gyis: 'og min gnas dang ri bo gru 'dzin zhing: po ṭa la nas brgyud gsum bla ma dang: 'phags ma yid

shā bzhin 'khor lo gshegs su gsol: dam tshig gdan gsum tshangs pa'i dal du bzhugs mthong ba'i sgom pa sel mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal: srid na kun ba11 mchod sprin ci mchis mchod: chags thogs mi dmigs nam mkha' lta bu'i bzhes sku gsung thugs yon brin las rdzogs la bstod: rmong mun blo yis snang shes dri ma bshags: thams cad dag tshangs rig pa'i snying por blta: snang grags rig gsum la sngags chos skur khyer skye 'chi mi dmigs rig pa chos sku sgrubs rdo rje lta bu'i dgongs don mngon gyur dmigs: snyen ār+ya tā re tut+ta re tu re ma ma a yu pukhye tshe sbyo n+ni dza sidhi pha la hūṃ: ye sa med dgongs pa dbyi sa la bor gtad med rig pa 'i snyi po skyo sa 'dzan med 'od gsal nyi ma 'char rtogs pa ri rgyal lta bur 'char sa ma yā gsum pa mchod cing bstod pa ni gi gang shar rang grol chos sku'i rol mtsho nas 'gags med rig pa'i dga' ston 'phrul mo che: blo yi mi dpog tshad bzung las 'das pa: rgyal yum 'phags ma'i gsang gsum bskangs phyir 'bul: yin ma hā puts+tsha sa ma yā ho: tshu hrī blta b.limi ngoms mtshan dpe'i zhal bzang

can: thos pa'i rnam grol 'gags med brda chos ston: dran pa'i srid zhi'i 'jigs 'phrog mkhyen brtse'i skyongs rnam kun mchog ldan yid bzhin 'khor lor bstod 'di bzung rang snang zhing la byang chub par: lha mo khyod kyis tshe rabs rjes bzung zhing: sa lam nyams rtogs yon tan dbugs dbyung zhing: sgyu lus bde ba chen por smin grol nas:dwangs ma'i dpal mchog rdo rje'i sku thob shog: spyod lam ni lha snang mi dmigs chos sku'i dgongs nyams skyongs: gzugs sku'i spyod pa'i snang stong sgyu mar blta: dus gsum dge bsags 'khor gsum dag par bsngo: ye shes chos skur rtogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig: thog mtha' bar gsum dam pa'i chos ltar bcos: nyon mongs rdul skyon bral ba'i bkra shis 31ga: de ltar sbyor dngos rjes tshang ba' 'phags ma'i nyam len 'dir brtson na tshe chos 'phral rkyen rgud pa zhi nyams rtogs yon tan gong 'phel rgyas the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' skal ba can gya dpal du shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya ba thim snyi ces pa' slob bu mthar phyan gyis gos bzang dbang gi kha tog can gyas na bza' da bkra shas la reg bcas te bskul ro ra/ kho bo nus ldan pa sa chos nyid nam mkha' mdzod kyis bdo ras las bsgyur
— rdo ba'i yi ge pa ni rang slob spros bral rdo rje sa bris dge legs 'phel/sarba masgo la/

shā oṃ tā re ka dag stong chen rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan dbyings nyid las: kha ba'i ldongs sogs mi mjed zhing gi skyabs gcig tā re ma: ga dar mar gad zhal ba shā ngoms bzhin brtan g.yo'i phywa g.yang stsol: nga yi srung bya mi nor 'jigs pa kun las skyab du gsol: ca co tsam min snying nas khyed la phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs na: cha lugs 'chi med nam mkha'i bu mo'i zhal bzang legs ngoms shing: ja dar 'byor ba'i phud bzhes bdag gzhan bsod nams tshogs rdzo gas nas: nya ga zla zhal ga la ba der lam sna 'dren du gsol: ta ler zhal bzhes bdud dgra 'khor ba'i 'jigs las sgol ba mo: tha tshig gnad bskul dgongs pas nyer bzhes bdag gzhan yon mchod kun:da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying por 'chis kyi bar: na 'chi skye rga mi mthun phyogs zhi chos mthun bsam pa 'grub ha cing kun spyod rtsub mos thar ba'i sgog dbug mi 'phrog par: a ti 'bras bu'i chos kyis lhag zhabs 'khod cing don gnyis lcan tshob 31ga: zhesadadacing mos pas shā lo ka gsum da rka pa gnyas kyi smon tshig 'di sbyin bdag dug rgya'i pa da grags
dang blo grags gnyas kyis bskul ngor/nu ldan pa'i dgongs pa'i rol mtsho las bsgyur ba dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig sarba maṅga la/

'o/ dag snang las: bshags pa sgrib bral shel dkar me long bzhugs —— na mo ār+ya tā ra ya: dzha(13/ gnyen po stobs bzhi tsha sa ba yis ༅gas pa 'i rgyal po 'di brjod bya ma ye shes thugs ni mkha' ltar dag mod kyang: glo bur rlung dang sems rtog sgrib rkyon gyis: gnyis su snang zhing phung lnga'i dri ma kun: ka dag chos kyis sku la bzod par gsol: rang bzhin 'od gsal phyogs ris mi dmigs kyang: kha dog so sor blta ba'i gol sgrib kyis: phyi nang 'byung ba lnga yi dri ma kun: mnyam nyid bde ba chen por bshags bgyi'o: thugs rje dmigs gtad mtshan ma ye grol kya : blo yid rnams par rtog pa'i gol sgrib kyis: brtan g.yo rten 'brel snang ba bag chags bcas: sgrib bral rig pa ye shes rjen par bshags mtha' bral lta ba phyogs lhung bral ba la: rtogs ge'i blo yi 'jigs lta mthar 'dzin kun bcing grol las 'das 'od gsal rdzogs pa che: 'bras bu ye shes bla ma'i dgongs 1nga bshags: min pa med pa'i

sgom pa dmigs gtad grol: btang bzungs gnas nyams yid dpyod blo yi chos rdul skyon gang gi ma bcos de kho na rig pa phyogs las rnam rgyal rjen par bshags: a 'thas spyod payin min spros las grol mthar 'dzin phyogs rer gol ba'i nyi tshe ba ye nas bcing med grol med de bzhin nyid: chos nyid rang yan rjen par bshags bgyi'o:bshags bya bshags byedalas 'das chos kyi dbyings: kun bzang ye shes bla ma'i sa la ba'ag: a ā:de ltar bshags pa'i chags nyams dag salam nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang slob bu blos dar nas bskul ngor/ nus ldan pas spel ba dge zhuso/

7༷ dag snang las:tā re dmar mo'i rdzas bskang bsod nams gter sprin bzhugs:——1 na mo gu ru ya: zad1)rte rdosabazha spros la 'di skad gyer hrī:rig pa 'od gsal snang ba'i mar me 'di:rig dbyings rgyal yum 'phags mar gus pas 'bul:rig rtsal ma 'gags 'dod yon bā lirnyi:rig mchog pad+ma'i lcam la 'bul bar bgyi:rig pa'i rlabs kyi gzung 'dzin mtshan ma bsgral:rig grol pad+ma tā rer gus bcas 'bul:rig gdangs 'od gsal ye shes bdud rtsi 'khyil:rig pa rang byung rje btsun sgol mar 'bul:rig rtsal rol pa khams gsum 'khor chos grol rig pa'i ga sa lugs sku gsum mngon gyur regag:de ltar bskang ba'i tshogs chen rdzogs sgrib dag don gnyis lhun gyi grub sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu h+ya bdo thim snyi zhes pa 'da'ang snying slob blo bzang dar rgyas nas bskur ro ra/nus ldan rdo rjes spel ba dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga la/

shā a ho: ka ma las 'khrungs mtsho phyungs rgyal ba yi zhal skyen rig 'dzin gang gis thugs bskyed smon lam gyis zin pas: 'dir 'tshogs dga' 'o skyid do phun tsho/shā rtes gzhi bzungs sgyu lus bde ba mchog ldan ye shes kyi srog thob dbyings ye sras gsum dkyil 'khor 'bad med la lhun rdzogs: gsang ba dwangs ma lnga 'dus dhak+ki yi gter mdzod cha med kun 'gro khyab pa nam mkha' yi thig le rdo dze+ebazhen nu'i mchog gsang thob par la spro byung: zag lus rdo rjer smin pa gsang sngags kyi khyad chos:snang gsum skye 'chi bar do'i tha snyad kun grol nas: nang dbyings ye shes phur pa'i sa mchog la bsgrod de: du ma rang grol 'grub pa'i dgongs spyod zhig zhu 'o: zhes nus ldan pas thol byu du smras — 'o/
—11 dag snang ye shes rol pa las: zhus len gyi gab don: dze+ebatsun 'phags ma ta re'i phyi sgrub maṇ+ḍal dang 'brel ba dngos grub kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

7༷ na mo dzñā nāhwa re ye 241rdza/sngo /gra1 1 'jigasatshogasakun lasarab sgrol zhi tshe da bsod nams dpal spel ba'i rgyal ba kun yum rta re la gus pa'i yid kyi phyag 'tshal lo rje 131 7phags ma'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas gsang gsum gnyes pa 'i phyar maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i cho ga na daro sa grub kun 'byung zhes bya bstan sa ma yu de ya dkyal 'khor mda' gang ba gru bzhi nam mkha' 'doms ga dpag khod snyoms 'jam dang ldan pa la dri bzang ba byung rnam lnga dang bzang po drug gi chag chag gdab dbus su pa d+ma' 'od 'khor la rdo rje'i rwa ba'i rnam par mdzes phyi rim pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi lte bar nor bu mdzes pa sa brgyan de rgyab pad zlum nyer gcig dang rdo rje'i 'od dang pad+ma' phreng phya nang mchod pa dag gis mdzes dbus su ldeng khrir sku gzugs dang phyogs bzhi mdzes pa'i maṇ+ḍal te rnam lnga bzhi skor mchod yon brgya sna gsal brgya dang bdug spos brgya zhal zas brgya sogs phyi na gi mchod pa bsam ma khyab pas bskor khrus da gtsang sbra sngon du gtong de nas rnal 'byor bzhi sde yang bde ba'i stan la bag pheb nas sems bskyed dmigs 'dun dag pa yis 'di nyad rtag tu brjod par bya sa ma yā de ya sbyor dngos rjes gsum las dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed na na mo phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs sras dang bcas rje btsun 'phags ma'i

shāX dkyil 'khor la byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi:dmus longs mar gyur 'gro ba rnams:rdzogs sangs rgyas phyir sems bskyed do:lan gsum de nas mchod rdzas bye zlos ni oṃ āḥsnodangos por 'dzin pa'i chos rnams kun:dmigs med stong pa'i rang bzhin las:phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i sprin:kun bzang nam mkha'i khams gang gyur:skyes āḥ/san ma sarba sogasag ga na khaṃ swā hā:lan bdun dang na mchod sprin gzungs ci rig par na brjod par bya gnyis pa bskyed chog rim pa ni tshod sā bha sogasarnya tī:chos kun mi dmigs gzhi rtsa bral:rang rig byang chub sems kyi mdangs:rta yig ljang gu'i 'phro 'du las:zhing khams rnam par dag pa ni:sa gzhi thams cad rin po che:yangs shing 'jam la khod snyoms brdal:dri bzang sman gyi ngad pa mthul:me tog sna tshogs sil ma bkram:bya rigs ri dwags rtse 'jo sgeg:yan lag brgyad ldan chu mtsho rgyas:rin chen gser gyi phye ma brdal:g.yu yi ne seng rab tu bzhad:'ja' 'od zer gyis mu khyad mdzes:'dod yon bdud rtsi'i sbang char 'bebs:lha ma'i bkod pa phun sum tshogs:de

dbus chu skyes bzhad pa'i khar thabs shes nyi ma zla ba'i ste :te:yig gnas su gyur pa las:rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma ljang:zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum mdzes bzhad:rin chen dbu rgyan snyan cha dang :mgul rgyan 'phre ba se mo do:phyag zhabs gdu bu do shal 'phyang:dar gyi stod g.yog smad shams dang:zi ldir cod paṇa phu dung sogs:longs sku'i rgyan chas bcu gsum spras zhabs gnyis phyed skyil dag gis bzhugs 'ja' 'od zer gsum phyogs bcur 'phro:phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mdzad:g.yon pa'i pad+ma thugs gar bkan 'dabs ma snyan thad gyes pa'i steng:'dod 'byung gter bum nor bu'i mtshan:rigs bdag sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas:phyi rim sgrol ma rigs bzhi dang de rgyab 'phags ma nyi shu gcig bar mtshams sangs rgyas byang chub sems sras bcas ma lus lam mer gsal:gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas:spyan drangs rigs lnga'i rnam pa yis:dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag cha hūṃ swā e hā:rlu:loḥsum̐ḥdzhaiḥtai:kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa sa:a

53 bhi ṣiñtsa s+t+waṃ: de nas spyan 'dren bya ba ni ma: rang snang rnam dag g.yu lo can: bde chen 'od 'bar 'og min nas: rgyal yum rje btsun sgrol ma dang: ār+ya tā re nyer shes rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshes su gsol khro ār+ya tā re dzñā na sarba sa ma ya dza dza: de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni hrī: ma chags dre bral pad+ma'i gdan: 'gyur med yangs pa'i gdan khri la 'phags ma nyer gcig 'khor dang bcas: dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs: tho ār+ya tā re dzñā na sa 5/ ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni sa rin chen maṇ+ḍal gser g.yus rgyan: stong gsum rab 'byams bkod pa sprin: lha klu mi yi rgyan rnams rdzogs: bla ma sprul pa'i sku la 'bul: rang lus maṇ+ḍal dbang po'i brgyan phung khams skye mched bkrag mdangs ldan: rtsa khams mchod pa'i lha mo 'phro: bla ma long sa spyod rdzogs la 'bul: sems nyid maṇ+ḍal rig pa'i brgyan: bya chub sems kyis 'od zer 'phro: 'gags med ye shes rgyan rnams rdzogs: bla ma chos kyi sku la 'bul: tshogs rdzogs sgrib gnyis dag pa dang: don 'grub sku gnyis mngon gyur shog: tre:rat+na

maṇ+ḍal pu tsi ti / de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni hūṃ hrī: ting nge 'jin las sprul pa yis me tog bdug sbos mar me dri: zhal zas sil snyan yid 'ong sgra: lha rdzas las grub gzugs sgra dri ro dang reg bya chos dbyings e: dug gsum rnam dag sman gtor raka: sbyor sgrol byang chub sems kyi sprin yid 'od rdo rje'i rig ma lnga: pad phreng glu gar dbyangs dang bcas: khams gsum gang ba'i mchod sprin gyis: 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyes gyur cig: dgyes nas bdag la dngos grub stsol: tho ma hā sarba pa4 5/ tsa ho: de nas tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni oṃ ātwa bde stong bhan+ta yangs pa phu gtam pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs: 'dod yon lha mo'i gar bsgyur bcas dngos 'dzin rnam par dag pa yis:'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskangs: bdag la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: ma ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu tsa la khā hi: de nas yan lan bdun pa na hrī: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol

shāX dge'i las nyon bshags:dus gsum dge la rjes yi rang:'gro la gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor:rgyal rnams mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs:dge tshogs ma rte rdo gro la bsngo:phyam gcig kun bza sa thob shog lan gsum de nas phyag 'tshal rim pa ni na mo:yisangs rgyas pa chos sku las thugs rje ye shes 'gro ba'i dpal:ma bcos rang rig 'dus ma byas:'phags ma yum la phyag tshal lo be+eḍūr lhun po lta bu'i mdangs:byams brtses 'gro ba skyob pa dang:btang snyoms grub la nye ring bral 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:spyan ni skad cig glog 'dra zhing:'jigs tshogs ma lus gzhom par byed 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal skyobs par mdzad:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:srid pa gsum gyi mgon gcig ma:lha mi'i thor gtsug cod paṇa gtugasnyengan song gsum gyis 'dam las skyobs:'phags ma yum ut+pa la yi dri bsung 'thul:ge sar bye ba'i sngabs las byung:chags pa'i rkyon gyis ma gos pa'i:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:zhe sdang seng ge'i dpa' skongs shing:nga rgyal glang po'i rgol

ba 'joms:'bar ba'i me yi tsha zer 'dul:'phags ma yum la phrag tog sbrul dug rab gsod cing:'jab 'phrog rkun jag ring bar byed sdom byed lcags sgrogs zhi mdzad pa'i:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:tsha grang dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa skyobs:bkres skom yi dwags gdung ba zhi:rmongs pa dung 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:rgya mtsho che las skyobs pa'i gru:sha za srin po'i gdug rtsubs gzhom dus kyi rgud pa sel mjad dpal:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:kla 1'i 'tshubs ma bzlog pa dang:nad yams rdzas sbyor ngan pa dang mi 'tshams nyes pa'i la yog gzhom:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:btsa' sad ser gsum 'bu srin dang:phyugs la god kha gtong ba sogs:phral gyi mu ge zhi mdzad dpal:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar sde:bar gdon lha srin sde brgyad dang:'og gdon sa bdag klu nad bzlog:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:dmag 'khrug mtshon chas g.yul ngo dang:phu nu nang 'khrugs nye ba 'thab:thams cad khyod

/rdo zhal dran pas bzlog 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo nam mkha'i dug sprin dmar nag dang:bar snang mtshon cha sa rdo'i char:sa gzhi'i nad yam zhi (11 pa'i 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:gang sku lha lam yangs pa nas:thugs rje'i gru char rab 'beb cing:'gro blo'i ge sar rab rgyas pa'i:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:ga gsung dri za'i rgyud mang las:nyer byung 'dzam gling chos sgras khyab:bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde'i gzhi:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:gang thugs dri bral 'od stong gis:'gro ba nyon mongs 'dam las skyobs:rdzogs ldan lang tsho gsal ba'i mdzes:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las ma:'pha gas mchog thugs rje'i sbyan las sprul:rta yig ljang guli'aphro 'du can 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:ye grol chos sku kun bzang mo:lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs sku yum:ma 'gags ye shes zung 'jug 'phrul 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:rnam 'phrul ma 'gags nyi shu gcig:yang sprul bye ba sa ya 'bum:gang thugs mkhyen

brtse'i zer las 'phos 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo: rje btsun thugs rje'i mnga' bdag la: zhing rdul kun gyis grangs snyed kyis lus btud gus pa'i gsol gdab bcas mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni ma :po ṭa la yi gnas mchog nas to yig ljang gu'i 'phro 'du yis 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig 'phags ma shar:rgyal ba kun yum nyid la 'dud: mtshungs med blta ba'i chog mi shes: be+eḍūr lhun po lta bu'i sku ma chags tshul gyisa.āt+pal bsnams: 'phags ma yum la gus pa'i 'dud:'gro la skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mdzad thugs rje'i gru la nye ring bral phongs rgud 'gro ba'i dbul ba sel: yid bzhin nor bu ma la 'dud mtshan thos ngan 'gro'i g.yang las skyobs: gsol btabs 'jigs brgyad skad cig zhi dran pa'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag sel: myur ma dpa' mo mchog la 'dud: mdzes pa longs sku'i cha lugs canaḥ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od stong 'bar: dad ldan 'dul bya smin mdzad pa'i: bka' drin mnyams med nyid la 'dud: rgyal ba'i span sngar mchod sgrin stobs: ngan song sgo brgya gcod

shā zi par byed dmus long 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig pu: snyigs ma'i skyabs mgon mchog la 'dud: tshad med rnams bzhi'i rang gdangs las: rje btsun sgrol ma da 1 dmar dang nyer gcig lha mo'i spro bsdu 'gyed: rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab la 'dud: skyabs med 'gro ba yongs kyis mgon: dbang med sdug bsngal 'dam las sgrol:tshad med lcags kyu'i 'gro rnams 'dren: 'phags ma lha mo nyid la 'dud: lus ni gus 'dud phyag rgya dang: ngag gis gdung dbyangs glu dang bcas: sems ni dad brgya'i 'od zer gyis: sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la bstod: de nas bka' las byung ba yis phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig dang 'di nyid ya yang brjod par bya bas 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs tā re ma: 'dod rgu'i mchod stsol tut+ta re: nad yam kun bzlog tu re yum: swā hā sgrib gnyis dri 'joms dpal: 'phags ma lha mo khyed mkhyen no: ngan 'gro'i 'phrang las skyab tu gsol: nyer gcig la sogs ci 'thub brjod de nas dad pa 'i gsol gdab ni thal mo sbyar la 'di skad do kyi: rgyal ba kun yum rje bcun ma: bdag la mkhyen brtse nus pas dgongs: 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab

rtogs pa'i khrod mun gling srid pa'i gtson khang 'di: dbang med spyod pa'i zug rngu can: mgo rmong log pa'i lam la gol: na ba'i gzer la tsha ba'i bcom: bkres skom gdung ba drag pos mnar: sngar ma grags pa'i nad gdon rgod: mi 'dod sdig pa'i las la g.yeng: dus ngan snyigs ma'i mar gsham 'dir: bsam pa chos la mos na yang: mi dge bdud kyi bar chad che: 'di las skyobs shig thugs rje can: 'jigs tshogs kun bzlog 'phags ma yum thugs rje skyobs mdzod bka' drin can: byin gyis rlobs shig nus mthu can: sgrib kun sbyongs shing thugs rje gter: bdag gzhan re sa gzhan na med: skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang: 'gro ba'i mgon po khyed mkhyen no: 'khor ba srid pa'i btson khang las: da lta nyid du bde chen zhing: g.yu ma can gyi pho brang dbus: rje btsun 'phags ma'i zhabs drung du: 'bum phrag tshom bu dang bcas par: skye nas phyir mi ldog par 31ga lan gsum de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni rje btsun ma'i thugs gar pad+ma'i dal dbus su te las rtsa ba'i sngags kyis g.yon du 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros: sems can

shā thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs: 'gro ba rigs drug gi las nyon dag: snod bcud ma dag 'khor ba'i snang ba thams cad dbyings su shes dngos 'dzin gyi dri ma bsregs: stong gsal 'od kyi zhing khams su gyur: skye 'gro sems can thams cad dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i rol par sad: thugs rje chen po' skyabs 'og tu bdag dang sems can thams cad tshud par bsam la oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā: brgya rtsa la sogs ca 'grub brjod de nas snyang po bsgrangs ba ni oṃ tā re tā re zhes pa stong rtsa bsgrangs gnad des 'grub pa'i rtags mtshan 'byung tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag daro sa grub thob bden rdzun lag tu longs da gsal phyi nang gegs sel 'dod rgu 'grub the tshom med do sa ma yu gsum pa gtor skyems 'bul ba ni dkar gtor 'o phud bshams nas su: tho ā hūṃ: rin chen snod du gtor ma ni 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod du dmigs: tshe a ka sogs hā: trīḥ rje btsun 'phags ma nyer gcig la: gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'bul: gnyes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: tshe gcig sangs rgyas sa na drengs cha ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wa ra rat+na e de bā ling kha kha

khā hi kha hi: lan bdun brjod la phul bar bya de nas bstan srung dam can la gtor ma 'bul ba'i rim pa ni byin rlabs la sogs grub nas su skye/ badz+ra dharmā pā la k+ṣe ṭa pā la 21 ka pā la badz+ra sa ma ya dza:gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams: bka' srung dam can rnams la 'bul dgyes bskang brin las rab 'byams bsgrub sangs rgyasabastan pa bsrung du gsol: skyed badz+ra dharmā pā la k+ṣe ṭa pā la 81 ka pā la sarba sa ma ya e dam bā lirnya kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan bdun gyis ni phul bar bya de nas bgegs la gtor ma bshams sam+bha ra yis byin gyis rlobs oṃ sarba bisne badz+ra aṅku sha ya dza dza: 'dod yon lnga ldan phung po la: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma ni: bgegs rigs lan chags mgron la 'bul: ngoms tshim byang chub sems ldan gyur: 31 sarba bisne e de bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis ni yul bar bya de nas rigs drug mgron rnams la gtor ma byin brlabs sngags phyag drug skyed aḥzloḥs :tri pre ༷duḥbadz+ra sa ma yā dza dza: gtor ma 'dod yon lnga ldan 'di: rigs drug snying rje'i mgron la 'bul: ngoms tshim las snang sdug bsngal bral bde ba mchog dang ldan par

shā bsam: cha āḥzloḥsaḥtri0pre ཿduḥdzaḥ.e rda rat+na bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis ni 'bul bar bya de nas 'dod don gsol ba mi ho rgya yum rje btsun sgrol ma:'drodas ma nyi shu rtsa gcig: mkha' 'gro bye ba sa ya 'bum sde dang bcas pa rnams la zag med ye shes kyis bdud rtsi 'dod pa'i yon tan tshang ba mi zad gtor ma'i mchod pa rgya chen po 'bul lo: thugs dam bskang nas bdag la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub rgya chen po stsol ba dang: gnas skabs nad gdon 'jig tshogs zhi zhing tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs yon tan thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo'i bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel zhi rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: ho: ye shes pa'i chos skyong dpal mgon bdun bcu dregs chen bco brgyad: sde dpon sum bcu sogs bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'dod yon gtor ma'i mchod pa rgya chen po 'bul lo sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba dang sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig: lha bgegs reg ste nga phrag brgyad cu sogs dug gsum las kyis

bskyed pa'i gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams la mchod sbyin gyis gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa ru dmigs nas 'bul lo:thams cad ngoms shing tshims nas gnod gdug gi bsam pa bral:phan pa byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang ldan pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ho'agre ba regs drug gi sems can:las nyon sdug bsngal gyis gnar ba'i pha ma rnams la zag med 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod du sprul pa'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'bul lo:rang rang so so'i las snang sdug bsngal bag chags rgyu 'bras thams cad dang bral nas bde chen chos kyi dbyings la mnga' dbang bsgyur:khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po byed cing gzhon nu bum skur grol ba' phrin las mdzod cig:de nas bshags pa bya ba ni he rje btsun 'phags ma'i lha tshogs dgongs bdag ni ma rig dbang gyur te rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig la nyams chags 'gal 'khrul gyur ba dang:'phags ma'i sbyan sngar 'byor tshogs chung:ti 'dzin ma gsal rmugs 'thibs byang:dag par ma bltas bden par bzungs:tha mal rang gar 'khrul ba

sgo skya rnams: gnong zhing 'gyod sems drag po'i bshags: dag tshangs sor chud dngos grub stsol oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya bhi shud+dhi ā yig brgya lan gsum bzlas pa ya lhag ga (1 )(la byang zhi dag sa ma yā de nas bsngo ba smon lam ni ho 'das dang ma 'ongs da lta phu bsags dang bsags gyur bsags pa yis: zag dang zag med dge ba rnams: bsdus te ma gyur 'gro la bsngo phyam gcig kun bzang sa thob shog lan gsum de nas bsdu rim bya ba ni ste 'phags ma gco 'dzadar gzhal yas rnams 'od zhu bdag dang 'gro ba la:thim pas 'phags ma'i dgongs par 'dres ye rdzogs ga ga ma'i rang ngor sad: dag mnyam sgyu ma'i spyod lam bya: a a ā: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ de nas bkra shis bya ba ni na mo chen grol dbang byin 'byung ba'i gnas: rtsa rgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog: mchog thun dngos grub gter mdzod che yi dam lha yi bkra shis shog: bar chad sel zhing bde stong bskyed:gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis shog: 'jigs brgyad zhi zhing tshe bsod 'phel: 'phags ma twa re'i bkra shis shog: phrin las rnam bzhi lcan grub pa'i: dam can rgya

mtsho'i bkra shis shog: skye 'gro bde legs 'byung ba'i gzhi: zab gsang chos kyi bkra shis re ga: nyin yang bde legs mtshan bde legs: rtags par dge ba'i bkra shis regag ces brjod bsngo ba smon lam sogs gzhan las byung ltar mtha' rgyas bya gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sel tshe dang bsod nam zla ltar 'phel bar chad bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal 'jags pa brgyad lasaskyobs par byed the tshom med do sa ma pā bdag 'dra pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis snyang bcud dam pa dmar byung ba rin chen srog las phang na ya nga sprul dang dbyer med pa nus ldan rdo rje da 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel snyigs ma'i rgud pa 'ga' re gso las can 'bum phrag grol bar byed chos bdag dpa' bo bdun dang ni dpa' mo gsum yang 'byung bar 'gyur snod ldan de dag rnams la spel gzhan du ma yin a tham rgya bka' gsang bsrungs shig tshe ring ma sgod ngan nang du ma ral cag snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu h+ya snyi cesapa 'di yang bskal ba shing khyi'i lo' zla tshes25 bzang por 'phagasama'i zhing khams kyis mthong snang las 'phags ma nyid dang zhus len gyis gab don zur du bkod pa grangs bcu'i bar du gsang rgya bsdam nas mthar rten 'brel

47 ༷ dus la bab tshe chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtshos ya ya bskur ba dang /chos la dbang ba'i ḍani rat+na sa ras bskul ba dang / slob bu chos gsal ye shes sogs kyi ya yang bskur ngor bdag 'dra daX pa nus lda na rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba' brda ris las zhal bshus te dag pa ra phab pa dge legs 'phel/sabo maṅga le/

shāX'i rje btsun 'phags ma'igasol 'deb mthong thos don ldan bzhugs so dad da mos gus gdong shug drag po yis 'phags ma yid la bsgom te 'di skad do e ma ho bla med bla ma byin rlabs 'bye dri'i gnas: dngos grub kun 'byung yi dam rgya mtsho yis: 'byung gnas dam pa rje btsun sgrol ma la: gus pas gsol 'deb phyi nang bar chad sol: nyams rtog yon tan rgyas par byin gyis rlobs ma chags pad+ma ra ga'i mdang 'dzin zhing: ma lus 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas gcig gyur pa: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo tā re la: gus pas gsol 'debs 'jigs brgyad dbyings su sol: nyams rtogs gong 'phel yar ngos zla ltar bskyed: thugs rje lcags kyus 'gro ba thabs kyis 'dren: 'dod 'byung nor bu'i dgos 'dod char ltar 'bebs: dar dang rat+na'i rgyan rdzogs 'phags ma la gus pa'i gsol 'deb 'phral rkyen dbyings su sol: don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyi rlobs:sems ma'i stabs bzhugs byang chub sems rgyas 'debs: ye shes lnga ldan 'od brgya'i 'gro ba 'dul: dbying rig zung 'jug 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor laḥ gus pas

gsol 'deb mi mthun nyes tshogs bzlog: tshe bsod nyams rtogs rgyas par mdzad du gsol: gang sku bkrag mdangs 'od brgya'i 'byud pa'i zhal: bdag blo'i pad mo'i ze'u 'bru mngon sum ston gang gsung snyan 'gyur rta bu ra yi sgra zag med chos char sgra 'dzin lam du stsol: gang thugs mkhyen brtse'i 'od stong 'bar ba yi: bdag blo'i pabye'i 'dabs brgya rgyas par mdzod: ji lta ji snyed ye shes klong nas rdol: 'phags ma'i yon tan mchog la mnga' brtes shog rlabs chen phrin las gang la gang 'dul gyis: 'gro khams dong sprug sangs rgyas sa thob 31ga: de ltar smon pa' re 'bras 'grubs phya nang gsang ba'i bar chad sel nyams rtog yon tan gong 'phel rgyas ze tshom med do sa ma yā rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs bcud 'di nusaldan rdo rje khyod la gtad bstan dang 'gro ba'i gsos sman du drag bshad rol ba'i rdo rje yis slob bu pad+ma smon semasal gces pa'i nor bu rnam par sbyin rgyal mtshan rtser bsten mchod bstod rem dgos dgu shugs la 'byung bar 'gyur mthun rkyen phun tshogs 'byor ba'i tshe bsgrub rgyud bstan pa 'dzin thabs la ma 'chug rem rem snying gi bu sarba mang ga le/

shārwa da ngo skyabs 'gro sems bskyed na mdun kyinams khar rje btsun ma mngon gsum du bsas par mos la/ mapha na mo ma chags bgechen ye shes sku: 'phags ma yum la skyabs su (byedam rtog dmus longs 'gro ba rnams rig dbyings 'god phyir sems bskyed do: lan gsum gnyis pa yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba na na re rgyal yum 'phags ma sgrol ma la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: rnam dag kun bzang mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum ma rig dri ma bshags gzhan gyi dge la rjes yi rang : gang la gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor: rgyal rnams mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs: dge tshogs gcig bsdus 'gro la bsngo: phyam gcig 'phags ma'i zhal mthong shog lan gsum gsum pa maṇ+ḍal gzhung ltar 'bul 'di yang nyer mkho' cha lags su slob bu smon sems gyis bskul ro ra nus ldan rdo rje' pha ba pa 'o sarba masgo la

shāX'i dag snang ye shes rol pa las rje btsun tā re dmar mo'i maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa dra med shel bum 'azhugs so na mo gu ru we don dam mi shig rdo rje dbyang rnam kun mchog ldan ye shes sku rgyal dro /je yum mkha' 'gro mar rnam kun dad rgya'i phyag 'tshal lo skul ba ldan pa 'i skyes bu yi rgyun khyer 'phags ma'i rnal 'byor la dad dam mos gus tshad med pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul la 'di skad do shes āḥshā: rang mdun ma chags pad+ma 'dab rgyas khar: rgyal ba kun yum rje btsun thugs rje'i bdag myur dpal lha mo pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs: bcu drug mdangs ldan rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: lcags kyu gter bum dbang gi 'od zer 'bar: 'phags ma nyer bzhi'i 'du 'phro skar ltar 'khrigs bskal bzang sangs rgyas byang sems rgya mtsho bzhugs: gnas gsum 'od kyis rgyal ba sras dang bcas: spyan drangs dam ye ro gcig gnyis med gyur bdag dang ma gyur nam mkha'i gar khyab kyis: 'gro ba yong kyis 'dun ma gcig dril ngang: sgo gsum gas pa chen po'i thug 'tshal lo: snang srid 'dod yon kun bzang mchod pa 'bul: phyi nang gsang ba'i dag mnyam mchal 'bul: gzung 'dzin las nyon 'khrul ba mthol lo

bshags skyes bu gsum gyis dge la rjes yi rang: gang la gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor du gsol: rgyal rnams mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: zag dang zag med dus gsum bsags pa'i dge bsdus te ma gyur 'gro ba yong la bsngo: phyam gcig g.yu lo can du phyin par 31ga: de nas gsol gdab bya ba'i rim pa ni rkye: rje btsun thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'gro ba'i mgon 'phags ma myur dpal lha mor gsol ba 'debs: 'di phyi'i 'phral rkyen ngan pa zhi ba dang don gnyis lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol: lan gsum brjod oṃ rje btsun thugs rje'i dbang phyug ni ma chags pad+ma ra ga'i mdangasaḥ thugs rje rtse ba'i 'gro ba 'dzin: btang snyoms gru la nye rang bral bka' drin 'gran bral tā re la: sgo gsum gus pa'i phyag 'tshal lo skye dang tshe rab thams cad du 'phags ma'i thugs rje'i bzung du gsol gnyis gsum bdun sogs mngon par brjod de nas bzlas pa'i 'khrul 'khor ni hrī: rje btsun myur ma lha mo yi: thugs gar hūṃ la sngags gyis bskor: bzlas pa'i snang srid 'khor 'das kyi: dpal yon dngas bcud kun bsdus

shā te: bdag thim dngos grub kun thob dmigs: cha ār+ya tā re ma hā sarba sirnyi sa: de nas bsdu sdang ni 〉 snang cha thabs kyi dkyil 'khor lha: shes rab stong pa'i /byed sa su ā lha dang rang sems dbyer med kyi: kun bzang dgongs pa mngon du bya: a āX phaṭa phaṭa: de nas bkra shis na na lnga sku dag nam mkha' yangs pa nas: zag bral bdud rtsi'i sbrar char 'bebs dad ldan gdul bya'i myu gu 'khrungs: bde skyid spyod pa'i bkra shis shog: de ltar lngan pa'i tshogs gnyas rdzogs sgrib dag dbang dang dngos grub thob phyi nang rkyen las rnam par rgyal bde rdzun lag tu lo dang gsal sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa 'di yang chos kyi bdag po 'gyur med rgya mtsho'i rinapo che bye ru'i 'phreng ba bkra shis lha reg dang bcas te ya ya bskul ro ra bdag 'dra nus lngan rdo rje'i dag par pha ba pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga le// skabs su kha bskang mchod bstod na o dmigs med ka dag chos ma'i kong: lngan grab gzhi snang mchod pa'i smin: 'dod yon lnga mo'i gar baspar bcas: rje btsun 'phags

ma'i lha la 'bul: tshe ma hā pañtsa pu dza twa: two hrī: ma chags rā ga'i mdangs 'dzin cing: 'gags med gsung gi chos sgo 'byed: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'gro ba 'dul: 'phags ma'i sku gsung thugs la bstod: ces kya smon sems kyi bskul ro ranusaldan rdo rje'i phab pa'o/ sarba maṅga le/༈ mtha' bsten smon lam gdab pa ni na mo: mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden pa dang: bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i nus stobs kyis: rgyal bstan nub med dar zhing rgyas pa dang: 'dzam gling tha gru chos kyi mdzes gyur cig: bstan 'dzin ngur smugs gos dkar sde kun kyang: thugs mthun khrim gtsang dam tshig dag pa yis: bshad dang sgrub pa'i bya ba mthar phyin cing: 'gro rnam bde skyid dpal la 'god par re ga: dus min 'chi dang rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan: nad mug mtshon 'khrugs bkra mi shis pa'i rkyen:'jigs pa brgyad sogs nye bar 'tshe ba kun: myur du zhi zhing mi gnas stong par re ga: 'jig rten khams su char chu dus 'bebs shing: lo phyug rtag legs phan bde'i lang tsho

'o/ rgyas: rdzogs ldan gsal ba'i dga' ston dpal 'byor la: sdang zhen bral bar skye rgu'i spyod gyur cig bdag ni mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba yi: rgyud la stong snyeb snyeng rje'i rgyas theb nas: phyam gcig bde chen g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing: mi 'bral 'phags ma'i zhal drung skye bar shogs: ces kya slob busgron sems kyi 'phagasama'i rnal 'gror maṇ+ḍal dang 'brel ba rgyun 'don zhal gyis bzhes pa 'i kha skongs su nus ldan rdo rje'i dag snang las gtan la pha ba pa 'i yi ge pa ni slob bu nyid kyis bgyis pa'o sarba masgo le// dag sna las rje btsun sgrol ma'i maṇ+ḍal dang 'brel ba' tshogs bsdus bsod nam mtha' yas bzhugs so na mo ar+ya tā re ye las ldan bskal ba bza po yi bsod nam tshogs bsags spel 'dod na 'aza' bca' bayi ba'i rig rnams spu gsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas slar hūṃ trī rin chen snod du hūṃ yig las: byung ba'i tshogs rdzas 'dod dgu'i gter: rmad byung kun tu bzang po'i sprin: ye shes rol ba la dmigs te: rje btsun 'phags ma'i lha la 'bul: sor byang sngags sdom nyams pa bshags: gzungs 'dzin rtogs pa'i ru ṭa bsgral: mi 'gyur gsang ba'i

klong du bstabs:rtog pa mngon gyur dngos grub stsol:so rtogs rtsal sgo 'byed pa dang sku dang ye shes gnyug ma'i zhal:ji bzhin mngon du gyur bar mdzod:ces brjod tshogs rdzogs bsgrib pa dag don gnyis lhun gyas grub par 'gyur sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya mi mkho dgu ma ོ bra bzang la mi dran dgu dranakun nyas phul yig ge res byed smon semasaso sarba masgo lo/

maca zab tig rdo rje'i phreng ba 'chi med dpal bum bzhugs so:rtag na mo gu ru we: sgozaX) tshe bdag pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo rnal 'byor las dang skal ba 'dzom pa 'i dam chos bya chub sgrub pa la tshe ri ba gal che bas zab tig rdo rje phre ba 'di la brtson par bya'o zabararnas 'di la spri don gsum las dang po lto sto rlung rag gi ngar ma shor ba'i dus su las kyi rlung dug ngan pa thams cad dbyung bar bya ye shes rang sar gnas pa 'i rlu sbyor la yang yang 'bad de nas dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i ngo bo o rgyan tshe dpag med mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal btab la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sgom pa ni byas āḥshā: dus 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob par skyabs kun 'dus zhal bla ma tshe dparga med: srog gi gtar 'dzin snying nas skyabs su mchi: ma rig log 'khrul 'khor bar 'khyams pa rnams: sku gsum rgyal sar bsgrod phyir sems bskyed do: lan gsum tshogs bsags pa 'i thabs ni oṃ āḥhūṃ: 'das dang ma byon da ltar bzhugs pa yi: rgyal kun spri gzigs tshe bdag pad+ma 'byung: bka' drin mtshungs med rje la

phyag 'tshal lo: gang shar spang blang bral ba'i rgyan mchod 'bul gnyis snang dri ma'i dbang gyur sgrib tshogs bshags: zag dang zag med dge la rjes yi rang: gang 'dul phan bde'i chos 'khor bskor du gsol rgyal ba sras bcas mya ngan 'da' med bzhugs: dge tshogs 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por bsngo: mi g.yo kun tu bzang por byang chub shog: gnyis pa daro sa gzhi lha yi dkyil labar bzhengs pa ni hrī chos dbyings rdo rje bcun mo'i mkha' klong du: thabs mchog rig pa'i rgyal po yong sa su 'khyil zung 'jug ye shes rgyu ru rnam par shar: spro bsdu'i zer gyis dag chen bkod pa ni: yum chen lnga'i slong lhun grub gzhal med khang: sgo gru rta babs rgyan bkod phun tshogs dbus chags bral pad sdong thabs shes nyi zla'i steng: bdag snang yo rgyan gu ru tshe dpag med: sku mdog dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs: zhal 'dzum spyan da sa dgyes brtse'i 'od zer 'bar: dbu sgra thor cog rat+nas rnam par brgyan dar gyi cod pan pad+ma'i gdengs ka spungs: gcer bu rus rgyan pad phre 'ja' sham mdzes: bcu drug mad sa ldan zhabs gnyis skyil krung

rtagaza bzhugs: phyag g.yas rig pa mi 'gyur rdo rje brten: g.yon pas snang stong bhan thod lte bar 'dzin: gsang ba'i yum chen man+ta ra ba 'khril thabs shes zung 'jug bde chen gzi 'od 'byugs: srid gsum zin gnon he ru ka dpal gyi: thugs gar gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram dbus: thabs shes zung 'jug nyi zla kha sbyor sbubs: rigs nga 'i ngo bo nyiyig 'od mdangs 'bar: g.yas su udakar g.yon ngos rdziljang sngon: gsal 'tsher bkrag mdangs bco lnga'i zla bzhin 'bar: srog sngags gser gyi thag pa lta bu yis: g.yas bskor las ni 'od 'phros 'khor 'das kyi: dwangs bcud ma lus sib sib rug rug bstims: 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe la mnga' brtes shing: rlabs chen mdzad pas 'khor ba dong sprug dmigs: yin badz+ra gu ru ā yudzñā na sarba sidhi /: gsang sngags kyi rgyal po 'di gra zur ma nyams par nyi sa nge 'dzan dang bcas nas rgyun du bzlas na lus kyi 'byung ba mi 'brugs sha rgyas bkrag mdangs 'bar la gzhon chul chags nyams rtogs yon tan nyi zla bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas nges par tshe yi rig 'dzan 'grub pa tshe bdag pad+ma bdag gi tha tshig go sa ma yā gsum pa ga chad kha bskang yi ge brgya ba

da dbyangs gsal rten snying bcas bzlas nas mchod bstod ni hūṃ hrī: 'chi med rdo rje tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: spyan 'dren 'dzab bsnyen grangs them mchod pa 'bul: sku gsum mnyam rdzogs rdo rje'i klong la bstod: ting 'dzin bying rmugs 'thibs skyon dri kun bshags: mchog thun mi 'gyur tshe yi dngos grub stsol: sa ma hā pu dza a dṛ ta khā hi: de ltar mtha' rten shas brjod bsngo smon sogasagrub 'phral 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por ma bcos mnyam pa ra bzhag na rtogs pa' yon tan thams cad dpag bsam ljon pa'i 'bras bu bzhin mi 'gag gong 'phel du 'byung ngo zhes rdo rje tshe ya sgrub pa 'di bsam yas ar+ya pa lo' logs gcag nas bdag mtsho rgyal la gces nor du gnang ba'o skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad pa ra shog sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi ces pa 'di'ang lung zinapad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtshos bskul ba dang / dad ldan 'os las bskul ngor nubangaldan rdo rje bras pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

steg zab tig rdo rje'i phreng ba/ 'chi med dpal bum gyi kha bskang zab mo bzhugs so:rtagaza na mo gu na we sgoza'og tsho bdag pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ sgo gsum gus pa'i phyag 'tshal lo tshe sgrub rgyun khyer rnal 'byor bas tshe 'gugs 'don na 'di ltar bya hūṃ trī: rang snang mi shig bde chen pad+ma 'od lnga ldan zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang nas 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig o rgyan tshe dpag med: rā ga'i gzi 'bar bcu drug lang tsho'i 'byud rang 'dra'i pho nya nam mkha'i glog ltar 'khyugs: phrin las tshe bcud 'gugs pa'i brtul zhugs kyis: dri za'i yul sogs phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nas: brtan g.yo'i dpal yon dngas bcud thams cad kun: 'bru gsum yi ge'i rnam par rab bsdus te: bstan 'gro'i skyabs mgon rtsa rgyud bla ma dang: sgrub mchog bdag gi tshe yi gsos su bskyil: phyi 'byung dpal yon nang gi stobs su shar: 'du ba khod snyoms rnam bzhi'i nad las grol: lhan skyes bla yis tshe srog mthun snang spror: dgongs brgyud chos skya'i rtogs pa gdeng thob

par: 'pho 'jug chad gas phre ba kun las skyobs: mkha' mnyam rdo rje'e tsho la mnga' brnyes sheng: g.yin phan phren las 'byer ba rgyas gyur tsag: tshe gzungs brjod par bya'o de nas sba bstims bya ba ni hrī: sgyu ma'i rten la phongs rgud mi 'byung phyir: mi shig rig stong zhal sbyor nyi zla'i sbubs: bla srog bsod nams rten 'dus yig 'bru gsum: 'khor 'das phywa bstim 'gyur med tshe rgyas gdab: ( tra tra shag: mu tra ho: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: brgya rtsa brgyad dag par brjod la mchod bstod bya'o smon lam ni hrī: tshe dang ye shes bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das sku gsum gsang rdzogs sprul sku pad+ma 'byung: bsnyen cing bsgrub nas gsol ba 'debs lags na: tshe sgrub mthar phyin gsang gsum mngon gyur re ga: lan gsum 'chi bzlog ni hrī:tshe mchog gsang gsum sgrub pa'i byin rlabs kyis: 'phral rkyen nad dang dug gsum 'khrul ba'i gdon rnam rtogs ma rig 'khrul ba'i rkyen snang kun: zhi ba chos nyid spros bral dbyings su bzlog: lan gsum brjod de nas shas brjod na na mo: skye 'chi med pa ye shes grub pa'i zhal: tshe dang yon tan bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das: phung rgud 'jigs

rtagaca tshogs sgrol ba'i thugs rje yis: gzhan phan tshe mtha' yas thob bkra shis regag: de ltar tshe yi nyams len 'di brtson bas bzhes gnyen zhabs brten zhang rnal 'byor tshe sgrub mthar ru phyin don gnyis 'grub pa'i rgyu ru 'gro sa ma yu de nas rnal 'byor bas rgyun gyi nyams len 'cha ba bslu ba'i thabs la brtson par 'dod na skra sen lus rdul snab lud khu ba sogs sbyar nas glud lan chags 'theb skyu sogs byas la kye: ma rig las skyes dug gsum 'khrul ba'i 'dre: a 'thas 'dzan pas tshe srog dbugs len bdud rtag par rgab 'dre dam sri 'chi bdag gdon: 'dod lnga rang grol sku glud 'di longs la: skye med sems la rtog bdud mi slong bar: thams cad sgyu mar rig pas 'phrul mo che: bdag bzung mtshan ma rang grol mngon gyur te mkha' khyab chos sku'i klong la spyod par shog: saṃ bha ra ci 'grub brngo da la glud gtor bsngo sarba bisnan gasno bsngo smon rgyas par bya'o des ni tshe 'phra zhi zhing nad rkyen grol nas tshe sgrub mtha' ru phyin pa'i dgos pa yod do sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya rnal 'byor bas tshogs chen rdzogs phyir rgyun khyer nyams len bsdus pa na sha chang gtso bor gyur bas bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs rnams dum gcig tu bsags te re yi khe: snyen āḥ(: dum gcig

snod dubaza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs: mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa ram̐ yi khaṃ zhi lhag rig pa'i dga' ston oṃ āḥka: ka dang ye shes dpal mdzod bcom ldan 'das: 'chi med grub pa'irdo rje dgyes phyir 'bul: rnal 'byor sdom dam nyams pa gso phyir bskangs: gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rgong rgya dbyings su gtor: ye shes zang thal thig le'i ga'ur bstabs: gnyis snang bag nyal dri ma sna tshogs bshags: lhag gtor rdo rje'i pho nya rgya mtshos bzhes: 'khrul ba ka dag nang dbyings gting gsal sbub: sku gsum lhun grub srid la mnga' brtes regag: skyos badz+ra sa twa hūṃ: de ltar grangs ldan phul bas tshogs gnyis rdzogs shang nyams rtogs mkha' ltar rgyas par 'gyur ro sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya shin tu zab pa' man ngag 'di las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog gu h+ya brda thim lha ces bla ma kun bzang chos 'phel dang / lung zan dharma'i mtshan can gyis bskul ngor/ nusaldan rdo rjesabris pa dge legs 'aze la/ sarba ma le/

rtagaca zab taig rdo rje'iphreng bamibasrung ba'i ra gur 'jigs med pha lam bzhugs so:/lta na ཿ gu ru we ratho44 brtul zhugs grub pa'i rdo rje gshog rgod rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo ma 'ong sa o rgyan pad+ma bdag gi brgyud 'dzin rnams bar chad rkyen gyas bsgyur srid pas 'jigs med rdo rje'i pha lam 'di srog gi gta' ru zungs gnad kyang de dang bral na snyags ma lnga yi dus su srid gsum dam sris 'dzin pa 'i skabs 'byung bas chos tshul gzugs bsnyan tsam 'dzin pa'ang nyin skar las kyang nyung gal te de tsam cha shas byung yang spyang gi rgyab ser mkhan da shan pa cor chu dmar g.yos 'gyed pa las mi 'da' na pad+ma nga yi brgyud 'jin las ldan re mchis na bdud las dben pa'i ri sul snyogs nyin mtshan dus drug tu gsol ba lhang lhang thob yi dam 'di srog gi gta' ru zungs mkha' 'gro chos skyo la ba na pa phul zhing byang chub sgrub pa 'a grogs su gnyer g.yang yang bcol dang po sgrib pa sbyang ba la 'bad de nas tshogs gnyis kyi bre kha gang bar bya khyad par bla ma'i rnal 'byor la nan tan chen pos rtson g.yeng ba le los mi bslu bar ka dag dang lhun grub zab mo'i gsang gnad las 'da' med bya bog 'don du snang ba dbyings la bor rig pa 'od gsal du bsgyur thugs 'phrad gcar phog la

bkrom kud yangs la 'dzan rtsol re dogs kya 'phrang las bsgal bar bya'o thugs sras rig pa 'dzan pa 'a snying la phur gtad rgya sa ma mā 'di la spyo don gsum las dang po ni na 31: 37sa nyid mi 'a kyar sku gsum lhun rdzogs zhal: srid pa phur ba skyabs kyi dam par 'dzin: 'khor la lugs 'byung srid pa'i chos khams kun lugs sdog chos skur bsgral phyir sems bskyed do: lan gsum gnyis pa gzhir bzhengs lha yi bskyed rim ni ā: gzhi rtsa bral ba'i sems kyi rdo rje ni: chos rnams kun gyi sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gsang: skye 'gag spros bral don dam rdo rje che 'pho 'gyur bsgres bral dpal chen ku ma ra gzhan gyis ma bcos ngo bo nyid du gnas: thig le nyag gcig chos sku'i zhal mnga' ba: snang dang stong pa phyag gi da la na thams cad dag chen rdo rje'i mtshon chen bsnams skye ba rnam bzhi zhabs kyis rnam par gnon sdang sems 'dul ba'i khro bo skar ltar 'khrigs: chags rtogs dbyings sbyor khro bo rdul ltar spro:dug lnga ye shes mnyam rol shī la ya: rlung sems dbu mar 'dren pa'i za gsod 'gyed: mu bzhi gnas dag sgo skyongs phrin las sgrub: grol 'khrul sa srung ma mo bcu gnyis

rtagaca dang: skyes bu king bzhis legs nyes stangs 'dzin byed: mdor na stong dbyings 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mkha' khams gsum rol pa rig pa'i rdo rje che:thams cad ma 'gag dpa' bo yab kyi cha: gang yang ma grub btsun mo'i mkha' klong 'khyil: snang tshad gtum rngam khros pa'i gar bsgyur rol grags stong a la ha la'i gad rgyang sgrogs: chos nyid mnyam pa chen po thugs kyi klong bar chad mtshan ma'i gdon gyi glags mi rted: bdud srin bse mo'i tshogs kyang nye mi nus: 'jig rten dregs pa pho mo zil gyis gnon: 'khor ba stobs kyis sbyor sgrol dpal chen po: 'das pa rdo rje'i klong la dgongs mnyam rol byab chub sems kyi phur ba'i 'du 'phro 'khrigs: ( spa ra ṇa phaṭa:hūṃ saṃ ha ra ṇa nyu: chos kun 'byung gnas yi ge yisagacig ma: dbyangs dang gsal byed sgyu 'phrul nub med dpal: ma bcos rig pa rdo rje gzhon nu las: ye shes sras tshogs 'gag med phrin las sgo: gang shar rang grol ting 'dzin g.yo med ngang: bla badz+ra kai li ki la ya hūṃ phaṭa: sems ma bcos par tha mal gyi shes rig zang thal du skyongs de'i tshe thugs 'phrad rjes med

du grol lo snang ba yul bdud kyis mi bsru 'dzin pa nang gi dam dzos mi bskyod a 'thas 'khrul ba'i 'phyang thag chad sku mi g.yo ba rdo rje' sa 'dzan gsung mi 'gag pa chos kyi sgo 'byed thugs mi 'khrul ba bde chen kun tu bzang po'i btsan sa zin par 'gyur ro sam yu don gsum pa lhag chad kha bskang phyir dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying gsum gsum grub phral mchod bstod ni hūṃ hrī chos nyid mi 'gyur ye shes phur ba'i lha:spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag spros pa mi mnga' yang: thabs tshul spyod 'dir shes rab las bskyod gshegs: dmigs bral rdo rje gsang ba'i 'dzab mchod 'bul: 'pho 'gyur mi mnga' dpal chen klong la bstod: gnyisasnang sems kyi dri ma ci mchis bshags: bdud bzhi zil gnon stobs kyi dngos grub stsol: rig stong zung 'jug dgongs pa mngon gyur mdzod: yo ma hāpu dza ho: sarba sirnyi hrī: bsngo smon shas brjod rgya cher byas la mtha' brgyan par bya'o lam bde la tshegs chung ba don chen po grub pa'i gdamasangag zab khyad can 'di lta bu ni shin tu dkon no snying dang 'dra ba' yang zab srog tig dmar nag 'di ma 'ongasalas can thug kya sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu yo rgyan chosakyirgyal po pad+ma he ru gas sgrub gnas ar+ya pa lo la sogasanas bdag 'brog ma lotsā la gces jor du gnang ba'o

rtag du snyigs ma' sems can la shin du brtse ba'i sems kyisarin chen 'phrul brdar bkod de mdo khamasaphyogasasu dgongasapra btab po maṇ+ḍal gu rgya rgya sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya brda thim snyi bka' dran mtshungs med o rgyan 1 4 ka

zab tig rdo rje'i phreng ba'i srung ba ra gur zab mo dang 'brel ba'i tshogs bsags bzhugs so:rtag na tho gu ru ge za 1(1 na/na ma 'ongasa.o rgyan pad+ma'i rgyud 'dzin rnams gyi tshe dpa la bskyed pa da chags nyams sbyang ba rtog sgrib sa sa ba las nyon dag pa nyams rtogs 'phel ba yon tan rgyas pa sogs kyi thabs la nye lam sngagasakyi tshogs chen bsags pa la 'bad dgos so de yang ma da na dang ma sa gtso bor gyur bas bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib kya rags rnams bsags la gtsang sme gnyis rtogs gis mi bslad par ro mnyam chen po' dgongs pa dang ldan pas gang shar rang grol rag pa ye shes kya gzi byin dbab ste hā dur khrod gsang ba mchog ga dkyil 'khor du sna tshogs ro mnyam chen ngo 'a dus ston ni ma hā me sa tsat+ta rdzas ltar bsnyel zhun me rkang mar bltams pa nyi ltar 'khyugs sbyar spos tshal chen dud pa spran ltar gtibs rak+ta mkhris pa dza gad mtsho ltar bskyil don lnga snod drug dbang lnga' phung po ba da: ri klong sgog pa shā ma rtsi shing bcud zas sna sman sna dang rus khrol bur sbungs khan chos rje yi: smon lam gtad rgya dus tshigs 'dzom pa las: kho bo 'brog ban sprul pa nus ldan pas mdo khams dregs gtso klu btsan dbang mo

yi/ gsang ba'i gar dang rdo rje'i brda don las/ rnam par bkrol ba chos bdag gsum pa spel/ sa man bha tra dharma'i mtshan can dang / las smon mthu btsanagu h+ya zhes su grags/zab gter yongs 'dzin dharma ku mud ta/ rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags pa de gsum la/ 'di phyi'i phan bde gegs med 'byung phyir phul/ dad ldan las kyis bskul ba 'brug sgra yis/ dar bcas nan tan gyis bskul ba don ldan phyir/ dpa' bo bdud 'dul rdo rjes spel ba dge/ sarba maṅga le/rtagaca dug lnga dug gsum rnam rtog gcod byed pa'i rmad byung tshogs kyi 'khor lo lhun gyis grub ashā: / hrī: mi gnas yeshes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni:nam mkha'i mtha' da mnyam pa'i slong yangs nas: rig stong mi shig rdo rje gzhon nu'i gar: snang ba yab la stong pa yum gyi tshul: ye shes sras lnga phrin las khro tshogs 'gyed:mu bzhi gnas dag sgo skyongs chen po sogs: thal 'byin mngon sprod drag po'i lha tshogs rnams: spyon 'dren gshegs bzhugs mtshan ma mi dmigs kyang: spror sgol ting 'dzin

rtag— tshogs ston dpal la byon:sa ma yā dza hūṃ trī:chos can chos nyid rol ba'i tshogs ston 'bul:bde stong spros mtha' bral bar bzhes su gsol:mtha' bral 1nga yangs kun bzang chos kyi dbyings 'bul bzhes gnyis med ka dag dgongs pas bskangs sems kyi nongs pa gzung 'dzin gnyis sgrib kun: mi gnas dbu ma 'od gsal chen por bshags:nga bdag mtshan mar blta ba'i rū tra kun bdag med shes rab phur bas 'big cing 'dren:phung po dbang yul shar ba'i rol ston 'di:srid pa rdo rje phur ba'i dgongs klong bstabs dbang dang ye shes dngos grub 1nga nas stsol oṃ ā tswa ha ti stobs:( hrī bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs rnams kyang :ting 'dzin sgyu 'phrul dga' ston dgyes rol nas:gnyis med don la gnyis bzung rmongs ba'i 'gro: thabs kyi 'dren pa'i skal ba chung na'ang:shugs kyis bsgral ba'i phrin las la drangs nas:'og min bde ba chen por byang chub mdzod:de ma thob pas snang grags rigs gsum 'dir lha mchog thugs kyi thig le dang 'grogs shing:rtogs pas bdag bsgral

thugs rjes gzhan bsgral nas thams cad 'od skur grol ba'i phrin las mdzod: rnam kun mchog ldan rig pa'i rdo rje che: bde stong klong rgyas 'debs ma'i lto bar rol:gnyis med dgongs pa gzhon nu bum sku'i klong: kun bzang he ru ka dpal myur 'grub shog: snyen āḥshā: kun rdzob don dam bya brtsal blo 'das dge thams cad 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por bsngo: tha snyad spros bral gnas lugs rdzogs pa cher: dbyer med thugs kyi dgongs klong byang chub shog: āḥshā: 'dus ma byas pa 'dzin rtsol rtogs pa'i sgrib sor byang sngags kyi tha snyad phyogs ris shar 'khrul zhing bzos pa'i dri ma gang mchis pa: mi gnas ka dag dgongs par bshags bgyi'o: snyed āX shā snang cha ma 'gags sgyu ma'i dga' ston kun: chos dbyings spros bral klob la mnyam par bzhag: dran bsam snang ba ma 'gag sa le ba: gang shar rang grol rig pas rjes thob skyongs:31 āX (: gzhi rgyud rtogs pas rang rig tshad la pheb: lam rgyud rtogs pas gzhan snang smin zhing grol 'bras rgyud rtogs pas 'khor ba chos skur sangs: thams cad mnyam
